jobs.title: Backend Engineer — High-Volume Data Processing
jobs.description: **Location:** Dumbo, Brooklyn, NY **Work Arrangement:** Onsite, 5 days per week (required) **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Base Salary:** $220,000–$300,000 **Equity:** Competitive equity package **Visa:** Open to OPT and H\-1B transfers; additional sponsorship may be considered **Relocation:** Up to $10,000 in relocation assistance **About the Opportunity** A rapidly growing AI and data company is building the data infrastructure that powers next\-generation AI models. The company works with proprietary enterprise data, transforming information generated through real\-world business operations into de\-identified datasets for leading AI research organizations. Having grown from $0 to a multi\-eight\-figure annualized run rate within months, the business is scaling rapidly with a lean engineering team of approximately five people. This is an opportunity to join at an early stage, take meaningful ownership of mission\-critical systems, and directly influence the architecture and reliability of a high\-impact data\-processing platform. The team is seeking a **Backend Engineer** to build and evolve the systems that transform sensitive enterprise information into high\-quality, AI\-training\-ready datasets. **The core focus is on the processing logic applied to the data itself**, rather than traditional data engineering, ETL, or infrastructure work centered primarily on moving data between systems. **What You\#39;ll Do** * Design, build, and scale multi\-stage, high\-volume data\-processing pipelines that de\-identify sensitive enterprise data from collaboration tools, email, cloud storage, code repositories, and project\-management systems. * Own backend systems end\-to\-end, from architecture and implementation through debugging, correctness validation, production monitoring, and recovery. * Develop safeguards to detect silent failures, duplicate outputs, stale data, and other data\-quality issues before customer delivery. * Build reliable mechanisms for retries, checkpoints, partial failures, replay, backfills, and rollbacks across asynchronous workflows, batch workers, queues, and object storage. * Develop internal tools and dashboards to monitor pipeline performance, investigate data quality, and inform release decisions. * Partner with ML, full\-stack, platform, and security engineers to support new data modalities and expand processing capabilities. * Improve the reliability, observability, and scalability of systems handling complex and sensitive datasets. **What We\#39;re Looking For** **Required Qualifications** * **3–10 years of software engineering experience**, with direct ownership of production backend systems. * Demonstrated experience shipping and operating production software, ideally involving multi\-stage, high\-volume data\-processing pipelines. * **Relevant undergraduate STEM degree from a top\-30 U.S. institution.** * Strong understanding of distributed and asynchronous backend systems, including: * + Queues, workers, and concurrency + Idempotency and retry strategies + Partial failures and fault tolerance + Recovery, replay, and data consistency * Meaningful full\-time experience at an early\-stage or high\-growth startup, with demonstrated ownership, adaptability, and comfort operating in ambiguous environments. * Strong proficiency in a general\-purpose backend programming language. * Ability and willingness to work onsite five days per week in Dumbo, Brooklyn, NY. **Important:** The undergraduate education requirement and five\-day onsite requirement are firm. Candidates who do not meet both criteria will not be considered. **Technical Environment** The current technology stack includes: **Python, AWS, Airflow, AWS Batch, SQS, S3, DynamoDB, and PostgreSQL** Python experience is not mandatory. Strong backend engineers with experience in **Go, Rust, Java, or other general\-purpose languages** are encouraged to apply. Particularly relevant technical experience includes: * AWS and cloud\-based backend systems * Batch processing and workflow orchestration * Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Named Entity Recognition (NER) * Distributed systems and asynchronous processing * Data quality, correctness, and production reliability * Internal tooling, monitoring, and observability The team values engineers who think beyond implementation. Ideal candidates enjoy understanding how data\-processing systems behave, building tools to investigate performance and quality, diagnosing complex failures, and solving problems across the entire workflow. A backend\-focused engineer with some full\-stack experience can also be a strong fit. **Experience That Stands Out** Candidates may be particularly well suited to this role if they bring: * Experience at a highly regarded engineering organization combined with meaningful startup experience. * A clear record of career progression and increasing technical ownership. * Hands\-on AWS experience. * Experience building or operating batch\-processing pipelines and workflow orchestration systems. * Experience developing internal tools, dashboards, or observability systems for data\-processing workflows. * A strong understanding of production failure modes, data correctness, recovery strategies, and system reliability. * The ability to take a broad, ambiguous problem and deliver a reliable end\-to\-end solution. **Who May Not Be a Fit** This position is less suited to candidates whose experience is primarily focused on: * Traditional data engineering, data platforms, or infrastructure work centered on moving data between systems. * ETL development using tools such as Databricks, without substantial ownership of the underlying processing logic. * Frontend\-heavy full\-stack development without significant backend engineering depth. * Large\-company engineering environments without meaningful early\-stage or high\-growth startup experience, unless the candidate\#39;s technical background is directly relevant. * Startup exposure limited mainly to internships or short\-term engagements. **Team amp; Culture** You\#39;ll join a small, high\-performing engineering team operating in a fast\-moving environment with significant customer demand and substantial room to influence the product and technical direction. The team emphasizes: * **First\-principles problem\-solving:** Understand the underlying challenge and build the right solution. * **Ownership and accountability:** Take responsibility for systems and outcomes from start to finish. * **Bias toward action:** Move quickly, experiment, and learn through execution. * **Engineering excellence:** Deliver reliable, high\-quality work that meets a high technical bar. * **Humility and collaboration:** Support teammates, share knowledge, and work together toward common goals. * **Outcome\-driven execution:** Prioritize meaningful results over activity or output alone. With a very small engineering team, this role offers significant responsibility, close collaboration, and the opportunity to help shape critical systems as the business scales. **Compensation amp; Benefits** * **Base Salary:** $220,000–$300,000 * **Equity:** Competitive equity package * **Medical, Dental amp; Vision:** 100% covered * **Paid Time Off:** Unlimited PTO * **Relocation Assistance:** Up to $10,000 **Visa amp; Relocation Support** The company is open to visa transfers, including **OPT and H\-1B transfers**. Additional visa sponsorship may be considered for exceptional candidates, depending on individual circumstances. Sponsorship is not guaranteed and will be evaluated on a case\-by\-case basis. Candidates relocating to New York may be eligible for up to $10,000 in relocation assistance. **Interview Process** The following stages begin after a candidate has been submitted to the hiring team. Agency screening and the initial resume review are not counted as interview stages. **Stage 1 — Introductory Call (30 minutes)** A conversation with the hiring manager covering your background, motivations, experience, and alignment with the role. **Stage 2 — System Design (1 hour)** A distributed\-systems and data\-processing exercise focused on architecture, technical tradeoffs, scalability, and correctness in high\-volume backend pipelines. **Stage 3 — Take\-Home Technical Assessment (A few hours)** An independent, practical backend coding exercise evaluating engineering fundamentals and hands\-on problem\-solving. The engineering team will review the completed submission. **Stage 4 — Final Onsite Interviews (2 hours)** An onsite session at the Dumbo, Brooklyn office with engineering and leadership. The final round evaluates technical depth, problem\-solving, and team fit while giving candidates an opportunity to meet the team and learn more about the business. **Travel Support:** Candidates who are not currently based in New York will be flown in and provided with accommodation for the final onsite interview.

jobs.title: MID Level AI Engineer
jobs.description: **The role** Cogniify is hiring a hands\-on engineer to build secure identity and loyalty integrations for AI\-assisted commerce. You will connect AI agents, merchant applications and digital identity wallets so customers can access verified membership benefits while protecting their personal information. This role focuses on backend development, identity protocols and verifiable credentials, with Python, MCP and AI\-agent runtime integration. You will build working integrations, test fraud scenarios and create reference implementations that merchants can adopt. **What you will do** * Build UCP integrations that carry verified loyalty information from platform agents to merchants. * Use Python to integrate agent runtimes with identity and loyalty APIs, handling asynchronous calls, structured results, timeouts and failures. * Build or integrate MCP tools that let AI agents access verified loyalty functions. Enforce identity and authorization checks server\-side before merchant actions are executed. * Develop a sample merchant that verifies trust signals, checks loyalty eligibility through backend APIs, applies member pricing and stock reservations, and records pending loyalty earnings. * Implement OAuth Authorization Code with PKCE for customer account linking before loyalty points are redeemed or transferred. * Design an HTTP trust\-header contract and build a Cloudflare Worker verifier with JWKS caching, spoofed\-header removal and rate limiting. * Build Node.js/TypeScript middleware that exposes verified loyalty context to merchant application handlers. * Create a verifiable credential proof of concept covering issuance to a wallet, selective disclosure, presentation and merchant verification. * Test replay across merchants, token reuse, enumeration, account takeover and stock reservation abuse. Verify that personal information does not reach the AI agent. * Write merchant integration guides, build reference clients and servers, and demonstrate the complete flow through a sample storefront. **Required experience and skills** * 5\+ years of hands\-on TypeScript/Node.js development, with experience building backend APIs and integrations. Familiarity with Node 22 and Next.js or a similar framework. * Hands\-on Python backend integration experience, including asyncio, typed code and automated testing. * Experience integrating AI\-agent runtimes or tool\-using LLM applications with external APIs, including MCP server or client integration and structured tool results. * Strong HTTP fundamentals and the ability to build servers and reference clients that follow protocol specifications. * Production implementation of OAuth 2\.0 Authorization Code with PKCE, OpenID Connect and JWT/JWS token verification. * Experience with ES256 or EdDSA signatures, JWKS key rotation, audience validation, token expiry and replay protection using token identifiers. * Hands\-on verifiable credential experience, including W3C VC 2\.0, OID4VCI, OID4VP and SD\-JWT VC. * Familiarity with did:web, did:key and at least one identity wallet SDK, such as Credo or an equivalent. * Cloudflare Workers or equivalent edge development, including KV or Durable Objects, header verification and rate limiting. * Ability to interpret MCP, UCP, OpenID and relevant RFC specifications, including RFC 9421 and RFC 8693, and implement independently against acceptance criteria. **Good to have** * BBS\+ or zero\-knowledge proof tooling. * Google UCP or Merchant Center integrations. * Loyalty programmes, promotions systems, e\-commerce fraud prevention or bot management. * Experience with Claude or comparable LLM APIs and agent SDKs. **What you will deliver in the first 90 days** A UCP loyalty signal and platform\-agent reference implementation with Python and MCP integration; a sample merchant with loyalty tiers; an HTTP header contract, edge verifier and middleware SDK; a credential issuer, wallet and verifier proof of concept; a fraud test suite; integration guides; and a working storefront demonstration. jobs.title: ML/AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Bridge Neurotech** -------------------------- Bridge Neurotech is building a non\-invasive functional ultrasound imaging (fUSI) platform with AI\-based neural decoding for brain\-computer interface applications. We are a seed\-stage neurotechnology company developing technology that has the potential to transform how we interact with the human brain. **About the role** ------------------ We are looking for an ML/AI Engineer to own and scale key parts of the models and infrastructure behind our neural decoding pipeline, from raw functional ultrasound acquisition through image reconstruction, preprocessing, and decoding. This role sits at the frontier of two rapidly converging fields: neural decoding and foundation models. Recent work has shown that brain activity can be mapped into the latent spaces of pretrained deep learning models to reconstruct visual perception and continuous language with remarkable fidelity. This has been demonstrated with fMRI, in research settings. Your job is to bring these techniques to functional ultrasound: a modality with superior spatial and temporal resolution, portability, and a path to consumer deployment. This is a hands\-on role with an unusual amount of surface area. You will scope and lead projects from open question to result with a high degree of independence, and help set the technical direction of our decoding work. You will report to our ML/AI Engineering Lead. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Design, implement, train, and evaluate models across the pipeline: fUSI reconstruction, signal preprocessing, and downstream decoding, and own the results for the components you lead. * Drive the experimental agenda for your area: form and test hypotheses about why a model is not learning, design ablations, and tune architectures, losses, and training schedules, then turn what you find into decisions the team can act on. * Extend models to new data regimes, for example new dimensionalities (2D to 3D volumetric), new probes, and new subjects, and build the preprocessing pipelines needed to normalize that data for training. * Own the training infrastructure: experiment tracking, config management, checkpointing, mixed\-precision and multi\-GPU training, and profiling, built well enough for the rest of the team to rely on. * Define the evaluation strategy: metrics, pre\-launch tests, and regression checks that tell us when a model is actually better. * Debug numerical and performance problems, for example NaNs under mixed precision, silent shape bugs, page\-cache thrashing, dead gradients, and GPU memory ceilings. * Build inference paths for full\-volume reconstruction and low\-latency real\-time decoding. * Work directly with our imaging scientists and neuroscientists to understand where the data comes from and what its artifacts mean, and help shape how future data is collected. * Track the relevant literature in neural operators, neuroimaging, and neural decoding, reproduce the results that matter to our roadmap, and propose where we should go next. * Review code and designs, and help onboard new engineers and interns as the team grows. **Who you are** --------------- **Required** * A PhD in machine learning, computer science, electrical engineering, computational neuroscience, physics, or a related field; or a bachelor’s or master’s degree in one of those fields plus 2 to 3 years of experience building and shipping machine learning systems in a research or product setting. * Strong Python and hands\-on PyTorch development (or an equivalent framework such as JAX or TensorFlow). * A track record of independently taking a model from a paper or a prototype to something that trains reliably on real data. * Evidence of owning an open\-ended technical problem end to end, such as a thesis, publications, open\-source work, or a shipped system. * Comfort with large numerical datasets, for example hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes, and memory\-mapped arrays. * Solid grounding in first principles, for example linear algebra and signal processing. * GPU proficiency: mixed precision, memory profiling, gradient checkpointing, and the ability to diagnose bottlenecks. * Strong software engineering practices: version control, testing, code review, and coding conventions. * Self\-directed and self\-motivated, with the ability to execute on a goal rather than a step\-by\-step guide. **Nice to have** * Experience with neural operators (FNO), implicit neural representations, or physics\-informed machine learning architectures. * Exposure to neural decoding, brain\-computer interfaces, or neuroimaging data. * Familiarity with complex\-valued neural networks or spectral methods. * Experience developing real\-time or low\-latency inference systems. * Distributed or multi\-GPU training at scale. * Publications at machine learning or neuroscience venues, or contributions to open\-source machine learning tooling. * Prior work in a startup or small team, or other evidence of thriving without much scaffolding. **What we offer** ----------------- * Real ownership of core technical infrastructure at a seed\-stage company, with a direct path to growing into a senior or lead role as the team scales. * Mentorship from our ML/AI Engineering Lead, and direct collaboration with leading clinicians and neuroscientists at top\-tier academic institutions. * Work on a modality early enough that the tooling does not exist yet. Much of what you build will be the first of its kind. * Excellent medical benefits and a 6% match 401(k). Bridge Neurotech is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Backend/Platform
jobs.description: **About APADCode** ------------------ APADCode is an early\-stage AI startup building the infrastructure for a more meaningful way to evaluate software engineers. Our platform conducts live, adaptive technical interviews and captures how candidates approach problems, reason about trade\-offs, write code, and respond to challenges. Behind the product is a two\-engine architecture combining real\-time AI interview orchestration with structured reasoning analysis. We've moved beyond prototypes into real hiring workflows. Now we're looking for engineers who want to help build the systems that will take us further. **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a Member of Technical Staff to help own the architecture and evolution of APADCode's core backend platform. At the heart of our product is a stateful AI interviewer that needs to manage multi\-stage technical conversations, coordinate live coding interactions, make context\-aware decisions, and preserve a complete record of what happened. You'll work on the engineering challenges behind making that experience reliable, responsive, secure, and scalable, while building the data infrastructure that powers our AI evaluation engine. This is a hands\-on role with significant architectural ownership and direct collaboration with the founding team. **What You'll Work On** ----------------------- * **Real\-time interview orchestration:** Design and evolve the stateful runtime powering our Interview Control Engine, including interview stages, transitions, time budgets, and session lifecycle management. * **AI agent coordination:** Build the orchestration layer connecting live conversation, lightweight reasoning classifiers, adaptive follow\-up decisions, and coding permissions. Handle model latency, failures, retries, and inconsistent outputs gracefully. * **Event\-driven architecture:** Develop reliable event capture for candidate responses, interviewer actions, stage transitions, code revisions, and execution results. Preserve event ordering and data integrity for downstream evaluation. * **Coding execution infrastructure:** Improve the backend supporting our interactive coding environment, including execution isolation, resource limits, timeouts, and secure handling of untrusted code. * **Asynchronous processing:** Design pipelines that move raw interview events into the Cognitive Intelligence Engine for normalization, feature extraction, and evaluation. * **Reliability and observability:** Build instrumentation around session failures, agent latency, execution errors, processing delays, and infrastructure costs. Improve recovery behavior and production visibility. * **Platform foundations:** Shape service boundaries, database architecture, APIs, deployment workflows, multi\-tenant isolation, and security practices as the platform grows. **What We Look For** -------------------- * Strong experience designing, building, and operating SaaS production backend systems. * Deep understanding of concurrency, asynchronous workflows, state management, distributed systems, and failure recovery. * Proficiency in a backend language such as Python, Go, or TypeScript. * Experience with relational databases, caching, queues, and event\-driven architectures. * Practical experience with cloud infrastructure, containerization, CI/CD, and production observability. * Ability to make sound engineering trade\-offs around latency, consistency, reliability, complexity, and cost. * Comfortable taking ambiguous technical problems from architecture through implementation and production operation. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with LLM agents, tool calling, or workflow orchestration (not in demo, but in production system of Enterprise). * Experience building WebSocket\-based or other low\-latency interactive applications. * Familiarity with sandboxed code execution, container isolation, or resource\-constrained workloads. * Experience with technologies such as PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, Kubernetes, or comparable systems. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive compensation and meaningful early\-stage equity opportunities. * Significant architectural ownership and influence over technical direction. * Direct collaboration with the founders and a small engineering team. * Flexible working arrangements, paid time off, and health benefits based on location. * Equipment and professional development support. * The opportunity to build foundational AI infrastructure for hiring v3\.0 We're looking for engineers who enjoy owning complex systems, making thoughtful technical decisions, and shipping software that holds up in production. Compensation Range: $160K \- $210K

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Enterprise Engineering I [Bay Area]

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Backend & AI Infra

jobs.title: Robot Operations Technician (Hospital)
jobs.description: Robot Operations Technician (Hospital) Rovex Technologies Corporation Location: On\-site at Morton Plant Hospital, Clearwater, Florida; assignments may also include other BayCare locations Employment types: Full\-time, part\-time, and PRN (as\-needed) opportunities available Base pay: 22–25 per hour, depending on relevant experience Night differential: An additional $2\.50 per hour for eligible night\-shift hours Weekend differential: An additional $1\.50 per hour for eligible weekend hours Holiday pay: 1\.5 times the base hourly rate for hours worked on designated holidays Schedule: Assigned shifts may include days, overnights, weekends, and holidays. Shifts will be eight hours, with fixed rotations posted well in advance for regularly scheduled positions. About the Role We’re hiring a robot operator to join Rovex as a Robot Operations Technician supporting our hospital deployment in Clearwater, Florida. Rovex builds robotic systems that help hospitals move equipment and resources throughout their facilities. In this role, you’ll walk alongside Rovi, our mobile robotic platform, and use a remote controller to control every aspect of its movement as it travels through hospital hallways, doorways, and elevators. During this phase of deployment, Rovi moves only in response to correct operator input. You will be responsible for controlling its direction, speed, starting, stopping, turning, positioning, and movement around people and equipment. This is an active, hands\-on driving role that requires strong spatial awareness, precise control, sound judgment, and sustained attention. Your work will include remotely guiding Rovi as it returns empty stretchers to the emergency department, moves linen carts between designated locations, and follows routes for hospital mapping and evaluation. We’re looking for someone with good driving and maneuvering skills who learns technology quickly, follows procedures carefully, and stays attentive while performing repeated tasks. An engineering degree and previous professional robotics experience are not required. Rovex will provide training. The current role involves transporting equipment and materials only. It does not involve transporting patients or providing clinical care. What You’ll Do Remotely Drive and Control Rovi* Use a remote controller to control every aspect of Rovi’s movement throughout assigned hospital areas. * Control starting, stopping, speed, direction, turns, and positioning using approved operating procedures. * Walk alongside Rovi and maintain direct awareness of the robot, its load, and the surrounding environment. * Navigate hallways, doorways, turns, elevators, and other constrained spaces. * Maintain awareness of staff, patients, visitors, and surrounding equipment. * Stop, wait, or reposition Rovi whenever a route or operating condition is unclear. * Follow assigned routes, operating limits, and safety checklists. Complete Equipment and Linen Transport Tasks* Attach and detach Rovi from compatible empty stretchers and linen carts using approved procedures. * Check that attachments are secure before beginning a transport. * Return empty stretchers from designated hospital areas to the emergency department or other assigned locations. * Deliver filled linen carts and retrieve or exchange empty carts as directed. * Confirm that equipment reaches the correct destination and coordinate handoffs with designated hospital staff. Support Mapping and Deployment Evaluation* Remotely operate Rovi along assigned routes to support hospital mapping and route validation. * Repeat tasks consistently to help evaluate performance under different hospital conditions. * Record completed tasks, operating time, delays, interventions, and unexpected behavior. * Provide practical feedback about routes, workflows, controls, and equipment handling. Keep the Robot Ready and Report Issues* Complete pre\-shift checks and assist with charging, staging, and approved cleaning procedures. * Perform basic troubleshooting within the scope of your training. * Document problems clearly and promptly report them to the Rovex integrations engineer. * Include useful details such as the location, task, control input, observed behavior, and sequence of events. * Provide clear shift handoffs, including equipment status and unresolved issues. Work Professionally in the Hospital* Coordinate pickups, deliveries, and equipment handoffs with designated staff. * Communicate courteously and minimize disruption to hospital operations. * Follow hospital access, privacy, infection prevention, and safety procedures. * Protect confidential Rovex and hospital information, including technical details, deployment results, and any patient information encountered during work. **Requirements** What We’re Looking For * Strong driving, maneuvering, and spatial\-awareness skills, including the ability to judge distance, clearance, speed, and turning space. * Ability to operate a remote controller smoothly and pre and issue reports. * Ability to work independently after training, with a Rovex integrations engineer available on\-site or remotely. * Availability for the shifts associated with the position, which may include overnights, weekends, and holidays. * Ability to attend initial paid training in Gainesville, Florida. * Ability to complete applicable hospital onboarding and access requirements, including a background check and drug screening. Physical Requirements and Work Environment This role takes place in an active hospital and involves substantial walking and periods of standing throughout assigned shifts. Most physical activity consists of walking alongside Rovi while operating it with a remote controller, with occasional bending, reaching, and positioning equipment during attachment and transport tasks. Candidates must be able to perform these essential duties with or without reasonable accommodation. Rovex provides training on safe equipment handling and operating procedures. Helpful but Not Required * Experience in hospital transport, hospital logistics, warehouse operations, technical support, or equipment operations. * Experience with robotics, drones, remotely operated equipment, electronics, or product testing. * Experience driving, maneuvering, or precisely positioning vehicles or equipment. * Experience recording task results or reporting technical problems. Previous professional robotics experience is not required. Training and Support Initial training takes place in Gainesville, Florida. Training is paid, and Rovex covers required training travel and lodging. You’ll receive supervised instruction in remote robot operation, equipment attachments, safety procedures, task documentation, and issue reporting before operating independently. After training, you’ll complete assigned tasks with support from a Rovex integrations engineer who may be on\-site or available remotely. Assignments may also include other BayCare locations, with location and travel expectations communicated in advance. Schedule Details Full\-time, part\-time, and PRN (as\-needed) opportunities are available. * Shifts will not exceed eight hours. * Assigned shifts may include days, overnights, weekends, and holidays. * Fixed rotations will be posted well in advance for regularly scheduled positions. * PRN shifts will be arranged based on operational needs and agreed availability. Shift assignments and the applicable differential and holiday\-pay rules will be provided before accepting an offer. Employer\-sponsored health insurance is not currently offered. Why This Role Matters Every completed transport helps Rovex understand how Rovi performs in an active hospital. Your precise operation, reliable attendance, and clear feedback will help improve the system’s reliability and usefulness for hospital teams. Growth Opportunities This role offers a path for growth as Rovex expands its hospital operations. Technicians who demonstrate reliable performance, strong operating skills, sound judgment, and clear communication may have opportunities to advance into a Lead Operator role. Lead Operators may help train new technicians, coordinate shifts, promote consistent operating practices, and support communication between operators and the engineering team. How to Apply Submit your résumé and indicate whether you’re interested in full\-time, part\-time, or PRN work. Please include your availability for day, overnight, weekend, and holiday shifts. **Benefits** **Base pay: 22–25 per hour, depending on relevant experience** **Night differential: An additional $2\.50 per hour for eligible night\-shift hours** **Weekend differential: An additional $1\.50 per hour for eligible weekend hours** **Holiday pay: 1\.5 times the base hourly rate for hours worked on designated holidays** **Schedule: Assigned shifts may include days, overnights, weekends, and holidays. Shifts will be eight hours, with fixed rotations posted well in advance for regularly scheduled positions.**

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** We have an exciting opportunity for a **Robotics Software Engineer** at UL Research Institutes , based in our Skokie, IL office. The **Robotics Software Engineer** will design and maintain the software infrastructure that connects laboratory automation, robotics, scientific instruments, data systems, and decision tools into integrated autonomous workflows. The role will work closely with scientists, automation engineers, robotics engineers, and data scientists to build scalable, reliable software for experimental orchestration and closed\-loop research. **UL Research Institutes:** At UL Research Institutes (ULRI) , we expand the boundaries of safety science to create a more secure and sustainable world. For more than a century, we have studied the unintended consequences of innovation, designed solutions to mitigate risk and shared our findings with academia, scientists, manufacturers, and policymakers across industries. We identify critical safety and sustainability issues, asking the tough questions because we believe a safer world begins with knowledge. Build a safer, more secure, and sustainable future with us. Join us and work with our Materials Discovery Research Institute teams who conduct the research required to produce that knowledge and put into practice. **Materials Discovery Research Institute:** The Materials Discovery Research Institute (MDRI) works to develop and deploy new materials with the potential to address current global safety challenges. Pursuing materials that will help produce transformational safety breakthroughs, MDRI harnesses the power of advanced computing and high\-throughput experimental methods to create innovative materials that will produce resilience for a sustainable future and protect individual and societal health. We focus on today’s critical challenges, working to create new and better materials that will support renewable energy and environmental sustainability. Among our top priorities is research into materials capable of carbon capture and energy storage, with an eye toward reducing the adverse impacts of humanity’s reliance upon fossil fuel resources and enabling a transition to renewable energy sources. Above all, our research builds on our commitment to a safer, more sustainable future. **What you’ll learn and achieve:** **As the Robotics Software Engineer, you will play a key role in the rapid growth of UL** **as you:** * Develop and maintain software integrations for laboratory instruments, robotics, and automation platforms. * Design and implement scalable APIs and reusable interfaces for communication across heterogeneous systems. * Build workflow orchestration for multi\-step experimental processes across synthesis, sample handling, characterization, and analysis. * Develop and maintain sample tracking, metadata, and lineage capabilities to support experimental traceability. * Implement scheduling, system\-state management, error handling, and recovery capabilities to support reliable unattended operation. * Integrate systems using APIs, OPC\-UA, Ethernet/IP, Modbus TCP, serial communication, and related protocols. * Collaborate with Data Science team to support integration with scientific databases, data platforms, ML models, and decision tools. * Develop monitoring, logging, dashboards, and diagnostic tools in conjunction with Data Science team. * Apply modern software engineering practices including Git, testing, CI/CD, documentation, and containerization. * Troubleshoot and resolve software issues, implementing proactive solutions to enhance system stability. * Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to translate laboratory needs into scalable software solutions. Perform other duties as assigned. * **What you’ll experience working at UL Research Institutes:** We have pursued our mission of working for a safer, more secure, and sustainable world for nearly 130 years, embedding conscientious stewardship into everything we do. * **People** : Our people make us special. You’ll work with a diverse team of experts respected for their independence and transparency and build a network, because our approach is collaborative. We collaborate across disciplines, organizations, and geographies to build the global scientific response that today’s global challenges require. * **Interesting work** : Every day is different for us here. We see what’s on the horizon and use our expertise to build the foundations of a safer future. You’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of human understanding as part of a team working to advance the public good. * **Grow and achieve** : We learn, work, and grow together through targeted development, reward, and recognition programs. * **Values** . Four core values guide our work: collaboration, respect, integrity, and beneficence. By living our values, we inspire the trust essential to fulfilling our mission and foster the partnerships that enable us to pursue a beneficent future in which we all can thrive. * **Total Rewards** : All employees at UL Research Institutes are eligible for bonus compensation. We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans and a generous 401k matching structure of up to 5% of eligible pay. Moreover, we invest an additional 4% into your retirement saving fund after your first year of continuous employment. Depending on your role, you may be able to discuss flexible working arrangements with your manager. We also provide employees with paid time off, including vacation, holiday, sick, and volunteer days. **What makes you a great fit:** **While no one candidate will embody every quality, the successful candidate will bring many of the following professional competencies and personal attributes:** * Demonstrated proficiency in Python and experience developing production\-quality software. * Experience with an additional programming language or development framework such as C\#, .NET, Java, Go, or TypeScript is preferred. * Experience designing APIs, distributed systems, microservices, or event\-driven architectures. * Experience integrating software with hardware, robotics, instrumentation, or automation systems. * Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases and data integration. * Knowledge of workflow orchestration, scheduling, state machines, and asynchronous systems. * Experience with Git, automated testing, Docker, CI/CD, and software documentation. * Strong troubleshooting, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills. Experience with scientific laboratories, robotics, controls, or autonomous systems is highly desirable. * **Professional education and experience requirements for the role include:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, robotics, controls, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. * Minimum 4 years of professional software development experience. * Experience building scalable software systems beyond standalone scripts. * Experience integrating laboratory instruments, robotics, automation, or other cyber\-physical systems is strongly preferred. Experience working in a scientific research, laboratory, manufacturing, or research and development environment is preferred. * **About UL Research Institutes and UL Standards \& Engagement** UL Research Institutes and UL Standards \& Engagement are nonprofit organizations dedicated to advancing safety science research through the discovery and application of scientific knowledge. We conduct rigorous independent research and analyze safety data, convene experts worldwide to address risks, share knowledge through safety education and public outreach initiatives, and develop standards to guide safe commercialization of evolving technologies. We foster communities of safety, from grassroots initiatives for neighborhoods to summits of world leaders. Our organization employs collaborative and scientific approaches with partners and stakeholders to drive innovation and progress toward improving safety, security, and sustainability, ultimately enhancing societal well\-being. To learn more, visit our websites UL.org and ULSE.org . **Salary Range:** $89,602\.01\-$123,202\.76 **Pay Type:** Salary

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Credit
jobs.description: Alt is unlocking the value of alternative assets, starting with the $5 B trading\-card market. We let collectors buy, sell, vault, and finance their cards in one place and we are backed by leaders at Stripe, Coinbase, Seven Seven Six, and pro athletes like Tom Brady and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Our next frontier is real\-time pricing at scale—the Alt Value that powers every trade, loan, and product on the platform. ### **THE ROLE** A collector borrows against a card sitting in our vault. We size the advance off its Alt Value, underwrite it, disburse the money, and manage the loan until the last dollar comes back or the collateral is released. Today too much of that path runs on people: manual approvals, hand\-checked disbursements, a triage queue that grows when a transfer goes sideways, and screens that don't always tell the borrower where their money is. Your job is to turn that into a product. You'll implement our new underwriting design hand in hand with our data scientists, automate the loan workflow end to end, own disbursement failures until they stop happening, and ship the borrower and operator experiences on top, built from our designs. This is a full\-stack seat: the same engineer who fixes the idempotency bug builds the screen that tells the borrower their funds are on the way. The north star: T7 (trailing 7\-day) Disbursement within SLA rate, with a target of 99%. Every underwriting change, automation, triage fix, and screen you ship either moves that number or protects it. Supporting KPIs: time from application to underwriting decision, share of loans that go from application to funded with no manual touch, disbursement exceptions per week, and support tickets asking "where is my money," driven toward zero. In lending, a disbursement that "probably went out" is a failure. The people who are great at this have owned a lending or payments product where it mattered, from the state machine to the pixels. They think in idempotency and reconciliation because they've been on the wrong side of both, and they care that the UI tells the truth about what the system is doing. ### **WHAT YOU'LL OWN** * **The underwriting revamp.** We're redesigning how we underwrite cash advances and term loans, and you'll implement the new design end to end, working hand in hand with our data scientists. That means turning their models and credit policy into a production decisioning service: inputs computed reliably, every decision versioned and explainable, and every rule or model change shipped through shadow mode and backtests before it goes live. Done looks like the new logic deciding every application, with Data Science able to iterate on it without an engineering rewrite. * **The automated loan workflow.** Application, underwriting decision, offer, acceptance, disbursement, servicing, repayment, delinquency, and collateral release, modeled as an explicit state machine with every transition logged. Manual steps become rules, and rules become auditable. Done looks like a standard advance funding with no human in the loop, and a non\-standard one landing in front of the right person with the context already attached. * **Disbursement triage, fixed at the root.** Failed, duplicated, delayed, and stuck disbursements. You'll find out why each class of break happens (a retry without an idempotency key, a webhook that arrived out of order, a rail that returned after we marked it settled) and close it for good. Done looks like the triage queue shrinking week over week, with the T7 SLA rate to prove it. * **The borrower experience, built to design.** The cash advance offer, acceptance, disbursement status, repayment, payoff, and loan history screens across web and mobile, implemented faithfully from our designs and improved through what you learn in production. You own design fidelity, accessibility, and performance, and you make sure the status a borrower sees is the status the loan is actually in. * **Operator and triage tooling.** The internal console where Credit, Operations, and Support see every loan and disbursement, spot the stuck ones, and resolve them with the context already on screen. Watch what they do in spreadsheets today, then delete the spreadsheet. * **Loan servicing and money movement.** Scheduled auto\-pay, partial payments, payoff quotes, reversals, and the edge cases between them, over ACH, RTP, and wires. Every movement integrates cleanly with the ledger so it posts, reconciles, and has an owner. You'll work closely with the Ledger team and own the product consequences of settlement timing, not just the API call. * **Risk controls in the workflow.** Limits, holds, loan\-to\-value checks, and step\-up review triggered by risk signals rather than blanket friction. You'll know what each control costs in conversion. * **The bar.** Rigorous code reviews, clear technical docs, and mentorship for the rest of the Credit team. You'll be the team's closest partner to Design and Data Science. ### **WHAT GREAT LOOKS  . We ask. If you've built agents, wired up connectors, written skills or MCP servers, or shipped internal tooling your team actually depends on, lead with that. Name the artifact, not the tool. ### **WHAT YOU BRING** * 5\+ years building and scaling production applications across the stack: backend (Python, Postgres, AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure) and frontend (React, React Native, TypeScript). Both halves are load\-bearing here. * You've built or owned a lending, credit, or payments workflow in production. Loan origination, servicing, or disbursement, and you can explain a design decision you'd make differently now. * You've moved real money on real rails. ACH origination and returns, RTP or FedNow, wires, or equivalent. You know what an R01 is and why return windows matter to a disbursement. * Workflow and state\-machine design. You model long\-running processes explicitly, with retries, timeouts, compensation, and a clear audit trail. * Operational debugging instinct. You've taken over a noisy exception queue and made it quiet by fixing causes, not by adding alerts. * You've implemented complex designs faithfully and quickly, and you can talk a designer through a trade\-off without losing the intent. * Database mastery. Expert SQL and relational design, and transactions that hold under load during scheduled auto\-pay batches. * API\-native. Webhooks, idempotency, eventual consistency, and reconciliation are your default vocabulary. * Product\-owner thinking. You understand the flow of funds and how to tell a worried borrower exactly where their money is. * Pragmatism. You know when a queue and a lambda are the answer and when they are three new partial\-failure modes. * You've implemented credit decisioning or underwriting logic in production alongside data scientists: turning a model or policy spec into a reliable, versioned, testable service, with shadow mode, backtesting, and a clean rollout. **Bonus:** workflow engines (Temporal, Step Functions or similar); credit or risk modeling; direct experience with Stripe, Plaid, Modern Treasury, or Increase; asset\-backed or secured lending; design systems or internal tooling for operations teams; KYC/KYB, bank partnerships, or audit\-readiness exposure. You collect, or you have a view on where this market is going. ### **HOW WE'LL INTERVIEW YOU** We'll be specific so you can prepare. Before any of it: download the app, put a card up, make a bid, and try selling. Every round assumes you've used the product, and we expect your point of view to sharpen as you go. For this role, go through the cash advance flow: how an offer is presented, what happens after you accept, what you're told while you wait for funds, and where it made you hesitate. We will ask. * Recruiter screen, 30 minutes, Google Meet. Come ready to talk about the metric you own today and how you're performing against it, why Alt specifically, and how you're actually using AI. We'll align on comp and answer your questions. * Hiring manager, Mina Quon, 30 minutes * Technical Assignment \- 45 minutes * Architecture and system design, 60 minutes. * Culture interview, 30 minutes. * Leore, our founder and CEO, 30 minutes. Everyone who joins Alt meets Leore. Come with a point of view on where you'd take Alt's credit product first. * Reference checks, 15 minutes with a former manager(s) . **Compensation:** $200,000 – $220,000 per year, plus equity for all full\-time employees. **What we offer:** ================== ***For full\-time Employees*** * We cover 85% of your medical, dental, and vision, and up to 50% for dependents. HSA/FSA available * Generous PTO that people actually take * Parental leave at full salary * $200/month wellness \+ $100/month home office stipend * Free DoorDash Pass membership, because dinner shouldn't be a decision * Remote\-first (for most positions), with WeWork access when you want a room with other humans * 401(k) * Alt Equity to all full\-time employees Compensation Range: $200K \- $220K

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Early Career)
jobs.description: ***Who We Are*** ---------------- The Constructive Dialogue Institute (CDI) is a non\-partisan, non\-profit dedicated to equipping the next generation of Americans with the skills to communicate and collaborate across lines of difference. We work with U.S. colleges and universities by providing co\-curricular programming for students, professional development for faculty and staff, and strategic guidance to leadership. Our goal is to foster constructive dialogue at every level of the institution and to create the conditions for lasting organizational change. CDI was co\-founded by psychologist Jonathan Haidt, the bestselling author of *The Righteous Mind* and *The Anxious Generation*. ***The Role*** -------------- We're seeking an early\-career Software Engineer to help build the technology behind CDI's learning programs. You'll work on Perspectives, our online learning platform, and our AI\-powered dialogue practice experience, helping students build the skills to bridge divides and giving educators better tools to support their learning. You'll work directly with and be mentored by our Senior Technical Lead, and collaborate closely with our Product team. You'll contribute to real product features, fix bugs, help keep our platform reliable, and improve the systems we use to build and maintain software. You'll start with clearly scoped work, get regular guidance and code review, and take on more responsibility, including production support, as your skills grow. AI agents are part of our everyday engineering workflow. You'll learn to break problems into manageable pieces, evaluate implementation approaches, and review and test agent\-generated code so you understand the work you ship. Our stack includes TypeScript, React, and Next.js; Java and Spring Boot; Python; and AWS. You don't need to arrive knowing all of it. ***With guidance and mentorship from our Senior Technical Lead, you'll:*** -------------------------------------------------------------------------- * Build and improve features for students, instructors, and CDI staff, such as learning activities, progress displays, and tools for managing courses and learners. * Work with our Senior Technical Lead and Product team to break product needs into clear tasks, and deliver small, well\-tested changes. * Use AI coding agents to help implement features, investigate bugs, and explore unfamiliar code. Read, question, and test their output before treating it as finished. * Diagnose problems by reproducing them, tracing application behavior, and using logs and tests to understand what went wrong. * Write and maintain automated tests, check user\-facing behavior, and participate in code reviews with attention to accessibility, reliability, and protecting learner data. * Help monitor and support our production systems, building toward taking part in incident response. * Contribute to the tools and practices that make AI\-assisted development effective at CDI, including project context, custom agents and skills, tool integrations, and agent\-assisted code review. * Document what you learn, communicate progress and blockers, and ask for help early when something is unclear. ***Who You Are*** ----------------- #### **Required** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * At least one hands\-on engineering project beyond coursework, such as an internship, co\-op, job, freelance project, or sustained open\-source contribution, where you worked in a shared codebase and had your code reviewed. * A working foundation in at least one programming language, and a project you can explain: how it works, the decisions you made, and how you investigated problems. * Understanding of web application basics, including how a user interface communicates with an API and how an application stores and retrieves data. * Ability to read and modify code, work through problems step by step, and test your changes to make sure they work as expected. * Thoughtful use of AI development tools: willingness to learn how to direct them, critically evaluate their output, and ask questions when something is unclear. * Clear communication and follow\-through, including responding constructively to feedback, flagging when you're blocked, and knowing when to ask for help. * Motivation for CDI's mission and interest in building tools that help people learn and practice new skills. #### **Preferred** * Experience building a web application with JavaScript or TypeScript and React, Next.js, or a similar framework, or exposure to Java, Spring Boot, or Python. * Familiarity with automated testing or SQL. * Interest in accessible design or education technology. ***What We Offer*** ------------------- * **A Mission\-Driven Culture** — our work culture genuinely reflects our mission, characterized by intellectual humility, continuous improvement, and open\-mindedness * **Unlimited PTO** — recharge on your own schedule with unlimited paid time off, in addition to 13 company holidays * **Health, Vision \& Dental** — health, vision, and dental plans, with CDI contributing toward your premiums each month * **401(k) Match** — invest in your future with a 100% match on your contributions, up to 3% of your pay * **Professional Development** — a generous annual budget to invest in your growth: build new skills, deepen existing ones, and stay inspired in your work * **Remote Work Support** — up to $500 reimbursed for home office equipment and up to $50/month reimbursed for home internet or cell phone expenses ***The Details*** ----------------- * **Compensation:** $72,000 \- $82,000 * **Location:** Remote, must be based in the U.S. * **Schedule:** Full\-time, flexible within U.S. time zones * **Reports to:**Senior Technical Lead * **Direct Report(s):** None * **Target start date:** 12/01/2026

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Product
jobs.description: **Company** ----------- Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Palo Alto, we turn complex human knowledge, including tax codes, legal rules, clinical guidelines and security protocols, into a formal representation, so every AI answer can be traced, challenged, and proved. Pramaana's architecture pairs foundation models trained to formalize and reason with a symbolic world model encoded in Lean 4\. Pramaana was founded by a team out of Google, DeepMind, and Glean, combining frontier AI researchers and formal methods experts. **The Role** ------------ We’re looking for a full\-stack Product Engineer to turn Pramaana’s research into products that customers and developers can use and trust. You’ll make complex reasoning accessible through intuitive interfaces and thoughtful developer experiences, helping users understand, inspect, and verify AI outputs. This is a hands\-on, early\-stage role spanning customer\-facing applications, developer APIs, and new product experiments. You won’t be confined to one feature or product. You’ll help discover what users need, build the experience across the stack, and improve it through real\-world use. You’ll work closely with product, design, engineering, and research, taking ownership of projects from the MVP through production. We’re looking for someone who cares about both how AI works and how people experience it \- and who enjoys making complex technology feel straightforward. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Build complete product experiences.** Take problems from initial exploration to working software, owning the frontend, backend, data models, integrations, and testing needed to deliver a useful result. * **Create thoughtful, responsive interfaces.** Build workflows that help users bring in knowledge, review rules, ask questions, and inspect results and supporting evidence. Pay attention to interaction details, accessibility, loading states, and errors. * **Develop reliable APIs and services.** Build the systems behind document processing, asynchronous jobs, verification workflows, and customer integrations. Make progress, failures, and recovery understandable to users. * **Turn research capabilities into usable products.** Partner with researchers to integrate models, agents, and verification services. Help bridge the gap between a promising technical demonstration and an experience customers can depend on. * **Learn directly from users.** Work with customers and internal stakeholders to understand their workflows, test assumptions, and identify useful improvements. Instrument features and use feedback and usage data to guide iteration. * **Own quality beyond launch.** Write tests, review code, monitor the features you ship, and investigate production issues. Improve performance, security, and reliability as usage grows. * **Build foundations that support multiple products.** Create reusable components, services, and integration patterns. Make practical decisions about what to share, what to keep simple, and when a prototype needs a more durable implementation. **You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have** -------------------------------------------- * **Minimum 2–3 years of software engineering experience**, with examples of products or features you’ve shipped and improved. We value meaningful hands\-on ownership more than a particular title or background. * **Strong full\-stack fundamentals.** You’re comfortable building interfaces with TypeScript and React, backend services with Python or Node.js, and working with APIs and relational databases. You may be stronger on one side of the stack, but you’re willing to work across both. * **Product judgment and attention to detail.** You think about the user’s goal, question unnecessary complexity, and care whether the final experience is understandable—not just technically functional. * **Practical experience delivering production software.** You’re familiar with testing, version control, code review, deployment, and debugging. You understand the basics of authentication, authorization, and handling user data responsibly. * **Comfort working through ambiguity.** You can break a loosely defined problem into manageable steps, test an approach, and adjust as you learn. * **Ownership, curiosity, and clear communication.** You follow through on what you build, surface problems early, and work well with people across engineering, design, product, and research. **Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have** ---------------------------------------------- * Experience building applications with LLM APIs, retrieval, agent workflows, or evaluation systems. * Experience with enterprise software, developer tools, or workflows involving complex documents, structured knowledge, or auditable decisions. * Strong frontend craft, including experience building editors, data visualizations, or other information\-rich interfaces. * Experience taking a startup product, substantial side project, or open\-source tool from an idea to active users. Prior experience in formal verification is not required. We’re looking for strong builders who are curious about the technology and motivated to make it useful.

academic department. **Key Responsibilities** * **Provide strategic leadership and vision** for the Quantum Innovation Center, advancing its research, education, workforce development, and innovation mission in alignment with University and national priorities. * **Build and expand a high\-impact quantum research portfolio** by identifying emerging opportunities, establishing strategic priorities, and developing interdisciplinary research initiatives across engineering, physics, chemistry, mathematics, computer science, and related fields. * **Recruit and engage exceptional faculty and funding partners. * **Advance graduate and undergraduate research and postdoctoral training**, creating opportunities for students and trainees to engage in quantum\-related research and prepare for careers in quantum science and technology. * **Lead the development and expansion of innovative education and workforce development programs**, including certificates, workshops, internships, experiential learning, and continuing education that respond to evolving workforce needs. * **Strengthen pathways from education to careers** by developing relationships with industry, government laboratories, national security organizations, graduate programs, and other employers and training partners. * **Develop and sustain strategic external partnerships** with industry, national laboratories, federal agencies, professional organizations, and other organizations to expand sponsored research, internships, workforce development, and collaborative educational opportunities. * **Serve as a visible ambassador for the Center and MU**, strengthening its national and international reputation and representing the Center at regional, national, and international forums. * **Cultivate philanthropic and other external support** in partnership with University Advancement and academic leadership, while identifying opportunities for strategic investment and industry engagement. * **Establish effective governance and operating practices** that foster interdisciplinary collaboration, support long\-term growth and sustainability, and ensure effective coordination across participating departments, colleges, and disciplines. * **Provide responsible stewardship of Center resources, programs, and activities**, developing sustainable approaches to resource allocation and operations while ensuring alignment with University poli uting, artificial intelligence, or related fields. * Experience working across academic, governmental, industrial, and community sectors. * Distinguished record of scholarship and externally funded research. * Demonstrated success leading interdisciplinary research initiatives, programs, centers, or collaborative teams. * Specific academic home(s) of candidates will be determined throughout the hiring process. This is not a remote opportunity. For affiliations and joint appointments materials may be shared with all faculty in all departments involved. **Community Information** Columbia, Missouri, has been consistently rated as one of the most desirable places to live and work in the U.S. This college city of 128,000\-plus residents has the best of both worlds — small\-town convenience and warmth with urban sophistication and amenities. jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer I
jobs.description: **At ACT, Your Work Makes a Difference** Education has power – a power that changes lives forever. It creates opportunities that lift up individuals, their families, and sparks societal change that echoes through generations to come. From our grassroots we have fought the good fight for inclusivity in education, and we remain devoted to helping anyone who struggles to access that power. This is what matters to us and we must do better \- we’ve never been more sure of our purpose. ACT team members are part of an organization dedicated to a mission that has never been more important: Helping people achieve education and workplace success. Advancing that mission within our organization, by helping our team members achieve education and workplace success of their own, is core to our values. ACT values a diverse workplace and is committed to fostering an inclusive environment in which every team member has an equal opportunity to grow. We want our team members to have the well\-being and confidence they need to do their best work, in an environment where both they and ACT thrive. To support this, our total rewards include company paid life insurance, medical, dental, vision, flexible health and dependent spending accounts, 401(k) retirement savings with company match, paid holidays, paid time off, and so much more. You can find a comprehensive list of our benefits here. We are seeking an **Infrastructure Engineer I** to help us fulfill that mission. The Infrastructure Engineer I is an entry\-level role designed as a learning and growth opportunity for individuals developing foundational skills in infrastructure engineering and cloud technologies. Working under the guidance of senior Infrastructure and DevOps engineers, this role helps build, automate, and support cloud\-native infrastructure across ACT's AWS environment. This role develops practical experience with Terraform, automated deployment pipelines, and AI\-assisted tools to provision, patch, monitor, and troubleshoot infrastructure. The finalist will be hired at the salary and level commensurate with their qualifications. **For this position, we anticipate offering an annual salary in the range of $70,000 to $85,000\.** ACT manages salaries within the range based on relevant factors including, skills, experience, and internal equity. This position is not incentive eligible. **Location:**This is a remote position, based in the United States. Individuals located in the Iowa City area may choose to work on\-site or in a hybrid arrangement. **Visa:** Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for visa sponsorship. **What you will be working on:** **40% \- Cloud Infrastructure Operations** * Monitor backup jobs across ACT's AWS environment using cloud\-native and enterprise backup platforms (e.g., CommVault, AWS Backup), applying AI\-assisted tools to help investigate and resolve failures. * Maintain backup schedules, retention policies, and restore procedures; support recovery requests and audits. * Assist with deploying, configuring, and maintaining monitoring and observability tooling; partner with the monitoring tool administration team on agent health and coverage. * Triage and respond to monitoring alerts routed through ITSM tools, using AI\-assisted diagnostics, resolve routine incidents and escalate more complex incidents appropriately. * Support AWS\-native infrastructure management, monitoring, backup, recovery, and automation activities; maintain awareness of Azure concepts where limited hybrid\-cloud support is needed. **35% \- Infrastructure as Code \& Automated Deployment** * Assist with building and provisioning cloud infrastructure with Terraform, Ansible, and automated CI/CD pipelines, replacing manual, ticket\-driven build processes. * Support and help investigate patching cycles through automated pipelines and scripts to minimize manual patch\-weekend effort. * Support administration of underlying Windows Server and Linux systems supporting cloud workloads, including patching, service troubleshooting, log review, filesystem/storage management, access support, and routine health checks. * Maintain, and with guidance, develop reusable Infrastructure as Code modules, automation scripts, and runbooks for common server, storage, backup, and monitoring tasks. * Apply AI\-assisted engineering tools to accelerate infrastructure automation development, troubleshooting, diagnostics, and documentation. **25% \- Analysis \& Continuous Improvement** * Identify recurring issues, manual toil, and gaps in current infrastructure, deployment, and patching processes; recommend automation, AI\-assisted tooling, or pipeline improvements. * Research and evaluate new tools and automation approaches, with senior engineer guidance, for backup, monitoring, and server management, recommending adoption where they improve reliability or reduce manual effort. * Document standard operating procedures and contribute to the team's knowledge base as initiative and drive to dig deep into problems and think sideways when creative solutions are needed * Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the discipline to follow runbooks and escalate appropriately. * Ability to learn new automation tools and AI\-assisted engineering practices quickly and apply them to daily work. * Ability to troubleshoot server and cloud infrastructure issues involving performance, storage, network connectivity, access, monitoring, backup, and operating system services. * Familiarity with tools such as PowerShell, Bash, systemd, Windows Event Viewer, package managers, configuration management, and operational runbooks. * Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively with senior engineers and vendors. * Ability to work on standard tasks independently or as part of a larger team on more complex projects * Ability to work occasional off\-hour shifts to support monthly patching weekends. **It’s a plus if you have (preferred qualifications):** * Experience with CommVault, AWS Backup, or another enterprise backup platform. * Hands\-on experience with AWS infrastructure services such as EC2, S3, EBS, IAM, CloudWatch, Systems Manager, AWS Backup, VPC, and related automation tooling. * Experience with Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or similar Infrastructure as Code tools for provisioning and maintaining cloud and server infrastructure. * Experience administering enterprise Windows Server and Linux environments, including Active Directory/Group Policy awareness, DNS, PowerShell, shell scripting, vulnerability remediation, virtualization, and automated configuration management. * Experience supporting server, storage, or backup operations in a complex enterprise environment. **About ACT** When ACT was founded in 1959, it disrupted the assessment industry with a new approach to helping students better understand their readiness so they could take steps to improve it. jobs.title: Medical Director, AI Safety
jobs.description: **About Avo** Avo is the leading AI platform for healthcare enterprises, helping clinicians make better decisions, move faster, and improve the quality of patient care. Serving as a central hub for care teams, Avo brings together patient data, clinical knowledge, and AI\-powered workflows to support diagnosis, care planning, documentation, orders, and evidence\-based decision\-making at the point of care. Clinicians today navigate dozens of tabs, applications, datasets, hospital protocols, medical guidelines, and payer policies to deliver high\-quality care. Avo changes that. We are product\-obsessed, collaborative, and scrappy, united by a mission to improve healthcare delivery through AI. Our investors include Noro\-Moseley Partners, AlleyCorp, Scrub Capital, and several leading hospitals and universities. **The Role** We are seeking a Medical Director, AI Safety that will own the safety of Avo's AI\-generated clinical content. That means deciding what "safe enough to ship" means for a discharge summary, a pre\-visit summary, or a decision\-support module, building the tests that enforce it, and signing off before it reaches a clinician. You will design the grading rubrics, run the evaluations, classify failures by clinical severity, and turn the findings into changes the Studio and engineering teams make. Roughly 85% of your time goes to safety. The remaining 15% splits two ways: building clinical modules yourself in Avo's Studio, so your safety judgments are grounded in how the content is actually produced, and joining sales and customer conversations as the physician who can explain how we test and why a CMIO should trust the output. You report to the CMIO, with a dotted line to the Chief Commercial Officer. #### **What You'll Do** * *AI safety (core of the role)* + Define the safety standard for each product line: what counts as a hallucination, an omission, or a clinically material error, and how severe each is + Design and run evaluation protocols for clinical AI modules, including hallucination detection, omission analysis, and accuracy checks against source records and evidence\-based guidelines + Build and maintain a clinical harm taxonomy and grading rubric (NCC MERP\-style severity scoring) and apply it across benchmark sets + Review AI\-generated clinical content directly, and grade the automated graders so we know when to trust them + Own the release gate: write the go/no\-go safety assessment for new modules and major prompt or model changes + Investigate reported clinical errors from customers, trace root cause, and drive the fix through Studio and engineering + Write the safety reports, validation summaries, and white papers that buyers and their clinical governance committees ask for + Track the regulatory and standards landscape for clinical AI (FDA, ONC, CHAI, Joint Commission) and translate it into internal requirements*Clinical builder (\~5\-10%)* + Build or revise clinical modules in Avo's Studio, applying evidence\-based guidelines and your own practice experience + Feed what you learn from building back into the safety protocols, and vice versa*Sales\-forward clinician (\~5\-10%)* + Join prospect calls and pilot evaluations as the physician who can speak to how Avo's content is validated + Present the safety program to CMIOs, CIOs, and clinical quality leaders, and answer their hardest questions about failure modes + Challenge the status quo in the room: name where legacy documentation and CDS workflows fail patients, and show how a tested AI alternative does better #### **What You Bring** * Active clinical license (MD/DO, NP, or PA) with hands\-on patient care experience * 3\-7 years of clinical practice; you can read a discharge summary and spot the missed anticoagulation plan in under a minute * Experience with or strong interest in clinical AI, CDS, or health informatics * A testing mindset: you like designing the rubric, arguing about edge cases, and finding the error nobody else caught * Ability to write a clear, defensible safety report for a clinical governance committee * Comfort presenting to C\-suite clinical leaders and answering pointed questions about AI failure modes * Willingness to define the role's scope as the product and company grow * ***Travel:*** Some travel expected for customer meetings and demos, up to 10% #### **Nice to Have** * Experience with EHR systems (Epic, Meditech, Athena) * Background in clinical informatics, quality improvement, or patient safety * Prior experience in a sales engineering, solutions, or customer\-facing clinical role * Familiarity with AI/LLM evaluation methodologies **Why Join Avo** **Impact:** Avo's products run inside hospitals, helping clinicians make better calls at the point of care. The work is real, and the mission is meaningful. **Ownership:** We have a bias for action; you'll work alongside teams who take initiative, follow through on commitments, and take accountability for results. **High Agency:** We move fast, trust our people, and avoid bureaucracy. **Great Team:** Work alongside a talented, low\-ego group of clinicians, engineers, and product folks who care deeply about craft. **Remote\-First:** Work from anywhere in the US. The company has offices in NYC, so if you're in the area we'd love the chance to work in\-person together 2 days/week. **How We Take Care of Our Team** * **Generous Time Off:** Flexible and generous PTO * **Comprehensive Health Plans:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family * **401K Matching:** Contribution matching to help invest in your future * **Personal Device Allowance:** Tax\-free funds for personal device usage * **Compensation and Equity:** $175,000 \- $200,000 OTE and equity

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer

The platform also features a robust administrative panel for managing content and tracking, monitoring, and analyzing user data. **About the Opportunity** We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer who wants to stay close to the code and have a real say in how our next platform is designed and built. You'll spend about 70% of your time writing C\# and .NET code and 30% on architecture and design. The work includes multi\-tenancy, data at scale, domain boundaries, messaging, performance, and the long\-term evolution of the platform. You will also work with client technical teams, so you can hear the problems firsthand and build solutions that work across hundreds of organizations. **Why Jacksonville?** Grow your career at Advantage and make coastal Northeast Florida home. Jacksonville offers 22 miles of beaches, the nation's largest urban park system, the St. Johns River and a creative food and arts scene. Florida also has no personal state income tax, which means more of your paycheck stays with you. **What You Do** * Design and build production applications in C\# and .NET. * Help shape the architecture of ADG's next platform, including multi\-tenancy, domain boundaries, messaging, and scalability. * Solve complex SQL Server performance problems and build APIs and client integrations. * Evaluate technical options and explain the tradeoffs behind your recommendations. * Work with client technical teams and contribute to the standards our engineering team uses. **Required Experience** * At least six years of professional C\# and .NET development experience, including current hands\-on production work. * Experience contributing to application or platform architecture. * Strong SQL Server skills and experience building APIs and integrations. * Ability to solve complex technical problems and explain your approach clearly. * Multi\-tenant SaaS applications or Microsoft Azure. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field preferred.
