jobs.title: Product Strategy, Autonomous Laboratories
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- **About Agilent** Agilent is a global leader in laboratory and clinical technologies, we are passionate about bringing great science to life. We help scientists, researchers, and clinicians address some of the world’s most important challenges across life science research, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, food, environmental testing, and related markets. Leveraging more than 50 years of expertise, we develop advanced instruments, software, consumables, and services that enable customers to generate reliable scientific results and improve scientific, economic, and operational outcomes. Our global organization combines deep technical expertise with a commitment to quality, innovation, and customer impact. We work collaboratively with our customers on their journey to make a real difference in human lives. Our culture is founded on trust, respect, and uncompromising integrity, and we pride ourselves on being a dynamic and inclusive workplace that empowers employees and fosters innovation. **The Role** Agilent is seeking a highly experienced product strategy leader to help define how laboratories will evolve over the next five to ten years and translate that vision into actionable strategies for our businesses and product organizations. This senior individual contributor works across the enterprise at the intersection of customer insight, science, technology, and business strategy. As a recognized internal expert, you will lead high\-impact, long\-range initiatives, advise senior leadership, and independently solve complex challenges spanning multiple functions with limited support. You will connect external signals and customer needs with business\-group priorities, product roadmaps, and execution. **Key Responsibilities** * Assess how AI, automation, robotics, connected instruments, digital workflows, data platforms, and autonomous experimentation could change laboratory work. Identify practical applications in scientific productivity, instrument operation, workflow optimization, decision support, and service; distinguish durable shifts from short\-term technology cycles. * Evaluate new products, solutions, partnerships, and business models. Develop strategic and financial cases that assess customer value, differentiation, and feasibility; recommend when to build, partner, invest, acquire, or apply existing capabilities differently. * Develop and continually refine Agilent’s view of Autonomous Labs. Synthesize scientific, technological, economic, and operational trends, including changing workforce models and productivity pressures, into scenarios and implications for our portfolio, business models, and investments. * Engage scientists, laboratory leaders, executives, key opinion leaders, and strategic customers to understand current operations and emerging needs. Identify workflow bottlenecks, fragmented data, automation gaps, usability challenges, and inefficiencies that span individual instruments or product categories. * Synthesize customer feedback across markets and businesses into clear problem statements, strategic requirements, opportunity areas, and investment recommendations. Connect market direction, competitive developments, technology adoption, and laboratory economics to customer value and business opportunity. * Partner with individual business and product groups to translate enterprise insight into specific decisions about what to develop, accelerate, integrate, redesign, partner around, or stop pursuing. You will collaborate closely with our internal engineering team and our Barcelona\-based agency partners, Nexus Creative, to develop comprehensive seller and buyer portals, Webflow\-driven marketing web applications, and a robust data infrastructure. Key Responsibilities * **Data Lakehouse Architecture:** Build and manage an open\-format raw data layer using Azure Databricks, starting with our initial workspace and catalog rollout. * **Pipeline \& Data Engineering:** Ingest raw, unchanged data from Google Drive, Postgres, Databricks and n8n platforms. Manage complex workflows using n8n to execute on a single data layer. * **Backend \& API Development:** Build, extend, and maintain RESTful APIs in C\# on .NET Core, and work with our agency partner Nexus Creative we migrate our backend. * **AI\-First Integration \& Data Prep:** Structure and prepare data for advanced analytics and local\-model execution using Claude and related LLM tools, ensuring continuous feeds for ingesting scripts and vector storage. * **Security \& Governance:** Implement strict role\-based access controls to guarantee that buyer, seller, and internal data remain completely isolated. Ensure robust data lineage so that every fact traces back to its source file. So when we access data only data the user has access to is visible. * **Portal Development:** Architect and optimize dynamic buyer and seller portals on Azure App Service, ensuring a premium front\-end UI/UX for our wealth management clientele. * **Strategic Execution:** Operate within our Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, taking ownership of Q4 Rocks, maintaining our weekly scorecard, and presenting key Stage 2 architecture decisions on the Level 10 (L10\) meeting list. jobs.title: DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: * **Geo**: Europe — remote, EU hours with US overlap * **Position**: Full\-time * **Experience**: 5\+ years in DevOps / infrastructure / SRE, 7\+ preferred * **Flexible Location**: Remote; hybrid or in office depending on the city * **Corporate Language**: English * **Hours**: EU hours with US overlap. The role includes substantial on\-call responsibility within a small team. ### **Why this role exists** Scientists spend a staggering amount of time wrangling data instead of running experiments. We build the AI\-native platform that changes that: the system of record and the intelligence layer for R\&D labs formulating everything from next\-gen batteries to sustainable materials to alternative proteins. Our software doesn't just store lab data, it designs experiments, recommends formulations, surfaces insights, and automates the busywork that stands between a researcher and their next discovery. Alchemy is a multi\-tenant enterprise ELN, LIMS, PLM and QC platform used by applied science companies in chemicals, materials and aerospace as well as all CPG categories. Our platform runs on AWS across multiple regions, including regulated environments. Core technologies include Terraform, ECS/Fargate and Aurora MySQL. You’ll help operate and modernize an established cloud platform, expanding Terraform coverage while maintaining existing CloudFormation infrastructure. The role combines ongoing production operations with improvements to reliability, automation, security and cost efficiency. ### **What you'll do** You’ll take end\-to\-end responsibility for infrastructure operations and improvement: * Infrastructure as code. Expand and maintain Terraform coverage, safely bring existing resources under code management, diagnose configuration drift and maintain CloudFormation infrastructure as it is progressively modernized. * Deployment and release pipelines. Own and improve GitHub Actions and Jenkins pipelines, environment automation and regular releases across our cloud environments. * Production reliability. Monitor and troubleshoot application infrastructure, databases, containers and networking. Handle incidents, improve observability and take substantial on\-call responsibility as part of a small team. * Cloud cost optimization. Improve cloud efficiency through right\-sizing, capacity planning, resource lifecycle management and cost visibility. * Customer\-hosted deployments. Support deployments into customer\-managed AWS environments and produce clear technical documentation for customer infrastructure and security teams. * Security and compliance. Remediate infrastructure and dependency vulnerabilities, strengthen platform security and support audit evidence and compliance requirements. * Internal tooling. Build and improve tools for environment management, deployments and operational visibility. Java or Vue expertise is not required, but practical automation and tool\-building skills are essential. ### **Who you are** #### **Must have** * **Terraform** — modules, state, multi\-environment and multi\-region layout, and specifically import, state mv/rm, targeted applies, and diagnosing drift on infrastructure you did not create. * **AWS depth, not breadth** — VPC and networking (peering, NAT, security groups, NACLs), IAM, ECS/Fargate, Aurora MySQL including Serverless v2, ALB/NLB, S3, Secrets Manager and SSM, CloudWatch, Lambda, Batch. * **CloudFormation you can author and deploy, not only read** — legacy templates are still load\-bearing here and will be for a while. * **CI/CD ownership** — GitHub Actions and Jenkins, building and maintaining pipelines rather than consuming them. * **Bash and Python** for automation, tooling and operational glue. * **Aurora MySQL operations** — sizing and scaling, snapshots, clones and restores, failover, connection and pool behaviour, and reading a slow query. The application's schema is not yours to own. * **Incident discipline** — scope by time window, form a hypothesis, prepare a rollback before you touch anything, write up what happened. * **Cost awareness** as an engineering skill, not a finance report. * **AI\-assisted engineering \-** Practical experience using coding agents, writing clear guidance for them and building automated checks around their output. Sound engineering judgment and human review of production changes are essential. * **Clear written English** and the habit of documenting so someone else can operate it. #### **Strongly preferred** * Multi\-region operations (EU \+ US) and data\-residency awareness. * Experience with AWS GovCloud or other regulated cloud environments, including controlled access and operational requirements. * Deploying a product into a customer's own cloud account, and writing the documents their security review consumes. * PR\-based infrastructure change and review culture — plan output read as evidence, not as a formality. * SSO/OIDC, CloudFront behaviour and debugging. * Vulnerability patching at image and dependency level (ECR, Trivy, Scout, Dependabot or equivalents). * ISO 27001 / SOC 2 exposure from the engineering side. #### **Nice to have** * AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer Professional). * Azure or GCP exposure. * Java / Spring Boot familiarity, enough to read the application and reason about deployment behaviour. * WAF and edge security, EKS/Kubernetes, Datadog or Grafana\-stack experience are signals of range, not requirements. #### **How you work** * You automate repetitive work and maintain clear operational documentation * You are comfortable improving established systems while keeping them running reliably * You treat infrastructure as code as an ongoing engineering responsibility * You take ownership of operational problems across infrastructure and application behaviour * You balance planned improvements with internal engineering support. Around half of the team’s incoming work involves helping other teams resolve blockers * You document decisions and procedures so others can operate the systems you maintain ### **Your impact** You’ll help shape how we operate and improve the infrastructure behind an enterprise platform. Your work will improve deployment reliability, cloud efficiency, security and the day\-to\-day experience of our engineering teams. This is a hands\-on role in a small team, with broad ownership across an established platform. You’ll balance infrastructure modernization with production operations, on\-call responsibilities and substantial internal engineering support.

jobs.title: Support Engineer

This role focuses on resolving customer issues across the breadth of the Alianza portfolio — from configuration questions to deeper technical debugging — with speed, accuracy, and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate is an experienced troubleshooter who is comfortable owning a ticket queue autonomously, balancing competing priorities and SLA commitments, and who thrives in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment. **Key Responsibilities** * Front\-Line Intake: Serve as the first technical eye on incoming tickets in assigned product areas — validating, classifying by complexity, and routing to the right group when work belongs elsewhere. * Ticket Resolution: Resolve customer issues through systematic diagnostic techniques and applied product knowledge, working toward First Contact Resolution (FCR) wherever practical, as a key driver of customer satisfaction. Share efficient ticket\-handling techniques with newer team members. * On\-Call: Participate in a 24×7 emergency rotation, ensuring critical customer issues are addressed promptly. **Required Skills \& Experience** Technical \& Problem\-Solving * Strong technical troubleshooting skills, with proven ability to trace customer\-reported symptoms to root cause across complex systems and to learn and master the Alianza product portfolio. * Proficiency managing a ticket queue autonomously, balancing volume with effective prioritisation across competing demands. * Ability to work independently and multitask effectively in a dynamic, interrupt\-driven, high\-pressure environment. Qualifications (Required) * 3\+ years of professional technical support experience, with demonstrated growth in handling progressively complex technical issues. * Knowledge and experience with voice and/or telecom technologies. Qualifications (Preferred) * .Knowledge and experience with the Metaswitch MetaSphere suite of telecom products. **Attributes for Success** The ideal candidate possesses the following innate qualities and team behaviors: * Ownership: A natural sense of responsibility and commitment to task completion. * Teamwork: A strong team\-oriented approach to effectively share workloads and co\-work issues. * Attitude: Positive energy, enthusiasm, and a contribution to overall team morale. * Growth: Curiosity, openness to continuous learning, and resilience when faced with challenges.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Who You'll Work With:** The Senior AI Engineer works with the Data Engineering team under the Center of Excellence (Data Science). This role operates at the intersection of AI engineering, data engineering, agentic AI, platform engineering, and investment technology. It emphasizes Python, enterprise integration, reliable data products, security, CI/CD, observability, model and agent evaluation, and rigorous validation of production AI systems. **What You'll Do:** We are building a next\-generation enterprise AI and data platform that enables teams to design, deploy, integrate, and scale intelligent applications and agents across investment research, portfolio management, risk, client, and operational workflows. The platform provides standardized infrastructure, reliable data products, commercial and self\-hosted model access, retrieval, agent orchestration, evaluation, observability, security, and governance. It enables teams to rapidly deliver AI\-powered capabilities in a scalable, secure, and production\-ready manner. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: * Build reliable, reusable, and AI\-ready data products for investment and enterprise use cases. * Design and develop production\-grade AI applications, agents, and intelligent workflows using Python. * Implement agent orchestration, tool integration, retrieval, memory, and multi\-step workflows. * Integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications, data platforms, and business systems. * Contribute to the shared AI and data platform that powers these capabilities at scale. **What We're Looking For:** **Core AI and Data Engineering** * 5\+ years of experience in software, data, AI, or platform engineering. * Strong production development experience with Python and SQL. * Proven ability to build and operate AI applications, data pipelines, APIs, data products, and distributed systems. * Experience integrating AI capabilities into enterprise applications and business workflows. * Strong understanding of: + Object\-oriented and asynchronous Python + APIs, microservices, and application integration + Data modeling, contracts, quality, reconciliation, metadata, and lineage + Batch, streaming, event\-driven, and API\-based architectures + Workflow orchestration, distributed processing, and production operations * Experience with cloud data and AI platforms such as Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Snowflake. * Ability to design scalable, reusable, resilient, and operationally supportable services. **Generative AI and Agentic Systems** Hands\-on experience with: * Large language models, embeddings, prompt engineering, context engineering, and RAG architecture. * Commercial and open\-source model APIs and ecosystems. * AI agents, agentic workflows, reusable skills, tool calling, structured outputs, and multi\-step orchestration. * Vector, keyword, metadata\-filtered, graph\-based, and hybrid retrieval. * Agent frameworks such as LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, Pydantic AI, or equivalent platforms. Preferred experience includes: * MCP servers and clients, agent\-to\-agent communication, and enterprise search. * Semantic layers, ontologies, and knowledge graphs. * Agent memory, state management, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Document intelligence and multimodal processing. * Reusable agent tools, skills, manifests, and registration standards. **Model Hosting and Inference** Experience with one or more of the following: * Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or Vertex AI. * Hugging Face, vLLM, Ollama, Qwen, or other approved open\-source model technologies. * Containerized model deployment and GPU\-based inference. * Model serving, API gateways, quantization, memory optimization, and model configuration. * Context\-window, token, concurrency, batching, throughput, and caching optimization. * Benchmarking and monitoring model quality, latency, availability, resource utilization, and cost. **Platform Engineering, Security, and DevOps** Strong experience with: * CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated provisioning, and governed deployment. * API\-first and microservices architectures. * Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, GKE, or equivalent container platforms. * Authentication, authorization, secrets management, OAuth, managed identities, RBAC, and Microsoft Entra ID or equivalent technologies. * Repository governance, branch protection, pull\-request validation, dependency controls, and software supply\-chain security. * Metrics, distributed tracing, structured logging, monitoring, and alerting. * Designing observable, resilient, secure, and production\-ready AI systems. Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex, or comparable tools for: * Code generation, refactoring, debugging, testing, and documentation. * Data\-pipeline, infrastructure, and CI/CD development. * Codebase understanding, modernization, architecture extraction, and pull\-request review. * Governed development supported by automated testing, peer review, security scanning, and controlled deployment. Candidates must be able to independently validate AI\-generated code for: * Functional correctness and test coverage * Security and data\-access risks * Performance and scalability * Maintainability and architectural alignment * Dependency, licensing, and software supply\-chain concerns * Compliance with enterprise engineering standards **Evaluation, Observability, and Testing: Required** * Hands\-on experience with data\-quality, model\-evaluation, LLM\-evaluation, or AI\-observability frameworks. * Experience building: + Model benchmarking and evaluation pipelines + Data\-quality and reconciliation tests + Retrieval and RAG evaluations + Agent test harnesses and scenario\-based simulations + Continuous validation and regression testing + Production monitoring for data, retrieval, model, and agent quality * Ability to measure: + Data accuracy, completeness, freshness, and consistency + Retrieval relevance and coverage + Groundedness, factual consistency, citations, and provenance + Tool selection, execution, and structured\-output compliance + Agent workflow success, failure, and escalation behavior + Latency, throughput, reliability, resource utilization, and cost * Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, OpenInference, Datadog, Arize, LangSmith, MLflow, Microsoft Foundry evaluation capabilities, or equivalent tools. * Ability to use evaluation results to inform model selection, routing, release, rollback, and production\-readiness decisions. **About AB** We are a leading global investment management firm offering high\-quality research and diversified investment services to institutional clients, retail investors, and private\-wealth clients in major markets around the globe. With over 4,000 employees across 57 locations operating in 26 countries and jurisdictions, our ambition is simple: to be the most trusted investment firm in the world. We realize that it's our people who give us a competitive advantage and drive success in the market, and our goal is to create an inclusive culture that rewards hard work. Our culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration creates an environment where you can thrive and do your best work. Whether you're producing thought\-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business or providing thoughtful advice to our clients, we are fully invested in you. If you're ready to challenge your limits and empower your career, join us! All are encouraged to apply. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Securities Finance
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** **Alpaca is a US\-headquartered, global leader in agent\-first brokerage infrastructure** for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more. Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional\-grade APIs. This includes broker\-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts. Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open\-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award\-winning, developer\-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it. **Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top\-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.** **Our Team Members:** We're a dynamic team of 400\+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond! We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. ### **Your Role:** As a Software Engineer on the Securities Finance (SecFi) team, you'll build and run the systems behind Alpaca's lending and borrowing products. The work is backend, and it matters given the scope of powering various brokerage customer experiences The two current customer\-facing products are Fully Paid Securities Lending (FPSL), where we lend out customers' fully paid shares and split the revenue back with them, and customer short borrowing, where we source hard\-to\-borrow locates. Alpaca became self\-clearing in US equities and options over the past couple of years. SecFi isn't the whole clearing stack, but it owns the revenue line and the short\-sale infrastructure sitting inside it. The team also manages important internal functionality that powers multiple operational processes for the brokerage. jobs.title: Software Development Manager, EBS Server Agility
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- If leading a team that builds secure, autonomous systems to test, deploy, and patch server software for one of the world's largest storage services excites you, the EBS Server Agility team is the place to do it. EBS is a foundational AWS service on which most other AWS services depend, and our teams build and operate the Continuous Integration platform and the deployment and patching infrastructure that keep EBS server software fast to ship, current, and secure across 400,000 bare\-metal servers, infrastructure that serves millions of AWS customers and exabytes of data every day. We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead an engineering team in our DevOps space. This is the space that spans Continuous Integration, which builds the platform that decides whether a change is safe to ship, and Deployments and Patching, which safely rolls that change out to a stateful storage engine serving live customer I/O. Both sit in the critical path for feature velocity and security compliance, and both are places where strong engineering leadership has outsized impact. You will not be writing the code or designing the systems yourself. You will lead the engineers who do: hiring and growing the team, setting clear technical direction, removing ambiguity, and delivering results predictably. You will decide where your systems sit in their lifecycle, define goals tied to business needs, and build the mechanisms that let the team deliver consistently without wearing out its best people. The guiding philosophy is simple and demanding: every manual step in the operator path is a defect in the system, and your team builds the test frameworks, CI infrastructure, and deployment services that engineer that toil away. Server CI and deployment at EBS shape how the software evolves to support new hardware platforms, new partitions (including edge and Outpost), and new operational models. You will partner with principal engineers and leaders across EC2 and EBS, and represent your team's work in discussions that shape how EBS evolves. You might align the team on a roadmap for the quarter, coach an engineer through a design, review progress against goals, and make a principled call that trades a little speed for safety on a change headed to the fleet. You will remove blockers, set priorities, and keep on\-call sustainable while the team ships. You will partner with principal engineers and leaders across EBS and EC2, and you will represent your team's work to senior leadership. This is a high\-visibility role. The work in this space affects every EBS customer, and your team's output is regularly reviewed by senior leadership. You will collaborate across organizational boundaries, influence technical direction beyond your immediate team, and build a team that is better for your presence but does not need you to be successful. We value managers who lead through ambiguity, reduce toil through smart automation, make principled tradeoffs between speed and safety, hire and grow strong engineers, and elevate everyone around them. About the team EBS Server Agility is the DevOps space for EBS Server, owning the Continuous Integration platform and the server deployment and patching infrastructure. Our engineers build distributed test orchestration and qualification systems, deployment pipelines that safely deliver validated server software to 400,000 bare\-metal servers, automated patching that keeps software secure on a biweekly cadence, metrics and crash observability, and secure operational tooling for autonomous operations. We move fast to deliver for customers while maintaining operational excellence across these mission\-critical services. We are a Boston\-based group building toward a future where server software tests, patches, and deploys itself: safely, securely, on schedule, with full visibility. There is significant greenfield opportunity, because CI and safe deployment for stateful bare\-metal systems at global scale have almost no off\-the\-shelf solutions, so our teams design from first principles. We are dedicated to supporting the people on the team. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we are building an environment that celebrates knowledge\-sharing and mentorship. Senior members give one\-on\-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, design and code reviews. We care about career growth and work to assign projects that stretch each engineer so they feel empowered to take on more complex problems over time.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of engineering team management experience * 7\+ years of engineering experience * Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations * Experience partnering with product and program management teams * 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations, or experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy * Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Software Engineer II - AI/ML, Neuron Inference, Inference
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds the AWS Neuron SDK, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on AWS Trainium machine learning accelerators. The Neuron Inference organization is at the forefront of optimizing inference performance for a wide range of ML models and model architectures on AWS's custom ML accelerators. We are working across the stack from PyTorch to the hardware\-software boundary, our engineers build systematic infrastructure, develop high\-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every compute unit is fine\-tuned for optimal performance forour customers' demanding workloads. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI acceleration. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end\-to\-end products that surprise and delight out\-of\-the\-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. On Agentic WorkSpaces, our vision is to enable AI agents to work the way humans do — with access to real applications, real interfaces, and real computing environments. For enterprises to trust autonomous agents with their essential business applications, they need a full suite of governance capabilities: an identity for every agent, human\-in\-the\-loop controls to audit and approve what agents do, and the ability for a human intervene in an agent's session when required. Our team is building these systems end to end. Upcoming launches will give every agent a verifiable identity, record every desktop action as a reviewable visual audit trail, enforce policy on every tool call before it executes, pause agents for human approval on sensitive actions, and let a human take control of an agent's session mid\-task before handing it back to the agent, which resumes with full context of what changed. Identity and agentic governance present hard problems in our industry today, and we're excited to on the forefront of solving them. We're looking for an SDE II who can ramp quickly deliver features end\-to\-end and thrive in greenfield work. Much of what we're building doesn't exist yet. You'll take early designs to production make pragmatic calls about what to build versus what to compose from existing AWS services and ship on a schedule tied to real customer milestones. If you like owning features from design through production and want your work to be the reason enterprises trust AI agents this team is for you. jobs.description: **Job Posting End Date** 10\-23\-2026 Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date. **Job Summary** This hands\-on role builds and operates secure, scalable infrastructure for AI and machine learning workloads across AWS and approved on\-premises environments. Responsibilities include cloud foundations, networking, containers, compute, identity, cost management, and observability. The engineer partners with AI, architecture, cybersecurity, network, and application teams to deliver secure, cost\-effective, production\-ready infrastructure while supporting core cloud engineering services.**Job Description** **What you’ll do:** **Essential Job Functions \& Tasks** AI Cloud Foundations * Design, build and maintain the AWS account structure, landing zones, and reference patterns that host AI and machine learning workloads, leveraging AWS Control Tower, Landing Zone Accelerator, and Terraform. * Engineer the compute, storage, and networking foundations required for AI workloads, including GPU and accelerated instance families, high\-throughput storage, and data access paths to enterprise data platforms. * Enable and operate AI platform services such as Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker, including private connectivity, model access provisioning, logging, and quota management. * Build reusable infrastructure\-as\-code modules, templates and pipelines so that AI teams can deploy quickly within approved guardrails. * Design, build and maintain on\-premises AI infrastructure for edge and specialized use cases. Support AI in disconnected or intermittently connected environments, including local compute, model distribution, patching, monitoring, backup, and recovery. Create deployment standards, automation, runbooks, and support processes for on\-premises and edge AI. Integrate on\-premises AI with enterprise identity, security, networking, monitoring, and governance where feasible. Controls, Security \& Governance * Partner with Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture and Compliance to align AI infrastructure with AEP security standards, regulatory obligations, and responsible AI guardrails. * Review and remediate configuration drift, vulnerabilities and audit findings across the AI cloud estate; support evidence requests and control attestations. * Contribute to onboarding and intake processes for new AI use cases, ensuring workloads are provisioned into the right accounts with the right controls from day one. FinOps \& Cost Management * Establish and operate FinOps practices for AI workloads, including tagging standards, showback/chargeback, budgets, anomaly detection, and forecasting. * Analyze and optimize spend on GPU compute, inference and token consumption, storage, and data transfer; recommend commitment strategies such as Savings Plans and Reserved Instances. * Provide cost transparency and consumption reporting to business stakeholders and technology leadership, and identify optimization opportunities before they become budget issues. Monitoring \& Observability * Partner with monitoring team to create logging, alerting and dashboards for AI infrastructure and workloads. * Define service\-level objectives and operational thresholds for AI platforms, including model endpoint availability, latency, throughput, and error rates. * Support incident response, root cause analysis and problem management for AI\-related infrastructure events; drive preventive actions and automation to reduce recurrence. jobs.description: The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company's growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, paltforms and sercices globally. This role offers strong mentorship and opportunities to grow your technical depth in LLMs, agentic systems, and production AI engineering. This is not a research\-only role. Candidates are required to have a bachelor’s degree * **Preferred Qualifications** * Exposure to LLM tooling, prompt engineering, RAG, or agent frameworks through work, coursework, or personal projects. * Internship or early\-career experience in fintech or other regulated environments. * Contributions to open\-source projects, hackathons, or side projects related to AI or developer tooling. jobs.description: **Software Engineer, One Data Platform** American Express is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer to join the One Data platform team within Enterprise Architecture. This role is a key part of the organization’s technology strategy and supports the design, development, and delivery of scalable platform capabilities that enable engineering teams across the enterprise to build and deploy microservices at scale. Enterprise Architecture plays a critical role in shaping the company’s technology direction through four core pillars: Architecture as Code, Architecture as Design, Governance, and Colleague Enablement. The One Data platform team is focused on building foundational technologies that empower teams across American Express to deliver modern, resilient, and high\-performing software solutions. * 5\+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in Java and working knowledge of Python for backend or data\-driven applications. * Deep experience with Java ecosystems and frameworks such as Spring, Spring Boot, or equivalent technologies. * Proven experience in full\-stack development, including backend services and modern frontend frameworks such as React, Angular, or similar. * Strong experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs, microservices, and service\-to\-service integrations. * Solid understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, scalability, and performance optimization. * Hands\-on experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or MongoDB. * Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes. * Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation. * Experience with messaging and streaming platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or JMS. * Practical experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and cloud\-native development patterns. * Hands\-on experience in test data generation, unit testing, and test execution. * Experience with API design standards, Open API/Swagger, versioning, and contract\-driven development. * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI. * Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies and modern software development lifecycle practices. Joining a team of welcoming individuals who are exceptional, yet unassuming. Diverse, yet uncompromising in unity. aligned with long\-term platform strategy. * Guide modernization, technical debt reduction, and adoption of emerging Salesforce capabilities that support evolving business needs. **DevOps, Quality, and Operational Excellence** * Advance CI/CD, automated prise integration experience. * Experience improving DevOps maturity within enterprise technology organizations. * SAFe experience, including Agile Release Trains (ARTs) and PI Planning. * Commitment to the non\-profit sector and its values * Prior experience in nonprofit, humanitarian, or mission\-driven organizations. * Ability to clearly articulate hands\-on involvement in prior work. **Preferred Certifications** : * Salesforce Platform Developer I Certification. * Salesforce Platform Developer II Certification. * Salesforce Our products sit at the edge of these systems, processing data and providing real\-time control where it happens, when it happens, not in a distant cloud. Founded in 1995 and headquartered in Taiwan, we operate across the US, UK, Singapore, China, Japan, Korea, and Germany with products deployed in more than 40 countries. jobs.title: QA Automation Engineer - AI
jobs.description: At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market. What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers' success and to our Winning Culture. Our customers rank among the who's who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform. Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small. Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you'll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let's build what's next \- together! We're pioneering a new role focused exclusively on quality assurance for GenAI/Agentic systems. As our **QA Automation Engineer within AI**, you'll develop testing strategies, evaluation frameworks, and quality metrics specifically designed for LLM\-powered applications. This role requires a unique blend of QA expertise, understanding of GenAI behaviour, and automation skills to ensure our AI features are reliable, accurate, and trustworthy. **Your Impact** * Develop and execute end\-to\-end automated test coverage across evaluations, APIs, UIs, and performance tests using Python. * Implement testing strategies for GenAI features, including conversational AI, agentic systems, and LLM\-powered workflows within your workstream. * Run and maintain automated test suites for prompt testing, including regression tests designed to detect unintended changes in model behaviour. * Support and maintain evaluation frameworks to measure GenAI performance across accuracy, relevance, safety, consistency, and latency. * Contribute to curating high\-quality test datasets and "golden examples" that represent diverse user scenarios and edge cases. * Assist with adversarial testing to identify potential model hallucinations or biases, and support integrating production alerting systems. * Utilize internal tools and testing frameworks to help developers easily validate their GenAI code, and assist with user acceptance testing. * Take accountability for your workstream's automated coverage, documenting testing procedures and known issues in clear, accessible formats. **Your Skills** * Solid QA or test engineering experience, with exposure to or a keen interest in AI/ML systems. * Hands\-on Python coding experience. * Good understanding of GenAI technologies including LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI application patterns. * Solid experience with test automation frameworks and scripting (Python, Pytest, API, and UI Testing). * Practical knowledge of software testing methodologies (functional, integration, regression, performance, security testing). * Ability to execute test cases and evaluate criteria for non\-deterministic systems. * Experience with API testing tools (Postman, REST Assured) and backend testing. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing integration. \#LI\-SP1 **Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren't just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it's how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. **Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals. Anaplan does not: * Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person. * Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication. All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence. **Privacy \& AI** **Notice** Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **AnewHealth is one of the** **nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home. We enable better outcomes for patients and the healthcare organizations who support them. Established in 2023 through the combination of ExactCare and Tabula Rasa HealthCare, we provide a suite of solutions that includes comprehensive pharmacy services; full\-service pharmacy benefit management; and specialized support services for Program of All\-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. With over 1,400 team members, we care for more than 100,000 people across all 50 states.** **Job Details** **Job Objective:** The Data Engineer will design, build, and support the data pipelines that power our analytics, reporting, and operational systems. This role's primary focus is developing and maintaining data pipelines within our Databricks environment, serving as an escalation point when production pipeline issues arise, and leading the migration of existing Azure Data Factory workflows and Azure Functions into Databricks. The individual is a hands\-on engineer who is comfortable owning pipelines end to end — from design and development through troubleshooting and optimization — and who can work cross\-functionally with data architects, analysts, and business stakeholders. **Responsibilities:** * Pipeline Development — Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines within Databricks, using PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake, and Databricks Workflows/Jobs. * Build ETL/ELT processes that ingest, transform, and deliver data from a variety of source systems into curated, analytics\-ready datasets. * Implement data quality checks, validation logic, and monitoring/alerting to ensure pipeline reliability and data accuracy. * Escalation \& Production Support — Act as a primary point of escalation for production data pipeline issues, performing root\-cause analysis, troubleshooting failures, and implementing timely fixes. * Partner with support and business teams to triage incoming issues, communicate status, and drive incidents to resolution within SLA. * Document recurring issues and implement long\-term fixes or process improvements to reduce future escalations. * Azure\-to\-Databricks Migration — Lead and execute the migration of existing Azure Data Factory pipelines and Azure Functions to the Databricks platform, re\-architecting logic as needed to leverage Databricks\-native capabilities. * Validate data parity and pipeline performance between legacy Azure\-based solutions and their Databricks replacements, ensuring a clean, low\-risk cutover. * Retire legacy Azure Data Factory/Azure Functions components once migrations are validated and stable. * Collaboration \& Best Practices — Collaborate with data architects, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical designs. * Follow version control, code review, and CI/CD best practices for all pipeline code and configuration. * Contribute to documentation of pipeline architecture, data flows, and operational runbooks * Embody AnewHealth’s Core Values in all communications and interactions. * Other duties as assigned. The above essential functions are representative of major duties of positions in this job classification. Specific duties and responsibilities may vary based upon departmental needs. Other duties may be assigned similar to the above consistent with knowledge, skills and abilities required for the job. Not all of the duties may be assigned to a position. **Qualifications:** These represent the desired qualifications of the ideal candidate. They are not meant to limit consideration for candidates who do not meet all of the standards listed. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Education:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience **Experience:** * Required: 3\+ years of experience as a Data Engineer building and supporting production data pipelines. * Hands\-on experience developing data pipelines in Databricks, including PySpark, Delta Lake, and Databricks Workflows/Jobs. * Experience with Azure Data Factory and/or Azure Functions, with the ability to interpret existing ADF pipelines/Functions and re\-implement them in Databricks. **Skills and Abilities:** * Strong SQL skills, including query optimization and experience with relational and dimensional data models. * Proficiency in Python for data engineering and pipeline automation. * Working knowledge of the broader Azure cloud ecosystem (e.g., Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL Database, Azure Key Vault). * Solid understanding of ETL/ELT design patterns, data warehousing concepts, and data quality/validation practices. * Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve production issues under time pressure. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Physical/Mental Demands:** \[Refer to Job Analysis Questionnaire and/or options below] * \[If Remote/home office]: This position is administrative in nature and will present physical demands requisite to a position requiring: hearing, seeing, sitting, standing, talking, and walking. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. * Must be able to commute to multiple site locations within assigned territory. May be necessary to work extended hours as needed. **Schedule:** This is a full\-time position with an expectation to work an average of 40 hours per week and be available outside of normal business hours to meet customer expectations on an ad\-hoc basis. Schedules are set to accommodate the requirements of the position and the needs of the organization and may be adjusted as needed. **Travel:** Travel may be required for special organization or department events, department team meetings, trade shows, conferences, and other client engagements. **Supervisory:** No This is a remote position. *AnewHealth offers a comprehensive benefit package for full\-time employees that includes medical/dental/vision, flexible spending, company\-paid life insurance and short\-term disability as well as voluntary benefits, 401(k), Paid Time Off and paid holidays. Medical, dental and vision coverage are effective 1st of the month following date of hire**.* **AnewHealth provides equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status, or other legally protected classification in the state in which a person is seeking employment. Applicants are encouraged to confidentially self\-identify when applying. Local applicants are encouraged to apply. We maintain a drug\-free work environment. Applicants must be eligible to work in this country.**

jobs.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Platform Acceleration
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ As of May 2026, Claude authored more than 80% of the code we merge. Writing a change is fast now, and the hard part is knowing it's correct and safe to ship. Platform Acceleration builds the internal tools that close that gap for Anthropic's product engineers, who own the Claude API, our SDKs, and the rest of the Claude Platform. We work like a small product team whose customers are other Anthropic engineers. We're looking for Staff\+ engineers with a backend and infrastructure background who care about developer experience and have built tools other engineers rely on. We prefer candidates who can work from our San Francisco office, and we'll also consider candidates based in Seattle. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Own the technical strategy and roadmap for your area, and make sure its hardest problems get solved, by you or through others * Stay hands\-on: design, build, and operate the tools that help Platform teams ship code faster * Define what it takes to trust a change, including changes written by Claude, and build the tooling that holds that bar before and after merge * Build agents that take on repetitive engineering work, such as diagnosing failures, fixing broken tests, and running migrations * Embed with partner teams to find their biggest sources of friction, validate a solution with them, and turn the fix into a product other teams can adopt * Measure developer experience and adoption, and use the data to decide what to build next * Move between building new tools and improving the shared systems teams already depend on, as priorities shift **You might be a good fit if you:** ----------------------------------- * Experience building and operating large\-scale backend services or distributed systems in production * Proficiency in Go, Python, Rust, or TypeScript * Deep experience with developer tooling, CI/CD, test infrastructure, or deployment systems * Experience with cloud infrastructure and container orchestration * Experience leading large, complex technical projects across teams, from an ambiguous problem to a tool people use * Clear written and verbal communication, with experience supporting internal partner teams * Interest in Anthropic's mission of building safe, beneficial AI **Preferred qualifications:** ----------------------------- * Experience at a startup or on a similarly small team, taking a product from zero to one and talking directly to your users * Substantial experience with agents that do engineering or other technical work * Experience building widely adopted CLI tools, developer\-facing services, GitHub automation, or open source developer tools * Depth in progressive delivery, observability, VM orchestration, sandboxed execution, or workflow orchestration * Experience working in a large monorepo * Enough full\-stack ability to put a usable interface on your tools * A point of view on how software engineering changes as agents write more of the code **Deadline to apply:** None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. **Location Preference:** Preference will be given to candidates based in NY, SEA, SF or the Bay Area given the current location of team. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 \- $485,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

With our deep expertise in the health care domain, solid resource base, constant industry interface and the drive to be the best in the industry, we strive to provide services that re\-define health care in the years to come. The secret to our success is Appex Innovations commitment to our people and our work. We thrive on teamwork, intelligence, and innovation. Our bright and energetic employees, hailing from over different parts of the world, share a passion for leading the way to improved healthcare outcomes. Together we work diligently to add value to our clients. **Job Description** ------------------- **Job Details:** Title: Senior Full Stack Python Developer. Location: Remote (USA). Type: Contractual. leaders, solutions architects, and technical/ functional leads across Guidehouse digital teams and market segments to support client projects and provide solutions for growth efforts and capabilities build\-out. * Serve as a key member of the modernization team to support technical challenges/demos, building innovative solution prototypes using cloud architectures and software technologies. * Solutions architecture and hands\-on engineering/full\-stack development of scalable and secure distributed systems using modern software technologies and programming, Cloud Native and microservices architecture, containerization, and API\-First design patterns. * Work collaboratively with user experience designers, platform engineers, product owners, solution architects, and business analysts, the Cloud Applications Full Stack Developer will design, build, test, and deploy high\-value, operationally resilient software products on the AWS cloud platform that satisfy functional and non\-functional requirements. **What You Will Need:** * A bachelor's degree is required, or a Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience * Minimum of SIX (6\) years of prior relevant experience in full\-stack application development * Minimum of THREE (3\) years of experience with cloud applications development to build /modernize applications and datasets on the AWS cloud * Experience and proficiency in implementing frontend and backend services for cloud\-native software products and solutions such as Python, JavaScript, Django and Vue.JS. * The must\-have skills include proficiency in Python and JavaScript. * For Django experience, candidates can alternatively have experience with Flask, FastAPI, Falcon, or SQLAlchemy. * Similarly, for Vue.JS experience, alternatives include React, Svelte, or Angular (version 1\.6 or higher). * Proven ability to work autonomously and collaborate, mentor, help, and support other team members, as needed, to solve complex technical problems. * Proven ability to develop software products and solution prototypes and use prototypes to validate technical solution strategies and communicate and explain the pros and cons of complex design alternatives. * An in\-depth understanding of Agile and Scaled Agile practices and principles, with experience. Must be an experienced Agile practitioner with proven ability to plan and implement software products with agility. **What Would Be Nice To Have:** * Certification: AWS Certified Developer – Amazon Web Services * Flask, Docker, EKS/Kubernetes, AWS Step Functions, Event Bridge, AWS Lambda, AWS API Gateway, Elasticsearch, Caching frameworks, Redis, Memcached, the Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) for Postgres, and/or the MongoDB NoSQL database service. * Certification: AWS Certification Solutions Architect \- Amazon Web Services * Solution architecture support for technical volumes of proposals and white papers for RFPs/RFIs and thought leadership initiatives. * Familiarity with the AWS Serverless Application Model (SAM) and proven design patterns, like Model\-View\-Controller, is required, as is the ability to design and build cloud\-based software products that conform to the AWS Well\-Architected Framework design principles. * Proficiency in delivering cloud\-based software products using contemporary CI/CD pipeline tooling and the ability to continuously collaborate with development, operations, and security (DevSecOps) team members to deliver secure and operationally resilient software products and solutions. * This is a hands\-on cloud software developer/engineering position and requires the ability to proficiently and predictably build and deploy custom applications in the AWS cloud. * Proven ability to design, build, test, and deploy software products and solutions on the AWS cloud platform.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer 1
jobs.description: If you want to accelerate your career growth and are passionate about applying your expertise to solve problems of national importance, then we have an amazing opportunity for you! You will be able to achieve your personal and professional goals in an environment that emphasizes and rewards the entrepreneurial spirit. Not only will you solve challenging core problems, you will be able to grow your career in an exciting environment that promotes teamwork and cross\-training in a wide range of related disciplines. ARA’s Integrated Products Division is seeking a Software Engineer at our Greenville, SC location. You will join a dynamic team working on our Robotic, Sensor, and Geotechnical product lines working closely with other Software, Electrical and Mechanical Engineers to solve complex problems. You will be part of a team that designs, prototypes, integrates, and troubleshoots next generation technology: bringing state of the art ground and aerial vehicle robotic solutions to both our warfighter and commercial customers. Our technology stack is diverse and varies per product but most recently it ranges from embedded Linux to Windows applications and Android devices using a variety of programming languages: C, modern C\+\+, C\#, Java, Flutter and Rust while our development infrastructure includes Gitlab and Gitlab CI for continuous integration. Our robotics stack is heavily based around C\+\+ and ROS 1 and ROS 2 while using NixOS for deployment. * **What you’ll do as a Software Engineer 1** * + Work with a team to develop Open and Modular Software Architectures on a variety of platforms during all phases of development: requirements generation through product delivery and support. + Integrate sensors, algorithms and software for optionally manned and optionally autonomous robotic systems. + Work on a collaborative team with other software developers, electrical and mechanical engineers, program managers, and technicians. + Develop application software for sensor and platform control systems for both the defense and commercial products. * **Software Engineer 1 Requirements** * + BS Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent + 2\-4 years of experience + C/C\+\+, C\#, Python, Java, Rust or other modern object\-oriented programming + Familiarity with Linux (preferably NixOS or Ubuntu) + Experience with software application design and development principals and standards + Ability to develop in a Linux environment + Experience with git + Due to the nature of the work, qualified candidates must be current US Citizens * **Software Engineer 1 Preferences** * + Familiarity with Linux and Windows development + Experience with embedded systems and/or electrical engineering + Automotive experience + Experience with CI/CD (Gitlab CI, Jenkins, Circle CI, Travis etc.) + Robotics, ROS 1 or ROS 2 + Familiarity with C\+\+, Python, CMake, Nix + Familiarity with NGC2 requirements + Familiarity with TAK systems a plus + Familiarity with UI development on handheld devices for controlling systems + Familiarity with MAVLink, Ardupilot, Mission Planner or QGroundControl + Integration of communication amongst multiple optionally manned or autonomous vehicles + Experience with CAN Bus + Familiarity with Control Theory + Ability to read a schematic + Networking + Video decoding + Sensors or robotic autonomy algorithm (CPU or GPU based) development + Computer Vision + Machine Learning ARA is an employee\-owned international research and engineering company recognized for providing technically superior solutions to complex and challenging problems in the physical sciences. The company, founded in Albuquerque, NM, in 1979, currently employs over 2,300 professionals and is rapidly growing. ARA offices throughout the United States and Canada provide a broad range of technical expertise in defense technologies, civil technologies, computer software and simulation, systems analysis, environmental technologies, and testing and measurement. The corporation also provides sophisticated technical products for environmental site characterization, pavement analysis, and robotics. At ARA, employees are our greatest assets. We realize that employee ownership spawns greater creativity and initiative along with higher performance and customer satisfaction levels. ARA gives its employees the tools, training, and opportunities to take more active roles as owners. The culture is challenging; innovation and experimentation are the norm. Employees are eligible for contributions which not only add to the company’s success, but also their own through the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). Our motto is “Engineering and Science That Matters for Fun \& Profit” and we live our core values of *Passion, Freedom, Service* and *Growth* every day. #### **Experience** Required* 2 \- 4 years: Experience related to the position #### **Education** Required* Bachelor of Science or better in Software Engineering or related field #### **Behaviors** Preferred* Innovative: Consistently introduces new ideas and demonstrates original thinking * Team Player: Works well as a member of a group * Detail Oriented: Capable of carrying out a given task with all details necessary to get the task done well #### **Motivations** Preferred* Growth Opportunities: Inspired to perform well by the chance to take on more responsibility * Flexibility: Inspired to perform well when granted the ability to set your own schedule and goals * Self\-Starter: Inspired to perform without outside help * Goal Completion: Inspired to perform well by the completion of tasks Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Job ID** 2025\-14553 **Date posted** Oct. 12, 2026 **Location** Austin, Texas **Category** Software Engineering **Job Description:** -------------------- We are building a central AI control plane to support the safe, scalable, and efficient use of AI across Arm’s engineering teams. This hands\-on platform engineering role will help deliver and own the runtime platforms that make AI services reliable, secure, observable and supportable at Arm scale. You will work across Kubernetes, cloud, identity, secrets, networking, telemetry, incident management and automation to provide the production foundation for Arm’s AI platform. You will initially contribute in three key areas: **Production AI runtime platforms:** * Build/deploy and operate the infrastructure for centrally hosted AI platform services, including MCP server infrastructure, model gateway services and supporting control\-plane components. * Design runtime patterns for isolation, scalability, secure execution, capacity management and cost\-aware operation. * Automate provisioning, configuration, upgrades and lifecycle management using infrastructure\-as\-code and GitOps patterns. **Reliability, observability and support:** * Define and implement service\-level indicators, service\-level objectives, alerting, dashboards, runbooks and support workflows. * Incident response, post\-incident review and vendor outage handling for AI services embedded in engineering workflows. * Build telemetry that helps Arm understand AI platform health, usage, performance, cost and operational risk. **Secure operations by default:** * Ensure platform components meet production readiness, security and compliance expectations. * Help make secure AI usage the default by providing reliable paved paths rather than manual or fragmented infrastructure. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * Build, operate and continuously improve the production infrastructure for Arm’s AI platform services, using both custom and third party solutions. * Own reliability, scalability, monitoring, alerting, incident response, runbooks and operational readiness for AI platform components. * Develop automation for provisioning, deployment, configuration, backup, recovery, patching, upgrades and lifecycle management. * Implement secure runtime patterns, including workload isolation, secrets management, identity integration, network controls and auditability. * Participate in production support and our paid on\-call rota for high impact incident response. **Required Skills and Experience:** ----------------------------------- * Familiarity with AI platform concepts such as model routing, MCP servers, agentic workflows, RAG systems or LLM observability. * Strong experience deploying and operating production infrastructure or platform services in a Linux\-based environment using Kubernetes, containers, cloud or private\-cloud platforms, infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD/GitOps tooling. * Strong automation and scripting skills, for example Terraform, Go, Python or similar. * Experience with incident management, problem management, demand forecasting, and production readiness practices. * Good understanding of security fundamentals for production platforms, including identity, secrets, access control, network segmentation, vulnerability management and audit logging. **“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience :** ------------------------------------------ * Experience operating internal developer platforms, AI platforms, model gateways, MCP infrastructure or other shared engineering platforms. * Experience with service mesh, policy\-as\-code, workload identity, sandboxing, secure runtime environments or multi\-tenant platform designs. * Experience with regulated or security\-sensitive engineering environments. * Solid understanding of Open AI tools, products and APIs. **In Return:** -------------- Joining Arm means being part of a world\-class team that is high\-reaching and determined to achieve outstanding results. You will collaborate with industry leaders and innovators, contributing to flawless service builds that improve our global operations. We provide an encouraging and inclusive environment that encourages continuous learning and professional growth. Your success is our success, and together we can build services that compete on the world stage! **Salary Range:** ----------------- $161,500\-$218,500 per year We value people as individuals and our dedication is to reward people competitively and equitably for the work they do and the skills and experience they bring to Arm. Salary is only one component of Arm's offering. The total reward package will be shared with candidates during the recruitment and selection process. **Our 10x Mindset** ------------------- At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed.
