jobs.title: Senior Scientist, Bioinformatics / Computational Biology
jobs.description: **Location** Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States **Job ID** R\-261783 **Date posted** 12/10/2026 Are you ready to harness **multi\-omics**, **comparative genomics**, and **agentic AI** to accelerate vaccines and immune therapies from discovery to the clinic? In this role, you will transform complex human and pathogen datasets into clear, decision\-driving insights that shape **antigen design**, **patient stratification**, and **translational strategy** across high\-priority programs. Based in **Cambridge****, MA** you will work in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment alongside **immunologists**, **molecular biologists**, and **data scientists**. If you thrive at the intersection of computation and experiment—designing reproducible pipelines on **HPC** and cloud platforms while partnering closely with the lab to iterate rapidly—this role offers the opportunity to influence study design, guide **go/no\-go decisions**, and help advance novel immune\-based therapies toward patients. **Accountabilities** * You will design, implement, and deliver robust analyses across **genomics**, **bulk and single\-cell transcriptomics**, and **multi\-omics** to answer program\-critical questions with statistical rigor. You will assemble genomes, call variants, and perform **comparative genomics** and **phylogenetic analyses** on bacterial and viral pathogens to inform antigen selection and surveillance strategy. * You will apply **machine learning** and statistical modeling to discover biomarkers, stratify patients, predict antigen immunogenicity, and forecast treatment response, translating model outputs into actionable program recommendations. You will also build, optimize, and maintain reproducible workflows using **HPC schedulers** and **AWS** to scale analyses, reduce turnaround time, and ensure traceability. In addition, you will design and integrate **LLM\-powered agentic workflows** for literature mining, data extraction, and pipeline orchestration to accelerate discovery and improve developer productivity. Working closely with experimental scientists, you will propose computationally informed experiments, interpret results, and refine study designs to improve confidence and reduce cycle time. You will generate translational insights through **differential expression**, **pathway enrichment**, and **functional annotation**, connecting molecular signals to biological mechanisms and clinical hypotheses. You will produce publication\-quality visualizations and reports, present findings clearly to cross\-functional stakeholders, and champion **version control**, **workflow managers**, and **reproducible research practices** to strengthen code quality and method sharing across programs. Finally, you will stay current with emerging tools in **bioinformatics**, **AI/ML**, and **agentic AI**, piloting new approaches, sharing learnings, and scaling successful methods across the portfolio. **Essential Skills and Experience** * You should have a **PhD** in **Bioinformatics**, **Computational Biology**, **Genomics**, **Molecular Biology**, **Computer Science**, or a closely related quantitative discipline, with **2****–5** **years of industry experience**. * Alternatively, you may have an **MS** in a relevant discipline with **4****–6** **years of industry experience** in bioinformatics, computational biology, or genomics. * A demonstrated track record of independent research through **publications**, **conference presentations**, or successful project delivery is expected. * You should bring proficiency in **R** and/or **Python** for genomic data analysis, statistical computing, and data visualization, including tools such as **ggplot2**, **Bioconductor**, **tidyverse**, **pandas**, and **scikit\-learn**. * Hands\-on experience with **NGS data analysis** is required, including alignment tools such as **STAR**, **BWA**, and **Bowtie2**; quantification tools such as **Salmon**, **featureCounts**, and **HTSeq**; and variant calling tools such as **GATK** and **bcftools**. * You should be familiar with **RNA\-seq analysis workflows**, including **differential expression** methods such as **DESeq2**, **edgeR**, and **limma**, as well as pathway analysis and gene set enrichment approaches such as **ssGSEA** and **MSigDB**. Experience working in **Linux/Unix** environments and with **HPC job schedulers** such as **SLURM**, **SGE**, or **PBS**, and/or cloud computing platforms such as **AWS** or **GCP**, is important. You should also have working knowledge of **Git/GitHub** and reproducible research practices, including **Nextflow** or similar workflow managers. A solid understanding of **molecular biology fundamentals**, **genome annotation**, and public bioinformatics databases such as **NCBI**, **Ensembl**, **UniProt**, and **PDB** is required, along with foundational knowledge of **machine learning concepts** and applied statistics relevant to biomarker discovery and genomic data. Success in this role will also require strong analytical thinking, creative problem\-solving, and the ability to translate complex datasets into actionable biological insights. You should have excellent written and verbal communication skills, a collaborative mindset, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results within timelines. Desirable Skills and Experience Experience in at least one therapeutic area—**infectious diseases**, **oncology**, or **inflammatory disease**—would be valuable. We also welcome experience with **comparative genomics** and **microbial or viral genome analysis**, including **pangenome methods**, **AMR gene detection**, and **phylogenetics**. Additional desirable experience includes building **predictive and prognostic models** using supervised and unsupervised machine learning methods on clinical or preclinical omics data; familiarity with **deep learning frameworks** such as **PyTorch** and **TensorFlow**; and exposure to **biological foundation models** such as **ESM**, **EvolutionaryScale**, **scGPT**, **TranscriptFormer**, and **Evo**. We also value experience with or strong interest in **agentic AI workflows** for bioinformatics, including **LLM\-orchestrated pipelines**, **retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG)** for scientific literature, and tool\-using AI agents that interact with databases and analysis tools. Proficiency with AI\-assisted coding tools such as **Claude Code** or **GitHub Copilot** is a plus. Exposure to **single\-cell RNA\-seq** tools such as **Seurat**, **Scanpy**, and **CellRanger**; knowledge of **structural biology tools**, **protein modeling**, or **antigen/antibody design**; and experience with **containerization** and **infrastructure\-as\-code** would also be beneficial. Familiarity with **LLM APIs** and prompt engineering for scientific applications, including structured output generation and multi\-agent system design, is also desirable. Why AstraZeneca At **AstraZeneca**, ambitious science meets everyday collaboration. Here, bioinformaticians, immunologists, clinicians, and engineers come together to share knowledge openly, challenge ideas constructively, and learn from setbacks as they work toward better solutions. You will contribute across diverse therapy areas, with visibility into decisions that matter and support from leaders who encourage experimentation and innovation. We pair rigorous scientific standards with creativity and value kindness alongside ambition. Most importantly, we connect each individual’s contribution to a clear purpose: translating insights into medicines that can change patients’ lives. If you are ready to turn **data**, **models**, and **modern AI** into faster, smarter decisions for patients, we encourage you to apply and show us how you can make an impact from day one. *The annual base pay for this position ranges from $115,992\.00 \- $172,671\.60\. Our positions offer eligibility for various incentives—an opportunity to receive short\-term incentive bonuses, equity\-based awards for salaried roles and commissions for sales roles. Benefits offered include qualified retirement programs, paid time off (i.e., vacation, holiday, and leaves), as well as health, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.* **Date Posted** 13\-Oct\-2026 **Closing Date** 30\-Oct\-2026 Our mission is to build an inclusive environment where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. In furtherance of that mission, we welcome and consider applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of their protected characteristics. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please complete the corresponding section in the application form.

jobs.title: ML Engineer, Behavior Planning
jobs.description: **Who we are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. **What we are looking for** Aurora hires talented people with diverse backgrounds who are ready to help build a transportation ecosystem that will make our roads safer, get crucial goods where they need to go, and make mobility more efficient and accessible for all. We are seeking a ML Engineer to join the Behavior Planning Team. This is a high\-impact role where you will sit at the frontier of autonomous vehicle technology. You won't just be applying AI and ML methods; you will be advancing the state\-of\-the\-art for how a self\-driving system reasons about the world, interacts with humans on the road, and masters complex, high\-dimensional decision\-making. **In this role you will** * Define the architecture of our onboard planning models: Develop and deploy large\-scale models trained with Imitation Learning and Reinforcement Learning that enable the Aurora Driver to navigate complex environments with human\-like fluidity and superhuman safety. * Revolutionize evaluation: Develop powerful offboard critic models that can evaluate driving behavior at scale, identifying subtle nuances in comfort, progress, and safety that traditional heuristics miss. * Build our next\-generation simulation engine: Architect cutting\-edge offboard foundation models that power our simulation engine, creating realistic "world models" to test the Aurora Driver against an infinite variety of edge cases. * Bridge research and production: Reach new frontiers of autonomous driving technology by pushing forward the state\-of\-the\-art, but also deploy your models on real production vehicles that drive on public roads and must meet the highest standards of safety. **Required qualifications** * BS, MS, or PhD in Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. * 2\+ years of experience developing state\-of\-the\-art ML models, either in a research or production setting. * Hands\-on experience working on Imitation Learning or Reinforcement Learning applied to physical or simulated agents. * Experience training large models on massive datasets using distributed computing. * Fluency in Python, with a focus on writing high\-performance, maintainable code. * Deep experience with PyTorch (preferred) or another modern ML framework, and a mastery of modern ML architectures including Transformers and Diffusion Models. jobs.description: Job ID 26WD101603 Job ID 26WD101603 **Job Requisition ID \#** 26WD101603 **Position Overview** We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and operate resilient, scalable, high\-performing services for the Product Access platform, which supports the access experience for millions of Autodesk users worldwide. You will own end\-to\-end solution design and delivery across the full engineering lifecycle and use spec\-driven development and agentic systems to build, operate, and support Product Access in production, including agent\-based automation for engineering and operational workflows. This role includes shared production on\-call responsibilities as part of end\-to\-end service ownership. You will report to the Senior Engineering Manager and collaborate closely with Product Managers, Architects, Domain Leads, and cross\-functional stakeholders across Product Access and beyond. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and operate resilient, scalable, high\-performing cloud\-native Java microservices and distributed systems on AWS for the Product Access platform * Own business features and platform initiatives end to end, from requirement analysis through production support, working with product and engineering partners on design, testing, and operational readiness * Enhance system resiliency, reliability, scalability, and security; optimize performance, troubleshoot production issues, and implement engineering best practices across development and delivery pipelines * Lead project delivery by organizing scope, estimating effort, establishing timelines, and driving medium\-to\-large initiatives independently * Apply spec\-driven development in platform and feature delivery * Build and extend agentic systems and automation: composable skills, MCP integrations, and knowledge retrieval grounded in runbooks, tickets, and service documentation * Deliver proactive triage and write\-action automation with human\-in\-the\-loop gates where required, progressing toward autonomous design\-to\-delivery workflows * Enforce production standards for agentic systems through evaluation, CI quality gates, and end\-to\-end observability across agents and services * Provide production support; lead incident response and root cause analysis; participate in a shared on\-call rotation for production systems, including support outside standard business hours per team schedule; mentor engineers and uphold sound engineering practices **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * 6\+ years of progressive software engineering experience building and operating Java microservices and serverless architectures in production * Strong Java and Spring Boot skills; solid unit, integration, and system testing; strong debugging in local and integrated environments * Hands\-on experience building or integrating AI\-powered systems: agents, LLM\-based applications, RAG, or tool\-calling workflows * Experience with spec\-driven development (SDD) * Experience with event\-driven streaming (Kinesis, Kafka, or equivalent), containers on AWS (Docker, ECS Fargate), CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), and core AWS services (Lambda, DynamoDB, messaging, API gateways, logging, monitoring) * Strong collaboration and communication skills; effective in small teams with shared end\-to\-end ownership of design, delivery, and production support **Preferred Qualifications** * Proficiency in Python and FastAPI; experience building MCP servers or equivalent tool\-use frameworks for AI agents * Experience with RAG, proactive or event\-driven agents, and applying agentic AI to engineering workflows, operational automation, or DevOps * Experience designing LLM evaluation frameworks, multi\-agent patterns, and human\-in\-the\-loop review gates * Familiarity with high\-volume event pipelines (Kinesis/Kafka streaming, REST publish, SNS/SQS/DLQ patterns), Gradle or Maven, OpenTelemetry, and AI tracing tools (Opik, LangSmith, or equivalent) * Understanding of policy\-based access control (OPA), authentication for AI systems (OAuth, Entra ID), and Responsible AI practices **Technologies we use** * **Platform:** Java, Spring Boot; Python, FastAPI (agentic); AWS (ECS Fargate, Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, OpenSearch); Docker; GitHub; Jenkins / GitHub Actions; Gradle / Maven * **Streaming \& events:** Kinesis, Kafka, REST publish, SNS/SQS fan\-out, DLQ handling, checkpointed consumers, multi\-language event SDKs * **Observability \& ops:** Splunk, Kibana, Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry; Jira, Slack * **Agentic AI:** LLM agents, MCP, RAG and vector retrieval, spec\-driven development, evaluation and CI quality gates for production AI * **Security \& access:** OAuth, Entra ID, OPA and policy\-based access control *Exposure to equivalent technologies is welcome.* **Learn More** **About Autodesk** Welcome to Autodesk! jobs.title: Lead IBM iPlatform Engineer
jobs.description: What You'll Do: The Lead Software Engineer (iConnector) leads the team responsible for the Avalara IBM isoftware development kit, including design, build, testing, maintenance, and support. This role ensures Avalara customers and partners using IBM i systems have reliable connector capabilities that support accurate tax compliance and business continuity. This role is needed because the current manager is approaching retirement, creating a need for leadership continuity, product knowledge transfer, and sustained execution. The manager maintains and improves existing IBM isoftware development kit connectors, supports Sales teams and partners with technical demos and product questions, and identifies new IBM iconnector opportunities, including potential electronic invoicing applications. The role exists to improve connector reliability, keep customer cost per order low for IBM icustomers, and create new ways for Avalara to serve customers and partners on the IBM iplatform. **How This Role Elevates Avalara** This role strengthens Avalara’s ability to serve customers and partners who rely on IBM isystems by providing technical leadership for IBM i connector questions, issues, demos, and escalations. The manager brings expertise in a profitable but specialized technology platform that is not widely understood across Avalara. IBM icustomers contribute approximately $17 million in annual recurring revenue. This role protects that revenue by maintaining reliable software development kit connectors, keeping cost per order low, reducing churn risk, and ensuring customer escalations are resolved quickly. The manager also improves team execution by maintaining accurate technical documentation, reducing single points of knowledge, and ensuring new releases are fully tested before they are made available to customers. \#LI\-Remote What Your Responsibilities Will Be: * Lead, coach, and develop direct reports who design, build, test, release, and support Avalara’s IBM i software development kit connectors. * Own the IBM i software development kit delivery plan, including priorities, commitments, risks, and communication with Product Management and Engineering stakeholders. * Ensure connector releases meet quality, reliability, and supportability expectations before they are made available to customers and partners. * Drive timely resolution of customer escalations by coordinating engineering analysis, clear communication, and durable fixes. * Support Sales, partners, and customer\-facing teams with IBM i technical expertise, including product questions, demos, and solution guidance. * Maintain accurate technical documentation and knowledge\-sharing practices that reduce single points of knowledge and improve support readiness. * Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to align IBM i connector investments with customer needs, revenue protection, and cost per order goals. * Identify and evaluate new IBM i connector opportunities, including electronic invoicing applications, that expand Avalara’s value for IBM i customers and partners. **12\-Month Success Signals:** * Existing IBM i software development kit connectors remain stable, supported, and ready for customer and partner use. * Customer escalations are resolved within agreed service expectations, with clear communication and durable fixes. * IBM i customer cost per order remains controlled, with the current score of 8 maintained or improved. * A delivery plan is defined for new IBM i opportunities, including potential electronic invoicing applications. * Documentation and knowledge transfer are strong enough to reduce dependency on the retiring manager and support long\-term continuity. * Direct reports demonstrate stronger ownership, execution quality, and release discipline. What You'll Need to be Successful: * Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or Engineering. * 10\+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including hands\-on experience with IBM i systems. * 3\+ years of people management experience, including coaching, performance management, and team delivery ownership. * Experience with RPG IV (ILE RPG). Both free format and fixed format versions. * Experience with Control Language Program, systems analysis, application development, project management, change control, process improvement, documentation, research, and training. * Some experience with Open\-Source functionality on the IBMi (e.g. PASE runtime, Python, Node.js, PHP, Git, nginx, OpenSSH etc.) * Experience leading software delivery across design, build, test, release, and production support. * Ability to build effective working relationships with customers, partners, Sales, Product Management, and Engineering stakeholders. Avalara is an AI\-first Company: AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here. * You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers. * You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too. How We'll Take Care of You: Total Rewards In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses. Health \& Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance. Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship. What You Need To Know About Avalara: We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech. We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world. We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too. **We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer** Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer, Axon 911
jobs.description: #### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.** At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other. Life at Axon is fast\-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter. Axon 911 brings together Prepared and Carbyne under Axon. Together, we are creating the only platform that combines modern 911 infrastructure with an AI intelligence layer, helping public safety agencies move faster, make better decisions, and deliver better outcomes in the moments that matter most. 911 is the backbone of public safety, yet the professionals behind it have long been held back by outdated technology. Axon 911 is here to change that. Joining this team means more than taking a job. It means helping shape the future of emergency response and building a safer, more connected world. * **This role will be hybrid: 4x a week in the NY office.** **Your Impact** * Lead network projects, including network establishment, upgrades, expansions, and migrations. * Configure and maintain traditional networking infrastructure, including Fortinet firewalls and Cisco switches and routers, and implement security best practices. * Monitor network performance and troubleshoot issues, ensuring maximum uptime and reliability in a mission\-critical live system. * Thrive in a fast\-paced environment, managing multiple tasks and shifting priorities while resolving complex problems independently. * Collaborate with vendors and service providers to build and resolve network\-related challenges. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior network engineers. **What You'll Do** We are currently seeking a highly skilled Network Engineer to join our Global Operations team. In this role, you will focus primarily on network design and Infrastructure as Code, helping us scale the network that powers our innovative public safety products for national first responder systems (911\) and government sectors worldwide. You will play a key part in designing, deploying, and supporting the infrastructure that delivers the highest level of service to our customers 24/7\. **What You Bring** * Cloud Network Engineering (top priority): Strong hands\-on experience with AWS networking, including VPCs, Direct Connect, Route 53, and ingress/egress traffic flow. * Traditional Networking: Solid foundation in TCP/IP, VLANs, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VPNs, and DNS. Experience with Cisco and Fortinet equipment and SD\-WAN solutions is a plus. * Experience: Minimum 5 years of hands\-on experience in network engineering, preferably in a fast\-paced or critical service environment. * Responsibilities: Network design and deployment, with support as needed. * Troubleshooting Skills: Ability to analyze network logs, perform packet captures, and track down root causes for production issues. Exposure to monitoring tools (Datadog, PRTG) is a plus. * Soft Skills**:** Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical details clearly to team members and non\-technical stakeholders. #### **Benefits that Benefit You** * Competitive salary and 401k with employer match * Discretionary paid time off * Paid parental leave for all * Medical, Dental, Vision plans * Fitness Programs * Emotional \& Mental Wellness support * Learning \& Development programs * Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) * And yes, we have snacks in our offices *Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.* Don't meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long\-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve. Ensure leaders maintain effective observability, incident response, capacity planning, and tested disaster recovery and continuity plans—with rigor around peak\-season preparedness in a high\-stakes retail environment * Advance automation\-first quality engineering, CI/CD, deployment practices, and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle. jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer - Entry Level
jobs.description: Battelle delivers when others can’t. We conduct research and development, manage national laboratories, design and manufacture products and deliver critical services for our clients—whether they are a multi\-national corporation, a small start\-up or a government agency. We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply. **Job Summary** --------------- We are currently seeking an **AI/ML Engineer – Entry Level**. This position is a full\-time opportunity located in **Columbus, Ohio.** Battelle is seeking an AI/ML Engineer – Entry Level to help improve laboratory efficiency through practical AI, automation, and data solutions. Working alongside scientists, technicians, quality staff, and technology teams, this role will identify repetitive or time\-consuming work and develop tools that simplify laboratory workflows, reduce manual and redundant efforts, improve data quality, and support faster, more consistent operations — while capturing data for use in larger AI and machine learning initiatives. This is a hands\-on learning role. Initial projects may include AI\-assisted data review, sample and inventory tracking, workflow automation, dashboards, laboratory scheduling, document search, and tools that help staff access and use laboratory information more effectively. **Responsibilities** -------------------- As an AI/ML Engineer – Entry Level, the selected individual will develop and deploy practical AI and automation solutions that enhance laboratory operations and data quality. The salary range for this role is $71,200 – $101,400 per year, in addition to our comprehensive benefits package. A candidate's salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to education, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. Salary ranges may vary based on geographic location and market conditions. **Benefits: Live an Extraordinary Life** We care about your well\-being, not just on the job. Battelle offers comprehensive and competitive benefits to help you live your best life. * **Balance life through a compressed work schedule**: Most of our team follows a flexible, compressed work schedule that allows for every other Friday off—giving you a dedicated day to accomplish things in your personal life without using vacation time. * **Enjoy enhanced work flexibility, including a hybrid arrangement:** You have options for where and when you work. jobs.title: Process Engineer

The next step is putting agents to work across every team in the business. This is our first hire dedicated to making that happen. You’ll work with operations, sales, finance, and other non\-technical teams to find manual work worth automating. You’ll build agents in Claude and Copilot Studio, get them into daily use, and measure the time they save. Early on you’ll build most of them yourself, while teaching teams to build their own. You’ll have a big say in what we tackle first and how we build it. This is the first hire for what we plan to grow into a team, so a lot of what you set up early will stick. Beazley Security protects client data and systems for a living, so you’ll build security and privacy into every agent from the start. You’ll help us establish safeguards to ensure that agents can go into production quickly and safely, by building upon our existing agentic security tooling and capabilities.**Responsibilities** * Spend time with teams across the business, watch how the work gets done, and pick the problems where an agent saves hours or removes a manual, error\-prone step. Agree on what success looks like before you build. * Turn a stream of AI ideas into a short, ranked backlog with a clear call on each: build it, help the team build it, or leave it alone. * Estimate what each agent will cost to run, including licensing and token consumption. Use our pre\-agreed guardrails so low\-risk agents go live quickly, and bring in Security, IT, Legal, or Privacy when a use case needs a closer look. * Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents and supporting automation using the Claude Platform and Microsoft Copilot Studio. * Build a group of champions across the business, run hands\-on build sessions and office hours, and create the templates and playbooks teams use to build their own agents safely. * Help maintain a record of every agent in production with its owner, data sources, and access. Evaluate new AI tools when teams ask about them and recommend whether we adopt them. **Your First 90 Days** * **Days 1 to 30:** Get to know Beazley Security. Sit with at least three teams, map their most painful workflows, and build your first agent yourself. Get it into real use, even if it’s small. * **Days 31 to 60:** Two or three agents in production, each measured against a baseline of “value”. A published intake process, and your first AI champions identified. * **Days 61 to 90:** At least one team can point to manual work that’s gone. The agent register and build playbook are live. * **After that:** Champions build their own agents using your patterns, and your results justify the next hire onto this team. **What You'll Have** * Executive buy\-in and support. You report to our Chief Product and Technology Officer, who uses AI every day and has built several agents for internal use. Expect quick decisions and direct help when a project gets stuck. * A first project. A business sponsor and workflow lined up before day one. * A fast review path. Guardrails agreed with Security and Legal before you start, so low\-risk agents don’t sit in a queue. **Qualifications** * You’ve built AI agents or automations that are in daily use, with low\-code tools like Copilot Studio or with code (Python, TypeScript, and the Claude API). * You have hands\-on experience with prompt and context design, retrieval, tool use, and evaluating agent output, and you know where LLMs fail. * You’ve integrated with REST APIs, MCP servers, connectors, and enterprise authentication. * You’ve typically spent four or more years in a business\-facing technical role such as solutions engineering, solutions consulting, business analysis, automation, or platform delivery. * You can learn a finance or sales operations workflow from the people who run it and build something that improves it. * You know when a use case needs a security or privacy review before it goes anywhere, and you can estimate what an agent will cost to run on Copilot credits or Claude API usage. * You’ve run workshops or training for non\-technical audiences, and you write clearly. * You’d rather ship a small agent that works than constantly plan and iterate on a big one. **Preferred** * Experience in cybersecurity. * Experience running an AI champions program, community of practice, or citizen developer program. * Experience setting up lightweight AI guardrails, like an agent inventory or risk tiers, that keep teams moving quickly. * Familiarity EU data protection requirements. * **When you apply, please** **include a link or a short screen recording of something you built.** **Beazley Security Offers** * Competitive salary and bonus. * Flexible working arrangements. * Generous leave policies including 3 months paid parental. * 100% of employee\-only insurance premiums covered (healthcare, dental and vision). * Up to 5% matched 401k contribution. * Opportunities for career advancement and ongoing training. * Participation in industry conferences and events.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI
jobs.description: New York Engineering In office Full\-time **What is Bilt?** Bilt is the membership for where you live. What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants. Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once. We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens. This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here. **What is Bilt?** ----------------- Bilt is the membership for where you live. We started by rewarding people on their biggest expense, rent, and have grown into a network connecting members, property managers, and local merchants across dining, travel, fitness, and everyday spending. **The role** ------------ Concierge runs in the Bilt app, on the web, and over SMS, iMessage, and email. Members use it for dining, rent, payments, travel, and support. Restaurants and property managers use it to talk with their customers, and their staff use it as an assistant. It handles tens of thousands of conversations a day, with 2–3x spikes at the start of every month, and you'll build and run the backend behind all of it. **What you'll work on** ----------------------- * Agent capabilities end to end: tools, workflows, prompts, and the integrations with Bilt and partner systems behind them * The agent runtime: multi\-agent orchestration, context and memory, prompt caching, and routing across frontier and open\-weight models * Performance: p50 and p99 across the full request path, bursty traffic, and cost per conversation * Eval harnesses, LLM judges, and conversation replay, so every model and prompt change is measured before it ships * Assistants for merchants' staff that work from the business's own data, and browser agents that can act where no API exists * Proactive features that drive engagement with members and merchants' customers: briefings, follow\-ups, and outreach that land at the right moment * The conversation platform: one inbox where the agent, merchant staff, and Bilt support share threads across SMS, iMessage, email, web, and in\-app chat * Messaging: realtime streaming replies, attachments, message ordering and idempotent delivery, carrier and iMessage sending limits, and handing off to a person at the right moment * Authentication and fine\-grained authorization, so the agent only sees and does what it should for members, merchants, and staff **How we build** ---------------- We are an AI\-native team. Agents are part of how we write, review, debug, and operate everything. * **Writing.** Coding agents like Claude Code and Devin write much of our code. You design it, review it, and own what ships * **Reviewing.** Every PR gets AI review against rules we write down (prompt\-cache pitfalls, security, performance) before a human codeowner signs off * **Debugging.** Agents have access to our production tooling through an internal MCP gateway: logs, traces, analytics, feature flags, and the service catalog. Investigations usually start with an agent pulling the evidence * **Sharing context.** Repos carry agent instructions, and we keep a shared library of skills and playbooks, so recurring work becomes a single command and every agent starts with the team's context * **Owning.** Each engineer owns a large surface from design through rollout and on\-call. We ship daily behind flags, treat performance and availability as acceptance criteria, and read real conversations, not only dashboards **You have** ------------ * 4\+ years building and operating backend services in production * Strength in at least one backend language and experience running services in the cloud. We mostly use Python (FastAPI), Java (Quarkus), and Go on Google Cloud * Solid distributed systems fundamentals (async processing, pub/sub, idempotency, retries, caching), and you debug across services with logs, traces, and metrics * Hands\-on experience with LLMs, at work or on your own, and curiosity about making them reliable * Product judgment: you can read a bad conversation and tell whether the cause is the prompt, a tool, the data, or a service * Daily use of AI coding agents, and good judgment about when to trust their output * Clear writing. Design docs, PR descriptions, and the prompts you give agents all matter here **Bonus** --------- * Shipped an LLM\-powered feature to real users, and can explain what broke and how you measured it * Agent frameworks (Google ADK, LangGraph, or similar), tool calling, evals, LLM\-as\-judge * Model serving and inference: provider routing, open\-weight models, latency and cost tuning * Messaging or realtime infrastructure * Browser automation or computer\-use agents * Identity and access: OAuth/OIDC, token exchange, fine\-grained authorization **Benefits** ------------ * **Compensation** \- We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus program * **Health insurance for you (\& your loved ones) from day one \-** Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We’ve got you and your family covered from day one. * **401k plan with a match \-** Retirement may feel more like a pipe dream than a reality but we’re here to help you get there. * **Commuter FSAs \-** We believe the best ideas come from being together in one place. We just don’t think getting there should be so expensive. * **UNLIMITED PTO \-** Because we believe that working hard shouldn’t mean always working. Take time for yourself as often as you need it. * **Exclusive Employee only Bilt Points \-** We give our employees unique opportunities to earn points throughout their time at Bilt. * **Team Events \-** We believe in human connection so we hold events to help our employees break from the monotony of the typical work week. At Bilt Rewards, we believe in transparency and we do our best to make sure the company and our candidates are on the same page as it relates to compensation. In addition to posting salary ranges for our open roles, candidates should expect to be asked about compensation expectations and requirements early on in their interview process. Our goal is to highlight when expectations and Bilt’s salary range may be out of sync, and work with the candidate to determine whether it makes sense to continue conversations. We are considering candidates with differing levels of expertise for this position. Leveling will be based upon your experience and performance in the interview process. Where a new hire falls within a range will be based on their skills and experience, and how these competencies compare across other employees in the same role. Bilt's bands are designed to allow for individual compensation growth within the role. As such, new hires typically start at the lower end of the range. Bilt Rewards performance and outcomes \- should you join the company, you will have the opportunity to grow your salary over time. The salary range for a **Back End / AI Engineer** is **$170,000 \- $300,000** *(based on YOE/level)***,** and you will be eligible for equity and an annual performance\-based bonus. Req ID: R349

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer (IoT)
jobs.description: **Title:** Embedded Software Engineer (IoT) **Hours:** Full\-time **Location:** Midvale, UT (On\-site with occasional remote flexibility) \#LI\-Onsite **You report to:** Software Engineering Manager **Compensation:** A base salary range of $120,000\-$135,000 gross per year, depending on candidate experience. **Our Benefits:** * Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision plans with BioLite covering 90–100% of monthly premiums, depending on plan selection. * 401(k) with Employer Match * Paid Time Off: Paid holidays, vacation, sick time, and family leave to support work\-life balance. * Equity \& Bonus Opportunities: Community bonus plan and stock option eligibility for all full\-time employees. * Adventure Stipend (after two years): PTO to go on an adventure that aligns with BioLite's mission of bringing energy everywhere, whether that's outdoor recreation, climate action, or social impact. * Employee Product Discount: Employees enjoy generous discounts on BioLite and Goal Zero products. **This Role:** BioLite and Goal Zero have joined forces, and we are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to join our Midvale\-based team. In this role, you will develop the firmware that connects our power products to the cloud (AWS IoT) and to our Flutter and React Native mobile apps. You will work on the wireless connectivity modules in our home backup and portable power products. These modules work alongside battery management, inverter, and power conversion subsystems. You will focus on provisioning, OTA updates, device\-to\-cloud messaging, fleet telemetry, and the protocols among modules in the rest of the system. Our current products use the ESP32, and you will help choose and bring up the wireless platform for our next generation of products. Options we are looking at include embedded Rust (Embassy), embedded Linux, and smart home standards such as Matter and Thread. A large part of this job is making existing firmware better. You will refactor, add tests, and pay down technical debt so the team ships faster with fewer field issues. You will work with firmware, electrical, cloud, and mobile engineers. You will debug at the bench with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers, and your code will run on devices in homes and in the field. **You Will:** * **Develop connectivity\-module firmware:** Develop and maintain firmware for our Wi\-Fi and Bluetooth LE connectivity modules, including provisioning, configuration, OTA updates, and device\-to\-cloud messaging. * **Improve the codebase you inherit:** Refactor existing firmware, add unit and hardware\-in\-the\-loop tests, and set coding standards that make changes safe and code reviews fast. * **Build communication protocols:** Develop the protocol libraries that connect our subsystems (battery management, inverter, IoT module) to each other and to the mobile app. * **Lead the firmware build and release pipeline:** Maintain CI/CD in GitHub Actions for firmware builds, tests, and releases for your projects. Make OTA releases reliable and traceable. * **Work across the device\-to\-cloud path:** Work with cloud and mobile engineers on device APIs (AWS IoT), fleet telemetry, and app integration. Debug issues end\-to\-end, from the radio to the app. * **Use modern tools:** Use AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to speed up prototyping, debugging, testing, and documentation. * **Review and document:** Take part in code and design reviews. Document designs for other developers, QA, manufacturing partners, and support. **You Have:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; OR 5\+ years of directly relevant experience. * 3\+ years writing production firmware in C/C\+\+ for microcontrollers or SoCs (e.g., Espressif ESP32, Nordic nRF, ST STM32, or other Arm Cortex\-M). * Experience with a real\-time operating system (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr) and a wireless vendor SDK (e.g., ESP\-IDF, nRF Connect SDK). * Working knowledge of Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth LE, and an IoT messaging protocol such as MQTT. * Working knowledge of bootloaders, OTA updates, and device provisioning. * Working knowledge of serial communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN). * Experience testing embedded code (unit tests, simulation, or hardware\-in\-the\-loop). * Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript for build, test, and tooling scripts. * Experience with Git/GitHub, code review, and CI/CD. * Experience with AI coding assistants in your daily work. **Nice to Have:** You do not need the following skills to apply, but please let us know if you have experience in any of these areas. * Experience with AWS IoT Core or another cloud IoT platform, including REST APIs. * Experience with mobile app development (native, Flutter, or React Native). * Experience with smart home protocols such as Matter, Thread, Zigbee, or Z\-Wave. * Experience with or interest in embedded Rust (e.g., Embassy) or embedded Linux (e.g., Yocto, Buildroot). * Experience with fleet monitoring, device telemetry, or crash reporting. * Experience with consumer electronics, batteries, or power conversion. **To Apply:** * Please include a cover letter explaining why you're a good fit for this position. Feel free to link or describe a relevant personal project, hobby build, or open\-source contribution that highlights your firmware or software skills. * **You must be authorized to work for an employer in the U.S.** BioLite cannot sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa for this position. **About BioLite:** BioLite and Goal Zero have joined forces to power life, anywhere. Together, we provide clean energy solutions that serve two distinct yet connected markets: families living in energy poverty and outdoor adventurers seeking fuel\-independent power and light. From solar panels and portable power stations to cookstoves and lighting systems, our technologies help people cook, charge, and stay connected, whether at home, on the road, or off the grid. Rooted in innovation and motivated by impact, we're building a future where renewable energy is accessible to all. We believe in a bright and safe future, and that includes life at work. BioLite and Goal Zero are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace where everyone is encouraged to show up as their full selves. We know that inclusion makes our solutions better and our team stronger.

jobs.description: **About Bitdeer AI:** Bitdeer AI, a full\-stack AI cloud provider (AI Data Center, IaaS, PaaS, MaaS) under Bitdeer Technologies Group and a preferred NVIDIA Cloud Partner, is engineered to power the AI of tomorrow. With the group's 3 Gigawatts of power capacity deployed and under development globally, Bitdeer holds a decisive advantage in the AI era: the massive energy, physical infrastructure, and compute foundation required to run intelligence at global scale. Operating across strategic international hubs, including the United States, Singapore, and Europe, we build on one core promise: One Cloud, Infinite Possibilities. **Our Two Core Missions**: * Transforming Hyperscale Power into Useful AI: We take the extreme complexity of gigawatt\-scale energy grids, liquid\-cooled data center topologies, and low\-latency networking fabrics, and turn that raw physical power into accessible, high\-performance AI Cloud that directly drives real\-world intelligence. * Building an Integrated Full\-Stack Cloud Platform: We engineer the complete software layer, spanning bare\-metal provisioning, managed Kubernetes, distributed training pipelines, high\-throughput AI Inference engines, and Model\-as\-a\-Service (MaaS) with serverless APIs, empowering enterprises to seamlessly train, fine\-tune, deploy, and serve next\-generation AI intelligence. **We are seeking** **2027 New College Graduates:** Why Start Your Career at Bitdeer AI? We don't just look at the infrastructure layer, we build across the entire value chain for our full\-stack cloud. At Bitdeer AI, you will architect the actual backbone of global artificial intelligence. From foundation\-level hardware orchestration and low\-latency Inference systems to upper\-layer MaaS platforms and AI Agents environments, you will solve high\-scale systems challenges that few companies on Earth have the power capacity to attempt. Your work will directly power the global AI ecosystem, from ambitious startups and elite research institutions to global enterprises. Artificial intelligence is reshaping human potential, but the future of AI relies on real\-world compute, reliable infrastructure and engineering, and massive power. Don't just witness the AI revolution. Power it. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Frontend
jobs.description: **About Block Labs** ==================== Block Labs is a premier technology studio operating at the bleeding edge of **Web3, Artificial Intelligence, and iGaming**. We don't just ship features; we engineer high\-scale, production\-grade platforms that power the next generation of digital products. We are a collective of senior engineers, product strategists, and builders who refuse to compromise on architecture. Whether we are designing autonomous multi\-agent AI systems, building decentralized financial infrastructure, or architecting high\-frequency iGaming platforms, our standard is excellence. We move fast, but we build for the long term. If you are looking to work alongside a team that values deep technical expertise, thoughtful system design, and product ownership, Block Labs is where you belong. **The role** ============ We are building the frontend of a multi\-brand consumer platform in React, Next.js and TypeScript: one codebase serving several brands, where launching a brand should be a matter of configuration, not a copy. You will be the most senior frontend engineer in the company and the person the platform’s UI depends on. We don’t hire into squads. We work as a small number of very strong individual contributors, each owning a product end to end and shipping with AI agents at a pace that used to take a team. You get an outcome and constraints, not a backlog: you find the decisions nobody has made, scope the work, build it, ship it and stay accountable for how it behaves in production. Product ideas often arrive as working prototypes built with AI tools by people outside engineering. Your job is to steer them into production, not to reject them or rebuild them from zero. **Key Responsibilities:** ========================= * Own the frontend end to end: architecture, conventions, quality bar and production behaviour of a multi\-brand platform, with no spec handed to you. * Make adding a brand a configuration change: theming, brand\-aware routing and content, and clean boundaries between shared and brand\-specific code, all on a live product. * Build and own the design system and component library that engineers, designers and AI\-assisted prototyping all draw from. * Turn product prototypes into production features fast, and build the workflow and tooling that make this repeatable. * Ship with AI coding agents every day as your main way of working, with the checks that keep quality high at agent speed, and raise the bar for how others use them. * Ship consumer\-facing UI with real attention to detail, performance and accessibility. * Take UX and product concerns straight to the people who own the product, with alternatives and working examples, not just objections. **About You:** ============== * 8\+ years building production consumer\-facing web applications, several of them at Staff or equivalent ownership. * You have taken a frontend from a rough brief to production and owned it, and you can say exactly what was yours, what was your team’s and what was your agents’. * AI coding agents are how you build, not a helper. You have your own setup and can say precisely where agents make you faster, where they produce plausible but wrong output, and how you catch it. * Deep expertise in React, Next.js and modern TypeScript, with clear opinions on rendering strategies and when each is the wrong choice. * Hands\-on experience building or re\-architecting multi\-brand, multi\-tenant or white\-label frontends. * You have built or owned a design system and can discuss consistency versus flexibility, adoption and governance. * Strong UI and UX sensibility: you notice the small things and fix them without being asked. * Comfortable working with non\-engineers who build with AI tools, and you design for their output to be usable. * Demonstrable Core Web Vitals work in production. * You thrive with autonomy and light process, and you write clearly. Strong command of written and verbal English. **Nice to have** ================ * Experience with real\-time, high\-interaction consumer interfaces where latency and feel matter. * Background in fintech, crypto, real\-time gaming and entertainment platforms, or other high\-traffic consumer products. * Tooling, skills or integrations you built so agents work better inside a specific codebase or design system. * Working knowledge of CI/CD and cloud environments. **What this role is not** ========================= * Not a management or lead role. Influence comes from what you ship. * Not a pure architecture role. You write production code every day. * Not for someone who wants a team, a backlog or a complete spec before starting. **What kind of culture can I expect?** Mature, mission\-driven, and low\-ego. We value clarity over noise, outcomes over theatrics, and pace without chaos. If you’re one of the smartest minds in your craft and want to build with other experts, you’ll feel at home here.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering Integrated Platform | Platform Engineering, SRE & DevOps
jobs.description: At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. **Build the platform. Grow the leaders. Shape what comes next.** Broadridge is building a new Integrated Platform at the heart of its wider company strategy. Connecting enterprise applications and client\-facing experiences across Capital Markets, Wealth Management, Investor Communications, and other business domains, the platform brings together a common ontology, standardized APIs, and scalable event\-driven capabilities to enable connected services and innovation. This newly created Director of Engineering role is directly embedded in that strategy and critical to making it a reality. You will turn strategic ambition into reliable, scalable capabilities by leading multiple engineering managers and team leads across a multi\-layer organization. Your mandate spans platform reliability, incident and release management, DevOps transformation, and responsible AI adoption. This is a role for a builder of teams and technology who wants to shape a company\-wide strategic priority—not simply run an operational function. Partner with senior leaders to translate goals into engineering outcomes, empower your managers, and guide architecture and critical technical decisions while delivering through your teams. **Your leadership and delivery mandate** Lead leaders and build the organization. Manage and coach engineering managers and team leads across SRE, DevOps, and release engineering. Own organizational design, hiring, performance management, succession planning, and leadership development. Establish clear decision rights, delegated ownership, and sustainable on\-call practices. Own the DevOps and platform engineering roadmap. Translate company strategy and platform priorities into a multi\-quarter roadmap for CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment consistency, self\-service tooling, and toil reduction. Align capacity, dependencies, and investment with product, architecture, security, and operations. Lead incident management. Establish major\-incident readiness, escalation, incident command, and stakeholder communication. Ensure timely recovery, blameless reviews, and closure of corrective actions. Partner with service owners to reduce recurring incidents and improve recovery performance. Own release management and readiness. Establish release governance, delivery calendars, quality gates, and production\-readiness criteria. Advance automated testing, security checks, artifact traceability, progressive delivery, and safe rollback or roll\-forward across API, database, and event\-schema dependencies. **Your leadership and delivery mandate, continued** * Create and deliver the AI roadmap. Identify high\-value opportunities in engineering productivity, testing, knowledge retrieval, incident investigation, and controlled remediation. * Lead pilots and adoption of approved tools; measure benefits and quality, protect sensitive information, and retain human authorization for production changes. * Make reliability and resilience measurable. Define SLIs, SLOs, and error\-budget practices with service owners. Improve observability, capacity planning, performance, and data integrity across AWS, Java/Spring Boot, Kafka, and PostgreSQL. Validate failover, backup restoration, and disaster recovery against agreed objectives. * Provide leadership reporting and strategic delivery accountability. Connect engineering milestones to company goals through an executive scorecard covering service health, release performance, roadmap progress, AI outcomes, talent, cost, and risk. Surface dependencies and investment trade\-offs early; align leaders on the decisions needed to deliver. * Build a platform engineers want to use. Treat shared capabilities as products: create reusable patterns and self\-service experiences, gather developer feedback, and measure adoption. Partner with security and risk teams on auditable controls and software supply\-chain integrity; improve cloud cost efficiency without compromising resilience. **What you bring** * **Sustained production ownership:** 10\+ years in engineering, including sustained, direct ownership of production SRE or cloud reliability for business\-critical distributed systems. A record of improving availability, recovery time, and operational toil—not simply overseeing teams that own reliability. * **Deep AWS fluency:** Designing and operating resilient services across IAM, networking, compute (EKS, ECS, or Lambda), observability, and infrastructure as code. Demonstrated improvements in capacity, failure isolation, multi\-AZ resilience, and tested recovery against RTO/RPO targets. * **Proven major\-incident leadership:** Directing cross\-service response, making recovery decisions under pressure, and communicating business impact. Evidence of reduced detection and recovery  time while improving delivery speed. * **Applied SRE depth:** Establishing SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, actionable observability, and sustainable on\-call practices. A record of using reliability data to prioritize engineering investment and replacing recurring manual work with tested automation. * **Strong production troubleshooting:** Java/Spring Boot, Kafka, and PostgreSQL—including runtime performance, consumer lag and delivery semantics, query and transaction behavior, and data integrity. Ability to challenge designs and guide evidence\-based diagnosis beyond infrastructure symptoms. * **Leadership rooted in the discipline:** Experience leading engineering managers and team leads in SRE, DevOps, or production engineering. Ability to turn reliability and release priorities into funded roadmaps, measurable outcomes, and clear executive reporting; practical judgment on safe, evaluated AI\-assisted engineering. **Experience that will help you stand out** Financial services or other regulated environments; globally distributed engineering leadership; Kubernetes, Terraform, Open Telemetry, Kafka Connect, or PostgreSQL high availability; progressive delivery, developer platforms, policy\-as\-code, or measurable AI\-enabled engineering improvements. **The impact you can make** Help turn a company\-wide strategy into capabilities that teams and clients can rely on. Build a leadership bench that scales, create a safer and faster path to production, and use automation and AI to unlock engineering potential. Bring your curiosity, ambition, and passion for developing people—and help shape the next chapter of the Broadridge Integrated Platform. *"Broadridge considers various factors when evaluating a candidate's final salary including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, and education."* *Salary Range: 235,000\.00 – 250,000\.00 USD annual* *Bonus Eligible* *Please visit* www.broadridgebenefits.com *for more information on our comprehensive benefit offerings.* *\#LI\-NO1* We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective. **Use of AI in Hiring** As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)\-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration. US applicants: Click here to view the EEOC "Know Your Rights" poster. ***Disability Assistance*** We recognize that ensuring our long\-term success means creating an environment where everyone is welcome, where everyone's strengths are valued, and where everyone can perform at their best. Broadridge provides equal employment opportunities to all associates and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, ethnic origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, and other protected characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. If you need assistance or would like to request reasonable accommodations during the application and/or hiring process, please contact us at 888\-237\-7769 or by sending an email to BRcareers@broadridge.com.

jobs.title: Principal Cloud Engineer - AI Platform
jobs.description: **Compensation:** $175,000\-$250,000 per year **Location:** United States – Remote or Omaha, NE \- Hybrid **The job:** As a Principal Cloud Engineer, AI Platform at Buildertrend, you’ll shape the cloud foundation that allows AI agents to support real customer workflows while protecting data, controlling costs and maintaining performance. You’ll own critical platform architecture, establish standards that help engineering teams move independently and make the technical decisions that determine how safely we scale AI across our products. AI agents are already changing how work gets done, and the infrastructure behind them determines whether that change is secure, reliable and sustainable. Your work will help builders and remodelers spend less time managing processes and more time growing their businesses. **What you will do:** * Design and maintain the infrastructure behind production AI agents, including workload identity, ingress and egress gateways, network isolation and platform\-level sensitive data redaction. * Lead decisions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) networking, private connectivity, zero\-trust egress and service perimeters to protect workloads without limiting the platform’s ability to grow. * Develop reusable Terraform modules and CI/CD pipelines that help product teams deploy safely and independently, including temporary environments for validating changes before merge. * Establish a centralized, approved path for large language models (LLM) access, including routing, virtual keys, provider onboarding, observability and cost attribution. * Document platform and vendor decisions with total cost of ownership, barriers to entry, trade\-offs and open questions clearly defined so teams can make informed decisions and build on a consistent foundation. * Serve as a technical counterpart to major cloud and AI providers, escalate complex issues and validate roadmap commitments before they influence platform architecture. * Take incident command during critical production issues, make informed go/no\-go decisions under pressure and communicate risks and status clearly to technical leaders and executives. * Implement safeguards for credentials, secrets and AI usage, including automated secrets rotation and policy\-as\-code controls that reduce the risk of unauthorized AI deployments. * Lead blameless postmortems, identify systemic weaknesses and turn incident findings into measurable improvements in platform security, resilience and operational readiness. * Embrace using AI as a tool to enhance your work, while remaining open to learning, applying critical thinking, and owning the quality of your final work. **Who you are and what you need:** * 10\+ years of experience architecting enterprise\-grade GCP environments, with advanced knowledge of GCP\-native networking, including VPC Service Controls and Private Service Connect, as well as IAM perimeters and Workload Identity. * Previous experience at a B2B SaaS company. * Strong infrastructure as code practice. * Hands\-on experience running AI or ML workloads in production, such as model serving, agent runtimes or inference gateways, and understand how their needs differ from traditional web applications. * Practical depth in workload identity and machine\-to\-machine authorization, including service accounts, short\-lived credentials, certificate\-based identity, and token delegation, and the challenges of on\-behalf\-of authorization flows. * Track record\-owning production incidents, including calling deployments under pressure and updating executives during an outage. * Experience with agent development frameworks, agent runtime platforms and the emerging tooling around them. * Approach incidents without blame, communicate directly, take ownership of platform outcomes and turn lessons learned into practical improvements that help other engineers deliver reliable software. * Experience with automated secrets rotation, policy as code and governance that limits unauthorized “Shadow AI” deployments, with an eye on the new attack surfaces AI creates. **We are giving you:** * Exceptional health packages, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability benefits * A 401(k) plan with Buildertrend matching contributions to help you plan for the future * Generous paid time off, 11 paid holidays, plus personal days to make sure you have time to recharge * Parental leave and paid sabbaticals to support you during life’s big moments * Volunteer time off – because giving back matters Wellness program and onsite fitness center to keep you feeling your best * Opportunities for hybrid or remote work to give you the flexibility you need * Technology reimbursement to help cover costs for the tech you need to do your job from home * Free daily lunches when you're at our HQ office, plus monthly events to connect with your team **Who we are:** Great builders don’t just manage projects – they run successful businesses. That’s where Buildertrend comes in. As the leading residential construction management platform, we give contractors the power to control their financials, schedules, team workflows and client relationships – all in one system. No more juggling disconnected tools or guessing on profitability. With nearly two decades of industry expertise, Buildertrend helps builders work smarter, scale faster and stay ahead of the competition. If you want to learn more about us, check out: https://buildertrend.com/about/ **Working at Buildertrend:** At Buildertrend, we fully recognize that we all work so we can live better lives—we appreciate and respect that this is a job and not your whole life. What makes Buildertrend so special is a commitment to ensuring you can have the best job, work with the best people, and live your best life outside of work. Our goal is to create a culture where everyone can make an impact on our customers, communities, and each other. In short: We want you to be who you are, love what you do, and build your best life. *Buildertrend Solutions, Inc. is committed to a policy of Equal Employment Opportunity and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee based on race, including natural or protective hairstyle, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy and pregnancy\-related conditions, childbirth, breastfeeding, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, reproductive decision\-making), age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, citizenship, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law. The information collected by this application is solely to determine suitability for employment, verify identity, and maintain employment statistics on applicants.* *Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A “reasonable accommodation” is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Buildertrend Solutions, Inc. Please inform the company's personnel representative if you need assistance completing this application or to otherwise participate in the application process. To see the complete list of Essential Job Functions, visit* *https://buildertrend.com/essential\-job\-functions\-notice/*

jobs.title: Lead DevOps Engineer (Infrastructure Scale & Enablement) (HYBRID)
jobs.description: **Lead Software Engineer (Transformation \& Technical Excellence)** =================================================================== **Stack:** JavaScript (Node/Lambdas), MongoDB, Angular **The Mission** --------------- We are seeking a Lead Engineer who doesn't just write code, but builds the ecosystem where great code thrives. Currently, our engineering organization is at a pivotal junction. We are looking for a true technical leader who will act as the "North Star" for engineering discipline, quality, and architectural integrity. You are the transformative force that will instill a culture of collaborative architectural rigor. You will lead by example, proving that high\-quality software is built through a highly communicative and disciplined team. **The Role** ------------ As the Lead Software Engineer, you own the technical integrity of our stack. Your success is measured by the stability of the system and the efficiency of the contributors within it. We operate using a spec\-driven approach, where clear, testable specifications guide development and serve as the source of truth across teams. We work in an AI\-forward development environment, leveraging tools (e.g., AI\-assisted coding) to accelerate delivery while maintaining strong engineering judgment and code quality. ### **Key Responsibilities:** * **Architectural Stewardship:** Design systems using S.O.L.I.D. principles to ensure our architecture is extensible and maintainable for long\-term in\-house ownership. * **AI\-Augmented Development:** Essential Requirement. You must be an expert in utilizing AI\-assisted development tools (Copilots, LLMs, automated refactoring) to transform how the team builds, tests, and deploys. You will lead the team in integrating AI into the daily workflow to maximize efficiency and code quality. * **SDLC Transformation:** Audit and overhaul our development processes. You define "Quality"—from automated testing to rigorous code review standards. * **Leadership \& Discipline:** Act as the technical anchor for the team. You ensure that "moving fast" never comes at the expense of "moving correctly." * **Technical Priority:** Partner with the Engineering Manager to prioritize the roadmap, acting as the primary advocate for remediating technical debt and protecting the codebase's health. **Who You Are** --------------- * **A Leader First:** You understand that leadership is about setting the standard. jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ **Senior Data Conversion Engineer** **Location: Remote** **Salary Range: $105,000 \- $130,000 annually** **Build Your Career With Purpose at CCMSI** At CCMSI, we partner with global clients to solve their most complex risk management challenges, delivering measurable results through advanced technology, collaborative problem\-solving, and an unwavering commitment to their success. We don’t just process claims—we support people. We are a certified *Great Place to Work®*, and our employee\-owners are empowered to grow, collaborate, and make meaningful contributions every day. **Position Summary** CCMSI is seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Conversion Engineer to for complex data migration and transformation initiatives supporting claims administration, policy administration, financial systems, medical bill review platforms, and client onboarding projects. This role specializes in converting data from legacy systems, third\-party TPAs, carriers, and self\-insured entities, into CCMSI's core platforms and analytics environment.
