The Senior Data Conversion Engineer serves as both a technical lead and hands\-on builder, partnering directly with implementation teams, claims operations, client services, IT, analytics, and external clients to ensure accurate, auditable, and timely data conversions. Accuracy is critical, as converted data supports claims handling, client reporting, regulatory compliance, financial reporting, actuarial analyses, and operational decision\-making. This role requires periodic travel to CCMSI branch locations for project planning, implementation support, stakeholder collaboration, and training activities. Travel is expected approximately four or more times annually. **Responsibilities** -------------------- **Data Conversion*** Able to independently work end\-to\-end data conversion projects from discovery through production implementation. * Analyze source systems and develop detailed conversion strategies, mapping documents, and transformation specifications. * Design and execute data migration plans for claims, policy, billing, medical, financial, and client\-specific datasets. * Collaborate with internal business stakeholders and external clients to define conversion requirements and acceptance criteria. * Manage multiple concurrent conversion initiatives while maintaining project timelines and quality standards. **Data Transformation \& Engineering** * Design, build, and maintain automated data transformation processes using SQL, ETL/ELT tools, scripting, and cloud\-based technologies. * Develop reusable conversion frameworks and automation solutions that improve speed, consistency, and accuracy. * Create and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, validation routines, and reconciliation processes. * Support data movement between legacy platforms, third\-party systems, CCMSI core applications, and enterprise reporting environments. * Build and maintain data pipelines supporting claims, policy, billing, medical bill review, and financial reporting data. **Data Validation \& Quality Assurance** * Develop comprehensive validation and reconciliation processes to ensure completeness and accuracy of converted data. * Perform detailed record\-level analysis to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data anomalies. * Establish automated quality controls, exception reporting, and audit processes. * Verify converted data aligns with business rules, operational workflows, and reporting requirements. * Validate financial transactions, reserves, payments, recoveries, and claim history data to ensure accurate conversion outcomes. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field; equivalent experience considered. * 5\+ years of experience leading and executing data conversion, migration, or transformation projects. * Strong proficiency in SQL and relational databases. * Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT processes. * Experience with data mapping, transformation logic, reconciliation, and validation methodologies. * Proven ability to work with large and complex datasets. * Experience developing automation solutions to streamline conversion efforts. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. * Experience managing multiple projects and competing priorities * Ability to travel domestically to CCMSI branch locations at least four times annually. * Must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working with claims administration or insurance systems. * Direct experience with Third\-Party Administrator (TPA) platforms. * Experience converting data from legacy insurance or claims systems. * Knowledge of workers' compensation, liability, property, and casualty insurance data. * Familiarity with cloud\-based data platforms and data warehouses. * Experience supporting client onboarding and implementation projects. * Exposure to data governance and master data management practices. * Knowledge of data integration tools and APIs. **Why You’ll Love Working Here** * **4 weeks** ***(Paid time off that accrues throughout the year in accordance with company policy)*** **\+ 10 paid holidays in your first year** * **Comprehensive benefits**: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance * **Retirement plans**: 401(k) and Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) * **Career growth**: Internal training and advancement opportunities * **Culture**: A supportive, team\-based work environment ***Compensation \& Compliance*** *The posted salary reflects CCMSI’s good\-faith estimate in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws. Actual compensation will be based on qualifications, experience, geographic location, and internal equity. This role may also qualify for bonuses or additional forms of pay.* *CCMSI offers comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. Paid time off accrues throughout the year in accordance with company policy, with paid holidays and eligibility for retirement programs in accordance with plan documents.* *CCMSI posts internal career opportunities in compliance with applicable state and local promotion transparency laws.* ***Visa Sponsorship:*** *CCMSI does not provide visa sponsorship for this position.* ***ADA Accommodations:*** *CCMSI is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application and hiring process.* ***Equal Opportunity Employer:*** *CCMSI complies with all applicable employment laws, including pay transparency and fair chance hiring regulations.* *Background checks, if required for the role, are conducted only after a conditional offer and in accordance with applicable fair chance hiring laws.* **Our Core Values** At CCMSI, we believe in doing what’s right—for our clients, our coworkers, and ourselves. We look for team members who: * **Lead with transparency** We build trust by being open and listening intently in every interaction. * **Perform with integrity** We choose the right path, even when it is hard. * **Chase excellence** We set the bar high and measure our success. What gets measured gets done. * **Own the outcome** Every employee is an owner, treating every claim, every decision, and every result as our own. * **Win together** Our greatest victories come when our clients succeed. **We don’t just work together—we grow together. If that sounds like your kind of workplace, we’d love to meet you.** \#CCMSICareers \#EmployeeOwned \#GreatPlaceToWorkCertified \#ESOP \#SeniorDataConversionEngineer \#DataEngineering \#DataMigration \#SQLJobs \#ETL \#DataTransformation \#InsuranceTechnology \#ClaimsManagement \#TPA \#InsurTech \#NowHiring \#IND123

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Pretraining Data
jobs.description: Engineering · Full\-time · San Francisco SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. ### **About the role** We’re looking for Software Engineers to build the data systems behind our frontier coding models’ initial training. You’ll work on large\-scale crawling, data platform, and pipeline infrastructure, turning raw dumps into the datasets our models train on, and making iteration with researchers fast and reliable. * **The Data Quality team** owns the entire road between raw internet\-scale data and the tokens that train frontier models. This team makes sure the right data, in the right form, hits the training clusters on time and at the quality bar required to push the scaling curve. This is done by building our own models, our own high\-performance pipelines, and by running the experiments that prove the data is actually stellar. * **The Data Platform Team** owns the infrastructure and pipelines that transform raw data dumps into training\-ready datasets. This team improves the speed, reliability, and developer experience of our initial training data pipelines so researchers can quickly experiment with new data sources, quality filters, taxonomies, multimodal data, and data mixes that improve model performance. * **The Crawling team** owns large\-scale web crawling and parsing that feeds the top of the funnel for initial training. They discover, schedule, fetch, and parse public web content so high\-quality documents become the raw scrapes that Data Quality and Data Platform turn into tokens and mixes. This is deep distributed systems work with real ownership: host coverage and prioritization, fetch success under antibot and trap content, HTML/document parsing quality, and reliability of the crawl infrastructure that must continuously supply every downstream data pipeline. ### **What you’ll do** * **on the Data Quality Team:** + Build and own high\-throughput, fully telemetered data pipelines that process frontier\-scale data with end\-to\-end traceability. If something breaks or drifts, your systems will tell us before the training run does. + Train and ship models that classify, rank, filter, clean, and identify data at extreme throughput. These models have to be both accurate *and* fast enough to sit in the critical path without becoming the bottleneck. + Design and run scaling\-ladder experiments on data\-mixture, repeatability, and quality depth that turn “this dataset feels good” into hard evidence the training team can trust. + Partner tightly with Data Acquisition to hunt down missing or low\-quality sources, and with the training teams to close the loop on what actually moves loss and downstream evals. + Treat data quality as a systems problem *and* a research problem. You will write performance\-critical code one week and design careful experiments the next. * **on the Data Platform Team:** + Build the platform that turns raw web, code, multimodal, and acquired data into training\-ready datasets for frontier pretraining runs. + Own the pipelines, orchestration, and tooling that make pretraining data iteration fast, reliable, observable, and reproducible at scale. + Create clear signals for data quality, lineage, freshness, and pipeline health so researchers can trust what goes into each run. + Partner with initial training, crawling, data quality, and acquisition teams to turn new data ideas into measurable improvements in loss, evals, and model capability. * **on the Crawling Team:** + Build and scale the web crawling systems that discover, schedule, fetch, and parse high\-quality documents across the open web for initial training. + Improve URL seeding, scoring, and fair host scheduling so crawl capacity lands on the hosts and pages that matter most for model quality. + Raise crawl success and parsing quality — defeating antibot failures, improving extractors, and capturing content we previously could not get cleanly. + Debug and harden complex crawl infrastructure end\-to\-end for availability, recovery, and ingestion lag, and automate delivery of crawl datasets into the data pipeline. + Work independently (and alongside AI agents) and partner with Data Quality and Data Platform so new coverage shows up as better tokens in training runs. ### **You may be a fit if** * You have a strong infrastructure or data platform background, and ideally a spike of outlier depth somewhere (crawling/search infra is a plus, not a hard requirement) * You are a high\-slope engineer who has moved unusually fast — for example, staff\-level ownership within a few years — or you bring deep domain experience * You are able to architect and ship end\-to\-end with high ownership, debug complex systems independently, and work alongside AI agents * You have strong intuitions about large\-scale distributed systems * You’re excited to learn how pre\-training data shapes model quality, and want the ownership and visibility that comes with building systems that feed frontier training runs \#LI\-DNI

jobs.title: MMS/RPG Engineer
jobs.description: Specialization: IBM i / RPG I Location: Remote (US) CapNexus is an AWS consulting partner specializing in AI and cloud engineering. We build and deliver software through agentic engineering: we build and operate the systems that produce code, direct AI tooling to accelerate delivery, and exercise the judgment that keeps AI\-generated work correct. Everyone at CapNexus works fluently inside our delivery system, which combines agentic tooling, spec\-driven development, evidence\-based quality, and AI\-augmented delivery governance. **Who You Are and What You'll Do:** CapNexus is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to own complex software outcomes: designing and building applications, APIs, and services, and raising the bar for the engineers around you. You'll work through our agentic delivery system, where AI tooling carries the mechanical load and you own the architecture, the correctness of what ships, and the growth of the people you mentor. We care more about how you think about building systems than which language you learned first. In this role, you'll focus on IBM i: building and supporting RPG applications, the DB2 for i data behind them, and the integrations that connect them to the rest of the business. **Responsibilities:** * Build and maintain IBM i applications in free\-format RPGLE, SQLRPGLE, and CL, using ILE concepts such as procedures, service programs, and modules. * Work with DB2 for i through SQL and DDS, including physical and logical files and subfiles. Integrate IBM i applications with other systems through web services, JSON and XML, FTP, and the Integrated File System (IFS). * Support changes through testing, deployment, and post\-deployment, and resolve technical issues directly with client teams. * * Set coding and testing standards for IBM i work, and identify where modernizing an application pays off. * Own the technical outcome for a system area or major feature set: propose the approach, define the task breakdown, and deliver with minimal escalation. * Design APIs and data models that account for cost, scale, and failure, and build in observability (logging, tracing, and metrics) from the start. * Work with Cloud Engineers on infrastructure as code and CI/CD so what you build deploys the same way every time. * Partner with the Solutions Architect on solution design and with the Engagement Manager on delivery, and turn designs into a build plan the team can execute. * Set code\-quality standards for your area, and mentor Software Engineers I and II through pairing and reviews that teach, including how to direct AI tooling and check what it produces. * Join architecture presentations and technical deep\-dives alongside the Solutions Architect when the client needs your depth. **How You'll Work: Agentic Engineering:** You own outcomes on complex work, exercise architectural judgment, and raise the bar for those around you. * **Agentic tooling.** Set the tooling approach for a codebase or engagement: which work goes to a conversion engine, which is spec\-driven build, where the human\-in\-the\-loop gates belong, and how the toolchain is wired for the problem at hand. * **Spec validation and readiness.** Own the quality of the handoff from specification to build. Make sure specs are executable and actually satisfy the requirements, and hold delivered work to a defined readiness bar. When generated code is wrong, fix the spec, not just the output. * **Validating AI output.** Be the final judgment on correctness for high\-risk changes, including in unfamiliar domains, by designing the evidence that proves behavior is preserved. * **Delivery\-system ownership.** Design and maintain the project\-specific setup of our delivery tooling (steering, agent roles, templates, quality gates, and metrics) as durable capability, not one\-off scaffolding. **Judgment over correctness:** you can tell when confident, plausible\-looking AI output is quietly wrong. Tooling does the mechanical work; you're accountable for whether it's right. **Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * A strong grasp of architecture concepts: event\-driven and service\-based design, API design, data modeling, separation of concerns, and designing for change. * Experience owning a significant system from design through production, and mentoring the engineers who built it with you. * Working knowledge of CI/CD and infrastructure as code. * Hands\-on experience with spec\-driven or agentic development workflows, where specs drive code generation, for example Kiro, Claude Code, Amazon Q Developer, or Cursor with rules. Using AI only for autocomplete or snippets doesn't count. * A track record of catching what AI\-generated or refactored code gets quietly wrong, and of building the tests and gates that prove behavior is preserved. * Hands\-on experience programming on IBM i (AS/400, iSeries): free\-format RPGLE, SQLRPGLE, CL, and OS/400 commands. * Strong SQL skills on DB2 for i, plus working knowledge of DDS, subfiles, and older RPG (RPG III and fixed format). * Experience with IBM i Access Client Solutions or iSeries Navigator, the IFS, and JSON and XML. \| * Experience with Blue Yonder (JDA) MMS. **Nice to Have:** * Experience with AWS or application modernization, such as integrating IBM i applications with AWS services or moving IBM i workloads to modern platforms. * Experience with Java, including Java on IBM i or RPG\-to\-Java modernization. * Experience supporting IBM i in an enterprise data center. * Background in retail. **Our Culture:** Four keystones guide how we work: * **Customer obsessed, delivery focused.** We deliver what we promise. Trust \= consistency × time. * **Learning and sharing.** We hire lifetime learners, and teaching others matters as much as knowing. * **Growth and scalability.** We value cross\-functional skills over role boundaries, and simple solutions over clever ones. * **All work is strategic.** Every engagement, big or small, is a chance to earn trust that lasts. **We offer:** Job Type: Full\-time Benefits: Medical, dental, 401(k), and more CapNexus is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment for all employees. Experience comes in many forms, and we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly align with what we have listed. We look forward to hearing from you. **No Agencies Please!**

jobs.title: Identity Resolution Engineer
jobs.description: **At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. That’s why we’re not just transforming cancer care—we’re changing lives.** We introduced precision medicine to the world and built an industry around the idea that every patient deserves answers as unique as their DNA. Backed by cutting\-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day: *“What would I do if this patient were my mom?”* That question drives everything we do. But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose. **Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.** **Position Summary** Caris Life Sciences serves hundreds of thousands of molecular cases a year and continues to grow at double\-digit rates. Its molecular, imaging, and clinical\-outcomes data support software that helps ensure a cancer patient's report is right, complete, and on time. The Senior Software Engineer \- Identity Resolution \& Master Data Management designs, builds, and operates the production identity capabilities that regulated clinical workflows depend on: matching, linking, merging, and separating identity records under auditable controls, so that clinical information lands on the correct patient and provider records across complex healthcare data flows. The engineer improves resolution quality, data integrity, and operational reliability, and every change ships through controlled, testable delivery practices. The engineering environment supports advanced AI coding assistants and agentic workflows across design, implementation, and test generation. Characterization tests and golden\-master replay serve as executable evidence, and onboarding is harness\-first: the engineer builds or extends those tests to capture current behavior as repeatable validation evidence. Delivery runs on CI/CD, automated testing, application\-level observability, and risk\-based release governance aligned with current FDA Computer Software Assurance guidance. The specific technology stack is discussed during the interview process. Reporting to an Engineering Manager or Senior Engineering Manager in Clinical Software Engineering, this senior individual contributor leads technical delivery in the identity\-resolution domain, participates in architecture and design decisions, and maintains software subject to SOX financial controls and FDA regulatory requirements. Location: Irving, Texas (Dallas–Fort Worth), on\-site/hybrid, minimum three days per week on campus; co\-located with Caris's laboratory and clinical operations. **Job Responsibilities** * Design, build, test, and maintain identity\-resolution and MDM services for patient and provider data. * Develop and tune deterministic and probabilistic matching across names, addresses, dates of birth, contact information, identifiers, and other approved attributes. * Implement workflows to merge, unmerge, link, and separate records, with durable audit trails and safeguards for downstream clinical use. * Define and monitor resolution\-quality, data\-quality, performance, and reliability measures; investigate anomalies and strengthen controls. * Own the data models, APIs, and integration patterns that connect upstream and downstream clinical systems. * Partner with product management, data governance, clinical operations, compliance, and engineering to refine requirements and manage identity\-related risks. * Write and maintain the technical record: design documents, architecture decision records, data\-flow documentation, and operational runbooks. * Review code and submit work for review; contribute automated unit, integration, regression, and performance tests. * Automate recurring engineering and operational tasks: repeated manual steps become scripted, reviewed automation rather than standing process. * Instrument and support production services; participate in incident response, root\-cause analysis, and corrective\-action work. * Mentor less\-experienced engineers through code review, pair programming, and knowledge sharing. * Work AI\-first: use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as daily practice across design, implementation, and test generation, with peer and engineering review as the quality gate. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining production software systems. * 3\+ of those years designing or operating entity\-resolution, record\-linkage, MDM, or comparable identity systems in production. * 2\+ of those years building system integrations through APIs, event\-driven patterns, or batch data pipelines. * A track record of implementing matching logic across multiple identity attributes and evaluating it against measurable quality controls. * Experience designing data models and remediation workflows for duplicate, conflicting, or incomplete records. * Command of full SDLC practices, automated testing, code review, and controlled production delivery. * Operating experience with high\-volume production services: observability, incident response, and root\-cause analysis. * Hands\-on fluency with AI coding assistants and agentic development workflows in real engineering work. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in healthcare, clinical laboratory, diagnostics, or life sciences software environments. * Experience with MPI or enterprise identity\-resolution platforms. * Familiarity with HL7 messaging and FHIR. * Depth in relational and document databases: SQL, indexing, and query optimization. * Experience applying graph databases, probabilistic methods, or ML to entity resolution. * Experience with CI/CD, automated regression testing, and production observability. * Experience implementing or operating controls aligned with SOX ITGCs or FDA requirements under 21 CFR. * Experience in CLIA\- or HIPAA\-governed environments. Regulated\-domain experience is preferred, not required. **Physical Demands** * Ability to sit, stand, and work at a computer for extended periods. **Training** * All job\-specific, safety, and compliance training is assigned based on the job functions associated with this employee. **Other** * This role may require periodic travel to other Caris sites or partner locations. After\-hours response to critical patient\-identity or clinical\-data issues and participation in periodic scheduled on\-call rotations may be required. **Conditions of Employment:** Individual must successfully complete pre\-employment process, which includes criminal background check, drug screening, credit check ( applicable for certain positions) and reference verification. This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Caris Life Sciences is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

This role offers the opportunity to support a diverse range of environmental, ecological, engineering, surveying, and infrastructure projects through GIS spatial analysis, data management, mapping, and visualization. Our Bridgeport office is one of the region's largest multidisciplinary engineering offices, bringing together more than 130 engineers, scientists, surveyors, and technical professionals. In this role, you'll collaborate with project managers, scientists, engineers, surveyors, and field personnel to develop GIS datasets, perform spatial analysis, and create high\-quality mapping products that support projects throughout West Virginia and the surrounding region. As a 100% employee\-owned firm, CEC offers a unique opportunity to build long\-term wealth while expanding your technical expertise in GIS technologies and geospatial data management. We provide a collaborative environment that encourages innovation, cross\-training, and professional development while supporting a diverse portfolio of projects across multiple industries. Responsibilities: * Develop, maintain, and manage GIS databases, datasets, and geospatial information in the Esri ArcGIS platform * Create maps, exhibits, figures, and data visualizations to support jobs.description: About the Role T. Mark Fay Consulting, Inc. (Claim Toolkit) builds software that enterprise property and casualty carriers across the US and Canada rely on for claims audit, compliance, total loss, and auto liability work. We are hiring a full\-time, remote, US\-based Full Stack Developer. You will be the in\-house technical owner of our production applications. That means keeping them running, secure, and compliant day to day, delivering enhancements our carrier clients request, and helping lead the modernization of our legacy Classic ASP applications. You will work alongside a small internal team and our external development partner, with wide latitude to design, build, test, and release your solutions. Products You Will Support You will support all four Claim Toolkit product lines, with the heaviest day\-to\-day load in Total Loss and Compliance. * **Total Loss:** calculates state\-specific taxes and fees on total loss vehicle settlements. Main touchpoints are monthly tax and fee updates, state programming, vendor rate issues, new clients, Notice to Owner, and form letters. * **Compliance:** tracks claims handling against state regulatory requirements. Main touchpoints are MFA and login reporting, SSO, new customer setup, and enhancements such as an interest calculator. * **Audit:** supports carrier claim file audits. Main touchpoints are SFTP, Guidewire integration, SSO, enhancements, and product redesign. * **Auto Liability:** supports auto liability claim evaluation. Main touchpoints are SFTP, Guidewire integration, SSO, enhancements, and product redesign. Key Responsibilities **Production support and incidents (all products)** * Own incident response for all products, including 500 errors and failed scheduled jobs, with same\-day diagnosis and resolution * Write programming specs in real time when issues are found, and follow them through to release * Manage the code deployment and release process * Keep UAT documentation current, including server screenshots * Contribute to hardware and infrastructure discussions **Total Loss system** * Complete monthly tax and fee updates and program future\-dated changes * Program state\-specific rules in CORE and maintain them as regulations change * When tax rate issues surface, retrieve XML files and work directly with vendors such as Thomson Reuters to investigate * Set up new clients, modify vehicle types and categories, and add user access for select clients * Maintain address validation, form letters, and Notice to Owner PDFs * Rotate Dealertrack/Vitu credentials securely * Produce client tax and fee reports on request (for example, all first\-party claims finalized in a date range, with all taxes and fees) * Explain how calculations are programmed so internal staff can answer client questions * Support billing setup, invoices, and billing\-related emails **Security and compliance** * Prepare for and respond to the annual penetration test, and implement remediation * Keep MFA compliance reporting accurate and troubleshoot compliance reports * Research enterprise SSO gaps, such as logins not captured when users reach Compliance through Total Loss * Evaluate and, if approved, implement the Shibboleth upgrade * Finish the WAF (Sucuri) rollout: confirm which sites are protected, add the remaining sites, and update .asp pages to prevent false blocking * Set up new Compliance customers, in\-house and external, using the onboarding checklist **Integrations, SSO, and SFTP** * Install and maintain SSO for all products, including annual certificate renewals, and priorities * Define and run the enhancement process: intake, mockup, customer approval, customer review, build, release * Build project timelines and keep work on schedule **Product modernization** * specs, and build with the development team **Customers and team** * Work directly with new and existing carrier clients when technical context is needed * Mentor assigned team members and attend meetings as needed Technical Qualifications **Required** * Hands\-on production experience with Classic ASP/VBScript, plus ASP.NET, React and C\#,GitHub * Strong Microsoft SQL Server skills: complex jobs.title: Director, Analytics & Semantic Layer
jobs.description: **About Us** Clayco is a full\-service, turnkey real estate development, master planning, architecture, engineering, and construction firm that safely delivers clients across North America the highest quality solutions on time, on budget, and above and beyond expectations. With $8\.1 billion in revenue for 2025, Clayco specializes in the "art and science of building," providing fast track, efficient solutions for mission critical, industrial, life sciences, power \& energy, aviation, commercial, institutional, residential and sports \& entertainment related building projects. **The Role We Want You For** Clayco is building a data and AI organization from the ground up, and the semantic layer sits at the center of it. We are looking for the person who will own it. We run a Snowflake\-based platform that has to answer questions about billions of dollars of construction work: what a project costs to complete, where a schedule is slipping, whether a trade package is trending over. The hard part is not the pipelines. It is that cost to complete means one thing in finance, another in project controls, and a third on the job site — and until someone settles that, no dashboard and no AI agent can be trusted. That is this job. You will define what a Clayco number means, build the governed models behind it, and lead the analytics engineering team that grows to eleven people over the next two years. Most semantic layer roles are maintenance jobs on someone else's architecture. This one is a build. The strategy is set and funded, the executive sponsorship is real, and a dozen agents are already running on semantic models we have built. There are hundreds more to come, and you will set the standard they follow rather than inherit one **Specific Responsibilities:** * Own Clayco's semantic layer, the certified definitions, the models behind them, and the process by which a definition gets approved, versioned, and retired. * Build the core conformed models: project, cost code, vendor, contract, schedule activity. * Stand up domain models for finance and WIP, project controls, and safety and risk. * Hire and lead the analytics engineering team, growing from two to eleven. * Own the schedule for retiring our legacy reporting estate onto governed models. * Partner with our data platform, AI products, and governance leads on where your layer starts and stops. **Job Requirements and Competencies:** * You have built a semantic layer before. Not dashboards on top of one — the layer itself, in Snowflake, dbt, or equivalent, at a scale where definitional consistency was a real problem you had to solve. * You know AEC. You have worked in construction, engineering, or architecture, or you studied it. You know what a schedule of values is, why percentage\-of\-completion accounting is contentious, and what a superintendent actually needs to see. We are not going to teach this. * You have led analytics engineers. Hiring, performance, and setting standards. We would like to hear about a team you grew rather than inherited, but leading one well matters more to us than how much it grew. * You can hold your ground with the business. Half this job is telling a finance executive and an operations executive that they cannot both be right, and getting them to a shared definition anyway. * You bring outside perspective. We have made real architectural decisions and we are not looking for someone to ratify them. Bring ideas from wherever you have been, make them work with what already exists, and push us to change what should change when you can show the benefit. * Nice to have: metric certification under audit, experience retiring a legacy BI estate, Procore or similar project systems. * Not required: AI or machine learning background. That work lives elsewhere on the team. **Some Things You Should Know** * Our clients and projects are nationwide – Travel will be required. * No other builder can offer the collaborative design\-build approach that Clayco does. * We work on creative, complex, award\-winning, high\-profile jobs. * The pace is fast! * This position is classified as a safety\-sensitive role in accordance with applicable state and federal laws. Candidates selected for this position will be subject to a comprehensive background check, which includes mandatory drug testing. **Why Clayco?** * 2025 Best Places to Work – St. Louis Business Journal, Los Angeles Business Journal, and Phoenix Business Journal. * 2025 ENR Top 400 – Top Data Center Contractor (Top 3\). * 2025 ENR Top 100 Design\-Build Firms – Design\-Build Contractor (Top 5\). * 2025 ENR Top 100 Green Contractors – Green Contractor (Top 3\). **Benefits** * Discretionary Annual Bonus: Subject to company and individual performance. * Comprehensive Benefits Package Including: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401k, generous PTO and paid company holidays, employee assistance program, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, learning \& development programs and more! **Compensation** * The salary range for this position considers a wide range of factors in making compensation decisions including but not limited to: Education, qualifications, skills, training, experience, certifications, internal equity, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for the role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The Clayco Nationwide salary range for this position is approximately $180,000 \- $230,000 \+/\- annually (not adjusted for location).

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer - AI Infrastructure
jobs.description: #### **About Clockwork Systems** **Clockwork.io – Software Driven Fabrics to increase GPU cluster utilization** Clockwork Systems was founded by Stanford researchers and veteran systems engineers who share a vision for redefining the foundations of distributed computing. As AI workloads grow increasingly complex, traditional infrastructure struggles to meet the demands of performance, reliability, and precise coordination. Clockwork is pioneering a software\-driven approach to AI fabrics by delivering **cross\-stack observability** to catch and quickly resolve problems, **workload fault tolerance** to keep jobs running through failures, and **performance acceleration** that dynamically routes and paces traffic to avoid congestion. #### **To learn more, visit** **www.clockwork.io****.** ### **About the Role** We're building infrastructure for fault\-tolerant, high\-performance distributed GPU training. You'll work at the intersection of GPU systems, high\-speed networking, and distributed coordination—designing and implementing systems that run at scale. This is a systems building role. You'll dig into internals, understand why things break under pressure, and design solutions that handle the messy reality of distributed systems. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and implement low\-level systems software for GPU clusters * Work with internals of frameworks like PyTorch, NCCL, CUDA runtime—not as a user, but modifying and extending them * Build components that make large\-scale GPU training more reliable and efficient * Debug complex distributed/concurrent systems where failures are subtle and non\-deterministic * Own systems end\-to\-end: from design through production ### **What We're Looking For** Required: Systems building experience You've designed and built complex systems—not just deployed or operated them. Examples: * Kernel subsystems, device drivers, or OS\-level components * Distributed storage, databases, or coordination systems * Runtimes, profilers, or performance tooling * Network stacks, protocols, or high\-performance I/O systems * Large\-scale infrastructure at the systems layer Core technical skills: * Strong C/C\+\+ in systems contexts * Deep understanding of concurrency, memory models. * Experience reasoning about distributed system behavior: consistency, ordering, partial failures * Comfortable reading and modifying large, unfamiliar codebases Nice to have: * GPU programming (CUDA) or GPU systems experience * High\-performance networking (RDMA, InfiniBand) * ML framework or runtime internals * Cluster scheduling or orchestration systems *We believe strong systems engineers pick up domain\-specific tools quickly. We value your ability to reason about complex systems over checkbox familiarity with our specific stack.* **Enjoy** * Challenging projects. * A friendly and inclusive workplace culture. * Competitive compensation. * A great benefits package. * Catered lunch. Compensation for this position will vary based on the skills and experience you bring, as well as internal equity considerations. For candidates hired at the posted level, the expected base salary range is $150,000 \- $210,000\. In addition to cash compensation, this role is eligible to participate in the **company's equity program**, which may include stock options granted in accordance with the company's equity plan and subject to approval and applicable vesting schedules. **Clockwork Systems is an equal opportunity employer.** We are committed to building world\-class teams by welcoming bright, passionate individuals from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. We believe diversity drives innovation, and we grow stronger together.

You will be responsible for the IslandDER digital interface, built to comply with a new device\-to\-device communication standard we are co\-developing with the leading battery and inverter companies for secure integration with home batteries (e.g., Tesla Powerwall) and Vehicle\-to\-Home (V2H) solutions. The software monitors voltage and current, drives relays, performs safety checks, and communicates securely with third\-party devices and the ConnectDER cloud. The device software breaks into four subsystems you'll own: Data Acquisition (grid/microgrid metering), Control (real\-time, safety\-critical), Communication (Ethernet, WireGuard, multi\-core interfaces), and Integration (fault tolerance, firmware updates, security, logging). **In your first year, you might:** * Write the design diagrams and safety case for the IslandDER's safety\-critical software, and sit across the table from the NRTL to defend it. * Bring up firmware on a new board with the EE team, debugging across the hardware/software boundary with a logic analyzer. * Stand up the code\-signing pipeline so a production firmware build can be signed and shipped as a verified OTA update. * Hand a teammate a well\-scoped metering or comms workstream with a clean interface, then review their PRs. * Tighten a line\-frequency control loop that's missing its timing budget. ### **Responsibilities will include:** * Systems Architecture \& Leadership: Own the overall device software architecture. Break complex requirements into well\-scoped workstreams, delegate with clean interfaces, and guide the team while staying hands\-on where it matters. * Device Software Safety Architecture: Architect and implement the safety\-critical software, scoping the safety boundary tightly and owning the FMEA, safety case, and NRTL certification. * Metering: Design and implement revenue\-grade metering systems, including data acquisition, signal processing, and calibration. * Hardware\-Software Co\-Design: Partner with electrical engineering — co\-defining requirements, driving board bring\-up, debugging across the boundary, and influencing hardware design for testability and safety. * Firmware Integrity \& Updates: Own the secure firmware\-update path, including secure boot, code signing, and the key\-management system behind it. * Build, Test \& Scale: Keep a modern CI/CD pipeline and testable code and take systems from prototype to mass production. **Location, Workstyle \& Travel:** **This role is based in our Philadelphia office, with an in\-person schedule of Tuesday–Thursday (three days per week) and approximately 10% travel. Remote candidates will be considered but** **must be able to travel to the Philadelphia office for at least one week per month,** **with an overall travel expectation of approximately 25%.** ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science, with 7\+ years in firmware engineering and a track record of shipping new products at scale. * Rigorous system design and documentation: you bring an exacting commitment to clear, thorough technical documentation and design diagrams, and the discipline to drive a complex safety certification (e.g., IEC 61508 / IEC 60730 / UL 1998\) to completion. * Technical leadership: you've led the technical direction of a project. You architect the approach, partition it into workstreams for others, and still ship code yourself. * Embedded mastery: expert in C, C\+\+, and/or Rust, with deep experience debugging embedded systems via oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG/SWD. * Deep bare\-metal/RTOS firmware experience on modern 32\-bit microcontrollers, including low\-level architecture and multi\-core memory optimization. (ARM Cortex\-M or similar.) * AI\-assisted development with ownership: sophisticated use of AI coding agents paired with full ownership; you can explain every significant decision you ship. * A bias for fast iteration and judgment to size effort to business value, with the communication skills to explain complex requirements to diverse stakeholders. ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science * Prior experience taking safety\-critical software through NRTL certification. * Matter/Thread device commissioning (SPAKE2\+/PASE, setup\-code or QR pairing). * Protocols \& build: I2C, UART, SPI, CAN/CAN\-FD, and Ethernet; build systems (Make, CMake); test automation and CI/CD. * + Embedded TCP/IP networking (e.g., lwIP); experience implementing WireGuard or similar secure tunnels on a real\-time embedded platform + Reverse\-engineering CAN protocols or developing custom evaluation tools. * Experience configuring and using an RTOS for multi\-threaded, timing\-critical applications across metrology, safety, and communications. * + Experience with PX5 or ThreadX. * Experience designing or operating a code\-signing / PKI system for firmware (key custody, signing pipeline, secure boot verification, key rotation and revocation). * Familiarity with relevant standards, e.g., UL 1741/IEEE 1547, UL 3141, UL 2900 (cybersecurity), and ANSI C12\.1 (metering). Compensation offers are determined based on relevant skills, experience, and qualifications and may vary within the posted salary range To apply, please submit your resume. Applications without a resume will not be considered. At ConnectDER, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and experiences and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every listed qualification—great talent comes in many forms. ConnectDER is committed to developing a barrier\-free recruitment process and work environment. If you require any accommodation during the application and interview process, please email us at careers @ connectder.com (no spaces) and we'll work with you to meet your accessibility needs. Selected candidates must pass a criminal history background screening and a reference check and must be able to show proof of work authorization. All your information will be kept confidential according to all applicable guidelines.

jobs.title: IT Compute Storage Engineer
jobs.description: **IT Compute Storage Engineer** supports the day\-to\-day operation, maintenance, security, availability, and lifecycle management of the organization's server, virtualization, storage, backup, recovery, and related infrastructure platforms. The position responds to incidents, service requests, monitoring alerts, operational tasks, and approved changes while following established security, change\-management, and support procedures. The Engineer installs, configures, patches, monitors, troubleshoots, documents, and maintains physical and virtual servers, operating systems, storage platforms, data\-protection systems, infrastructure appliances, and related services. The position also supports server provisioning and decommissioning, capacity and performance monitoring, backup and recovery activities, disaster recovery exercises, certificate and access\-related tasks, and vendor\-supported maintenance. The role is primarily focused on reliable day\-to\-day operations but also participates in infrastructure upgrades, lifecycle initiatives, migrations, automation efforts, and other projects. The role is expected to identify recurring operational issues, improve documentation, recommend practical process improvements, and gradually assume greater ownership as knowledge and experience increase. **\*The candidate must be within one hour to the Cincinnati area. This role can be hybrid or remote but will need to be open to on\-call issues throughout the week and weekend.\*** **Your role and impact** Here's a glimpse of your responsibilities and the meaningful impact you'll create as the **IT Compute Storage Engineer:** **Production Support** * Monitor, administer, and maintain physical and virtual servers, Windows/Linux systems, virtualization, storage, file services, and backup/recovery platforms. * Respond to incidents, service requests, alerts, changes, and operational issues in accordance with service expectations. * Perform server provisioning, patching, upgrades, decommissioning, storage allocation, backups, restores, and routine maintenance. * Troubleshoot hardware, operating system, virtualization, storage, backup, connectivity, performance, and availability issues. * Execute approved changes and follow established security, change\-management, and recovery procedures. * Monitor system health, capacity, performance, logs, backups, and vendor notifications; address or escalate issues as needed. * Participate in 24x7 on\-call rotation and scheduled after\-hours maintenance and recovery activities. * Collaborate with Security, Networking, Database, Application, Service Desk, and vendor teams to resolve issues and support infrastructure operations. **Project Support** * Participate in infrastructure projects involving servers, virtualization, storage, backup, disaster recovery, operating systems, and data center technologies. * Support upgrades, migrations, hardware refreshes, capacity expansions, and technology implementations. * Develop implementation, testing, validation, and backout plans for assigned project work. * Support disaster recovery exercises, testing, and documentation. **Documentation \& Continuous Improvement** * Maintain technical documentation, procedures, inventories, change records, and knowledge articles. * Identify opportunities to automate and improve recurring processes using scripting and infrastructure tools. * Identify recurring issues, capacity concerns, and process improvements to enhance reliability and efficiency. * Participate in knowledge sharing, cross\-training, technical reviews, and mentoring of team members. **What's in it for you** * **Competitive pay:** Fair compensation for your hard work. * **Healthcare coverage:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision from day one. * **Life insurance:** Company\-paid coverage for you and your loved ones. * **401(k) plan:** Matching contributions to help secure your financial future. * **Family support:** Paid parental leave and reimbursement for adoption and surrogacy expenses. * **Work\-life balance**: Flexible time\-off policy to recharge and pursue passions. * **Dress for your day:** Express your style comfortably at work. * **Inclusion and Culture:** A respectful environment that values unique contributions. * **Flexible work options:** Remote, hybrid, and onsite opportunities at various locations across the U.S. for better work\-life integration. * **Well\-being focus:** Programs to support a healthy balance between work and home life. * **Community connections:** Build strong relationships through virtual and in\-person interactions, with resources for your growth. Requirements: **What sets you up for success** * Preferred bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * At least five years of progressively responsible IT infrastructure, systems administration, or related experience in an enterprise environment. Experience administering and troubleshooting * Windows and/or Linux server environments, virtualization technologies, enterprise storage, backup/recovery solutions, and core infrastructure services. * Windows Server administration and troubleshooting * Linux/Red Hat administration and troubleshooting * VMware or enterprise virtualization platforms * Physical server hardware and firmware * Enterprise storage systems, including SAN and NAS * Backup, recovery, replication, and disaster recovery * Infrastructure monitoring and performance management * Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP * PowerShell and/or Linux scripting and automation * IT service management and change\-management processes * Basic networking, TCP/IP, VLANs, firewalls, and troubleshooting * Responsible use of AI tools to improve administration, research, documentation, and operational efficiency while maintaining security and compliance **Preferred** * Experience supporting enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and certificate management processes, including certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, lifecycle tracking, SSL/TLS certificate deployment, certificate\-based authentication, and troubleshooting certificate\-related issues across servers, applications, load balancers, and infrastructure platforms. * Experience working in a regulated industry or an environment with formal security, audit, change\-management, and documentation requirements. * Experience with Microsoft Exchange Server or hybrid Exchange, including server health and service monitoring, patching, certificate management, mail\-flow/SMTP troubleshooting, connector configuration, backup/recovery coordination, and collaboration with Microsoft 365 or messaging administrators. * ITIL Foundation certification or familiarity with ITIL\-aligned incident, problem, change, request, and configuration\-management practices. Relevant Microsoft, Linux, virtualization, storage, backup, cloud, or IT service\-management certification. * Compensation: na

jobs.title: Software Engineer: Core
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote \- EMEA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering **About Us** ------------ Constructor is the next\-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in\-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so. Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco. We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things. Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019\. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today. **The Team** ------------ The Core Team sits at the heart of Constructor, shaping Constructor’s in\-house search engine, where user requests meet customer catalogs and Constructor’s learnings. We build and operate the foundational systems that power every request flowing through the platform, enabling fast, reliable, and intelligent interactions at massive scale. Our systems handle billions of requests daily with exceptional uptime, and we take pride in delivering a highly scalable, resilient, and globally distributed platform. As part of the Core team, you will help design, build, and maintain the critical infrastructure and services that underpin the entire product, ensuring performance, stability, and reliability across the globe. **Requirements** ---------------- You’ll thrive in this role if you: * Have a strong foundation in computer science, including algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and systems design. * Have experience building and scaling high\-traffic, high\-availability backend systems. * Have experience designing and operating backend infrastructure, including deployment automation, capacity planning, and observability. * Are comfortable working across different layers of the stack, from performance\-critical code to production operations. * Enjoy learning new technologies and tools in a fast\-moving, large\-scale environment. * Collaborate effectively and contribute to a positive, ownership\-driven team culture. ### **Our Tech Stack** * Languages: Rust, C\+\+, Python * Cloud Infrastructure: AWS * CI/CD: Jenkins, GitHub Actions * Monitoring \& Observability: Prometheus, Grafana **Benefits** ------------ * ️ Unlimited vacation time \- we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year * Fully remote team \- choose where you live * ️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office * Apple laptops provided for new employees ‍ * Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year * Maternity \& Paternity leave for qualified employees * Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact * Base salary: $80k–$120k USD, depending on knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results * Stock options \- offered in addition to the base salary * Regular team offsites to connect and collaborate **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor** --------------------------------------------------- At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group. *Studies have shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every one of the qualifications listed. Our primary interest is in finding the best candidate for the job. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of our listed qualifications.* **How we handle your data.** By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized.

There will always be more to accomplish, and at Crestron, we believe the best way forward is together. EOE/M/F/D/V * No Solicitation\* Any agency submittal to any employee of Crestron Electronics, Inc by any method of communication will be deemed the sole property of Crestron Electronics Inc.

jobs.title: Sr AI Engineer (Emerging AI)
jobs.description: **About DAT** DAT Freight \& Analytics is an award\-winning employer of choice and a next\-generation SaaS technology company that has been at the leading edge of freight and logistics innovation for nearly five decades. Founded in 1978, DAT operates the largest freight marketplace in North America — processing 250 million\+ load posts annually and maintaining one of the largest repositories of freight market transaction data in the world. On a defined path to $1 billion in revenue, DAT deploys a suite of software solutions, machine learning models, and intelligent automation tools that help brokers, carriers, and shippers price freight accurately, source capacity, reduce risk, and operate more efficiently. With nearly 700 teammates across offices in Denver, CO; Portland, OR; Seattle, WA; Springfield, MO; Toronto, ON; and Bangalore, India, DAT combines the credibility of a multi\-decade market leader with the drive of a company that is not done disrupting the industry it helped build. For more information, visit www.DAT.com **Job Application Deadline:** 11/30/2026 **The Opportunity** As a Sr AI Engineer, you'll build and own the platform that power our agentic solutions at DAT. Freight is an uncertain business, and the models we ship reduce that uncertainty: rate forecasts, load\-to\-truck matching, document extraction, fraud signals, and the agentic workflows our brokers and carriers use to move freight faster. None of that reaches a customer without a platform that makes training, serving, evaluating, and monitoring models routine instead of heroic. You'll help build the platform, from the model gateway and inference layer through feature and vector storage, evaluation harnesses, production observability, agentic framework (A2A) all on a spine based on secure access and utilization. This is a highly visible role for an engineer who wants their work multiplied across every AI team in the company. **What You'll Do** * **Platform Ownership:** Design, build, and operate the shared services that engineers and business users use to ship models: a model gateway for LLM access, inference endpoints for real\-time and batch scoring, feature storage, vector search, and a common SDK. * **Technical Leadership:** Lead architecture for large\-scale AI systems, write the design documents, and drive alignment across Product, and Engineering and Business users on how models get built and shipped at DAT. * **Cloud Architecture:** Architect and run scalable, reliable AI infrastructure on AWS, including Bedrock, SageMaker, EKS, Redpanda, MSK (Kafka), Lambda, and S3, all defined in Pulumi.. * **Evaluation and Quality:** Build the offline and online evaluation systems that tell us whether a model or prompt change is an improvement, including regression suites, LLM\-as\-judge pipelines, A/B and shadow testing, and drift detection. * **Cost and Performance:** Own inference cost and latency as first\-class metrics. Right\-size GPU and serverless capacity, tune batching, caching, and quantization, and give teams clear visibility into what their workloads cost. * **Safety and Governance:** Implement guardrails, prompt and output logging, PII handling, access controls, and model and dataset lineage so AI systems meet our security and customer data commitments. * **Best Practices:** Drive the adoption of modern software development practices across AI work, including automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure\-as\-code. * **Mentorship:** Mentor engineers and data scientists on production ML and distributed systems, and raise the operational bar of every team that builds on the platform. * **Incident Management:** Lead the response and resolution for complex production incidents involving AI services, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventative measures. **The Skills and Experience You'll Bring** * 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, including significant time as a senior or staff engineer owning production infrastructure that other engineering teams depend on. * 4\+ years building and operating machine learning or AI platforms, with models you've taken from notebook to production traffic and then kept healthy. * Strong development language skills ideally using TypeScript/js, Java, or Go, with the software engineering discipline to build libraries other teams adopt willingly. * Extensive AWS experience with production systems, ideally including EKS/Kubernetes, Lambda, Redpanda, MSK/Kafka, S3, and Secrets Manager, plus infrastructure\-as\-code with Pulumi, Terraform or similar. * Hands\-on experience serving models at scale: containerized inference, GPU scheduling, autoscaling, batching, and the tradeoffs between real\-time, streaming, and batch scoring. * Practical experience with LLM systems in production, including retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, prompt and context management, tool\-calling or agent frameworks, and managed model APIs such as Amazon Bedrock. * Prov ous problem spaces, writing clear system design documents and operations runbooks, and driving alignment across Engineering, Product, and Operations. * Proven mentoring track record, especially helping engineers and data scientists grow in system design, observability, and operational excellence. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain trade\-offs and system behavior clearly to engineers, product managers, and non\-technical stakeholders. **Bonus Skills** * Experience with model fine\-tuning, distillation, or parameter\-efficient training, and a clear point of view on when it beats prompting. * Background in marketplace, pricing, forecasting, or document extraction problems. DOSS is trusted by fast\-growing operators to run critical operations with speed, control, and confidence. About the role: Every ERP claims to be "AI\-powered." Almost none of them let an operator ask a question in plain language and get an answer grounded in their live procurement, inventory, and finance data, let alone let an agent safely take action on it. That's the goal of this job: you'll own applied AI across Doss: Dossbot (query, analyze, and automate via chat), AI\-assisted schema and workflow generation, and the agentic automations that turn back\-office busywork into background processes. You'll be the technical anchor for how foundation models meet a transactional system of record. What you’ll do: * Own the applied AI architecture end\-to\-end: model selection, orchestration, RAG over the unified operational data model, evals, guardrails, and cost/latency budgets in production. * Build Dossbot into the primary interface for operations: natural\-language search, analysis, and automation grounded in live supply\-chain, finance, and ops data. * Engineer AI\-assisted tooling that uses foundation models to propose, validate, and apply customer schemas and workflow definitions on live production tenants. * Design agentic workflows that act inside enterprise guardrails: permission\-aware, auditable, tenant\-isolated, and safe to run against a customer's system of record. * Stand up the eval and observability infrastructure to measure quality, catch regressions, and proactively detect anomalous or risky emergent behavior. * Partner with product, design, and our Forward Deployed team to deliver on their highest\-leverage AI use cases. * Mentor and shape engineering culture as the team's center of gravity for applied AI, raising the bar on how we build, evaluate, and ship LLM\-powered systems. What we’re looking for: **Experience** * Shipped LLM\-powered features or agents to production and operated them at scale, not just prototypes or demos. * Deep hands\-on work with foundation model APIs, RAG pipelines, tool use/function calling, prompt and context engineering, and fine\-tuning where it earns its keep. * Built eval harnesses and guardrails for non\-deterministic systems running against business\-critical data. * Strong backend fundamentals: Designing systems, Postgres, and cloud services for reliable, multi\-tenant web applications. * Going from 0 to 1 in ambiguous settings, and judgment for when AI is the right tool and when it isn't. **Qualities** * Team player: you bring positivity, openness, and curiosity to the team every day. * Growth mindset: everything is an opportunity to learn and improve yourself, the team, and the company. * Craftsmanship: you care about making something of quality. * Customer First: you care immensely about the customer experience journey and want to create a product full of delight. * Pragmatic: you make the right decision based on circumstance, not theory. * Low Ego: you work best in collaborative environments where everyone supports the team. Compensation Range: $230K \- $260K

jobs.title: Control Designer
jobs.description: **Dakota Automation, in Watertown, SD, is looking to hire a Control Designer!** **Department:** Engineering **Reports To:** Engineering Manager **Position Type:** Full\-Time **Position Summary** We are seeking a Controls Designer to join our engineering team in the design and development of custom industrial automation equipment. This position is responsible for electrical control system design, including schematic development, component selection, control panel layouts, and electrical documentation. The Controls Designer will work closely with mechanical engineers, controls programmers, and manufacturing personnel to develop practical, reliable, and cost\-effective solutions. Our custom equipment environment offers the opportunity to work on a wide variety of projects, technologies, and manufacturing applications. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop electrical schematics, control panel layouts, and machine wiring documentation for custom automation equipment. * Select and specify electrical components, including PLC hardware, drives, motors, sensors, safety devices, and related control equipment. * Develop and maintain electrical bills of materials (BOMs) and design documentation. * Collaborate with mechanical engineers and controls programmers to ensure proper integration of electrical and mechanical systems. * Design electrical systems in accordance with applicable industry standards and customer requirements. * Support electrical assembly personnel by answering design questions and resolving documentation issues. * Participate in design reviews and identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability, safety, and manufacturability. * Complete assigned design work within established project schedules. * Assist with electrical troubleshooting and design modifications during equipment assembly and testing. **Education, Skills \& Experience** * Associate's or bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Automation Technology, or a related technical field. * Fundamental understanding of electrical circuits, industrial controls, and electrical components. * Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and technical documentation. * Experience with electrical CAD software such as AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, or similar platforms, or the aptitude to learn. * Familiarity with industrial control hardware, including PLCs, motor controls, VFDs, servo systems, sensors, and machine safety devices. * Knowledge of applicable electrical standards, including NFPA 79, NEC, and UL 508A, is beneficial. * Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with engineering and manufacturing teams. * Previous experience with industrial machinery or automation equipment is beneficial but not required. **Candidates with relevant technical education, strong aptitude, and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply, including those with limited industry experience.** **Ideal Candidate** The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, organized, and enjoys solving technical challenges. They have a practical approach to electrical design, communicate effectively with engineering and manufacturing teams, and are comfortable working in an environment where each project presents new requirements and challenges. They take ownership of their work, demonstrate a willingness to learn, and appreciate seeing their designs become functioning equipment. **What We Offer** * Diverse and challenging projects involving custom industrial automation. * A collaborative engineering and manufacturing environment. * Opportunities for technical growth and professional development. * Competitive compensation and benefits based on experience and qualifications. + 401K with match + Flexible schedule + Competitive PTO + Bonus plan \#hc268708

Our customized technology solutions are designed to help customers effectively manage risk, improve their technology performance and allow them to focus on their core business objectives. DataBank is headquartered in the historic former Federal Reserve Bank Building, in downtown Dallas, TX. DataBank is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. The **Technical Support Engineer (Overnight)** is a member of the Support Operations team in the Managed Services department and reports to the Overnight Support Manager. This individual serves as the primary point of contact during overnight hours, providing system management, monitoring, patch management, and scheduled maintenance to meet and exceed the SLA requirements of DataBank while maintaining industry best practices in a multi data center environment. The Overnight Technical Support Engineer 1 addresses Windows, Linux, Cloud, Application, and Network issues and brings them to resolution, while executing planned maintenance windows and patching activities with minimal disruption to customer environments.
