jobs.title: Technical Business Development Manager, Startup & VC Ecosystem
jobs.description: RDQ427R630 This role is in\-person and Bay\-Area\-based by design, so you can be in the room with founders and investors. At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform, so our customers can focus on the high\-value challenges central to their missions. Founded in 2013 by the original creators of Apache Spark™, Databricks has grown from a tiny corner office in Berkeley, CA, to a global organization with over 11,000 employees. Thousands of organizations, from small startups to Fortune 100, trust Databricks with their mission\-critical workloads, making us one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies in the world and one of the top 5 most valuable private companies. ### **About the Role:** Databricks works with founders from the earliest days of their companies, when it is still just a team, an idea, and a lot of unproven AI. The Technical Business Development Manager for the Startup and VC Ecosystem owns the operational engine and the relationships behind that work, and the role is technical. You will run our startup program day to day, sit across from early\-stage founders and talk seriously about their AI systems, produce a steady cadence of founder and investor events in San Francisco, and work hand in hand with the events teams at the venture firms whose founders we most want to reach. You will work closely with Databricks Ventures. This role is built to grow: you will start close to the program, the founders, and the events, and over time, take on more of the relationships and the strategy for how Databricks engages the startup ecosystem end\-to\-end. This role asks for four things that rarely sit in one person: the discipline of an operator who tracks every applicant and commitment without dropping one, the hands of a builder who is genuinely fluent in AI and can talk to a founder as a peer, the ease of someone who earns the trust of founders and the partners at the best venture firms in the country, and the judgment to turn all of that into strategy for how Databricks wins the next generation of companies. Most strong candidates have two of these, and some have three. We are hiring for trajectory: you should already be strong in the operating and the building, and hungry to grow into relationships and strategy. This is one of the rare seats where operating, building, and relationship\-building are the same job. ### **The impact you will have:** * *Run the startup program*: Own the day\-to\-day operations of the program, including applicant intake, evaluation, scoring, routing, and offer decisions, with precise tracking of every applicant, commitment, and outcome. Run it on AI automation built with Databricks AI tooling such as Omnigent, Unity Gateway, Agent Bricks, etc. Strong, hands\-on proficiency with these tools is a requirement, not just knowing your way around them. * *Bring programmatic discipline*: Own the trackers, the automation, the quality bar, and the follow\-through so that nothing falls through the cracks. * *Be technical with founders*: Hold real technical conversations with early\-stage founders about their models, agents, data, and automation, and where Databricks and Neon fit. Earn their trust by being credible on the technology, not by pitching. * *Build and prototype*: Build the automation and internal tooling that runs the program, and stay hands\-on with the same AI tools founders use, so you can assess their technical ideas from a place of experience. This is developer relations at its most technical: close to the code and close to the builders. * *Assess and translate*: Assess each founder's technical capability and the strength of their idea, and carry what you learn back to Product and to Databricks Ventures. * *Run founder and investor events*: Design and run a regular calendar of founder and investor gatherings in San Francisco, including dinners, workshops, office hours, and demo\-day tie\-ins. Partner with the events and platform teams at leading venture firms to co\-produce these gatherings, and build durable relationships with those teams that deepen over time. * *Represent Databricks in the ecosystem*: Show up as a founder\-first, technically credible presence at founder and investor events, and grow into being one of the faces of Databricks across the venture community. * *Grow into ownership*: Work alongside Databricks Ventures on how we engage founders across the full arc of their journey, from a first look at their technology and ideas to whatever they build next, and grow into broader ownership of the startup function as you build trust and results. ### **What we look for:** This is a rare combination, and we know it. We are hiring for trajectory as much as for a finished resume: the strongest candidates are already strong on the first three and eager to grow into the rest. * Genuinely technical with AI. You build. You can prototype an automation, reason about an agent architecture, and get into the details of a founder's stack without hand\-waving. * A programmatic operator with an obsessive eye for detail. You run complex, multi\-track programs without dropping a thread. * The developer\-relations instinct. You earn credibility with builders by being one, and you can explain and teach hard technical ideas clearly. * Comfortable around early\-stage founders and investors, and ready to build relationships with top venture firms, starting with their events teams and growing toward their partners. * Experience helping design and run events that people actually want to attend. * Comfort switching between hands\-on technical work, operational execution, and strategic thinking in the same day. * Based in San Francisco. This role requires regular in\-person time with founders and investors in the Bay Area. * Empathy for founders and a long view of their careers. You understand that a founder's first company is rarely their last. * Nice to have: a background as a founder, an early engineer, or a forward\-deployed or solutions engineer; experience in B2B SaaS, AI and data infrastructure, or developer ecosystems. **Pay Range Transparency** Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non\-commissionable roles or on\-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job\-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. Zone 1 Pay Range $118,900—$163,450 USD **About Databricks** Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram. **Benefits** At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. **Compliance** **If access to export\-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.**

jobs.description: **About Us:** Datacor is the leading provider of software solutions, including ERP, CRM, Asset Tracking, Simulation and Formulation, to the process manufacturing space. We are on a mission to better equip the industry with software solutions and move it forward by building thoughtful, intuitive products that solve our customers' most difficult problems. We are passionate about serving our customers and helping them use data as a competitive advantage. Our customers make products that extend and sustain lives by sanitizing, fertilizing, beautifying, cleaning, and recycling the world we live in. We at Datacor help our customers make those products you use every day more safely, cost effectively and more efficiently through our technology platforms and applications. **The Role:** The Datacor Engineering Software Group (DESG) is seeking a curious, motivated early\-career Software Engineer to join our Flow Simulation team and help build the future of our software. You will work on Fathom, Arrow, Impulse, and xStream, our industry\-leading fluid flow simulation applications, which engineers around the world use to design and analyze piping systems, from steady\-state operation to transient events like a pump trip. This is a generalist role for someone with a solid computer science foundation who wants to grow into a well\-rounded engineer. There are no skill silos here: you will work across the whole application, from user interface and application logic to data models, file formats, integrations, and the tooling that builds and tests it all. You will join a team of software engineers and mechanical and chemical engineers in a mature codebase that is being actively modernized. A structured onboarding plan and an experienced teammate will guide your first weeks, and you will take on more ownership as you grow. **Responsibilities:** * Design, build, and maintain features across all layers of our Windows desktop applications, working from requirements with guidance from senior engineers. * Diagnose and fix defects anywhere in the codebase, including customer\-reported issues escalated from our Support team. * Contribute to internal tooling, build automation, CI/CD pipelines, and test infrastructure. * Take part in our ongoing modernization, including new architecture and user interface frameworks. * Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested code, and take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback. * Share team responsibilities such as build pipeline and bug\-triage rotations. * Collaborate with engineers, QA, Product Management, and domain experts to deliver solutions that meet user needs. * Stay on top of industry trends, and use modern tools, including AI coding assistants, responsibly to continuously improve your skillset. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). * 0–2 years of professional software development experience; internships, co\-ops, and substantial academic or personal projects count. * Proficiency in at least one object\-oriented language, preferably C\# (VB.NET, Java, or C\+\+ also welcome). * Solid grounding in computer science fundamentals: object\-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms. * Working knowledge of version control, including branching, commits, and merging. * Demonstrated ability to write clean, readable, and maintainable code. * Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills, and the judgment to ask for help when stuck. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with the .NET ecosystem and Visual Studio. * Exposure to user interface development, whether desktop (WPF, WinForms) or web. * Experience writing unit tests or working with automated testing. * Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell. * Experience with Git, including pull requests and code reviews. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Agile practices, or tools such as Jira and Bitbucket. * Familiarity with data serialization (JSON, XML) or multi\-threading concepts. * Experience using AI coding assistants thoughtfully, including verifying the code they produce. * Interest in engineering, scientific, or simulation software. Hybrid in Colorado Springs, CO preferred; exceptional remote candidates will be considered. **EOE Statement:** Datacor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis or race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. **Use of AI During Interviews:** At Datacor, we value thoughtful problem\-solving and authentic perspectives. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation process, we ask that candidates do not use generative AI tools or outside assistance during live interviews unless explicitly stated otherwise. We're interested in hearing your experience, your approach, and how you think through challenges.

jobs.description: The Continuous Profiler team at Datadog is building a cutting\-edge continuous profiling product that has low enough overhead to run continuously in production, unlocking insights into how customer applications perform under real workloads at scale. As AI reshapes software development and teams lose touch with how their code works and interacts with the hardware, this capability is becoming more essential than ever, for humans and AI alike. Today the information produced by our profilers is used for everything from automatic performance tuning to root cause analysis. As a distributed systems engineer on the profiling team, you will be contributing to the systems that intake, process, index, store and make sense of the data collected. You will be working with some of the best runtime engineers, visualization experts, data scientists and designers in the industry on challenging and fun problems. Together, we contribute to runtime ecosystems such as Go and tackle novel problems, from profiling asynchronous Python applications to helping customers solve memory leaks in their applications. *At Datadog, we place value in our office culture: the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. jobs.title: AI Development & Agent Ops — Product Manager
jobs.description: **AI Development \& Agent Ops — Product Manager** **Product Management — Infrastructure Solutions Group** Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a **Product Manager** on our **AI Development \& Agent Ops** team in **Hopkinton, MA.** **The Opportunity** Dell Technologies is at an inflection point in how software is built. Our Infrastructure Solutions Group — home to one of the industry's largest developer organizations — is undergoing a fundamental transformation: from traditional SDLC to an agentic development model where engineers orchestrate AI agents across the full software lifecycle. This newly created, hands\-on role sits at the center of a broad and evolving portfolio of agentic operations work — designing, building, and refining the services, platforms, and practices that will enable \~9,000 engineers to develop with agents at scale. **Why This Role** This is not a support role. Dell's AI Development \& Agent Ops organization is operating at the frontier of what it means to build software with AI — and this individual will be in the engine room making it work. You will partner directly with a VP who is deeply engaged in the work, contribute to shaping how one of the world's largest technology companies builds software, and operate at a scale where your individual contributions have outsized organizational impact. You will also be joining at the right moment: early enough to shape the architecture of the transformation, with enough organizational commitment that the work has real resources and real stakes. **About Dell Technologies — ISG Developer Experience** Dell's Infrastructure Solutions Group is a global leader in Solutions, Storage, Compute, and Networking. The Developer Experience organization within ISG is responsible for developer productivity, tooling, observability, and platform engineering for approximately 9,000 engineers. Our current mandate spans agentic SDLC transformation, AI tooling governance, and the operating model changes required to make AI\-assisted development the norm — not the exception. **Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale. **Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.** Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology\- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters. We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer\-first, first\-to\-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo\- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it. If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here. **Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology.** **What You'll Achieve** As a **Product Manager — AI Development \& Agent Ops**, you will be responsible for shaping the agentic portfolio strategy and designing capabilities that enable \~9,000 engineers to develop with AI agents at scale. You will work with cross\-functional stakeholders across ISG on Dell's agentic SDLC transformation — driving how the organization scales and integrates agentic capabilities across the full software development lifecycle. **What We're Looking For** The right candidate is a versatile technical practitioner who combines deep fluency and domain expertise with a genuine passion for the emerging agentic AI landscape. We are looking for someone who is a builder — think prototypes, frameworks, dashboards, documentation — and who thrives in environments where the playbook is still being written. You will: * Influence the agentic portfolio strategy, roadmap, and prioritization framework, defining how Dell scales and integrates agentic capabilities across the am in the SDLC * Establish and govern specification standards, quality gates, and operational best practices to ensure consistent, scalable, and high\-quality adoption of agentic solutions across the SDLC * Research emerging trends, technologies, and market developments within the AI and agentic landscape; conduct proofs of concept, pilots, evaluations, and experimentation to identify opportunities for innovation and value creation * Manage and assess the agentic vendor and partner ecosystem, evaluating solution capabilities, market offerings, and strategic partnerships to strengthen Dell's AI portfolio * Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders across ISG to align priorities, influence decision\-making, and build consensus on agentic strategy, investments, and portfolio direction * Develop executive\-level recommendations, business cases, and portfolio insights that enable leadership alignment and accelerate adoption of agentic capabilities across the organization **Take the First Step Towards Your Dream Career** Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here's what we are looking for with this role: **Essential Requirements** * 8\+ years in a product management role within software\-intensive organizations, with experience contributing to large\-scale transformation * Deep hands\-on familiarity with modern software development practices — CI/CD, DevOps, developer tooling — and a strong working knowledge of the current AI/agentic development landscape * Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous problems, structure them, and deliver concrete outputs: analyses, prototypes, specifications, or frameworks * Experience working cross\-functionally with engineering, product, security, and infrastructure stakeholders * Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical complexity into clear documentation for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Self\-directed work style with a track record of delivering high\-quality work with minimal oversight **Desirable Requirements** * Direct, hands\-on experience with agentic development tools and platforms (e.g., Windsurf/Codeium, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) * Familiarity with MCP ecosystems, LLM token economics, and AI governance frameworks at enterprise scale * Experience in a large enterprise environment with gated release cycles, compliance requirements, and non\-negotiable human oversight needs * Background in developer experience, platform engineering, or internal developer tooling * Experience building dashboards, measurement frameworks, or data instrumentation for developer productivity * Comfort operating in ambiguity: defining structures and processes where few exist, and creating clarity without waiting for it **Compensation** Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. jobs.title: R&D Engineer
jobs.description: **SUMMARY** DI exists to relieve the world of mediocre experiences and to create remarkable ones. Our people make the remarkable possible through an unwavering display of uncommon commitment each day. The R\&D team drives continuous operational excellence by empowering interdepartmental collaboration, integrating systems, and refining processes within physical and digital workflows. Through direct assistance with client projects and internal operational initiatives, The Lab helps to ensure that Dimensional Innovations consistently delivers remarkable experiences. Reporting to the R\&D Manager, the R\&D Engineer I (OPS) role is responsible for executing, maintaining, and documenting internal R\&D operations workflows. This role contributes to the effective operation of existing tools and systems while helping identify opportunities for process improvement and cross\-functional alignment. It plays a meaningful part in enhancing operational efficiency, supporting margin improvement, and eliminating silos within the organization. This position combines developing process knowledge with foundational data analysis skills to support trend identification, system improvements, and monitoring of implementation progress. The R\&D Engineer I (OPS) works closely with the rest of the R\&D team and other department leads to provide training, offer technical support, and contribute to continuous improvement of operational processes. Once updates to systems or procedures are made, this role helps document those changes clearly and consistently to support internal communication and future scalability. The R\&D Engineer I (OPS) learns the team's tools and systems, ensures data and asset integrity, and builds foundational domain expertise under the guidance of more senior team members. **ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES/FUNCTIONS** may include but are not limited to: **Execute*** Execute assigned tasks reliably on client projects and internal initiatives, contributing hands\-on to established workflows. * Make routine decisions within established guidelines and escalate complex issues to senior team members when appropriate. * Conduct data reporting across operations and accounting, covering capacity planning, labor tracking, inventory oversight, and project performance metrics. * Manage project system setup by organizing project folders, configuring Wrike projects, and maintaining associated documentation. * Support Wrike data integrity in collaboration with department leaders and project teams. * Deliver performance visibility to operations teams through the data and reporting infrastructure. * Identify issues and gaps in own work and immediate procedures; raise them for review and seek input to resolve them. * Check details with supervisors to maintain accuracy; follow SOPs closely; flag inconsistencies for review. **Steward (Tools \& Systems)*** Perform routine maintenance to keep the team's tools and systems healthy across physical and digital workflows. * Stay current on software updates and emerging technologies; surface observations and ideas that support innovation, automation, and process improvement. * Manage Wrike maintenance, project folder integrity, and BIM template library upkeep. * Maintain BI dashboard and report integrity along with capacity tracking systems. * Support data reporting and automation tools for operations and accounting, including capacity planning, labor tracking, inventory management, and project performance analysis. * Ensure data and asset integrity within established practices, particularly for internal performance and reporting systems. **Document \& Share.*** Develop clear, accessible documentation for R\&D operations workflows and processes to support understanding and ease of use across teams. * Contribute to team training sessions focused on R\&D operations workflows and continuous process improvement, expanding scope and ownership over time. * Contribute to training materials for both current staff and new hires, aligning content with evolving tools and practices. * Maintain and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) using written guides, video tutorials, and organized file storage; support department\-level training using these resources. **Collaborate*** Participate in cross\-functional team activities; build relationships across DI departments. * Work across departmental lines to identify friction points, resource and knowledge gaps; collaborate with stakeholders on solutions aligned with project goals and client expectations. * Communicate clearly with team members; ask questions to stay aligned with team goals. * Maintain active presence in relevant DI departments (Engineering, Design, Operations, Accounting) to understand each team's specific workflows and challenges. **Learn \& Develop*** Build foundational understanding of the R\&D OPS domain: operations systems, computational/BIM workflows, BI/data analytics, change management. * Demonstrate curiosity and apply fundamentals u al construction methods, material application, and manufacturing processes is a plus. * Strong attention to detail and data accuracy. **Core Abilities*** Takes responsibility for assigned work and follows through reliably under general supervision. * Passion and integrity with the drive to excel and deliver exceptional results. * Responsive: resolves problems as they come up; escalates appropriately; uses available resources when prompted. * Understands the basics of how systems interact across physical and digital workflows; supports team efforts to maintain established systems. * Process\-oriented while maintaining awareness of the big picture. * Confident in providing well\-supported, data\-driven recommendations * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with a customer\-first mindset. * Clear written and verbal communicator; demonstrates leadership by example. * Adaptable to fast\-paced, creative, and custom environments across all team levels. * Able to multitask effectively, meet deadlines, and solve problems under pressure. * Authentic team\-player attitude; willing to help; uncommon commitment to clients and internal teams alike. **EDUCATION/CERTIFICATION/EXPERIENCE*** Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a related field. * Previous experience in fabrication, construction, or architecture industry is a plus. * Operations Management, Information Systems, Architecture (with computational focus), Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design. * 1–3 years of relevant experience in Operations, Project Management, Account Management, or Business Development, with a focus on business operations and process development. * Strong preference for experience with Salesforce CRM and Microsoft Excel. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. * The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms and stoop, kneel, climb, crouch, or crawl * Employee must be able to talk and hear * The employee must be able to occasionally lift and/or move up to 75 pounds * Specific vision abilities required for this job include close vision, distant vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus **WORK ENVIRONMENT**Due to our onsite Fabrication process, the work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, employee may be exposed to wet and/or humid conditions, moving mechanical parts, fumes or airborne particles and outside weather conditions. **INTERESTED IN JOINING OUR TEAM?** Permission to play at DI starts with the ability to be a team player, possess a positive attitude while under a tight deadline and demonstrate an uncommon commitment to your work. Please visit our website (www.dimin.com) to see some of the amazing work we do! This is a salary (exempt) position. DI offers a full benefit package including Medical, Dental and Vision insurance along with Short and Long Term Disability, Life Insurance and Supplemental Accident, Critical Illness and Hospital Indemnity. Additionally, we offer a 401(k) with a match, Health Savings Account match, Paid Time Off (PTO), 7 paid holidays plus an employee chosen Floating Holiday annually, and paid Parental Leave. In 2018, DI incorporated the Great Game of Business principles into the way we do things. The program is designed to create a business of business people, provide transparency into company performance and directly tie daily behavior to impact DIs performance. GGOB allows for the potential of quarterly bonuses as company goals are achieved. Please submit a cover letter, resume and salary requirements. No phone calls please. For more information about working at DI and a full list of available opportunities, please visit https://dimin.com/about/careers.

jobs.description: **If you are an internal applicant, please log into Workday and submit your application via the Jobs Hub.** Join the Discovery family, where quality and service are at the heart of everything we do! **This role will be located at one of Discovery Land Company’s Corporate Office locations in Beverly Hills, California.** **Discovery Land Company** is seeking a full\-time, year\-round **Principal AI Engineer** to join the **Artificial Intelligence** Department. **Job Summary:** Discovery Land Company (DLC) develops and operates private club communities across the U.S. and internationally. DLC's AI team builds the platforms, agents, and workflows that help corporate and club teams work faster with less manual effort. The Principal AI Engineer is the senior technical leader for DLC's AI program, reporting to the VP of Artificial Intelligence. You will co\-own DLC's AI strategy and roadmap with the VP of AI, set the technical direction and engineering standards for all AI solutions, and own the highest\-impact AI use cases end to end: scope the business problem with department leaders, design the solution, build it, ship it, and measure the hours saved. retrieval, and Microsoft 365 automation. + Set and enforce engineering standards for evaluation, logging, guardrails, security, and code review across all production AI solutions. + Lead technical jobs.title: DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description: DISQO is a leading provider of advertising intelligence, measuring brand and performance outcomes across every media channel to power data\-driven marketing decisions. Trusted by 500\+ of the world’s largest brands and 150\+ agency and media partners, and recognized by Inc., Deloitte, Ad Age, Digiday, Forbes, and Cynopsis, DISQO is redefining the power of measurement in advertising. Joining DISQO Nation means being part of a team that moves fast, thinks boldly, and is passionate about solving meaningful problems. At DISQO, our day\-to\-day roles are deeply integrated with AI. We actively empower every team member with cutting\-edge AI tools to automate repetitive tasks and streamline workflows, allowing you to focus your energy on high\-impact, strategic, and creative problem\-solving. Innovation isn't just something we talk about, it's how we operate. We challenge assumptions, embrace new ideas, and continuously push ourselves to build better solutions for our customers and each other. Our values guide how we work and win together. We believe in **winning as one team**, fostering a culture of collaboration, trust, and shared accountability. We **pursue outsized impact** by focusing on opportunities that drive meaningful results for our customers and our business. We **champion the customer** by putting their needs at the center of every decision and delivering solutions that create real value. And we are **relentlessly all in**, bringing energy, passion, and commitment to every challenge, every day. If you're energized by high\-growth environments, motivated by AI\-enabled productivity, and excited by the opportunity to do impactful work alongside talented, driven teammates, you'll feel right at home at DISQO. **About the role:** You'll work at the intersection of Site Reliability Engineering and Cloud Security, keeping our platform highly available, scalable and secure by design. We treat infrastructure as software and believe security should enable engineering velocity, not block it. You'll ship most infrastructure, automation and remediation work with AI coding agents. Your core job is to design the guardrails, reviews and tests that make that safe at scale, and to help build the internal agents that run a growing part of our reliability and security operations. The skill we value most is judgment: knowing when an agent's output is wrong, unsafe or not ready for production, and building systems that catch it when you're not looking. ### **What you will do:** **SRE \& Dev Ops:** * **Infrastructure as code:** Build and run secure, multi\-account AWS infrastructure with Terraform and GitOps. * **Kubernetes:** Operate and harden Amazon EKS workloads and the container platform. * **Service reliability:** Define, track and enforce SLOs, SLIs and error budgets across our microservices, including services that depend on LLMs (fallbacks, latency and cost budgets). * **Observability:** Run and improve our observability stack on Grafana, Newrelic * **Toil reduction:** Write automation in Python or Go. Agents do much of the authoring; you own the design, testing and review. * **Developer support:** Be the go\-to partner for engineering teams on infrastructure, deployments and environments. Help them debug build, pipeline and runtime issues, and turn recurring requests into self\-service. * **Infrastructure enablement:** Help teams provision and change infrastructure through reviewed Terraform and GitOps workflows, and support new services from first deploy to production readiness. * **CI/CD \& release:** Maintain and improve build and deployment pipelines, release processes and environment management so teams can ship quickly and safely. **Cloud Security****:** * **AWS security posture:** Own IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, CloudTrail and Control Tower across our accounts. * **Zero trust \& identity:** Enforce least privilege and short\-lived credentials for people, services and AI agents alike. * **Network defense:** Design secure network boundaries, egress filtering and WAF rules that limit blast radius. * **Shift\-left security:** Embed SAST, SCA, container scanning and policy\-as\-code (OPA) into GitLab CI and ArgoCD without slowing teams down. * **Vulnerability management:** Scale scanning, triage and code review to match the growing volume of AI\-generated code. * **Secure by default:** Partner with product teams in design reviews so new services follow secure architecture patterns. * **Detection \& response:** Build detections mapped to MITRE ATT\&CK and respond to both reliability outages and security incidents as part of the on\-call rotation. **AI Native Platform Development****:** * **Internal agents:** Build and operate agents, MCP servers and skills that automate SRE and security workflows. * **Agent identity \& guardrails:** Treat agents as non\-human identities with scoped permissions, approval gates for high\-risk actions (such as production changes and IAM edits) and u bring to the role:** * **Experience:** 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Cloud Security Engineering roles. * **Cloud Expertise:** Strong production expertise with AWS core services, networking, multi\-account governance, and AWS\-native security tooling (IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, KMS). * **Infrastructure as Code:** Advanced hands\-on proficiency with Terraform, GitOps, and configuration management. * **Containers \& Kubernetes:** In\-depth knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes (EKS) administration, deployment, and container runtime security. * **Coding \& Scripting:** Proven ability to write clean, modular automation code in **Python** or **Go** (not just configuring tools, but authoring custom automations, tooling, and integrations). * **CI/CD Integration:** Solid experience building, maintaining, and securing CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, ArgoCD, ArgoWorflows). * **AI Tooling Adoption:** Active, daily experience leveraging AI coding agents and development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to accelerate delivery and automate workflows. * **Mindset:** Strong collaboration, clear communication, and a philosophy that security empowers development velocity rather than acting as a blocker. ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * **Certifications:** AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Certified Security \- Specialty, CKA/CKS (Certified Kubernetes Administrator/Security Specialist), or CISSP. * **SecOps / EDR Experience:** Familiarity with endpoint security (CrowdStrike), modern SIEM/SOAR platforms, and vulnerability management workflows. * **Compliance Frameworks:** Familiarity with SOC 2 Type I/II, ISO 27001, GDPR, and CCPA compliance requirements in cloud environments. $180,000 \- $195,000 a year**Your pay will be determined by your experience, work location, and other applicable factors.** \#LI\-MV1 At DISQO, we pride ourselves on having a positive, performance\-oriented workplace that includes a flexible hybrid approach, competitive medical benefits, and an amazing vacation policy. **Perks \& Benefits:** * 100% covered Medical/Dental/Vision for employee, competitive dependent coverage * Stock options * 401K * Generous PTO policy * Team offsites, social events \& happy hours * Life Insurance * Health FSA * Catered lunch and fully stocked kitchen * Paid Maternity/Paternity leave * Disability Insurance * Travel Assistance Program * 24/7 Counseling Services offered to Employees ***Note: The benefits noted above are for full time US based employees only.*** **DISQO is an equal opportunity employer. Discovery, innovation, and growth are possible when we open ourselves to new possibilities, perspectives, and approaches. impact on real customer tasks. * **Find the best balance of quality, latency, and cost:** run rigorous experiments, including fine\-tuning open\-weights models and deploying small language models (SLMs) where they can replace or augment larger LLMs. * **Launch new agents:** take agentic opportunities for Merchants and Dashers from early exploration to production. * **Turn foundations into product impact:** work with teammates on agentic memory, agent\-compatible product representations, and post\-training SLMs for steerable generative recommendation, and bring those capabilities into production agents. * **Shape the roadmap:** partner with engineering, product, and business leaders to define an ML\-driven strategy for our fast\-growing grocery and retail delivery business. **We're software applications * Leveraging generative AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate research, coding, debugging, documentation, and testing while maintaining high standards of code quality * Supporting integration efforts across APIs, data sources, and external systems to ensure seamless, secure, and scalable application connectivity * Designing and developing robust software solutions that support business\-critical initiatives * Collaborating with cross\-functional teams in an environment that encourages innovation and continuous improvement * Contributing to the development of scalable distributed systems and modern web applications * Developing and maintaining front\-end and back\-end application components * Writing and maintaining unit tests to ensure software quality and reliability * Staying current on emerging software development technologies, architectures, design patterns, and generative AI advancements * Communicating technical concepts, project status, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders **So What Kind of Folks Are We Looking For?** --------------------------------------------- * Ability to build strong cross\-functional relationships with business and technology partners * Strong verbal and written communication skills * Passion for continuous learning and professional development, particularly in AI and LLM technologies * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities * Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a team environment * Ability to adapt quickly to evolving technologies and business priorities * Experience working on complex technical challenges and delivering practical solutions * Commitment to producing high\-quality, maintainable, and scalable software **The Specifics.** ------------------ * 3\+ years experience in software, web, or application development * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field or equivalent work experience * Experience with backend development frameworks such as Spring Boot, FastAPI, Gin/Fiber, or similar technologies * Experience with C\# and .NET development preferred * Experience developing and consuming APIs, including RESTful services, .NET Web API, MassTransit, and Async API * Experience with modern front\-end frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue * Experience with client\-side SPA development * Experience developing unit tests * Experience deploying and supporting applications in cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or GCP * Experience integrating applications with LLMs such as OpenAI using SDKs or frameworks including Semantic Kernel, LangChain, Foundry, or similar technologies * Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and/or TypeScript **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building and supporting distributed systems at scale * Exposure to modern AI\-assisted software development practices * Experience working in agile development environments * Familiarity with cloud\-native architectures and microservices design patterns **So What About the Perks? Perks matter** * **We** **take a hybrid work approach,** finding balance between the benefits of in\-person and work\-from\-home environments. This position has an on\-site expectation of a minimum of three days a week. * **Medical, dental, and vision, oh my!** DriveTime Family of Brands covers a sizable amount of insurance premiums to ensure our employees receive top\-tier healthcare coverage. * **But Wait, There’s More.** 401(K), Company paid life insurance policy, short and long\-term disability coverage to name a few. * **Growth Opportunities.** You grow, I grow, we all grow! But seriously, DriveTime Family of Brands is committed to providing its employees with every opportunity to grow professionally with roughly over 1,000 employees promoted year over year. * **Tuition Reimbursement.** We’re as passionate about your professional development as you are. With that, we’ll put our money where our mouth is. * **Wellness Program.** Health is wealth! This program includes self\-guided coaching and journeys, cash incentives and discounts on your medical premiums through engaging in fun activities! * **Gratitude is Green.** We offer competitive pay across the organization, because, well… money matters! * **In\-House Gym.** We want our employees to be the best versions of themselves. So come early, take a break in your day or finish strong with a workout! * **Give Us a Reason (or not), and We’ll Celebrate.** Regardless of whether there is a holiday or not, we are finding ways to kick back and enjoy each other’s company outside of day\-to\-day work. * **Smart\-Casual Dress.** Come dressed in jeans (you’ll fit right in with the rest of us). * **Paid Time Off.** Not just lip service: we work hard, to play hard! Paid time off includes (for all full\-time roles) wellness days, holidays, and good ole' fashioned YOU time! For our Part\-timers, don't fear you get some time too...vacation time is available \- the more you work, the more you earn! **Anything Else? Absolutely.** DriveTime Family of Brands is Great Place to Work Certified! And get this: 90% of our rockstar employees say they feel right at home here. We could spend a lot of time having you read about ALL our awards, but we’ll save time (and practice some humility) just naming a few others; Comparably Awards: Best Company for Diversity, Best Company Culture and Best Company Leadership, oh and don’t forget Phoenix Business Journal Healthiest Employers (okay, we’ll stop there)! Hiring is contingent upon successful completion of our background and drug screening process. DriveTime is a drug\-free, tobacco\-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. And when it comes to hiring, we don't just look for the right person for the job, we seek out the right person for DriveTime. Buckle up for plenty of opportunities to grow in a professional, fun, and high\-energy environment!

(see E Ink Our Company) (https://www.eink.com/about?company) #### **About the position:** The Sr. Process Engineer will provide technical leadership to build and operate the process capability for a new Copper Clad Laminate (CCL) research and development program. This hands\-on role owns small\-scale equipment, hot\-press and lamination process development, the CCL process laboratory, integrated process development, automation, process specifications, and transfer toward larger\-scale operation. The engineer will convert material and interface concepts into repeatable processes and will work with the analytical and reliability engineer to correlate process conditions with signal loss, physical performance, and reliability. The ideal candidate combines strong process\-engineering fundamentals with deep hands\-on hot\-press experience, equipment expertise, laboratory discipline, automation capability, and practical problem solving. #### **Responsibilities:** * Source, evaluate, specify, and commission small\-scale equipment—including laboratory hot presses, associated tooling, and auxiliary systems—needed to establish flexible CCL process\-development capability. * Modify and integrate commercial or custom equipment when needed, including fixtures, material handling, controls, sensors, data acquisition, ventilation, guarding, and safety interlocks. * Set up and manage the CCL process laboratory, including equipment layout, utilities, EHS controls, SOPs, training, preventive maintenance, calibration, material flow, and daily operational readiness. * Develop and integrate the end\-to\-end CCL process from incoming materials through finished research samples, with direct ownership of hot\-press and lamination operations, while protecting confidential process details and research direction. * Translate particle\-treatment and material concepts from the material scientist into repeatable, scalable, and increasingly automated chemical\-processing workflows. * Develop and optimize hot\-press tooling and platen configuration; pressure\-temperature\-time profiles; heating and cooling rates; material flow and consolidation; thickness and pressure uniformity; defect control; cycle repeatability; and safe operation. Establish critical process parameters, operating windows, process specifications, control plans, sampling requirements, and acceptance criteria for individual operations and the integrated process. * Design and execute DOE to determine how equipment settings and process conditions affect uniformity, defects, signal loss, mechanical and thermal behavior, and reliability. * Develop process monitoring, automation, and data\-collection methods that improve control, repeatability, traceability, throughput, and efficient learning. * Own equipment and process troubleshooting, support cross\-functional root cause analysis, and implement process corrective and preventive actions; improve safety, yield, repeatability, capability, and transferability toward larger scale. * Provide technical guidance to project team members; document equipment and process requirements, experimental results, and specifications; collaborate with the Director, material scientist, analytical and reliability engineer, suppliers, facilities, and EHS. #### **Qualifications:** * M.S. or PhD in Chemical, Mechanical, Materials, or Polymer Engineering, Chemistry, or a related field; typically 7\+ years of relevant industrial process\-development or equipment\-engineering experience. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience developing and operating hot\-press, compression\-molding, or lamination processes is required, including press setup, tooling, pressure\-temperature\-time profiles, heating and cooling control, uniformity, defect reduction, and cycle repeatability. Experience with related material, film, coating, thermal, or chemical processes at laboratory or pilot scale is also valued. * Ability to write equipment specifications, source qualified vendors, conduct technical evaluations, manage installation and commissioning, and modify equipment for new applications. * Experience establishing or managing a   automated chemical processing, instrumentation, process controls, data acquisition, and safe equipment integration. * Ability to interpret process and product data, including uniformity, defects, signal loss, mechanical and thermal behavior, and reliability results. * Experience with CCL, PCB materials, electronic materials, polymer composites, or other precision multilayer products is preferred. * Strong equipment and chemical safety mindset, including process\-hazard review, machine guarding, ventilation, interlocks, safe maintenance, and scale\-up practices. * Strong project management, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with scientists, engineers, suppliers, contractors, EHS, facilities, and business teams. **Benefits:** * Competitive Total Compensation Package * Medical, Dental and Vision on 1st day * Company 401K match * Paid Time Off \& Holidays * Sick Leave Policy * Casual day to day work environment * Hybrid/flexible work environment (for some positions) **Compensation Disclosure:** At E Ink, we believe in rewarding employees with competitive total compensation through a combination of base salary and performance\-based bonuses, with a larger portion of total compensation delivered through our annual bonus program than is typical at many companies. jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description: Overview: **About ERMCO** Electric Research and Manufacturing Cooperative, Inc. (ERMCO) is the leading manufacturer of distribution transformers and engineered electrical solutions, serving electric utilities, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), and industrial customers across North America. Headquartered in Dyersburg, Tenn., ERMCO delivers reliable, high\-quality products that power homes, businesses, and communities across North America. With commitments to safety, operational excellence, and continuous improvement, ERMCO is at the forefront of supporting grid modernization and energy transition. Our vertically integrated operations, customer\-focused culture, and investment in people and technology make ERMCO the Most Valued Partner for delivering resilient, sustainable power infrastructure for the future. **Summary** The Technical Project Manager (Process Engineering and Continuous Improvement) is responsible for developing and executing a portfolio of projects and initiatives that enable the Single\-Phase Pole Plant to achieve its strategic objectives including being viewed as the Most Valued Partner with its customers. The TPM will lead a team of Technical Process Engineers and be a key member of the Pole Plant Leadership team, reporting to the Pole Plant General Manager. ***This position is located onsite in Dyersburg, TN. Relocation assistance is available.*** Responsibilities: **Responsibilities** **Project Leadership \& Execution*** Lead the full lifecycle of manufacturing and technical projects from chartering through implementation and sustainment, ensuring delivery on time and within constraints (scope/cost/resources). * Establish project governance: charters, milestones, tollgates, RAID logs, change control, and stakeholder communication cadence. * Drive cross\-functional alignment and execution across Ops, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Planning/Scheduling, Maintenance, and EHS. * Translate business objectives into measurable targets using KPIs (throughput, lead time, WIP, FPY, scrap/rework, schedule adherence, OTD). * Establish financial and operational business cases for major projects and verify realized benefits following implementation. * Maintain a pipeline of projects that support the Pole Plant in achievement of best\-in\-class Safety, Quality, Delivery and Cost results. * Champion and build a Continuous Improvement Culture that engages the full workforce around improvement, in all aspects of the business. * Working closely with engineering and manufacturing, supports the addition of new equipment and processes including automation. * Develops a high\-performing Process Engineering Team that is integrated into the Pole Plant. **Flow Optimization/Lean System Design/Daily Management*** Diagnose and improve end\-to\-end system flow using modern Lean tools. * Map and redesign material and information pathways (routing, kitting, replenishment triggers, scheduling logic, shortages signaling) to reduce waiting, batching, expediting, and firefighting. * Partner with planning/scheduling to improve schedule quality (constraint\-based thinking, realistic load, execution discipline). * Lead Lean deployments: value stream mapping, line balancing, pull systems (Kanban), standard work, visual management, and point\-of\-use organization. * Build sustainment mechanisms: tiered daily management, Gemba routines, standard work audits, and leader standard work. **Quality Systems Integration (Built\-in Quality)*** Ensure improvements align with Quality Systems: control plans, process checks, layered audits, NCR/CAPA workflows, and mistake\-proofing. * Partner with Quality/Engineering to reduce defect escape and rework through improved process capability and controls. **Risk Management, Change Management \& Communication*** Identify risks early and develop mitigation plans (technical, operational, safety, quality, schedule, supply). * Lead change management: training plans, standard work updates, adoption verification, and sustainment routines. * Communicate clearly to leadership: concise updates with facts, options, and tradeoffs. **People Leadership*** Develop Process Engineers’ capability in modern lean tools and problem\-solving approaches. * Conduct regular 1:1s and development planning; build a strong bench of technical talent for growth and ramps. * Provide direct leadership, supervision, and development of a team of Process Engineers, including goal setting, prioritization, performance management, and coaching. Qualifications: **Required Qualifications** * Experience in transformer manufacturing or similar high\-mix industrial manufacturing environments preferred. * 8 to 10 yrs of leadership in Operations, Engineering, Quality or Continuous Improvement. * PMP and/or Lean/Six Sigma certification (Green Belt/Black Belt) preferred or willingness to obtain. * Experience leading Continuous Improvement initiatives and building CI Project Pipelines. * Experience leading Kaizen or other focused improvement activities. * Strong collaboration skills, ability to drive execution through positive influence. **Let’s Build the Future Together** At ERMCO, your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your impact is real. Overview: The Enterprise Systems Architect in Enterprise Data \& Analytics will define and guide the future\-state architecture across customer\-facing product systems, enterprise business applications, data, integrations, and internal platforms. Delivery teams and solution architects remain accountable for detailed solution design and implementation within that direction. The role will report to the Chief Information Officer and serve as the enterprise architecture lead across the Eagleview technology ecosystem. a full\-time, remote role with salary range of $147,700 \- $190,000, bonus eligible.** Responsibilities: * Define current\-state, transition\-state, and target\-state architectures across customer journeys, product platforms, business applications, data, integrations, security, and infrastructure dependencies. * Build and maintain enterprise capability maps, value\-stream views, system context diagrams, integration views, and application portfolio views that clarify purpose, ownership, lifecycle, dependencies, duplication, risk, and strategic disposition. * Guide architecture for lead\-to\-cash, customer onboarding, ordering, fulfillment, entitlement, usage and consumption, billing, payments, service, financial reporting, and customer self\-service. * Clarify systems of record and governed information flows for customer, account, contract, product, pricing, order, entitlement, usage, invoice, payment, support, and operational data. * Evaluate how product systems such as versioning, ownership, quality, auditability, and operational supportability. * Lead architecture discovery before solution choices become fixed, ensuring requirements reflect enterprise, customer, financial, operational, product, security, and cross\-functional needs. * Frame decision\-quality options for executives, including customer experience, operating model, cost, risk, delivery capacity, regulatory exposure, vendor dependency, and technical\-debt implications. * Evaluate vendor and platform proposals for business capability fit, interoperability, configurability, security, and third\-party risk requirements into architecture decisions.Partner with product managers, engineering leaders, business application owners, data leaders, security, and finance stakeholders * to align transformation roadmaps and sequencing. * Mentor architects, analysts, technical leads, and engineers while preserving clear accountability for delivery ownership. * Other duties as assigned. solution commitments are made. **First 12 months**: You have helped re  model business capabilities, value streams, customer journeys, applications, information flows, integration patterns, and technology dependencies for both executives and delivery teams. * Strong command of modern integration and data architecture, including APIs, events, data contracts, master data, systems of record, jobs.title: Engineering and AI Operations Specialist
jobs.description: **\*\*No sponsorship/C2C is available for this position\*\*** **Engineering and AI Specialist** **Reports To:** Director of Technical Delivery **Location:** Remote **FLSA:** Exempt **Job Summary** The AI Operations Specialist builds and runs the internal AI tooling, automations, and pilots that make AI a practical, everyday part of how Elevate Digital's Engineering team delivers. Reporting to the Director of Technical Delivery, this role turns the AI operations roadmap into working software: maintaining agent pipelines and internal tools, testing new models and tools against real workflows, and keeping engineers unblocked as they adopt them. This is an execution\-focused role, not a standard\-setting one. Direction, governance, and org\-wide AI standards for Engineering remain owned by the Director of Technical Delivery; the AI Operations Specialist is the builder who makes that direction real, working alongside the Director on shared tooling projects rather than owning all of it independently. **Duties and Responsibilities** **Tooling \& Automation** * Build, maintain, and extend the AI tooling and agent pipelines Engineering relies on — including coding\-agent integrations, MCP servers, and internal bots or scripts — working alongside the Director of Technical Delivery on shared tooling priorities. * Keep existing automations reliable as models, APIs, and internal workflows change, monitoring for breakage and patching quickly. * Maintain a lightweight, current catalog of what tooling is live, what's experimental, and what's been retired. **Pilots \& Evaluation** * Run scoped pilots applying AI to specific internal workflows — ticket triage, documentation, code review assistance, onboarding, and similar — and report results back to the Director of Technical Delivery. * Hands\-on evaluation of new AI models, tools, and vendors as they emerge: what they're good for, what they cost, and whether they fit Elevate's delivery workflows. * Track basic usage, cost, and quality signals for AI tooling so adoption decisions rest on evidence rather than hype. **Enablement \& Support** * Support engineers adopting AI tooling day to day — answering questions, unblocking issues, and sharing practical techniques that actually work. * Produce lightweight documentation, guides, or walkthroughs so internal tools are usable by people other than the person who built them. * Surface friction, bugs, and gaps in existing tooling and pipelines back to the Director of Technical Delivery as input to the roadmap. **Required Competencies and Skills** * **Builder Mentality:** Genuine hands\-on drive to build and ship internal tools and automations — this role is defined by making things, not evaluating them from the sidelines. * **AI/LLM Practical Fluency:** Working knowledge of agentic workflows, prompt engineering, MCP, and RAG\-style patterns, gained through real building rather than credentials alone. * **Automation \& Scripting:** Comfortable writing scripts, integrations, and lightweight pipelines to connect tools and remove manual work. * **Judgment Under Ambiguity:** Able to size up a new tool or pilot quickly, form a point of view, and know when a decision needs to go to the Director of Technical Delivery rather than being made unilaterally. * **Documentation Habit:** Writes clear, lightweight documentation as a habit, not an afterthought, so tools and pilots are usable by others. * **Collaborative Execution:** Works well executing someone else's roadmap and priorities on shared tooling projects, without needing to own the strategy to stay motivated. **Experience and Education** * Solid grounding in programming fundamentals — able to read, reason about, and debug the code and systems they build, not just accept AI\-generated output at face value. This is not a "vibe coding" role. * Demonstrated experience building automations, scripts, or AI\-assisted tooling — through professional work, side projects, or hands\-on experimentation. What you've built and can explain matters more than where you learned to build it. * Practical, hands\-on experience with agentic coding tools, AI coding assistants, or LLM\-based pipelines, used deliberately rather than as a black box. * Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast\-changing technical territory where best practices are still being written. * Self\-taught and non\-traditional paths are welcome, provided they come with real engineering fundamentals. Some formal computer science background is preferred, but demonstrated ability to understand and reason about the code and systems being built matters more than the credential itself. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is a plus but not required given equivalent, demonstrable fundamentals. **Values Alignment** The AI Operations Specialist embodies Elevate Digital's core pillars and the way we work: * **People Advantage:** You build tools that make engineers faster and better at their jobs, not tools that quietly replace their judgment. * **Client Growth:** You measure your work by whether it actually gets used and actually saves time — not by how sophisticated it looks. * **Services Transformation:** You're energized by building in undefined territory, comfortable that today's tool may be rebuilt or replaced next quarter as the landscape shifts. * **Responsible by Default:** You hold your own tooling to a high bar for reliability and security, especially anywhere it touches client work or sensitive data. **Travel Required** This is a remote role with no regular travel expectation. Occasional participation in team gatherings or planning sessions may be requested. **Other Duties** This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this role. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time, with or without notice, as business needs evolve.

jobs.title: Software Engineer- Full Stack
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. Full Stack Software Engineer – Software Product Engineering Come develop great software solutions to solve exciting problems that help patients! The Software Product Engineering team is looking for a full stack engineer. Are you determined to own and complete complicated and technically ambitious work? Are you passionate about technology, with extensive full stack development experience across both front\-end and back\-end systems? Our team is actively adopting AI across the development lifecycle to help us build better software, faster, and we're looking for engineers who are excited to be part of that evolution while bringing strong engineering fundamentals. If so, please apply. **What You'll Be Doing:** As part of a collaborative team of versatile engineers, you will build reusable, composable software components, taking them from design and requirement specifications through implementation, testing, and integration into Software Product Engineering's next\-generation platform ecosystem. By continuously improving the design, building for maintainability, and ensuring the product meets both business and patient needs, your work will transform patient experiences and improve treatment outcomes. **How You'll Succeed :** * Develop, test, and deploy components into provisioned cloud platform environments through automated Continuous Integration and Deployment (CI/CD) processes. * Review and implement technical designs, translating them into APIs, user interfaces, libraries, and services across a range of programming languages while adhering to Lilly's architecture, design, implementation, and security standards. * Use AI coding tools to accelerate design exploration, implementation, testing, and debugging, while owning the correctness, security, and maintainability of everything you ship. * Build and integrate AI capabilities into products, such as LLM\-powered features and agent tools, where they improve patient and user outcomes. * Build working knowledge of medical device delivery models and quality systems, including GxP expectations, to ensure solutions align with regulatory requirements and timelines. * Integrate open source and licensed components into larger solutions, making practical reuse decisions and ensuring dependencies are sourced through approved enterprise channels (e.g., Artifactory) and meet security and licensing requirements. * Investigate and propose solutions to development and design problems through open collaboration and healthy debate, including scope estimation and forecasting. * Collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, engineers, stakeholders, and vendors within the team and across Lilly. * Establish strong relationships with technical leaders and architects to influence technology direction for Software Product Engineering platforms and products. * Practice effective source control, code review, and collaborative programming to drive high\-quality outcomes. * Partner with data professionals to implement database and data warehousing solutions. * Complete projects with minimal supervision and direction. **What You Should Bring :** * Experience designing and building cloud\-native applications using containerized services and microservices architectures on AWS or Azure. * Exposure to large\-scale architectural patterns, ideally with hands\-on experience implementing event\-driven systems using Apache Kafka (or similar) for scalable, resilient processing. * Strong object\-oriented programming skills, excellent debugging skills, and expertise with data serialization, REST APIs, and version control. * Experience with TypeScript, Node.js, or a JVM language (e.g., Kotlin) for building front\-end and back\-end services, along with HTML, CSS, and SASS; Python experience is a plus. * Experience building applications with modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue, Next.js, or Nuxt) and modern build tooling (e.g., Vite, Webpack). * Familiarity with build automation and containerization technologies such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes. * Experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) in your development workflow; familiarity with LLM application patterns such as RAG, tool use, or MCP is a plus. * A proven track record of Agile software development, demonstrated through a portfo tems * Experience with multiple languages (polyglot programming), including JavaScript/TypeScript or a JVM language (e.g., Kotlin) * Professional experience delivering software solutions across the full development life cycle, including project initiation, design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, support, and retirement * Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F\-1 CPT, F\-1 OPT, F\-1 STEM OPT, J\-1, H\-1B, TN, O\-1, E\-3, H\-1B1, or L\-1\. Additional Information Position based in San Francisco, California with a hybrid work model. About the organization Tech @ Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using groundbreaking technologies like most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Tech @ Lilly is that we create new possibilities through tech to advance our purpose – creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, like data driven drug discovery and connected clinical trials. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of our business. Lilly's Software Product Engineering (SPE) organization is focused on building core foundational software platforms to accelerate our ability to reach and support patients, digitally. jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (NetSuite, Python, Node.js)

You will set the technical direction, assign and review the work of other developers, and report directly to leadership. NetSuite development experience is required. What you and your team build goes into use right away. **What You’ll Do** **Lead the team** * Manage a team of developers: assign work, set priorities, and hold the team to deadlines * Review code and approve releases before they reach production * Set coding standards, Git workflow, documentation and deployment practices for the team * Run sprint planning and turn leadership requests into scoped, scheduled work * Hire, onboard, mentor and evaluate developers * Report progress, risks and blockers to leadership every week **Build** * Build and maintain integrations, automations and internal tools across NetSuite, Zoho, warehouse, shipping and eCommerce systems * Write SuiteScript, SuiteQL and NetSuite REST and SOAP integrations * Develop APIs, backend services and automation scripts in Python and Node.js * Integrate shipping carriers, marketplaces and payment processors * Build internal dashboards, reporting and workflow automations * Build full stack web apps with React on the front end and Node.js and Express on the back end * Design scalable, high availability services, including microservices where they fit * Run CI/CD pipelines for continuous deployment * Optimize MySQL and PostgreSQL databases for data integrity and scale * Own projects end to end: planning, development, testing, deployment and iteration * Work with AWS and Azure deployment environments * Troubleshoot API failures and integration problems in production **Requirements** * Hands\-on NetSuite development experience: SuiteScript, SuiteQL, REST or SOAP APIs.
