jobs.title: Engineering Manager , Backend
jobs.description: **About Fubo:** FuboTV Inc. is a consumer\-first live TV streaming company that is defining the future of TV. Ranked among Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies (2026\) and the Financial Times' The Americas' Fastest\-Growing Companies (2026, 2025\), FuboTV owns Hulu \+ Live TV (entertainment), Fubo (sports) and Molotov (entertainment and sports), which stream in markets around the globe. **Our Mission:** Our mission is to deliver premium sports, news and entertainment programming through a best\-in\-class user experience that offers greater choice, flexibility and value. **About the Role:** **\*This role is a New York City based HYBRID position. Candidates must be located in NYC, and willing to come into the office on a hybrid basis, three times a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday).\*** As an Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of backend engineers building product features and maintaining a healthy, reliable platform. This is a hands\-on role. You will design, code, and review alongside your team while shaping how we build software in an AI\-first engineering organization. Your team owns backend services that power the Fubo user experience across a microservices architecture, and supports squads across Product, Design, and Engineering. You will direct your team's work wherever it's most impactful, grow your engineers' careers, and guide backend contributions from partner teams. You will own a team at the center of Fubo's platform, partnering with Engineering Managers in the US, France, and India to define a shared technical vision. You will report to an Engineering Manager in NYC and work closely with Product Managers and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical plans. **Responsibilities:** * Own the success and long\-term vision of the backend services layer by designing API's that drive the frontend user experience * Prioritize work for your team, ensuring on\-time deliverables and high\-quality software. * Provide hands\-on technical leadership through system design, coding, code review, and mentorship * Own the health, reliability, and performance of the systems your team builds * Fubo is investing heavily in AI to optimize its software development process. We expect you to be hands\-on and proactively discover new ways AI tools and new processes can improve speed and quality for you, your team, and the org * Lead recruiting, interviewing, hiring, and onboarding in partnership with Talent Acquisition * Partner with Engineering, Product, Design, and other teams to achieve shared goals **Requirements:** * 8\+ years experience as a software engineer and 3\+ years leading medium to large software engineering teams * Proven experience building large\-scale distributed systems with SOA or microservices architecture, preferably with Golang * Experience with caching, circuit\-breaking, distributed traces, load testing * Experience in a CI/CD environment, and with test automation strategies * Experience with relational databases * Experience with monitoring and observability tools * Strong verbal and written communication * A self\-driven, proactive, and curious team player with the ability to collaborate cross functionally with many different teams, with a focus on win\-win solutions **Our tech stack:** * Go/Golang * Docker and Kubernetes * Google Cloud Platform * Datadog **Perks \& Benefits:** * At Fubo, you will have the opportunity to personally influence what live media looks like after it goes through its next big transformation * Fubo provides a highly competitive compensation based on experience and market standards * Robust benefit package including Health/Dental/Vision coverage 401k, Life Insurance, and commuter benefits * Free Premium Fubo Account * Unlimited PTO days and regular company\-wide activities * Fubo's main headquarters are located in Midtown Manhattan, with offices in Paris, and Bangalore * Fubo is an e\-verified company Fubo's minimum base salary for this role if hired in New York City is $200,000 per year; maximum base salary for this role is $250,000 per year. Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Fubo's equity plan, annual cash bonus plans, unlimited PTO, and a full range of medical benefits. The final offer amount will be at the company's sole discretion and determined by multiple factors, including years and depth of experience and expertise, location and other business considerations.

jobs.title: IT Technician
jobs.description: Job description: **ROLE SUMMARY** Junior IT Generalist / IT Support Technician responsible for the day today technical setup, support, and equipment movement that keeps the San Antonio operation running. This role exists to take the small technical work off the CEO and the dev team, onboarding tech, hardware setup, fixes, and physical IT support. So higher value people aren't pulled into laptop builds and desk setups. **Level:** Junior. This is a hands\-on support/setup role, NOT a network engineer, sysadmin, or developer. Strong fit for someone early\-career who is reliable, hands\-on, and wants to grow. **Status:** Full\-time (minimum). Willingness to stay late when the operation needs it is expected and valued — this role rewards people who show they want to be here. **Compensation:** $40,000 year salary. **CORE RESPONSIBILITIES** 1\. New Hire Technology Onboarding (recurring: primary work) Set up laptops for every new hire (image, software, accounts, security) Set up company phones (device, lines, apps: Telegram, Zoom, Samsara, Dialpad, etc.) Create/configure email accounts (Google Workspace) and access. Set up the new hire's desk/workstation. Monitor, dock, peripherals, cabling. Hardware Setup \& Repair Set up new computers/workstations Fix/troubleshoot computers (hardware \+ basic software issues) Printers, monitors, peripherals, wifi/connectivity troubleshooting Maintain a basic inventory of equipment and supplies. 3\. jobs.title: Designated Technical Support Engineer, Ops
jobs.description: **About Glean:** Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry's most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full\-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business \- without vendor lock\-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context\-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean's agentic capabilities \- AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry's broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real\-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World's Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025\), by CNBC's Disruptor 50, Bloomberg's AI Startups to Watch (2026\), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner's Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50\+ industries and 1,000\+ employees in more than 25 countries, we're helping the world's largest organizations make every employee AI\-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you're excited to shape how the world works, you'll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. **About the Role:** Glean is seeking a highly analytical individual to sit within the Support Organization and focus on making our Support team more effective through metrics, AI‑powered tooling, and operational excellence. **You will:** * Metrics, Reporting \& Insights + Define, track, and continuously refine Support metrics, including ticket volume, TTR, CSAT, deflection, automation rate, containment, backlog health, and agent effort. + Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports in spreadsheets and BI tools (e.g., Sigma / Looker / Tableau) to give Support and CX leadership clear visibility into performance and trends. + Present insights and recommendations to Support and CX leadership on a regular cadence, highlighting risks, opportunities, and the impact of AI/automation initiatives. * AI Tooling, Agents \& Automation + Serve as the operational owner for AI‑powered support tools (e.g., Glean agents, internal copilots, routing/triage bots, macros with AI, deflection experiences), including configuration, monitoring, and continuous improvement. + Analyze agent and automation performance (resolution rate, handoff quality, mis‑routes, downvotes) and run structured experiments on prompts, workflows, and routing rules to improve outcomes. + Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to scope and launch new AI use cases for Support (e.g., intelligent routing, duplicate detection, auto‑tagging, SLA risk prediction, backlog forecasting). + Ensure AI/automation features are rolled out with clear guardrails, runbooks, and monitoring, and that human support workflows integrate smoothly with AI experiences. * Program \& Project Management + Lead special projects that materially improve Support productivity and customer experience (e.g., new queue designs, channel strategy updates, AI rollout pilots, process re‑designs). + Own work‑back plans, stakeholder alignment, risks, and communication for these initiatives, ensuring projects land on time and with clear success metrics. + Partner with CX Ops and cross‑functional stakeholders to design and run A/B tests and quasi‑experiments across macros, forms, flows, and AI experiences, quantifying impact on FRT, TTR, CSAT, deflection, and agent effort. * Process Design \& Knowledge + Analyze support workflows and ticket data to identify operational inefficiencies and recommend process improvements across tools, queues, and channels. + Document support processes, SOPs, and runbooks; maintain internal knowledge base and enablement content for Support tooling and AI features. + Partner with Support leadership to define SLIs/SLOs for Support operations and AI tools, with clear alerting and actionable runbooks when thresholds are breached. **About you:** * 5\+ years of experience in CX Operations, Revenue Operations, or related GTM operations roles, ideally in B2B SaaS. * Track record of building or materially mproving CS systems and processes (health scoring, renewals forecasting, playbooks, segmentation) and demonstrating measurable impact on retention, expansion, or health. * Strong understanding of key post\-sales metrics and leading indicators * Experience operating in high‑growth or startup environments where you've had to build structure in ambiguity. * Curious: Eager to tackle process, workflow, and AI‑related challenges to improve team outcomes. * Customer‑driven: Motivated by improving both internal support processes and the end customer's experience. * Systems thinker: You enjoy mapping how tools, data, and processes fit together and simplifying complexity for others. * Data‑driven experimenter: You're comfortable forming hypotheses, running experiments, and measuring impact, especially around AI and automation. * Continuous learner: Always looking for opportunities to document, measure, and refine team practices as AI capabilities evolve. * Nice‑to‑Have Skills: + Proficiency with SQL and at least one BI platform (e.g., Sigma, Looker, Metabase, Tableau). + Prior experience designing or operating support automations and AI agents (e.g., Fin, Glean agents, Zendesk bots, workflow tools). + Experience driving change management in support organizations, including training, communications, and adoption measurement. + Working knowledge of SaaS products and/or cloud technologies. + Familiarity with knowledge base management and content creation. **Location:** * This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View office) **Compensation \& Benefits:** The standard base salary range for this position is $120,000 \- 175,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time\-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long\-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We're committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. \#LI\-HYBRID **AI\-First Mindset at Glean:** At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. **As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI\-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.** Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. **Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:** Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. jobs.title: Software Engineer- Equity Derivatives Trading Desk
jobs.description: ***We are Gelber Group \- Passion for Trading. Powered by Technology.*** ------------------------------------------------------------------------ For more than 40 years, Gelber has been one of the industry's leading proprietary trading firms, combining entrepreneurial thinking with disciplined execution. Headquartered in Chicago, with offices and remote team members throughout the United States and Europe, we have built a reputation for innovation, longevity, and consistent performance. Through regulated businesses that include a FINRA\-registered broker\-dealer, a self\-clearing Chicago Mercantile Exchange member firm, and an AFM\-licensed MiFID II investment firm, Gelber is positioned to trade across all major global financial markets. Our business is driven by a relentless pursuit of new trading opportunities and a deep commitment to technical excellence. We trade a diverse range of asset classes and financial instruments using strategies that span the full spectrum of trading—from high\-frequency and systematic approaches to longer\-term discretionary trading. This diversity creates an intellectually rich environment where ideas, perspectives, and expertise from across the firm contribute to our continued evolution. Our culture is collaborative, entrepreneurial, and meritocratic. We empower talented people to take ownership, contribute meaningfully, and make an impact early in their careers. We believe our people are our greatest competitive advantage, and we invest in their development by providing meaningful responsibility, exceptional colleagues, and the resources they need to succeed **The Opportunity** ------------------- As a Software Engineer at Gelber Securities, LLC, you will work directly with a successful trading desk that trades derivatives listed on the U.S. markets. You will work side by side with experienced traders, quants, and other talented engineers to design, develop, and support systems and applications used by both human and algorithmic traders, having a direct and meaningful impact on PnL. An amazing opportunity to learn and grow from a team of intelligent and skilled individuals. This role is for someone who flourishes in a fast\-paced environment, has a strong work ethic, clear communication, and a very strong interest in working at a trading firm. ***This position can either sit in our Chicago Headquarters office or remote within the United States.*** ### ***What you'll do:*** * Communicate with engineers, traders, and quants to architect, design, develop, deploy, and support our proprietary trading applications and tools * Have a significant impact in development for our existing infrastructure in C\#, as well as adding new features and applications for our human and algorithmic traders * Become an expert in the entire trading pipeline and the software and technology that it is built upon, including the back end, front end, and everything in between * Provide real time support and bug fixes for live trading applications ### ***What you'll need:*** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field * 3\+ years of work experience working in C\#, Java, or C\+\+ * Strong understanding of and experience with an Object Oriented Programming language * Excellent communication skills specifically when it comes to understanding requirements and translating that into code and fixing bugs * Self\-motivation and ability to work with others in a remote environment * Understanding of the financial markets is not required, but preferred and must have a strong interest * Working knowledge of Options, Volatility, and SQL not required but is a plus **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- *The approximate annual base salary for this position in* ***Chicago, Illinois/Nationwide*** *is $100,000 to $150,000\. The actual offer, reflecting the total compensation package plus benefits, will be determined by a number of factors which include but are not limited to the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities; geographic location; and internal equity. In addition to your salary, our total rewards package includes health benefits, a 401(k) plan, PTO, parental leave, professional development, tuition reimbursement and discretionary bonus, enhancing your overall total rewards package.* Gelber offers a wide range of benefits to full\-time employees, including: * Traditional and Roth 401(k) retirement program with discretionary employer match * Comprehensive health benefits including medical coverage provided by Blue Cross and Blue Shield (PPO and HDHP/HSA) and dental coverage; generous employer cost\-sharing * Tuition reimbursement for Undergraduate and Graduate courses * Flexible Spending Accounts for health care and dependent care; pre\-tax commuter benefits for parking and transit expenses * Life insurance and long\-term disability coverage * Health club membership with on\-site facilities (and reciprocal memberships) * Generous vacation time (23\-day accrual in first full calendar year of employment; prorated accrual in initial year), paid holidays, and paid maternity/paternity leave * Weekly catered lunches and monthly continental breakfasts (Chicago Headquarters Only) * Social events including sponsored 5k races and annual company party * Enjoyable work environment including golf simulator * Employee referral bonus program * Charitable giving and company matching opportunities * Casual, relaxed dress code *If you are based in California, we encourage you to read the Gelber Privacy Notice for California Employees and Applicants, linked* *here**.*

jobs.title: Manufacturing Systems Engineer - Experienced
jobs.description: Overview: **The Opportunity:** General Dynamics Electric Boat, the world’s foremost designer and builder of nuclear submarines, is seeking an IT System Engineer supporting the Manufacturing organizations within the EB Information Technology (EBIT) Department in North Kingstown, RI. The current business needs and demands are ever rapidly changing and require an agile, flexible, analytical candidate to join EBIT. **Position Summary:** This IT System Engineer will blend both roles of a Forward\-Deployed Engineer and Business Analyst serving as a critical bridge between manufacturing operations, business stakeholders, and technical engineering teams. In this hybrid role, the individual embeds directly within production environments to analyze business processes, understand operational challenges, and translate those needs into scalable technical solutions. They work closely with manufacturing leadership, subject\-matter experts, and cross\-functional teams to ensure that digital tools, automation systems, and data\-driven applications are aligned to real\-world manufacturing workflows. This role combines deep analytical skills with hands\-on technical implementation. It requires gathering and refining requirements, mapping complex processes, and identifying opportunities to improve throughput, quality, and efficiency. The engineer side of the role includes configuring, deploying, and validating software or operational technologies on the factory floor, ensuring solutions are robust, and optimized for performance in high\-volume environments. The ideal candidate is adaptable, customer\-focused, and comfortable working in fast\-paced production settings. They excel at turning ambiguous problems into structured solutions and ensuring that deployed systems deliver measurable business impact. By serving as an on\-site technical partner and a strategic process analyst, this role helps accelerate digital transformation across the organization’s business systems. The position is primarily on\-site support, with some flexibility for part time remote work. It will include semi\-regular travel between other regional Electric Boat locations. Qualifications: **Required:*** Bachelor of Science in Engineering,Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or Information Technology * 5\+ years of post\-graduate engineering experience supporting manufacturing operations, process improvement, or technical solution deployment within an industrial or production environment **Preferred:*** Experience working in **large\-scale, multi\-site manufacturing environments**, especially those involving automation, complex supply chains, or regulated production processes. * Familiarity with **manufacturing execution systems (MES)**, ERP platforms or industrial automation interfaces. * Experience with **LEAN, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies**, including process mapping, root‑cause analysis, and operational optimization. * Understanding of **industrial IoT, edge computing, or digital manufacturing technologies**. * Proficiency with data tools, such as SQL, Python, Power BI, or similar platforms used for analysis, reporting, and troubleshooting Skills: * Ability to solve complex technical problems, while also distilling complex information to present to varying levels of management within the organization * Ability to consult clients/customer to configure systems in line with business needs * Ability to lead cross\-functional deployments, guide change management activities, and drive adoption of new tools or processes. * Comfortable working in on\-site production areas, including around heavy machinery, automated systems, and fast\-paced operations. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment and drive projects to successful completion

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - Vehicle Quality Engineering

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **DUTIES:** Defines, designs, and develops control systems, diagnostics, and controller communications in the Propulsion Thermal ART in Vehicle Mechatronic Embedded Controls (VMEC) organization. Develops software and controls to manage integrated thermal loops to optimize energy use and thermal storage capacity. Participates in the development of controls and diagnostics within an agile environment using appropriate common methods for VMEC features. Perform as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Scrum team’s content. Collaborates with the Program Management Team to refine Program Vision, Roadmap and Program Backlog. Collaborates with System Architect to determine Enablers and coordinate Enabler Rollout. Coordinates dependencies with other Product Owners when deliverables are dependent on other Teams for completion, attending PO synchronizations as needed. Refines, maintains, and prioritizes the Team Backlog. Works closely with Scrum Team Leader to ascertain Team capacity. Translates product and feature strategy into User Stories, assisting Scrum Team with Story definition, estimation, and sequencing for Program Increment Planning events. Works day\-to\-day with the Scrum Teams clarifying requirements, constantly communicating, and gaining alignment around Feature or Product Strategy. jobs.title: Director, FP&A
jobs.description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.* **An overview of this role** ---------------------------- As Director, Financial Planning and Analysis (FP\&A), you'll lead finance for GitLab's Research \& Development (R\&D) organization, our largest operating expense area. You'll be the strategic finance partner to our Chief Technology Officer (CTO) and their leadership team, owning R\&D planning, forecasting, and investment decisions. R\&D builds our AI\-powered development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) platform, which more than 100,000 organizations use. You'll connect investment in headcount, infrastructure, AI and cloud usage, and tooling to product outcomes, with clear measurement and reliable forecasts. You'll sit at the CTO's staff table, shape GitLab's long\-range plan, and help leadership decide where to invest next, making R\&D spend predictable. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Serve as the finance advisor to the CTO and R\&D leadership. Hold partners accountable for execution against plan and connect R\&D priorities to company financial targets. * Lead annual planning, and rolling forecasts for R\&D. Own the operating plan across headcount, compensation, contractors, hosting and cloud, AI and large language model (LLM) costs, software, and tooling. * Build frameworks that connect R\&D investment to product roadmap outcomes. Evaluate business cases for new initiatives, AI capabilities, build\-versus\-buy decisions, and vendor commitments, and present risks and opportunities to leadership. * Define and track R\&D efficiency metrics, including R\&D spend as a percentage of revenue, cost per engineer, hosting cost per user, and AI inference cost per feature. Identify large\-scale savings and reallocation opportunities and see them through to completion. * Partner with People and R\&D leaders on hiring plans, location strategy, and organizational design. Keep headcount forecasts accurate and reconciled to actuals. * Lead the AI transformation of R\&D finance. Rethink planning, forecasting, and reporting workflows, and use AI tools to make them faster, more accurate, and more insightful. * Redesign FP\&A processes, policies, and planning and reporting systems for efficiency and effectiveness, with AI in the center. Work with Accounting on capitalized software, accruals, and allocations, and with Procurement on process improvements. * Lead and develop your R\&D finance team:: hire and coach team members, set goals and priorities, and give expert feedback. Put GitLab's values into practice through handbook\-first, asynchronous collaboration across time zones. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * Extensive finance experience, including serving as the lead finance partner to an R\&D, Engineering, or Product organization plus experience leading a team of analysts * A strong understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, and R\&D cost drivers, including engineering headcount, cloud hosting, AI and LLM usage, software licenses, and capitalized software development. * Experience leading process redesign and change in a finance team, including hands\-on use of AI tools to improve how work gets done. * Expertise in influencing senior technical stakeholders and translating complex analysis into clear recommendations for executives. * Advanced financial modeling skills that follow industry best practices, expertise in Google Sheets, and hands\-on experience with financial and data visualization tools. We don't use Excel for modeling. * A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. * Comfort working remotely and asynchronously, and the ability to use GitLab. * Preferred experience includes enterprise software\-as\-a\-service (SaaS) finance; direct CTO partnership; NetSuite, Sisense, Adaptive Planning, or SQL; or a Master of Business Administration (MBA), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) qualification. *The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our* *benefits* *and* *equity**. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.* United States Salary Range $168,000 \- $285,600 USD #### **How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees** * Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being * Flexible Paid Time Off * Team Member Resource Groups * Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan * Growth and Development Fund * Parental Leave Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. **Country Hiring Guidelines:** GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location\-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process. **Privacy Policy:** Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us. GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

jobs.title: Product Designer, AI (0 to 1)
jobs.description: ### **Description** **Zero\-to\-One Product Design for AI\-Native Ventures** Gitwit is hiring Product Designer to lead the product experience for new AI companies, and to set the standard of design quality the whole studio builds to. You will decide what the product should be and design it to a level of finish that holds up in front of real users. This is a seat for a designer with strong product judgment. This is a senior seat, and the designers who thrive in it tend to share a few things:* **5\+ years in product design**, hands\-on and deep in the craft. * **Experience taking products from zero to one.** * **A portfolio of work you can share that showcases your experience.** Most of all, we're looking for someone whose craft and judgment make the people around them better. Gitwit is an AI\-first venture studio built to find problems worth solving, validate them rigorously, and build the companies that earn the right to exist. We are on pace to launch **15\+ ventures** in the next four years. For a designer, that means repeated chances to work on the most interesting part of company building: the first version. You are not maintaining one mature product for years. You are helping create new companies from the beginning, shaping the ambiguity, getting close to users, making the product calls, building the prototypes, launching, reading early signal, and handing off to a founding team. The pace only works if design can make the first clear product calls before everything is figured out. We need someone who can jump into a half\-formed venture, figure out what the product needs to become, and help the team learn before we overbuild. You come in as a design lead from day one. We launch around five companies a year, and one or two of them will be yours to lead across the year. You own the product experience from early concept through prototype, first launch, user learning, and iteration. You help set the quality standard here. The ventures you lead carry your fingerprints on how they look, how they behave, and how finished they feel the day they meet their first users. When a founding team inherits a product from you, they should inherit a clear design system, resolved states and edge cases, and specs an engineer can build from directly. You will work shoulder to shoulder with discovery, product strategy, engineering, brand, and venture leadership to shape the first version of the company and product. The vision is shared. The product experience\- how it works, how it feels, where it earns trust, and where it gets out of the user's way\- is yours to lead. Early on, the work is hands\-on: wireframing in a room, shaping feature plans, prototyping with AI, sitting with users, and pulling apart what they say, what they do, where they hesitate, and what they actually need. You are never tossing screens over a wall. You build next to an engineer in tight rotation, make product calls, test them quickly, and keep the distance between decision and working product short. After the initial product, you stay close to what happens next: what users understand, where they hesitate, what breaks down, and what the early signal suggests, and turn that learning into sharper decisions and better next versions. When the product has enough shape and the right founding team is ready to carry it forward, you make the handoff clean, then move to the next early product problem.### **What You’ll Do** * Set and hold the visual and interaction quality standard for the studio's products. * Lead zero\-to\-one product design for new AI products, from blank canvas through first launch and iteration. * Resolve the hard parts: the states, edge cases, and interaction details that make a product feel finished. * Design AI workflows where the product may not behave the same way twice, changing outputs, wrong or uncertain answers, human review, approval moments, fallback paths, and clear next steps. * Generate multiple design directions, weigh tradeoffs, make the call, and explain the reasoning clearly. * Prototype quickly to help the team learn what is real before overbuilding. * Translate user observation, research, and usage signals into product hypotheses, experiments, and design decisions. * Work tightly with product strategists, researchers, engineers, designers, and venture leaders to turn a promising idea into something real enough to test. * Bring discipline and meticulousness to how design gets built across the studio, so each product does not have to reinvent the basics from scratch. * Help the studio get smarter with each AI product by capturing what we learn about review, correction, approval, uncertainty, failure states, and user trust, and sharing it so each new venture starts sharper than the last. In your first few months, you will have:* Stepped into an active venture, understood the product direction quickly, and identified the first design moves that would reduce risk, test key assumptions, and help the team move faster. * Brough ommunication.** You bring engineers, strategists, researchers, and venture leaders into the thinking so decisions do not feel mysterious or disconnected. You should be the kind of designer who already has these instincts and finally wants a seat that lets you use them. This is not a clean\-lane design job. If you want polished requirements, a tidy backlog, long cycles, layers of review, and a roadmap handed down from somewhere else, this will feel uncomfortable. We move quickly, with incomplete information, high trust, and a lot of direct collaboration. And this is not a brand design role. You do not need to invent a full identity system from scratch. But because our ventures are new, you do need to care about how the whole company shows up: a deck, an early website, a prototype, or how the product gets explained when it helps the venture become real. The product experience is where our standards are highest.### **What We Offer** This role comes with the things strong designers should expect: competitive salary, strong benefits, and **meaningful equity in every venture the studio builds,** but the real offer is bigger than a comp package alone. You get a rare zero\-to\-one seat in an AI\-first venture studio built to launch multiple companies, not just maintain one. You get the intensity and authorship of early\-stage building, with the structural advantages of a studio: stronger validation, shared resources, repeated shots on goal, and the chance to help build multiple high\-impact ventures over time. Practically, that includes:* Competitive salary * Meaningful equity in every venture the studio builds * 8 weeks off per year: 5 weeks vacation \+ 3 weeks paid holidays * Excellent health, vision, and dental insurance, with 99% of employee premiums paid * 401(k) with 4% match * Life insurance * Paid parental leave * Cell phone reimbursement * Monthly parking stipend * Weekly team lunches * Dog\-friendly office * High\-trust, high\-autonomy culture * The chance to work on multiple high\-impact ventures each year * Your own private office, and collaborative workspaces in one of the coolest office buildings in Tulsa The package matters. But for the right person, the bigger offer is where you get to place your next years. This is a **full\-time role** built around real collaboration (with room for real life). This role is based in **Tulsa or Bentonville**. We're open to exceptional candidates who would relocate for the right opportunity, but this is not a remote role. We want designers who want to build closely with the team in the room, in the work, and in the real decisions that shape what gets built. That being said, we are very flexible with real life. Some days you might need to work from home, for when the plumber shows up, to step out for a kids' appointment, or just for a day of heads\-down building. What we can't flex on is the overall proximity and regular in\-person presence that keeps the studio engine running fast. Send us a link to your portfolio or website, along with your resume. **Then answer one question:** *Pick one project from your portfolio and tell us about a decision you'd make differently if you did it over, and why.* Keep it short and honest. We care more about how you think than how polished the answer sounds. Click "Apply Now" to dive in.### **About Gitwit** Gitwit is a venture studio that finds problems worth solving, validates them rigorously, and builds AI\-native companies from the ground up. We invest early, build cross\-functionally, and work to create ventures that earn real traction, not just good stories. A big part of that comes from working closely with design partners who give us deep access to real workflows, urgent pain points, and early market truth. That helps us find better opportunities and build ventures with stronger validation and traction, faster. We are on pace to launch **15\+ ventures in the next four years**. That is how we turn insight into products, and products into companies.

When the product has enough shape and the right founding team is ready to carry it forward, you make the handoff clean, then move to the next early product problem.### **What You’ll Do** * Set and hold the visual and interaction quality standard for the studio's products. * Lead zero\-to\-one product design for new AI products, from blank canvas through first launch and iteration. * Resolve the hard parts: the states, edge cases, and interaction details that make a product feel finished. * Design AI workflows where the product may not behave the same way twice, changing outputs, wrong or uncertain answers, human review, approval moments, fallback paths, and clear next steps. * Generate multiple design directions, weigh tradeoffs, make the call, and explain the reasoning clearly. * Prototype quickly to help the team learn what is real before overbuilding. * Translate user observation, research, and usage signals into product hypotheses, experiments, and design decisions. * Work tightly with product strategists, researchers, engineers, designers, and venture leaders to turn a promising idea into something real enough to test. * Bring discipline and meticulousness to how design gets built across the studio, so each product does not have to reinvent the basics from scratch. * Help the studio get smarter with each AI product by capturing what we learn about review, correction, approval, uncertainty, failure states, and user trust, and sharing it so each new venture starts sharper than the last. In your first few months, you will have:* Stepped into an active venture, understood the product direction quickly, and identified the first design moves that would reduce risk, test key assumptions, and help the team move faster.  ommunication.** You bring engineers, strategists, researchers, and venture leaders into the thinking so decisions do not feel mysterious or disconnected. You should be the kind of designer who already has these instincts and finally wants a seat that lets you use them. This is not a clean\-lane design job. If you want polished requirements, a tidy backlog, long cycles, layers of review, and a roadmap handed down from somewhere else, this will feel uncomfortable. We move quickly, with incomplete information, high trust, and a lot of direct collaboration. And this is not a brand design role. You do not need to invent a full identity system from scratch. But because our ventures are new, you do need to care about how the whole company shows up: a deck, an early website, a prototype, or how the product gets explained when it helps the venture become real. The product experience is where our standards are highest.### **What We Offer** This role comes with the things strong designers should expect: competitive salary, strong benefits, and **meaningful equity in every venture the studio builds,** but the real offer is bigger than a comp package alone. You get a rare zero\-to\-one seat in an AI\-first venture studio built to launch multiple companies, not just maintain one. You get the intensity and authorship of early\-stage building, with the structural advantages of a studio: stronger validation, shared resources, repeated shots on goal, and the chance to help build multiple high\-impact ventures over time. Practically, that includes:* Competitive salary * Meaningful equity in every venture the studio builds * 8 weeks off per year: 5 weeks vacation \+ 3 weeks paid holidays * Excellent health, vision, and dental insurance, with 99% of employee premiums paid * 401(k) with 4% match * Life insurance * Paid parental leave * Cell phone reimbursement * Monthly parking stipend * Weekly team lunches * Dog\-friendly office * High\-trust, high\-autonomy culture * The chance to work on multiple high\-impact ventures each year * Your own private office, and collaborative workspaces in one of the coolest office buildings in Tulsa The package matters. But for the right person, the bigger offer is where you get to place your next years. This is a **full\-time role** built around real collaboration (with room for real life). This role is based in **Tulsa or Bentonville**. We're open to exceptional candidates who would relocate for the right opportunity, but this is not a remote role. We want designers who want to build closely with the team in the room, in the work, and in the real decisions that shape what gets built. That being said, we are very flexible with real life. Some days you might need to work from home, for when the plumber shows up, to step out for a kids' appointment, or just for a day of heads\-down building. What we can't flex on is the overall proximity and regular in\-person presence that keeps the studio engine running fast. Send us a link to your portfolio or website, along with your resume. **Then answer one question:** *Pick one project from your portfolio and tell us about a decision you'd make differently if you did it over, and why.* Keep it short and honest. We care more about how you think than how polished the answer sounds. Click "Apply Now" to dive in.### **About Gitwit** Gitwit is a venture studio that finds problems worth solving, validates them rigorously, and builds AI\-native companies from the ground up. We invest early, build cross\-functionally, and work to create ventures that earn real traction, not just good stories. A big part of that comes from working closely with design partners who give us deep access to real workflows, urgent pain points, and early market truth. That helps us find better opportunities and build ventures with stronger validation and traction, faster. We are on pace to launch **15\+ ventures in the next four years**. That is how we turn insight into products, and products into companies.

jobs.description: **About GridPoint** GridPoint is a private equity backed technology leader with a mission to accelerate the world's transition to a sustainable future by creating an intelligent energy network of grid\-interactive buildings. Our technology platform harnesses the power and potential within a building to deliver energy, operational, and resiliency benefits — spanning Fortune 500 enterprises, utilities, government organizations, and small businesses. **About the Role** GridPoint is hiring a Software Engineer II for the Application Firmware team. You will work in Elixir on the firmware running our in\-building energy controllers, the layer between our bare\-metal firmware and the GridPoint cloud. The work varies. A device\-side control feature one month, a telemetry pipeline the next, a field failure after that. The target does not vary: constrained hardware installed incustomer buildings, where memory, CPU, and network are all finite. **Responsibilities** * Build and maintain features in our Elixir application firmware, from story to release * Structure application services as OTP supervision trees with isolated, restartableprocesses * Define and implement device control logic, scheduling, local data collection, andconfiguration * Develop solutions that function within the memory, CPU, and storage limits of thetarget hardware * Debug on real hardware: bench units, serial consoles, and logs from the field * Maintain the interfaces to the GridPoint cloud for telemetry, control, and config sync * Verify your own work on hardware before calling it ready to ship * Work with stakeholders to define test plans and develop them alongside the solution * Work with the Bare\-Metal Firmware and Hardware teams on drivers, bring\-up, andpower behavior **Qualifications** Required * Bachelor's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, orequivalent experience * 2–5 years of professional software engineering experience * Elixir, or strong functional programming experience and a record of picking up newlanguages * Understanding of concurrent, fault\-tolerant design: processes, message passing,supervision * Enough embedded or systems background to design within hardware limits * Comfortable debugging on physical devices, not only locally * Git\-based development and code review Preferred * Production Elixir and OTP; Nerves or similar * Enough C/C\+\+ to read embedded firmware and work with the bare\-metal team * Device telemetry, OTA update, or fleet management * MQTT, Wi\-Fi, cellular, or LoRaWAN * Control protocols such as Modbus and BACnet, over both serial and TCP * Energy management, building automation, HVAC controls, or commercial IoT * Working alongside hardware and QA through bring\-up and validation **What Success Looks Like** Level II is where an engineer delivers a feature end to end without close supervision. The first year should look roughly like this. **Milestone** **What we expec**t 3 months Shipping scoped features through normal review; at home in the codebase and on bench hardware 6 momths Owning a feature area from design through field validation; taking part in release validation and triage 12 months Turning vague requests into designs the team agrees on; mentoring newer engineers; trusted to judge release risk Annual Salary Range: $135,000 to $175,000

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Description: AI Platform Engineer Job Details **Job Type** Full\-time, Remote, Occasional travel IL • Agentic Systems Description HALO Branded Solutions is a global leader in branded merchandise, uniform programs, and recognition solutions, and we're building something new. We're assembling a dedicated Agentic Systems team to design and build the intelligent systems that will transform how we take an order from ideation to delivery. That means reimagining the full order management lifecycle: quote capture, supplier and decorator coordination, shipping, PO and invoicing as a platform where AI agents do the work that today requires dozens of manual handoffs across customers, sales, operations, and finance. We're not experimenting with AI. We're building production systems that will run the business. The AI Platform Engineer makes the platform real: building, running, and hardening the AI harness (runtime layer), control plane (governance layer), and operations control center (observability layer) in close partnership with the AI Platform Architect. This is the role that sits between architectural vision and working production infrastructure, implementing the orchestration framework, building the shared state and memory layer, establishing the integration contracts, and ensuring the platform is reliable enough that every agent running on it actually works. The Architect draws the blueprint; you build the building and keep it standing. This is not a junior role with a senior title. This is a systems\-first engineering role with serious development depth. The decisions you make at the implementation level, how state is managed across agent handoffs, how the runtime is structured so deploying a new agent doesn't require rebuilding the platform, how failure is isolated so one agent's problem doesn't cascade, determine whether HALO's agents work in production. That's the responsibility this role carries. If you're a strong systems engineer with deep distributed systems instincts who is ready to move into AI infrastructure, or an experienced AI platform engineer who wants to build something from the ground up, this is the role. **Responsibilities** **Build and** **operate** **the orchestration infrastructure.** Implement the multi\-agent orchestration layer that all HALO agents run on, managing routing between agents, retry logic, circuit breakers, payload validation, and sequencing. This infrastructure lives outside of individual agents, not inside them. Framework selection is an Architect\-level decision; implementation and ongoing operation are yours. **Own shared state and memory.** Design and implement the state management layer that lets agents pass context across handoffs without losing information: session state, cross\-agent memory, and the persistence model that supports both short\-lived task agents and longer\-running workflow agents. **Build the** **agent** **runtime environment.** Own the infrastructure agents execute on: deployment pipelines, environment management, model version pinning, and the scaffolding that makes deploying a new agent a configuration exercise, not an infrastructure project. The Agent Developers should be able to ship a new agent without filing a ticket to you first. **Define and enforce** **integration** **contracts.** Work directly with the AI Integration Engineer to establish and maintain the contracts governing how agents request data: format, latency guarantees, error handling. Own the API gateway layer between the orchestration platform and the external systems agents interact with. **Own platform reliability.** Uptime, failure isolation, incident response for agent failures, and the runbook for what happens when an agent behaves unexpectedly in production. This is an ongoing operational responsibility. The platform is never "done" in a way that lets you stop thinking about its reliability. **Provide the observability infrastructure.** Implement the platform\-level hooks: logging interfaces, trace endpoints, policy enforcement points that the Governance Engineer instruments. The observability standards live with the Governance Engineer; the infrastructure that makes those standards enforceable lives with you. Requirements:**The team you're joining** --------------------------- You'll work directly with the AI Platform Architect (your technical lead and the source of the architectural decisions you implement), the AI Integration Engineer (your closest peer, jointly owning the contract between the orchestration and data layers), the AI Agent Developers (who build on the platform you operate), and the AI Governance \& Observability Engineer (who instruments the hooks you provide and dashboards to observe). It's a small, senior, and deliberately collaborative team building infrastructure that doesn't yet exist at HALO.Requirements * 5\+ years of software or platform engineering with genuine depth in distributed systems: state management, failure modes, event\-driven architecture, or API platform engineering * Experience building or operating infrastructure that other engineers build on, platforms with downstream consumers who depend on their reliability * Production experience with at least one agent or LLM orchestration framework (AWS AgentCore, LangGraph, CrewAI, LangChain, or equivalent) or strong distributed systems instincts and demonstrated ability to ramp quickly * Comfort with operational ownership and being accountable for reliability **You'll** **stand out if you have:** * Hands\-on experience building multi\-agent orchestration infrastructure in production * Familiarity with agent state and memory patterns: how context persists across agent turns, sessions, and workflow stages * Experience with AI observability tooling (LangSmith, Arize, Weights \& Biases, or equivalent) from the infrastructure side * Background in API gateway design and integration contract management between platform layers * Experience in order management, commerce, or supply chain domains

jobs.title: Project Engineer - Roadway/CPM Schedule Review
jobs.description: **Project Engineer – Roadway / CPM Schedule Review** **Contract \| $110 per hour \| Las Vegas, Nevada / Hybrid or Remote Depending on Experience** Gypsum Resources is seeking an experienced **Project Engineer with substantial roadway and critical path scheduling experience** for a short\-term consulting assignment involving review of the development schedule for a large land\-development and infrastructure project in Clark County, Nevada. This is **not a traditional design\-production role** and is **not initially an expert\-witness position**. We are looking for a practicing or recently practicing engineer who can independently evaluate the project’s **Critical Path Method (CPM) schedule**, identify the activities actually controlling project completion, and assess whether engineering redesign, agency review, right\-of\-way, permitting, or other project activities affected the critical path. The assignment will involve review of project schedules, engineering milestones, agency and permitting timelines, and contemporaneous project records. The engineer should be comfortable working independently and reaching conclusions based on the project record, including conclusions that may differ from the expectations of the client. **Primary Responsibilities** * Review baseline and updated project schedules and identify the **critical path and near\-critical paths**. * Evaluate logic relationships, durations, constraints, float, sequencing, and schedule assumptions. * Determine whether the critical path changed over time and identify the events responsible for any change. * Assess whether roadway engineering, redesign, permitting, agency review, right\-of\-way, utility coordination, or other project activities caused actual critical\-path delay or merely consumed available float. * Evaluate potential **concurrent delays** and independent project constraints. * Review relevant engineering and project\-control records necessary to understand the schedule. * Identify missing information or schedule deficiencies that prevent reliable conclusions. * Prepare a concise written assessment and discuss conclusions with project management and outside counsel. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in **Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Construction Management, or closely related field**. * Significant professional experience with **roadway, highway, transportation, or major civil\-infrastructure projects**. * Direct experience developing, maintaining, or critically reviewing **CPM schedules**. * Strong understanding of: * + Critical path and float + Schedule logic and constraints + Baseline versus updated schedules + Delay and concurrency + Sequence changes and recovery schedules + Design, permitting, utility, and right\-of\-way dependencies * Experience with **Primavera P6** or comparable professional scheduling software. * Ability to read roadway plans, profiles, grading plans, and related civil\-engineering documents. * Ability to explain schedule conclusions clearly to non\-engineers. **Strongly Preferred** * Professional Engineer (**P.E.**) license. * 10\+ years of roadway or civil\-infrastructure experience. * Experience as a **Project Engineer, Project Manager, Resident Engineer, Project Controls Engineer, or Scheduler** on major roadway projects. * Experience with public\-agency review and permitting. * Experience evaluating schedule impacts associated with design changes, utility conflicts, right\-of\-way, environmental approvals, or agency delays. * Nevada or Southwest roadway experience is helpful but not required. **Nature of Assignment** This is an **independent consulting review**. We are specifically seeking someone with current or recent real\-world project experience rather than a career litigation expert. The initial assignment is to independently evaluate the project’s CPM schedule and determine what activities actually controlled completion. The engineer will **not be asked to reach a predetermined conclusion**. Depending on the quality of the analysis and the engineer’s interest, the assignment could expand, but there is **no requirement that the engineer serve as an expert witness**. **Compensation: $110 per hour, contract basis.** Interested candidates should submit a résumé describing specific **roadway projects** and **CPM scheduling experience**. Please identify the scheduling software used and briefly describe one or two projects where you personally evaluated critical path, float, or delay. I would add that last sentence about describing **specific roadway and CPM experience** because otherwise you will get a pile of general civil\-engineering résumés from people who have seen a schedule but never actually interrogated one. For LinkedIn, I would probably lead with a shorter hook: **We are looking for a roadway engineer who actually understands CPM—not a professional expert witness.** **Benefits** * Private Health Insurance * Paid Time Off

jobs.title: Data Engineer / ITS Data Governance
jobs.description: **Location Detail:** 9 Farm Springs Rd Farmington (10566\) Work where **every moment** matters. Every day, more than 40,000 Hartford HealthCare colleagues come to work with one thing in common: Pride in what we do, knowing every moment matters here. We invite you to become part of Connecticut’s most comprehensive healthcare network. The creation of the HHC System Support Office recognizes the work of a large and growing group of employees whose responsibilities are continually evolving so that we and our departments now work on behalf of the system as a whole, rather than a single member organization. With the creation of our new umbrella organization we now have our own identity with a unique payroll, benefits, performance management system, service recognition programs and other common practices across the system. **Position Summary:** As a Data Engineer, you will design, build, deploy, and support enterprise data solutions that capture, integrate, transform, govern, and make data available for analytics, AI/ML, generative AI, operational reporting, research, and other enterprise use cases. The Data Engineer will help architect, implement, and operate robust, scalable data infrastructure across on\-premises and cloud environments, with a primary focus on Hartford HealthCare's enterprise data and digital platform (H2D2\). This role will also provide dedicated engineering support to the enterprise Data Governance program by implementing data\-quality controls, master data management (MDM), reference data management (RDM), metadata, lineage, and governance requirements as reusable capabilities within the H2D2 data fabric. **Position Responsibilities:** **Key Areas of Responsibility** Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate automated, scalable data pipelines and reusable ingestion frameworks for batch, streaming, and near\-real\-time workloads. Implement incremental ingestion, transformation, orchestration, observability, error handling, and recovery patterns. Monitor and troubleshoot pipeline performance and reliability, resolve bottlenecks, and automate controls that protect the quality, security, integrity, availability, and maintainability of HHC data solutions. Provide data\-engineering support for the enterprise Data Governance program. Build and maintain automated data\-quality rules, profiling, validation, reconciliation, exception management, and monitoring capabilities; publish measurable data\-quality results; and partner with data owners and stewards to investigate root causes and remediate defects at the appropriate source or transformation layer. Engineer and support master data management (MDM) and reference data management (RDM) capabilities, including source integration, matching and survivorship logic, hierarchy and crosswalk management, reference\-code synchronization, data\-standard enforcement, and distribution of trusted master and reference data to downstream consumers. Partner with data architects, the Data Governance Office, interoperability, analytics, research, security, and other data\-engineering teams to embed governance into the H2D2 fabric. Implement metadata capture, business and technical lineage, classification, ownership and stewardship attributes, access and retention controls, and policy\-as\-code or reusable control patterns across Bronze/Raw, Silver/Curated, and Gold/Governed data layers. Create and maintain technical documentation, including source\-to\-target mappings, data dictionaries, logical and physical models, lineage, interface specifications, data\-quality rules, operating procedures, runbooks, and support documentation. Ensure metadata and documentation remain synchronized with deployed solutions. Contribute to software engineering, data engineering, data architecture, DevSecOps, and governance standards across the team and broader organization. Participate in design and code reviews, promote reusable patterns and automated testing, and support a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, innovation, and responsible data use. **Working Relationships:** **This Job Reports To (Job Title):** Director Data Engineering and Architecture. ### **Qualifications** **Education** * Minimum: bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or related quantitative field * Preferred: Master’s degree in healthcare administration, computer sciences or related field **Experience** * Minimum: o 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in data software development including applications running on premise and/or cloud environments (GCP, AWS or Azure) o Experience implementing automated data\-quality profiling, validation, reconciliation, monitoring, and exception\-management controls. o Working knowledge of data governance concepts, including metadata management, technical lineage, data classification, stewardship, and policy enforcement. o Experience integrating governance controls into cloud data pipelines, lakehouse architectures, or enterprise data platforms. o 2\+ years of experience in data software development that includes building data and digital platforms for batch or streaming ingestion, processing the data for analytics, and storing the data in various stages o Extensive experience multiple programming languages (Python, C/C\+\+, SQL etc.) o 2\+ Years experience in ETL design and data modeling implementation, and maintenance. o Proactive and self\-motivated with a passion for continuous learning and staying updated with best practices, new features, and emerging technologies. o 2\+ years of Experience with specialized data architecture (e.g., data lake, lake house, data fabric, data mesh) * Preferred: o 3\+ years of experience working with Cloud native development. GCP preferred. o Experience with enterprise MDM and RDM platforms, including matching, survivorship, hierarchy, crosswalk, and reference\-code management. o Experience with metadata catalog, lineage, or data\-quality platforms; Informatica CDGC, Cloud Data Quality, or MDM experience is preferred. o Healthcare data experience involving Epic, FHIR, HL7, OMOP, clinical terminology, or other governed clinical and research data standards. o 3\+ years of experience in data software development that includes building data and digital platforms o Understanding of FHIR and other Health Level 7 (HL7\) communication standards and clinical documentation architecture. o 3\+ years of Experience with specialized data architecture **Knowledge, Skills and Ability Requirements** time and project management skills; demonstrated skills in verbal and written expression of ideas; in person and virtual presentation skills; good command and understanding of data engineering and architecture concepts. **We take great care of careers.** With locations around the state, Hartford HealthCare offers exciting opportunities for career development and growth. Here, you are part of an organization on the cutting edge – helping to bring new technologies, breakthrough treatments and community education to countless men, women and children. We know that a thriving organization starts with thriving employees\- we provide a competitive benefits program designed to ensure work/life balance. Every moment matters. And this is **your moment.**

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: Company Description By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world\-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive. **Why join Harvard Medical School?** Harvard Medical School's mission is to nurture a diverse, inclusive community dedicated to alleviating suffering and improving health and well\-being for all through excellence in teaching and learning, discovery and scholarship, and service and leadership. You’ll be at the heart of biomedical discovery, education, and innovation, working alongside world\-renowned faculty and a community dedicated to improving human health. This is more than a job \- it’s an opportunity to shape the future of medicine. Join our team of researchers, engineers, and designers to shape a future in which humans and AI collaborate to solve the most challenging biological and medical problems! **About the Department of Biomedical Informatics** The HIDIVE Lab in the Department of Biomedical Informatics at Harvard Medical School conducts research at the interface of human and artificial intelligence. We create methods and tools that enable humans and machines alike to interact with and generate insights from biomedical data, combining state\-of\-the\-art biomedical informatics, data visualization, and AI/ML techniques across the full spectrum of biomedical data. An overview of recent publications of the lab can be found on Google Scholar. We value diverse viewpoints, creative thinking, and bold initiative in a highly collaborative and interdisciplinary work environment. The HIDIVE Lab has an international reputation for creating high impact data visualization tools and we are driven to solve the most challenging design and engineering problems where biomedical data, humans, and AI meet. We would love to have you on our team! Under the guidance of senior developers, you will help integrate a natural\-language conversational AI system for exploring biomedical metadata and visualizations into biomedical data portals, including developing APIs and packages to move visualizations in and out of these systems. You will work with researchers, designers, and engineers to build tools that allow scientists to efficiently query, visualize, and understand complex biological data through natural language and direct interaction with visualizations. Additional Information * **Term:** This is a 1 year term position from the date of hire, with the possibility of extension, contingent upon work performance and continued funding to support the position. * **Standard Hours/Schedule:** 35 hours per week * **Visa Sponsorship Information:** Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position * **Pre\-Employment Screening:** Identity * **Other Information:** All interviews will be conducted remotely using a video conferencing platform. * **Staying Informed About Your Application:** Due to the high volume of applications, we may not always be able to reach out right away, but you can track your status anytime through the Careers@Harvard portal. \#LI\-DK1 **Work Format Details** This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that the duties and responsibilities can effectively be performed fully remotely at a non\-Harvard location. Employees in fully remote positions must work all scheduled hours in a Harvard registered state in compliance with the University’s Policy on Employment Outside of Massachusetts. At the discretion of the department, fully remote employees may occasionally be required on site at a Harvard location. Certain visa types and funding sources may limit work location. Individuals must meet work location sponsorship requirements prior to employment. **Salary Grade and Ranges** This position is salary grade level 057\. Please visit Harvard's Salary Ranges to view the corresponding salary range and related information. **Benefits** Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work\-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. Because here, you are what matters. Our benefits include, but are not limited to: * Generous paid time off including parental leave * Medical, dental, and vision health insurance coverage starting on day one * Retirement plans with university contributions * Wellbeing and mental health resources * Support for families and caregivers * Professional development opportunities including tuition assistance and reimbursement * Commuter benefits, discounts and campus perks Learn more about these and additional benefits on our Benefits \& Wellbeing Page. **EEO/Non\-Discrimination Commitment Statement** Harvard University is committed to equal opportunity and non\-discrimination. We seek talent from all parts of society and the world, and we strive to ensure everyone at Harvard thrives. Our differences help our community advance Harvard's academic purposes. Harvard has an equal employment opportunity policy that outlines our commitment to prohibiting discrimination on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law or identified in the university's non\-discrimination policy.
