jobs.title: Information Security Solutions Engineer II
jobs.description: **Holman is a family\-owned, global automotive services organization anchored by our deeply rooted core values and principles that have enabled us to continue Driving What’s Right throughout the last century. Our teams deliver the Holman Experience by treating our customers and each other as we would like to be treated, and creating positive, rewarding relationships all around.** **The automotive markets Holman serves include fleet management and leasing; vehicle fabrication and upfitting; component manufacturing and productivity solutions; powertrain distribution and logistics services; commercial and personal insurance and risk management; and retail automotive sales as one of the largest privately owned dealership groups in the United States.** **Holman** is looking for a Security Engineer to work where cloud infrastructure and software development meet. You will review and design security architecture for our cloud environments, maintain our application security tooling, and work directly with development teams to threat model applications and find and fix vulnerabilities. You will also perform third\-party vendor security reviews, support our work with external penetration testing partners, help secure our growing use of AI, and take part in incident response as part of the broader security team. **Principal Purpose of Position** --------------------------------- ### **Security Engineering** * Review cloud security solutions and contribute to secure architecture designs for Azure and AWS environments, turning business requirements into practical security controls. * Provide security architecture guidance and design patterns to Infrastructure, Cloud, and Development teams. * Build, deploy, and maintain security infrastructure as code with Terraform, Terragrunt, ARM, and Bicep, so that controls stay consistent, version\-controlled, and repeatable. * Perform third\-party vendor security reviews: assess vendor architecture, controls, and risk, document findings, and recommend mitigations or acceptance criteria. * Contribute to the security architecture and operation of enterprise AI platforms, including MCP gateways, LLM routers, and AI gateways. This covers access control and tool permissions, prompt injection and data leakage risks, AI usage and cost governance (FinOps), and observability and logging of AI activity. * Keep documentation of security controls, configurations, architecture decisions, and procedures accurate and current. ### **Software Security** * Perform threat modeling with development teams on new and existing applications, and work with developers to understand vulnerabilities and architectural security issues, supporting remediation through to verified closure. * Support the IAM team on cloud and application identity security, including workload and managed identities, service principals, least\-privilege role design, secrets handling, and application authentication and authorization patterns. * Administer and maintain application and cloud security tooling, including cloud security posture, runtime application security, and API security testing platforms. This covers configuration, tuning, integrations, and keeping findings accurate. * Help integrate security controls and testing into CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows. * Work with third\-party penetration testing providers to support scoping, ongoing attack surface assessment, results triage, and remediation tracking. * Report vulnerability exposure, remediation status, and risk to application owners and management. ### **Incident Response \& General** * Participate in incident response activities, contributing cloud and application security expertise to investigation, containment, and remediation. * Lead specific initiatives or workstreams when delegated. * Share knowledge with peers and developers on secure design and coding practices. * Stay current on cloud and application threats, attack techniques, and security technologies, and recommend improvements to Holman's security posture. * Perform other duties and special projects as assigned. **Relevant Work Experience** ---------------------------- * 5–7 years of combined information security and technical engineering experience, with significant time in cloud security, application security, or both. * Strong experience securing Microsoft Azure and Amazon AWS environments in cloud\-native and hybrid architectures. * Hands\-on experience writing and maintaining infrastructure as code with Terraform (Terragrunt a plus), ARM, and/or Bicep. * Ability to read and reason about application code in at least one of .NET, Python, Ruby, or Node.js, well enough to explain a vulnerability and its fix to a developer. * Strong working knowledge of OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, threat modeling methodologies (e.g., STRIDE), and secure software development practices. * Working knowledge of cloud and application identity: Entra ID and AWS IAM, managed identities and service principals, d, or equivalent work experience. \#LI\-BS1 \#LI\-REMOTE **At Holman, we exist to provide rewarding careers and better lives for employees and their families. We hire, train, empower, and reward exceptional people. Our journey is guided by our desire to get it right every time and the acknowledgement that we have an opportunity to be better. To be better, we have to do better, and to do better we must know better. That’s why we are listening, open to learning new things – about ourselves and each other. We will never stop striving for improved diversity, equity, and inclusion because we are successful together when we feel trusted and supported. It’s The Holman Way.** **At Holman, your total compensation goes beyond your paycheck. To position you for success and provide a rewarding career and better life for you and your family, Holman is proud to offer you the benefits you deserve; including protection against illness, disability, loss of work, or preparation for retirement. Below is a brief overview of the programs available to full\-time employees (programs may vary by country or worker type):** * Health Insurance * Vision Insurance * Dental Insurance * Life and Disability Insurance * Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts * Employee Assistance Program * 401(k) plan with Company Match * Paid Time Off (PTO) * Paid Holidays, Bereavement, and Jury Duty * Paid Pregnancy/Parental leave * Paid Military Leave * Tuition Reimbursement **Benefits:** *Regular Full\-Time* We offer excellent benefits including health, vision, dental, life and disability insurance, and 401(k) with company match. Our time off benefits include Paid Time Off (PTO), paid holidays, bereavement, and jury duty. In addition, we offer paid pregnancy and parental leave, and supplemental paid military leave to eligible employees. ### **Click here for Washington State benefit information.** *Temporary or Part\-Time* In geographic areas with statutory paid sick leave, part\-time and temporary employees will receive a paid sick leave benefit that meets the mandated requirements. ### **Click here for Washington State benefit information.** **Pay:** We offer competitive wages that are commensurate with job\-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, and geographic location, starting in the range of $105,050\.00 \- $149,700\.00 USD annually for full time employees. The annual compensation range is comprised of base pay earnings.**Artificial Intelligence Statement** We recognize that applicants for positions at any organization may view AI tools for tasks such as drafting a resume or cover letter, provided the information is accurate and truthful. However, applicants should not use AI tools to: * Answer interview questions on their behalf, or use AI tools in any way during the interview or other qualification process(es). * Misrepresent or embellish qualifications, skills, or experience * Create false or misleading representations of identity (e.g., deepfakes or altered images/videos) Your application, whether an AI tool is used or not, should reflect your authentic abilities and experiences. Any use of AI that compromises honesty or integrity may result in disqualification from the process. **Equal Opportunity Employment and Accommodations:** *Holman provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.* *If you are a person with a disability needing assistance with the application process, please contact* *HR@Holman.com* *This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Tenant
jobs.description: **What We’re Building** Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200\-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023! If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases. **Who We Are** We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers. **How We Work** We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1\. \#LI\-Remote Honeycomb is an observability platform that helps engineering teams understand how their software behaves in production. Our Tenant team is behind Honeycomb Private Cloud, a brand new product that allows customers to have their own Honeycomb instance. ### **What you'll do** * **Own delivery of Honeycomb Private Cloud** — the infrastructure, tooling, and operational processes that let enterprise customers run Honeycomb inside their own cloud environment. * **Grow the product** — we anticipate significant growth in the next year; help us meet sales goals and build relationships to support it. * **Work at the customer boundary** — partner with Field Engineering, Support, and Sales on PoCs, security reviews, access negotiations, and contract asks, and help the team know when to take feedback and when to help us show the customer what good looks like. * **Lead across the org** — Private Cloud depends on many engineering teams across the org. We maintain a tight drift between SaaS and Private Cloud, and this role will need to be able to understand and prioritize work that touches all parts of our engineering org. * **Feedback loops for developers.** We learn a lot about Honeycomb as a product while building Honeycomb. Ensure that we push Private\-Cloud\-inspired tooling back into our SaaS infrastructure so each side continues to make the other better. * **Build the team** — grow and develop a small, tenured, senior, very high\-context team; remove the single points of failure that come with that; hire and onboard the next engineers to scale the team as the product offering scales. ### **What we're looking for** * 1\+ year as an Engineering manager for a highly technical, senior team. * You have a solid track record as an engineer, influencing without authority, and leaving things better than you found them. * You've managed or led a team that carried a real production on\-call rotation, and you treat operational health as a core requirement. * Experience shipping and operating software in environments you don't fully control — on\-prem, private cloud, BYOC, or managed single\-tenant. You know what version skew, partial telemetry, and customer security constraints do to a roadmap. * Enough Kubernetes and AWS fluency to review a design, ask the challenging questions, and be useful in an incident review. You don't need to be the person writing the Terraform. * Comfort being customer\-facing with enterprise buyers: security questionnaires, access models, procurement, escalations. * Ruthless prioritization on a small team with an enormous surface area — you can name what you decided *not* to do, and why. * Hiring and onboarding engineers into a domain with a steep ramp. * Comfort with AI tooling, and a point of view on where it helps and where it doesn't. **Bonus points** * Familiarity with observability / OpenTelemetry (Honeycomb's domain). * You're still hands\-on and enjoy contributing to and reviewing code (welcome, but it won't be your primary role here). * Background in Go, Terraform, Kafka, and large\-scale data infrastructure. * FedRAMP, GovCloud, or regulated\-industry compliance experience. * A field\-adjacent past — solutions architecture, consulting, or deployment engineering. Base Salary based on level of experience $208,260 \- $234,000 USD **What you'll get when you join the Hive:** * A stake in our success \- generous equity with employee\-friendly stock program * It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are \- our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience * Time to recharge with unlimited PTO * A distributed\-first mindset and culture (really!) * Home office, co\-working, and internet stipend * Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents * Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood * Annual development allowance * And much more... **Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time.** Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work. **Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:** We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you: * All communications will come from an **@honeycomb.io** email address + We occasionally work with external recruiting agencies. These partners will use legitimate business email addresses—**never personal accounts like Gmail or Yahoo**. * Our recruiting process will **never** ask you to provide financial or sensitive personal information, including but not limited to: + Social security or tax identification numbers + Credit card numbers + Bank account information **Diversity \& Accommodations:** We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams. We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know. As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback. **Privacy Notice:** If you apply for a job at Honeycomb and your application is unsuccessful (or you withdraw from the process or decline our offer), Honeycomb will retain your information after your application for a period of time in accordance with local laws. We retain this information for various reasons, including in case we face a legal challenge in respect of a recruitment decision, to consider you for other current or future jobs at Honeycomb, and to help us better understand, analyze and improve our recruitment processes. For more information regarding our privacy practices please see the Honeycomb Privacy Notice. If you do not want us to retain your information, or want us to update it, please contact privacy@honeycomb.io. Please note, however, that we may retain some information if required by law or as necessary to protect ourselves from legal claims.

jobs.title: Product Architect
jobs.description: **Summary** ----------- **The Opportunity** Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Product Architect to join our Digital Sales \& Events team. In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader digital, technology and business teams, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests. **Who We Are** At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest\-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues. As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers. **Why Now?** This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception. **How We Care for Our People** What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious *100 Best Companies to Work For®* list since 2013\. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong. We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include: * Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally * Flexible work schedule * Work\-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on\-site fitness center * A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption * Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match **Who You Are** As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results\-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally. **The Role** The Product Architect provides architectural leadership for a digital product area, with a primary focus on data architecture. This role develops a deep understanding of Hyatt’s legacy data models, systems, and integrations, and helps product and engineering teams make sound decisions as business requirements evolve. The Product Architect assesses how proposed capabilities and changes affect the data model, data flows, integrations, and downstream consumers. They work with product, engineering, database, and platform teams to define solutions that preserve data integrity and support reliable, secure, and scalable applications. * Understand and document core legacy data models, including how key entities, business rules, and integrations are used across the Hyatt ecosystem. * Translate business requirements into data and application architecture, identifying impacts to existing models, interfaces, processes, and downstream systems. * Provide architectural direction across the product area, including application services, APIs, integrations, and platform dependencies, so solutions meet business needs and work reliably across the broader ecosystem. * Evaluate options and recommend architectural direction, explaining tradeoffs and implications for the product and its data. * Guide teams on data design, relational modeling, SQL, APIs, event\-driven integration, and application architecture patterns. * Coordinate solution strategies across teams so systems and data integrations work together and can scale. * Identify and optimize recurring operational processes that depend on product data and systems, such as monthly and annual sales data cycles. Coordinate execution, clarify ownership and controls, and reduce manual effort and failure risk. * Define and coordinate operational validation after maintenance windows, releases, and other system changes. Confirm that critical applications, integrations, and data processes are functioning as expected, and ensure issues are triaged and resolved with the responsible teams. * Establish and document architecture decisions, standards, and reference designs, including through RFCs. * Partner with internal and external stakeholders, and mentor engineers in data design, scalability, reliability, and operational practices. * Evaluate tools and frameworks when they address a clear product or architecture need. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Experience Required:** * 10\+ years of experience working in complex enterprise technology environments, including software engineering or architecture. * Demonstrated experience designing application and data architectures for scalable, reliable, and secure systems. * Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of relational database design, data modeling, and data migration. * Experience analyzing business requirements and determining their impact on existing data models, integrations, and downstream consumers. * Experience planning data and application integrations across operational databases, data warehouses or lakes, and external APIs. * Experience designing or supporting data pipelines and integrations; familiarity with event\-driven architectures and Apache Kafka. * Experience with REST APIs and integration platforms such as Apigee or nginx. * Experience improving and coordinating recurring business or technology operations, including scheduled data processes, post\-maintenance validation, issue triage, and cross\-team follow\-through. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills; able to explain architectural tradeoffs to technical and business partners. * Working knowledge of modern application development and delivery practices, including Java\-based services, source control, CI/CD, and cloud or container platforms. **Experience Preferred:** * Experience with Hyatt’s systems or similarly complex legacy enterprise data environments. * Experience with dimensional modeling and data warehousing. * Experience with Agile and DevOps practices. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience. The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all\-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary. **We welcome you:** Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better. *We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.* *The salary range for this position is $130,000 to $155,000\. This position is also eligible to earn incentive awards and an annual bonus. The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.*

jobs.title: Senior Director, Data, Analytics and Reporting
jobs.description: At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold **“what if.”** **What if** your ideas could ignite global innovation? **What if** your curiosity could redefine the future? We invite you to step into the next exciting chapter of **your** career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it’s like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. Our cloud\-first networking and security solutions already protect **70% of the Fortune 500** , and we’re looking for creative thinkers ready to push that influence even further. Join us and discover how far your bold “what if” can take the world, your community, and your career. How we empower our people is extraordinary: we’re recognized as a **Glassdoor Best Place to Work 2025, Great Place to Work\-Certified in five countries, and honored by Cigna as a Healthy Workforce honors for three consecutive years** ; And what we build is world class: named **CybersecAsia’s Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024** — clear evidence that when first\-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So, what if the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? **Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next”.** In a world where you can be anything, **Be Infoblox** . **Senior Director, Data, Analytics and Reporting** We have an opportunity for a Senior Director, Data, Analytics and Reporting to join our IT team in Santa Clara HQ reporting to the CIO. In this mission critical leadership position, you will be responsible for defining and executing a data strategy that fuels Infoblox’s growth, customer success, and operational excellence. Collaborating closely with executive leaders across the organization, including Finance, Operations, Product and Engineering, Business Applications, AI Engineering and Security teams ensuring our data assets are leveraged to their full potential. This role requires a leader who can build and mentor a world\-class team while personally driving strategic initiatives and ensuring the integrity of our data foundation. A core part of your responsibility will be to champion and enable our AI strategy and technical foundations, ensuring that clean, trusted, and well\-governed data is the foundation for all AI initiatives. You will also be a champion for the data user, focused on building a self\-service data platform that empowers all Infoblox employees to make data\-driven decisions with confidence. **Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do** * Lead and Inspire a High\-Performing Team: Build, mentor, and scale a diverse, high\-performing team of data analysts, data scientists, data \& analytics, and Business Intelligence engineers, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning * Define and Execute the Data Strategy: Architect a clear, scalable data strategy that aligns with Infoblox’s business goals and product roadmap. Ensure the right data architecture, tools, and processes are in place to deliver trusted, high\-quality data at scale * Champion AI Enablement: Act as a critical partner to the Business Applications and AI Engineering teams. Ensure that our data and data infrastructure and practices are optimized to support and accelerate AI development and deployment. This includes defining data governance standards, building high\-quality training datasets, and developing scalable data pipelines for AI/ML models, and building AI data products for all Infoblox employees * Drive Data\-Driven Decision\-Making: Partner with senior leaders across Finance, Operations, Product \& Engineering to identify and deliver actionable insights that inform key business decisions, optimize performance, and unlock new opportunities * Advance the Data Foundation: Own the end\-to\-end data lifecycle for critical business domains, from data ingestion and ETL/ELT pipelines to data modeling, quality assurance, and governance. Ensure a single source of truth for key metrics across the organization * Develop and maintain Master data management by establishing standards, data quality rules, matching/merging criteria, survivorship rules, and hierarchy management * Enhance Data Security and Governance: Partner with Security leaders to define and implement policies and systems to safeguard data privacy, ensure regulatory compliance, and protect sensitive information. This includes establishing robust data access controls, audit trails, and data retention policies * Enable Self\-Service and User Experience: Drive the development of a self\-service data platform that empowers business users with easy\-to\-use tools and intuitive dashboards * Focus on the end\-to\-end user experience, from data discovery to insight generation, to ensure our data is not just available but also accessible and understandable to all * Lead Enterprise Data Governance Council and establish data governance and quality frameworks to ensure trustworthy, compliant  sage. Implement policies and controls for secure, auditable, and ethical data management **Be Prepared — What You Bring** * Experience: 12 plus years of progressive experience in data analytics, data science, and data engineering, with at least 5 plus years in a senior leadership role * Strategic Leadership: Proven ability to define, communicate, and execute a data vision that drives measurable business outcomes * AI Acumen: Demonstrated experience in building data foundations and pipelines specifically to support and accelerate AI and machine learning initiatives * Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of modern data stacks, including data warehousing, ETL/ELT pipelines, data modeling, and Tableau. Experience with cloud\-based data environments that enable AI use\-cases (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, GCP, Azure) * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Exceptional ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and communicate complex data concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences * Strong Data governance and master data management background to build governance organizations and frameworks ground up * Team Development: A track record of successfully hiring, mentoring, and leading high\-performing data teams **Be Successful — Your Path** **First 90 Days:** * Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long term goals. **Six Months:** * Launch a scalable data architecture and governance framework to ensure high\-quality, trusted, and secure data across the organization * Deliver initial AI\-enablement capabilities by developing clean training datasets and foundational data pipelines to support early AI/ML initiatives * Roll out a self\-service data platform prototype with intuitive dashboards, empowering business users to access and utilize data independently * Establish a data strategy and define data governance principles for the enterprise * Make critical platfrom decisions in line with broader strategic transformation projects **One Year:** * Operationalize enterprise\-wide data governance council and master data management standards, ensuring consistent, compliant, and ethical data usage * Demonstrate measurable business impact through data\-driven insights that optimize performance and inform strategic decisions across departments * Scale the data and analytics team into a world\-class organization, fostering a culture of data literacy, innovation, and continuous improvement **Belong—** **Your Community** Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here. **Be Rewarded —** **Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong** * Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options * Learning opportunities, career\-mobility programs, and leadership workshops * Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy * Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks (and the occasional cupcake), plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations * Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match We practice pay transparency and reward performance. Offers reflect role location, internal equity, experience, skills, education, and certifications. Base salary for this position: $208,100\.00 \- $323,950\.00 plus bonus. Ready to **Be the Difference?** *Infoblox is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis* \#LI\-EC1 \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Responsible AI Engineering Senior Manager
jobs.description: Posted Date 7/19/2026 Description **We Are:** Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world's leading businesses, governments, and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth, and enhance citizen services, creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent\- and innovation\-led company with approximately 790,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, and we believe that scaling AI responsibly is what makes it durable. Technology is at the core of change today, and we combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data, and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise, and global delivery capability. Our Responsible AI capability, within our broader AI \& Data practice, sits at the intersection of deep industry knowledge, applied AI engineering, and trusted AI governance. We help the world's leading organizations build and run production\-grade AI and agentic systems that are safe, fair, transparent, and compliant by design, not by afterthought. We are not looking for generalists who advise on AI risk in the abstract. We need a practitioner who has built, shipped, and run AI systems at scale, who understands exactly where the technical, ethical, and operational risks live, and who can engineer the guardrails directly into the architecture and the delivery model, across both onshore and offshore teams. **You Are:** You are a Responsible AI Senior Manager who makes trustworthy AI real by building it, not just reviewing it. You bring that credibility because you are, at your core, a deeply technical AI and Data delivery leader: you have designed and shipped production AI, agentic AI, and data science solutions yourself, and you have led large, distributed delivery teams across onshore and offshore locations to do the same at scale. You are equally comfortable in a model architecture review, an agentic workflow design session, and a governance committee, and you use that technical fluency to embed fairness, transparency, safety, and compliance directly into how systems are designed, built, tested, and operated. You set the technical and ethical standard for how generative and agentic AI gets built, secured, and run, and you lead the engineering, data science, and delivery teams who build it. **The Work:** * **Embed Responsible AI across the lifecycle —** define and operationalize Responsible AI standards, including fairness and bias testing, explainability, model and data governance, privacy, safety jobs.title: VP of Materials Programs
jobs.description: **Company Description** Living Future is a non\-profit organization whose mission is to catalyze the transformation toward communities that are culturally rich, socially just and ecologically restorative. Living Future offers other certifications, transparency labels, education, and events that enable organizations and individuals to communicate their commitment to a healthier world. We also believe that the industry can and should address ecological impact, social impact, health impact and cultural impact as intersecting issues. Living Buildings are beacons for change, data points for skeptics, inspirational stories for young people, and test beds for innovation. We seek to affect change in the building industry by envisioning a living future and showing it’s possible to embody that future in practice and policy. The Materials Team is composed of team members who manage all aspects of our work to create supply chain transparency and certification of regenerative building materials, and who work in collaboration with the other Teams at Living Future (Buildings, Engagement, and Operations) to help advance progress towards a regenerative built world. The VP of Materials drives strategy and provides high\-level leadership for a team of highly functional and passionate individuals. The VP of Materials is accountable for strategy, execution and revenue generation for our Materials programs including leading the upcoming business strategy to scale our impact through a greater harmonization of Declare and the LPC. The role is also a key external ‘face’ for the organization, managing key client relationships and ensuring their continued engagement (philosophical and financial) in our programs. This role also sets and is accountable for the Materials Team revenue and expenses, tracking that budget and providing elegant and accurate reporting of Team impact and financial metrics to the Living Future team including the Board of Directors. The VP of Materials also plays a critical and active role in connecting Living Future to the wider movement for supply chain transparency and good materials in the building industry: the VP maintains active relationships and engagement with peer organizations and key leaders to ensure that Living Future is well\-coordinated in our tactics and programs. The VP of Materials is also a member of the Management Team for Living Future, which is the core leadership team of the organization. **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES** Overall strategic and operational responsibility for the Declare and LPC programs, from research \& development, client success, sales, marketing, and partnerships. **Relationship Management** * Create and maintain strategic partnerships that grow the Declare and LPC programs and help Living Future grow its regenerative work and engagement with the movement * Leverage our community to create and iterate on our programs strategy by effectively co\-creating and engaging clients as we consider adjustments to our Declare \& LPC programs * Support corporate membership and sponsorship outreach efforts, playing an active role in relationship building with key Declare and LPC clients to encourage their participation in the larger Living Future movement and our other programs (including membership and events) * Serve as an eloquent and knowledgeable spokesperson for the organization at industry events and in strategic conversations with stakeholders. * Lead R\&D fundraising efforts for the Materials Team, including relationship building with key collaborators (including philanthropic organizations where appropriate), drafting concept notes, developing pitch decks, and seeking opportunities for creative partnerships with peer NGOs and others to create mutually beneficial partnerships for the development of our movement. **Business Strategy** * Lead the development of a practical and thorough business strategy (in written form, for Board and staff participation) for the evolution of our Materials programs, including a 2027 full plan towards a harmonized program structure for the Materials team (i.e. along the lines of our ‘three sisters’ concept). * Maintain effective and simple pricing systems  roughly $1\.25M in revenue in 2025\. Foster a positive and productive work environment for a group that is accountable, inclusive, and innovative. * **Qualifications** **QUALIFICATIONS** * 15\+ years of experience in the nonprofit and/or sustainability sector, including 10\+ years in a leadership capacity with revenue responsibility in the $1\-3M range * Broad knowledge of green manufacturing, CSR, and DEI issues, trends, and programs. * Strong familiarity with business development, sales, customer service, and certification processes including comfort and willingness to use CRM platforms like Salesforce and customer service platforms like HelpScout. * Familiarity with Living Future’s labels and certifications, including familiarity with the broader theories of change in the building materials supply chain transparency movement. * Demonstrated strategic planning skills and experience, including business planning * Demonstrated organizational leadership and management experience including managing a growing team of direct reports * Demonstrated success in team leadership including thoughtful performance management processes and fostering growth and empowerment for team members. * Proficiency with financial management at the department level including the use of invoicing softwares, budgeting platforms and processes and efficient financial metric tracking. * Demonstrated operational experience, success in building out repeatable processes, quality assurance systems, staff training * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to encourage ideas and feedback from a diverse range of customers, funders, and other stakeholders. * Demonstrated commitment to diversity, equity, and creating an inclusive work environment. * Background and passion for sustainable design and development and values\-driven business operations are highly desirable. **DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS** * Undergraduate or graduate degree in a related field. * Strong connections with leaders in the building materials industry, including manufacturers, architects and engineers, construction, key industry groups and others. * Experience with administering programs/standards, establishing third\-party audit systems, adhering to best practices for program development and governance * Experience with and affinity for working across virtual teams and with remote management. * Living Future Accreditation. Candidates who are not already Living Future Accredited will be supported in achieving their LFA within one year. **Additional Information** Our mission at the Living Future is to build a future that is socially just, culturally rich, and ecologically restorative. We are committed to that vision within our organization and work to create a team that is equitable, inclusive, and diverse by hiring and supporting staff from a wide variety of backgrounds. We are committed as an organization to foster better cultural competency, equity, and diversity within our culture and policies and work to support staff in every phase of their career. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application and interview process. If you require any accommodations, please contact our hiring team at employment \[at] living\-future.org. The salary range for this position is **$111,981 to $122,445** annually and is supplemented by Living Future’s generous benefits package that includes employer\-paid health, dental and vision insurance for employees and dependents as well as employee life insurance, short\-term disability, and a 403(b) retirement plan. Annual time off benefits include three weeks of paid annual leave, 12 days of sick leave, and paid volunteer time. Living Future offers a collaborative, team\-oriented and mission\-driven remote workplace. We offer a $50/month stipend to offset home internet costs. Please include a **resume and cover letter** with your application. We will be reviewing applicants starting on **November 30, 2026**.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: **Own the interface into the Recall platform** ---------------------------------------------- At Recall.ai, we are building the API to record, understand and search conversations as context for AI. Making our users successful is a highly technical product problem. Our users have no priors to compare us to and there is no competition to copy ideas from. You’ll be our 12th engineering hire and the first fully dedicated to customer and agentic interfaces. You’ll find the right problems, own the roadmap, and build features 1000’s of companies rely on every day. **Why this role is different** ------------------------------ * You’ll own entire products within the platform, from the dashboard to the MCP and whatever is next, you’ll figure out how to deliver an exceptional experience to our customers. * Recall is critical infrastructure processing real\-time data, going down, even for a couple of seconds, causes major disruptions. We own the reliability of our infrastructure. You’ll own the product experience that helps customers build reliably on top of it. * Our job is to offload highly technical workloads from our customers and their agents. Your job is making product decisions at the intersection of that technical depth and our customer needs to make our products “just work”. * We sell to engineers and engineers are the users. This role is for engineers that think deeply about product and want to talk to users directly. You’ll figure out what to solve. * Building Recall is hard. You’ll make sure using it isn’t. **What you’ll own** ------------------- * The dashboard and MCP. You’ll own the experience engineers and their agents have while integrating, debugging and supporting the Recall platform. * Product roadmap. You’ll interview users, analyze user behavior and run experiments to validate your hypotheses. You’ll figure out what needs to be solved next to have the most impact. Success means customers integrate quicker, need less support and are more successful on the Recall platform. Every improvement you make has a measurable impact in customer happiness and retention. **Who we’re looking for** ------------------------- * You are an expert full\-stack engineer. You can break down complex problems into a clean architecture and maintainable code across frontend and backend. We use django and typescript. Unlimited tokens. * You uncover what people actually need. You ask good questions, dig into nebulous problems, and turn vague concerns into clear problems. * You have strong product judgment. You think about the end\-outcome and constantly optimize for user success. * You build for the next era for developers. You love that agents let users get more done, faster and to a higher degree of quality, you build with an agent\-first mindset. * You are paranoid about security. Keeping customer data safe is your top priority and writing code with security in mind is second\-nature. **Is this your kind of work?** ------------------------------ If you want to own entire products, live at the intersection between highly technical users and deep systems problems, and see your work used by 1000’s of companies we’d love to meet you. Compensation Range: $215K

jobs.title: Senior Mobile Engineer
jobs.description: **About Jitsu** Jitsu is a last\-mile delivery service that allows brands to give their customers a consistent delivery experience all the way to the doorstep. Using a proprietary AI\-powered technology platform, Jitsu helps its customers deliver on their promise of affordable, reliable, expedited shipping with a 99\+% on\-time delivery rate. Logistics teams can now provide a differentiated delivery experience at a competitive cost through successful first delivery attempts, fewer claims, coverage in the markets that matter, and upfront pricing with no hidden surcharges. Jitsu operates in urban areas across the U.S., enabling high\-volume shippers to exercise control over their end\-to\-end delivery network. Learn more at gojitsu.com **Role Overview** We're looking for a **Senior Mobile Engineer** to lead the design and architecture of **mission\-critical apps** our delivery fleet and operations teams rely on in the field and in our logistics facilities. Thousands of delivery partners and Jitsu staff use these apps at any given moment, and our operations run on them. That means **you'll own real solutions to real business problems**. You'll become a trusted member of a team that **cares deeply about quality and craft**, because we believe that's the best way to serve our clients, customers, partners, and teammates. AI is changing how software gets built week to week, and **we see that as an opportunity**. Together, we'll turn each new capability into better tools and better ways of working.**What You'll Do** ================== We're not hiring someone to close tickets. We're hiring someone to understand real operational problems and own the solutions, using whatever technology the problem calls for. * **Start with the problem.** Spend real time with the people who rely on our work: operations leaders, site leads, warehouse teams, and delivery partners. You'll do whatever it takes to deeply understand the problem and the people you're serving, which may include visiting warehouses, working a sort shift, or riding along on a delivery route. * **Own the solution, not just the code.** Take problems from discovery through design, delivery, and adoption, and stay with them until they're actually solved in the field. * **Build technology that holds up in the real world.** Our Flutter apps move millions of shipments a year, in warehouses and on the road. You'll make them work offline, scan fast, track location reliably, and ship releases our operations can count on. * **Work across the stack.** If the right solution needs a backend service, a data fix, new tooling, or a process change, you'll make sure it happens, building it yourself when needed, and also partnering with the broader engineering team. * **Shape how we build with AI.** Help us figure out what new AI capabilities mean for our tools, our workflow, and our craft, and turn the best ideas into everyday practice. * **Raise the bar for everyone.** Mentor teammates, set technical direction and quality standards for mobile, and make the engineers around you better. **What Matters Most** --------------------- We care more about how you solve problems than about any list of skills. The engineers who thrive here are the ones who see every unfamiliar problem as something they can figure out. We believe almost anything can be learned and accomplished if you ask the right questions and assemble the right context. We're looking for someone who: * **Owns solutions end to end.** You don't hand off a problem just because it's outside your area. You dig in and get it done instead of waiting for someone else. * **Uses AI to go beyond their specialty.** You can point to real work outside your core expertise that you shipped by working effectively with AI tools. * **Has good judgment about AI.** You know when its output is right, when it's subtly wrong, and how to give it the context it needs. * **Makes the people around them better.** You communicate clearly, explain your thinking to technical and non\-technical audiences, and people want you on their projects. **Permission to Play** ---------------------- These are the baseline for this senior role. They're necessary, but they're not what will set you apart: * 5\+ years building and shipping production iOS and Android apps, with deep Flutter expertise. * Solid mobile architecture skills: state management, modular structure, and patterns that keep a growing codebase maintainable. * Experience designing and consuming REST and gRPC APIs, and a working understanding of distributed systems. * A track record of performant, reliable features for a large user base, built alongside other engineers. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Native iOS or Android SDK experience (Swift or Kotlin). * Experience integrating on\-device or cloud AI/ML features into mobile apps. **Why Jitsu** ============= * Solve meaningful business problems that have a visible impact every single day * Be part of a well\-funded, fast\-growing company tackling complex and relevant challenges * Gain critical experience applying cutting\-edge AI technologies in a variety of settings * Competitive compensation and equity incentives * Health, vision, and dental insurance * 401(k) plan * Flexible time off * 100% remote **The pay range for this role is:** 125,000 \- 150,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: James Hardie is the industry leader in exterior home and outdoor living solutions, with a portfolio that includes fiber cement, fiber gypsum, composite and PVC decking and railing products. Our family of trusted brands includes Hardie®, TimberTech®, AZEK® Exteriors, Versatex®, fermacell®, and StruXure®. With over 8,000 employees and our U.S. operating entities headquartered in Chicago, we boast 31 operating sites, 6 recycling facilities, and 6 research and development centers globally. Powered by a dynamic workforce, we’re united by our purpose of Building a Better Future for All™ through sustainable innovation, a Zero Harm culture, and a commitment to empowering our people and communities. For more information, visit www.jameshardie.com. **Summary** ----------- The Product Engineer translates product requirements, industry standards and building\-code evaluation criteria into practical, defensible testing strategies. This role combines standards interpretation, mechanical design, hands\-on fabrication including 3D printing, engineering calculations and statistical analysis to develop reliable test methods and purpose\-built test equipment for current and future products. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable studying technical standards, creating a 3D model (SolidWorks), building and instrumenting a test fixture, analyzing the resulting data, and presenting a clear technical argument for the recommended test plan. The position will also help develop nonstandard or adapted test protocols when established methods do not fully address the product or performance question, with the goal of producing repeatable methods that may support future internal specifications, acceptance criteria or consensus standards. The Product Engineer will report to the Codes \& Compliance Manager, Outdoor Living Solutions, at the Wilmington Innovation Center. **What You’ll Do:** ------------------- Key Responsibilities * Interpret ASTM, ANSI, ICC\-ES acceptance criteria, building\-code provisions, agency requirements and other technical standards to define test intent, specimen configuration, conditioning, instrumentation, loading, acceptance criteria and reporting requirements. * Perform engineering calculations supporting test design and product evaluation, including statics, mechanics of materials, adjustment load factors, stress, strain, deflection, section properties, fastener behavior, tolerances and uncertainty as applicable. * Prepare, submit, and maintain compliance documentation (e.g., ESRs, CCRRs, technical files, and supporting packages) on specific projects. * Partner with R\&D, Quality, Operations, Applications, Marketing, external consultants and third\-party laboratories to align testing and certification activities with business objectives. * Develop adapted, improvised or novel test protocols when published standards do not adequately address the product, application or failure mode. * Coordinate with external laboratories and agencies (Intertek, QAI, ICC‑ES, CCMC, etc.) to define test programs, review results, and manage certifications. * Other duties as assigned. **What You’ll Bring:** ---------------------- Education \& Experience * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. * 3\+ years of relevant experience in product engineering, mechanical design, laboratory testing, test engineering, product development or a related role * Hands\-on fabrication including 3D modeling and printing * Strong mathematical and engineering\-calculation skills with the ability to document assumptions, formulas, units and conclusions. * Proficiency in statistical analysis and data visualization using Excel, Minitab, or comparable analytical tools. * Working knowledge of ASTM standards, ICC\-ES acceptance criteria, IBC, IRC, ANSI requirements or certification/listing agency processes. (Canadian Codes a plus), and related compliance pathways. Other Skills * Experience testing building products, polymer composites, PVC, fiber cement, metals, fasteners, decking, railing, cladding or related construction products. * Hands\-on experience operating and maintaining laboratory test equipment, including universal test machines, instrumentation, data acquisition systems, environmental conditioning equipment, and calibration/verification systems; capable of designing, fabricating, and modifying test fixtures using rapid prototyping or additive manufacturing methods. * Provide technical support to sales, marketing, field service, quality assurance, production, and contract manufacturers. * Effective communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation) across all organizational levels. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a matrix environment. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and project management systems (e.g., Excel, Smartsheet, MS Project). * Leverages AI\-enabled tools and digital technologies to enhance productivity, improve work quality, accelerate learning, and support data\-driven decision making. * Strong interpersonal skills, able to build relationships internally and externally. * Ability to travel an average of approx. 20% **What You’ll Receive:** ------------------------ As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay scale for this position is $75k to $90k. Placement in the range depends on several factors such as experience, skills, geography and internal equity and may change over time. This position qualifies for benefits and you will be eligible to participate in a bonus plan. At James Hardie, we recognize that our success depends on our people. jobs.title: Civil Engineer (0-3 yrs experience)
jobs.description: **Company Description** **KPFF Special Projects Group** Since 1996, KPFF's Special Projects Group has been at the forefront of addressing specialized challenges in project development. With over 150\+ team members in three offices strategically located in Long Beach, CA, Tacoma, WA, and Seattle, WA, our approach combines dedicated project managers, a skilled technical team, and a commitment to innovation. We offer a comprehensive range of services including civil, structural, and mechanical engineering, machinery design, construction and project management, and planning services. We specialize in the management and design of heavy civil, structural, industrial, and waterfront infrastructure projects across the United States. Our team thrives on solving unique, multi\-disciplinary challenges, collaborating closely with clients such as the Ports of Long Beach, Los Angeles, Tacoma, and Seattle, as well as various municipalities and government agencies. **KPFF Consulting Engineers** KPFF Consulting Engineers is a multi\-office, multi\-discipline engineering firm, committed to Excellence, Trust, Relationships, Stability, and Passion. With over 60 years of experience, we provide creative project solutions for a breadth of markets, scales, and industries. Our 1,500\+ professionals in 36 offices nationwide thrive in a decentralized structure, offering abundant flexibility and numerous opportunities for professional growth. At KPFF, join a legacy of excellence where every team member has the opportunity to contribute to innovative solutions and impactful projects. **Job Description** About the Role: The **Special Projects Group** at KPFF is growing, and we're looking for a **motivated, collaborative entry\-level Civil Engineer** to join our tight\-knit team in **Tacoma, WA**. You'll work on projects that matter, from sustainable port facilities to habitat restoration projects that protect our Pacific Northwest ecosystems. We want people who are curious, ask great questions, and want to make a real impact on the communities and environments we serve. You'll be surrounded by mentors who genuinely invest in your growth and a supportive team that values fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. What You'll Be Doing: **Civil Design That Makes a Difference:** * Work on meaningful projects where you'll see your impact, from designing stormwater systems and habitat restorations that protect the Puget Sound to creating clean power infrastructure for cruise terminals that welcome visitors from around the world * Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on innovative projects including port facilities, fisheries habitat restoration, small boat harbors, marinas, and railway infrastructure * Address real\-world challenges using both proven methods and emerging technologies, with mentorship from experienced engineers who want to see you succeed * Contribute to waterfront and industrial developments that balance economic growth with environmental stewardship, projects that help shape Tacoma’s and the Pacific Northwest’s sustainable future **Why This Matters:** Every project you touch helps build resilient infrastructure for our region's communities while protecting the natural systems we all depend on. You'll grow professionally, be heard, and contribute meaningfully to projects that will benefit generations to come. **Qualifications** Who We’re Looking For: * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering * Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) certification preferred * Willingness to work on a variety of projects * AutoCAD and Civil 3D knowledge * Proficiency in Microsoft Office Programs * Excellent teamwork, communication, and interpersonal skills. Where We Work, Physical Demands and Work Environment: * Our office is located in the Old Town neighborhood of Tacoma with convenient access to I\-5 and views of Commencement Bay, just steps from restaurants and coffee shops. * Duties are primarily conducted in a standard office setting, requiring prolonged periods of sitting at a desk or computer table. * Occasionally may be required to lift objects weighing up to 15 lbs. * Occasionally visiting project locations and performing field inspections which may involve walking, standing, kneeling, or navigating uneven terrain. Site visits occasionally require being in a boat. * Traveling to project sites or client meetings, which may involve driving or flying. **Additional Information** Why KPFF? Join KPFF for a career that grows with you from day one. We believe in investing in our people at every stage, whether you're learning the fundamentals or ready to lead your first project. Here, you'll have the autonomy to bring fresh ideas while getting the mentorship you need to turn those ideas into reality, all while maintaining the work\-life integration that's important to you. Our culture is built on genuine collaboration, shared ownership of success, and values that actually show up in how we work together. Your contributions are celebrated, your growth is intentional, and your career path is something we actively help you build, not something you figure out alone. At KPFF, you're joining more than a team; you're becoming part of a creative community where your perspective matters from the start. We work on challenging projects that shape the Pacific Northwest through collaborative problem\-solving, and we want you to contribute meaningfully to work that will outlast all of us. **We support your growth every step of the way:** * Structured mentorship with engineers who genuinely want to see you succeed * Clear advancement pathways with regular check\-ins on your goals * Professional development support including training, conferences, and PE licensure * Cross\-training opportunities to explore different areas of civil engineering * Real responsibility early in your career, with the safety net of experienced guidance This isn't just your first job, it's the foundation for the career you actually want to build. How We Compensate: The base salary for this role is competitive and will be determined based on the candidate's experience, education, and skills. The expected range for a qualified candidate with **0\-3 years of experience** is **$87,000\-$105,000**. Additionally, we offer **performance\-based bonuses** to recognize and reward outstanding contributions in each Reporting Center. During the interview process, we'll provide detailed information and address any questions you may have about the overall compensation package and benefits. We are passionate about supporting our employees through flexible and comprehensive Benefits. Our Benefits include: * 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer contribution (regardless of employee contribution) * Medical insurance (two plans available to choose from) * Dental insurance * Vision Insurance * Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution * Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * Life insurance * KPFF Paid Family Leave * Short\-term and Long\-term disability insurance * Paid holidays (including two floating holidays) * Paid time off (vacation, sick, jury duty) **Other Perks:** * Hybrid work environment * Professional development education opportunities * Mentorship program * Monthly social events * Professional Licensure Recognition Program * Winter parties and summer picnics * Office committee opportunities * Community projects participation KPFF Consulting Engineers participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. KPFF Consulting Engineers is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, ethnicity, national origin, religion, marital status, sex/gender (including sexual orientation or gender identity), pregnancy, veteran status, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, or any other protected basis.

rapid development (Cursor, Claude Code, etc) * Familiarity with containerization (Docker), cloud deployment (AWS preferred, Github Actions) * Demonstrated ability to ship high\-quality, production\-ready ML/AI systems under tight iteration cycles. * Passion for solving complex problems with real\-world impact, especially in high\-stakes or regulated domains. * Excellent communication To the right person, this will be the perfect kind of challenge. Our mission is compelling, our product is powerful, and we’re growing at a rate that makes us unstoppable. If you’re looking to be surrounded by people who will inspire you to think and challenge you to grow then look no further. Our team is made up of some of the most visionary and uncompromising individuals you will ever encounter. We don’t take ourselves seriously but we’re serious about the work we do and there is absolutely no slowing us down. To keep that momentum going, we do our very best to make sure that each and every team member is completely taken care of. As a Kharon team member, you can expect:* Fully sponsored medical, dental, and vision insurances * FSA program for both medical and dependent care * Long term disability * 401k \+ Roth with matching and immediate vesting * Flexible paid time off \+ 11 paid holidays The base salary range at Kharon is set between **$160,000 to $200,000**. jobs.description: Are you a seasoned software developer with a passion for coding, collaboration, and mentorship? Join Kinsale Insurance, a fast\-growing and successful excess and surplus (E\&S) lines carrier headquartered in Richmond, VA. We foster a highly collaborative technology environment where developers work side by side with product teams and business stakeholders in a dynamic, Agile setting where your contributions matter from day one. We’re looking for experienced engineers ready to influence solutions and architecture patterns that drive our business strategy. #### **About the Role** As a Principal Developer, you’ll join one of our cross\-functional Agile teams and contribute to the full lifecycle of enterprise applications, from design to deployment. You’ll leverage generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude Code) in day\-to\-day development and deployments to accelerate coding, automate repetitive tasks, and improve code quality and productivity. You’ll also help shape the vision and roadmap for your team’s software solutions and mentor developers across Application Development, with the support of a collaborative team that values learning and growth. #### **What You’ll Do** * Deliver high\-quality, scalable code and solutions aligned with business needs and team objectives. * Lead the architecture and design of maintainable, enterprise\-grade applications, aligning them with IT and business strategies. * Research, evaluate, and recommend technologies and approaches that solve our most complex and evolving technical and business challenges. * Champion best practices in coding, testing, security, and AI use across the team and department. * Innovate and prototype new ways to leverage our tools and capabilities, improving scale, time to market, quality, and architecture alignment. * Mentor developers across Application Development to align system direction and inspire growth. * Break down complex problems into well\-defined components that support parallel development and incremental delivery, while managing upstream and downstream dependencies. * Collaborate with developers, product owners, and business stakeholders, and participate in Agile ceremonies, as a recognized technical leader across multiple applications. #### **What You Bring** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * 6\+ years of experience as a full\-stack developer, with a strong foundation in enterprise application development. * Strong experience with Java (Spring, Spring Boot, Spring JPA, Docker, REST, SOAP, Hibernate) and Angular (v17\+). * 4\+ years of hands\-on AWS experience, with familiarity in services and technologies such as SQS, EKS, Python, Node.js, SQL, JSON, Kong, and Confluent Kafka. * Proficiency with AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) and LLMs to optimize engineering workflows, plus a solid understanding of RAG systems and agent\-based architectures. * Experience with CI/CD and tools such as Git, GitLab, Maven, SonarCloud, Visual Studio Code, and IntelliJ, and familiarity with Agile practices that evolve as we refine our approach to delivery. * A curiosity for staying current on emerging trends, with an eye for practical ways to apply them. * AWS Certified Developer certification jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Software Engineer Kipsu is a growth stage Minneapolis\-based technology company that has grown to over 100 employees. At Kipsu, we help service professionals Meet the Moment \- from partnering with some of the largest hospitality brands in the world to working with clients in the multifamily and healthcare industries. Our best\-in\-class technology enables organizations around the globe to better serve their customers through streamlined messaging, data\-driven performance metrics, sentiment analysis and workflow management. As one of the Twin Cities’ leading tech companies, Kipsu has cultivated a reputation for a strong company culture and is consistently recognized by the Star Tribune as a Top Workplace. THE OPPORTUNITY Kipsu is hiring a back\-end\-focused, but full\-stack capable, Software Engineer to join one of our cross\-functional delivery teams in Minneapolis. You'll be part of our Services practice, the engineers who build the server\-side applications, APIs, and data layer behind our platforms. The team is currently building Kipsu's next\-generation identity and access management system: the services that handle sign\-in, enterprise single sign\-on, and permissions for every Kipsu user. Team focus will shift over time as priorities change, so we're looking for someone who enjoys learning new parts of a system as much as going deep on one. You'll work across our technology stack: Typescript, React, PHP, Kotlin, and more – ship features end to end, and help the team make sound technical decisions as we modernize the platform. WHAT YOU'LL DO * Build complete features independently, from request handling and business logic through data persistence. * Design and build well\-structured REST APIs with clear resource models, consistent error handling, input validation, and documentation other teams can integrate against. * Write efficient SQL, manage schema migrations safely, and use transactions and Redis caching where they fit. * Apply secure design patterns as a matter of course, especially authentication, authorization, and input validation, which are central to identity work. * Author technical designs for features and moderately complex work, covering integration points, testing, observability, and deployment. * Instrument your code with structured logging and meaningful metrics, and design for failure when a dependency is slow or unavailable. * Investigate and resolve bugs and production issues independently, finding root cause rather than patching symptoms. * Write unit tests that cover edge cases and failure paths, and add coverage to existing code as you work in it. * Review teammates' pull requests promptly and give feedback that improves the code. * Work within our CI/CD pipelines and containerized environments, and troubleshoot build and deployment issues when they come up. We encourage the use of AI coding assistants and agents throughout your day\-to\-day work. You will stay accountable for everything you ship, so you must review, test, and understand what a tool produces. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR What you bring * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with most of it on the back end. * Hands\-on experience full\-stack experience in application development. You don't need to know our exact stack, but you need to have shipped code to production. * Working experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar): writing joins and aggregations, reasoning about query performance, and making schema changes. * Experience building or consuming REST APIs, including HTTP methods, status codes, and error handling. * A habit of writing unit tests and debugging systematically. * Familiarity with Git, pull\-request\-based code review, and CI/CD workflows. * Clear written and verbal communication. You raise blockers early, ask good questions in planning, and follow through on commitments. * Curiosity and adaptability. You pick up new languages, codebases, and domains quickly, and you're comfortable when team priorities change. Nice to have * Production experience with PHP and/or Kotlin (or another JVM language), TypeScript, React, React Native, Node * Experience with identity and access management: OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, enterprise SSO, or role\-based authorization. * Experience working in a large, long\-lived codebase while new services are carved out of a monolith. * Exposure to messaging and asynchronous patterns (queues, pub/sub, event\-driven workflows). * Experience with Redis or other caching layers, including cache invalidation trade\-offs. * Experience with Docker, cloud infrastructure, or infrastructure\-as\-code such as Terraform. * Experience with observability tooling: structured logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting. * Experience building integrations with external partner systems, or working in B2B SaaS. How you work * You own outcomes. You break work into small increments, ship working software often, and adjust when priorities change. * You communicate proactively. You share progress, blockers, and timeline risks without being asked, and you give reasonable estimates. * You collaborate across functions. You work well with product, QA, support, and other engineering teams, and you listen before you respond. * You connect your work to the bigger picture. You understand why the team is building what it's building and bring observations from your work back to the practice. * You're open\-minded and eager to grow. You take feedback well, seek out unfamiliar parts of the system, and help raise the bar for the team. WHAT MAKES KIPSU DIFFERENT * We’re a solid, stable company, and we enthusiastically embrace our founding startup spirit– everyone pitching in and working to the same goals. * Our culture– We have a team of highly motivated colleagues who are all in it together. We all succeed as one, and we all learn from our mistakes holding our interdependence in high regard. * Our unique philosophy– we bootstrapped this company ourselves and are in it for the long\-term. There is a distinct sense of purpose and ownership at Kipsu as we do things on our own terms. * Remarkable growth– with nearly a decade of advancement, we continue to accelerate. It’s an exciting time to be here. WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT HERE * Unity– Everyone here is committed to the same mission. Our core values are not platitudes but our pact. We believe in the best in each other while always reaching to be better. * Transparency– Our leadership gets into the details. We all gather for weekly space to discover how each team is doing so that we have a full understanding of the business and think like a CEO. * Trust– Our team members are given the trust and license to excel at their jobs, and are supported along the way to continuously grow. * Mentorship \- We all have more to learn and something to teach. The lessons are beyond technical.
