jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About Latent** ---------------- Latent is the enterprise pharmacy intelligence platform, powered by a clinical agentic engine, that enables health systems to grow their pharmacy operations and serve more patients. One engine works across the pharmacy journey to identify patients who qualify for care, improve medication access, capture eligible prescriptions and support patients throughout treatment. Latent’s platform enables more than 60 leading health systems that collectively serve an estimated 70 million people. Founded by Sriram “Sri” Somasundaram and Rishabh Jain, Latent has raised $80 million from Transformation Capital, Spark Capital, Conviction, General Catalyst, Y Combinator, and others. **The Role** ------------ We’re building the intelligence layer of American healthcare. Our systems sit directly in critical workflows and power how clinical AI is delivered and used in practice. You’ll be working on securing all aspects of Latent’s code, cloud, AI, and IT systems. You will be partnering with all Latent employees across engineering, product, legal, and GTM to safely enable Latent employees to move quickly without sacrificing security and compliance. **What You'll Do** ------------------ You’ll be a Security generalist, helping define, lead, and execute the roadmap in all aspects of Security. Here are some of the areas you will work in: * **Cloud Security** Mature and harden Latent’s cloud environment from a security and compliance standpoint into a secure\-by\-default stance so developers can ship code with confidence and the Infrastructure team doesn’t have to worry that their next Terraform apply will put everything on the open internet. * **AI Security** Employees at Latent use a lot of AI. Help us give all of our employees access to the latest and greatest AI\-powered tools in a secure and compliant way so our agents don’t run amok and do the wrong thing. * **Data Security** Latent’s business thrives on giving our users deep insights into their patient data, their pharmacy performance, and how our AI is performing. Help us secure our data warehouse so that our internal employees and customers get the insight they need without sacrificing our commitment to patient security and privacy. * **Application and Product Security** Latent’s developers ship a lot of code. Help us come up with ways to automate all aspects of the SDLC from a security perspective to ensure security is built in instead of being a bolt\-on afterwards. In addition, as Latent plans the next iteration of its application and agentic platform, help us come up with the right security requirements for new product features and enhancements. * **IT Security** Help our hard\-working IT folks secure Latent employee devices and applications. Defense R\&D and SBIR/STTR Initiatives * Evaluate DoD technology requirements and determine whether innovative AI solutions are technically feasible. * Collaborate with LES leadership, systems engineers, defense SMEs, and other t nd technical documentation. * Ability to develop a proof of concept independently or lead a small technical development team. * Strong analytical thinking, independent problem\-solving, and technical communication skills. Initial Areas of Technical Interest Depending on specific opportunities, the selected professional may contribute to: * Agentic AI for defense decision management and acquisition analysis. * AI\-enabled operational decision\-support systems. * Explainable and auditable AI recommendations. * Human\-AI collaboration and intelligent analytical workflows. * AI model evaluation and performance benchmarking. * Mission\-oriented data analysis and predictive decision intelligence. * Intelligent simulation and scenario evaluation. * Secure autonomous software architectures. Initial Engagement and Expected Deliverables Initial projects may include: * Assessing a specific defense R\&D opportunity and its technical requirements. * Proposing an innovative solution and explaining its technical differentiation. * Developing a system architecture and feasibility research plan. * Identifying prototype requirements, development resources, and research risks. * Producing a functional proof of concept when included in an authorized paid scope. * Establishing measurable testing and validation criteria. * Contributing technical material to research proposals and development roadmaps. This is **not a traditional AI trainer, general AI consultant, prompt\-engineering\-only specialist, or purely managerial position**. Did you know we are the world’s leading designer and manufacturer of seating support and comfort systems for transportation manufacturers, as well as tier one and two suppliers within the automotive industry? That’s right! Our automotive products fall into four primary groups: Seating and Lumbar support, Motors, Actuators and Massage Systems. If you join our team, your work will ensure people across the world have a little more comfort in their lives.*** ***As Sr Machine Design Engineer you will be responsible for*** ***performing engineering work related to researching, designing, and developing equipment using electro\-mechanical products and tools to develop and commission production equipment. Will be collaborating with others to implement tools for production processes. Responsibilities include meeting production and quality objectives using effective technology techniques and quality materials.*** **What will you be doing as a Senior Machine Design Engineer?** * Designs machines and machine elements * Manages work project schedules and project budget * Perform other duties as requested or as deemed appropriate * Conform with the environmental policy and procedures and with the requirements of the environmental management system. * Responsible for the development and the release of all manufacturing documents related to machine and product builds. * Responsible for supporting and delivering new manufacturing technologies to improve competitiveness and project profitability. * Ensure Engineering Change Requests (ECR) \& Manufacturing Change Requests (MCR) are followed up and implemented as projected. **Skills Required:** * Bachelor of Science degree in mechanical, design, manufacturing or electrical engineering, technical related degree or relevant work experience * At least 3 years of experience * Math skills which include the use of algebra, trigonometry and analytical geometry * Experience using 2D and 3D solid modeling CAD drafting software. SolidWorks preferred. * Provide professional quality written, oral communication and technical writing skills * Manage multiple projects, work schedules, and accounting budgets * Understand business quality systems and procedures * Ability to supervise and direct others in a professional manner * Maintain a high degree of accuracy in all aspects of work * Working knowledge of design and application for design of machine elements * Working knowledge of problem\-solving techniques for stress analysis * Pneumatic and hydraulic power systems design application * Understand kinematics and mechanism concepts and design * Ability to read, understand, and create engineering drawings * Working knowledge of geometric dimensioning and tolerance * Electrical control system design and application * PLC application and utilize programming skills * Servo/stepper motor application design and programming * Working knowledge of robotic applications * Working knowledge of PCs and MS Office application software * Working knowledge of machine shop practices * Ability to operate basic machining equipment given instruction **What to Do Next** Now that you’ve had a chance to learn more about us, what are you waiting for! Apply today and allow us the opportunity to learn more about you and the value you can bring to our team. Once you apply, be sure to create a profile, and sign up for job alerts, so you can be the first to know when new opportunities become available. **Our Values** Our values speak to our shared beliefs, and describe how we approach working together. * Put People First reflects our commitment to safety and care of each other, learning and development, and creating an environment of mutual respect, empathy and belonging. * Do the Right Thing focuses us on acting with honesty and integrity, delivering the results the right way, taking pride in our work, and speaking the truth – good or bad. * Do Great Work…Together occurs when we engage without hierarchy, collaborate as a team, embrace challenges, and work for the good of all of us. * Take Ownership and Raise the Bar demonstrates our responsibility to add value and make a difference, challenge the status quo and biases to make things better, foster innovative and creative solutions to drive impact, and explore new perspectives and embrace change. **Our Commitment to You** We're actively taking steps to make sure our culture is inclusive and that our processes and practices promote equity for all. Leggett Dynamics, a business unit of Leggett \& Platt, Incorporated, is comprised of people of all abilities, gender identities and expressions, ages, ethnicities, sexual orientations, veteran status, and more. Join us! We welcome and encourage applications if you meet the minimum qualifications. Even if you do not meet the preferred qualifications, we’d love the opportunity to consider you. For more information about how we handle your personal data in connection with our recruiting processes, please refer to the Recruiting Privacy Notice on the “Privacy Notice” tab located at http://privacy.leggett.com

jobs.title: Help Desk Technician
jobs.description: **Overview** We're is seeking a customer\-focused and technically minded Help Desk Technician to join our growing team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous help desk experience who enjoys solving problems, helping people, and building their IT career in a fast\-paced managed services environment. Based in Oklahoma City, this position provides support from our office as well as occasional onsite support at customer locations throughout the metro area. As a Help Desk Technician, you'll be the first point of contact for our customers, providing day\-to\-day technical support and helping resolve a wide variety of hardware, software, and connectivity issues. The ideal candidate is dependable, professional, eager to learn, and committed to delivering an excellent customer experience. **Responsibilities** * Provide first\-line technical support to end users through HaloPSA, assisting with hardware, software, email, and connectivity issues. * Troubleshoot and resolve problems involving desktops, laptops, printers, mobile devices, and peripheral equipment. * Support Windows and macOS operating systems, Microsoft 365 applications, and common business software. * Create, manage, and troubleshoot user accounts, passwords, and permissions using Active Directory and Microsoft 365\. * Assist with diagnosing network connectivity issues, including wireless networks, DNS, VPN access, and internet connectivity. * Install, configure, and maintain workstations, monitors, printers, and other end\-user technology. * Document support requests, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions within HaloPSA. * Utilize tools such as NinjaRMM, Group Policy, and remote support solutions to manage and support client environments. * Escalate complex technical issues to senior engineers when appropriate while maintaining ownership of customer communication. * Participate in onsite support visits and technology projects at customer locations as needed. * Maintain accurate documentation and follow established support procedures and best practices. **Skills** * Previous Help Desk, Desktop Support, or IT Support experience. * Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365 applications. * Familiarity with macOS environments and basic Linux exposure is a plus. * Experience troubleshooting computer hardware, printers, mobile devices, and other end\-user technology. * Fundamental understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, and wireless networking. * Experience working with Active Directory for user administration, password resets, and access management. * Familiarity with ticketing systems such as HaloPSA, ConnectWise, Autotask, or similar platforms. * Experience using remote monitoring and management (RMM) tools such as NinjaRMM is preferred. * Basic understanding of Group Policy and Windows Server environments. * Strong problem\-solving, organizational, and documentation skills. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a customer\-focused mindset. * Ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple requests, and work effectively in a fast\-paced environment. * Reliable transportation and willingness to travel occasionally to customer offices throughout the Oklahoma City metro area. This role is ideal for motivated individuals eager to grow their IT support expertise while making a tangible difference in organizational productivity. If you thrive on solving technical challenges with enthusiasm and professionalism — we want to hear from you! Pay: $20\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * How many years of Help Desk, Desktop Support, or IT Support experience do you have? * Do you have reliable transportation and are you willing to travel occasionally to customer offices throughout the Oklahoma City metro area? * Which ticketing systems have you used? * Are you able to work on\-site in Oklahoma City Monday through Friday? Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Backend)
jobs.description: At Lendbuzz, we believe financial opportunity should be more personalized and fair. We develop innovative technologies that provide underserved and overlooked borrowers with better access to credit. From our employees to our dealers, partners, and borrowers, we’ve built a company and a culture around a resolute belief in the promise and power of diversity. We value independent and critical thinking. We're looking for a backend\-focused Software Engineer to build high\-quality, scalable backend systems behind our products and help shape the user experiences they power. As part of our Boston\-based Core squad, you'll take on complex, high\-impact technical challenges that help our product teams move faster. You'll play a key role in making Lendbuzz's products reliable and sustainable as we scale. ### **Key Responsibilities:** * Drive the architecture and implementation of Lendbuzz's core platform to ensure high scalability and system reliability as the company grows * Build and maintain Python backend services behind RESTful APIs and event\-driven (Kafka) workflows * Modernize legacy architecture: migrate our core platform to containerized AWS services and split out domain microservices, rolling them out safely with canary releases * Improve CI/CD and developer experience: faster test runs, better deploy workflows, and smoother releases * Strengthen reliability through monitoring, health checks, autoscaling, and well\-run scheduled jobs and data pipelines * Work with product and platform teams to unblock delivery and make shared systems easier to build on ### **Key Requirements:** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience) * 5\+ years of production backend software development experience, with proficient Python expertise * Self\-driven, adaptable, and creative problem\-solver who thrives in a dynamic, fast\-changing environment — able to independently tackle complex technical challenges and production issues while collaborating seamlessly within a team * Proven track record designing scalable microservices and complex event\-driven architectures using Kafka and RabbitMQ or Temporal * Familiarity with agentic development workflows and AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar), and an interest in applying them to real engineering work * Deep technical fluency with relational databases (PostgreSQL, AWS RDS), cloud infrastructure (AWS), container management (ECS/K8s), and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) We believe: **Diversity** **is a competitive advantage.** We celebrate our differences, and are better when we have a variety of experiences, viewpoints, and backgrounds. **Compassion** **is a strength.** We care about our customers and look to build long\-term relationships with them. **Simplicity** **is a key feature.** We work hard to make our forms and processes as painless and intuitive as possible. **Honesty and transparency are non negotiable.** We incorporate these traits in all of our interactions. **Financial opportunity belongs to everyone.** We work every day to improve lives by extending this opportunity. If you believe these things too then we would love to hear from you! ### ***Background Checks*** *After an offer is accepted, Lendbuzz conducts a pre\-employment background check. Any evaluation of the background check will be subject to an individualized assessment, taking into account the applicant’s or employee’s specific record and the responsibilities and requirements of the particular role.* ***A Note on Recruiting Outreach*** *We’ve been made aware of individuals falsely claiming to represent Lendbuzz using lookalike email addresses (eg @**lendbuzzcareers.com**). Please note that all legitimate emails from our team come from @**lendbuzz.com**. We will never ask for sensitive information or conduct interviews via messaging apps.*

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. LendingTree and its affiliates ("LendingTree") will not provide or assume sponsorship for employment visas for this position, now or in the future.** **The Opportunity** As a Data Engineer at LendingTree, you'll build the pipelines, models, and data services behind reporting, analytics, and data science across our lending and insurance businesses. You'll tackle complex integration and modeling challenges, improve reliability and cost efficiency, and apply practical AI tools to help the team deliver better data solutions faster. **How You'll Make an Impact** * Build and operate scalable batch and real\-time streaming pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, and database applications across multiple lines of business, with clear plans for schema changes, retries, and recovery. * Design dimensional models and reusable datasets for business, analytics, and data science needs. Perform complex data analysis to validate business rules, identify trends and anomalies, and uncover opportunities. * Own the reliability and efficiency of your data solutions: automate quality checks, monitor freshness, tune performance and compute costs, and participate in the on\-call rotation to resolve incidents and prevent recurrence. * Create reusable frameworks and development patterns that improve delivery speed and consistency. Apply automated testing, code review, and repeatable deployments; maintain technical standards, runbooks, and learning materials. * Partner with business users and engineering teams to clarify requirements, resolve issues, and contribute to the data engineering roadmap, including platform capabilities, priorities, technical trade\-offs, and delivery estimates. * Apply AI tools to development, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting. Validate generated code and results, protect sensitive data, and assess whether these tools improve quality and reduce delivery time. **Who You'll Work With** You'll join the Data Engineering team, working with your manager, fellow engineers, and partners in analytics, data science, product, and business operations across Lending and Insurance. You'll also collaborate with platform and infrastructure teams to manage dependencies, support production services, and turn business priorities into practical data solutions. **What You'll Bring** * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in data engineering, including data warehousing, ETL/ELT development, and analytics, with a record of delivering and supporting production solutions. * Advanced SQL skills, including writing, tuning, and debugging complex queries and using data analysis to investigate problems. * Experience designing data lakes and warehouses on scalable, distributed platforms, with an understanding of batch and streaming integration patterns. * Strong dimensional modeling skills and sound data warehousing practices, including defining grain, fact and dimension tables, and how historical changes are represented. * Ability to deliver projects with minimal guidance in an Agile team, using testing, version control, documentation, and systematic troubleshooting to build maintainable solutions. * Clear written, verbal, and data presentation skills, including the ability to understand business needs and explain findings and technical decisions through documentation, presentations, or dashboards. **What Will Help You Thrive** You're curious about the business behind the data, learn new tools thoughtfully, communicate issues early, and share both credit and lessons learned. Experience in any of the following is a plus: * Snowflake virtual warehouses, performance and cost tuning, Streams and Tasks, and/or SQL Server. * Matillion, dbt, or similar tools for data integration and transformation. * Python, C\#, or PowerShell for integration and automation; Git/GitLab for collaboration and CI/CD workflows. * Power BI, Tableau, or Streamlit for dashboards, data applications, and communicating insights. * using AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Maia to accelerate coding, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting while validating generated code and results. * S. in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **What Success Looks Like** * Production pipelines meet agreed freshness and reliability targets, with clear monitoring, ownership, and recovery procedures. * Business, analytics, and data science partners use tested models with consistent definitions and less manual reconciliation. * Query tuning and pipeline improvements produce measurable reductions in runtime, compute cost, or recurring incidents. * Reusable frameworks, useful documentation, and validated AI workflows shorten delivery time while maintaining quality. **Life at LendingTree** We're a collaborative, entrepreneurial team that's curious, creative, and always ready to roll up our sleeves and get things done. You'll work alongside smart, driven people who care about doing great work — and about helping each other succeed. We believe the best ideas come from different perspectives, and we're committed to creating a workplace where people feel welcomed, valued, and empowered to make an impact. You'll have the trust and flexibility to do your best work, the opportunity to take ownership and try new things, and teammates who genuinely enjoy working together. And while we work hard, we don't take ourselves too seriously. We celebrate wins, recognize great work (our **GSD — Get Stuff Done — Award** is a fan favorite), and make time to have some fun along the way. Come grow with us, make an impact, and help us build what's next. **What We Offer** We want you to feel supported at work and beyond. Our benefits and programs are designed to help you stay healthy, recharge, plan for the future, and bring your best to whatever matters most to you. * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) matching * Generous time off * Wellness programs and resources * Annual performance bonus eligibility **Base Pay:** The base pay range for this position is $100,000\-130,000; pay offered may vary based on location, internal factors, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. **Incentive Compensation:** This position is eligible for an annual performance bonus. **Work Authorization:** This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship. Please do not apply for this role if you will need employer sponsorship now or in the future to begin or continue employment. **Everyone Belongs Here** LendingTree is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion (or creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to submit an application, please email us at humanresources@lendingtree.com. CCPA Disclosure

jobs.title: Manager Data Science
jobs.description: *Are you excited to lead the development of next\-generation AI\-powered legal solutions that help professionals draft, reason, and work more effectively with complex legal information?* *Do you thrive at the intersection of people leadership, large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, and product innovation, turning emerging AI capabilities into meaningful customer outcomes* ? **About our Team** LexisNexis Legal \& Professional, which serves customers in more than 150 countries with 11,800 employees worldwide, is part of RELX (http://www.relx.com), a global provider of information\-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. Our company has been a long\-time leader in deploying AI and advanced technologies to the legal market to improve productivity and transform the overall business and practice of law, deploying ethical and powerful generative AI solutions with a flexible, multi\-model approach that prioritizes using the best model from today’s top model creators for each individual legal use case. The company employs over 2,000 technologists, data scientists, and experts to develop, test, and validate solutions in line with RELX Responsible AI Principles. **About LexisNexis Data Sciences:** At LexisNexis, we're redefining legal intelligence through advanced AI. Our teams harness the power of **large language models (LLMs)** , **retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG)** , and **agentic systems** to build tools that analyze, draft, and reason with legal text. Join us in building AI systems that help legal professionals move faster, think deeper, and operate with confidence. **Role Overview:** We are seeking a **Manager of Data Science** to lead a high\-impact team focused on building intelligent systems powered by **LLMs and RAG architectures** . This role will focus on improving LLM\-powered drafting and retrieval solutions through advanced search, embeddings, reranking, evaluation, and production\-grade ML components. You’ll drive the strategy, technical execution, and team growth necessary to build next\-generation legal assistants, capable of contextual document drafting, and interaction with structured and unstructured data sources. **Key Responsibilities:** **Vision \& Strategy:** * Define the roadmap for applying LLMs and agentic AI to real\-world legal drafting. * Evangelize and embed AI\-driven change across legal product platforms. * Translate evolving generative AI capabilities into tangible customer value within the legal domain. **Technical \& Product Leadership:** * Architect systems that combine foundation models with RAG pipelines to draft contracts, memos, and pleadings grounded in enterprise knowledge. * Guide the development of **AI agents** that perform multi\-step reasoning, cite evidence, retrieve domain\-specific content, and produce compliant outputs. **Team \& Operational Excellence:** * Mentor and grow a multidisciplinary team of LLM\-focused Data Scientists and ML Engineers. * Drive cross\-functional collaboration with Legal SMEs, Data Engineers, Product Managers, and Design. * Establish best practices for evaluation, observability, and responsible use of generative AI. **Core Qualifications:** **Experience** * Previous people management experience (3\+ years) of teams building **LLM\-based applications** , especially in domains requiring rigor and traceability like legal, finance, or compliance. * Hands\-on experience delivering systems using **LangChain** , **LLM agent frameworks** , **vector databases** , and **prompt orchestration pipelines** . * Strong background in deploying **retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG)** systems for grounded and auditable responses. * Demonstrated success in taking LLM\-powered applications from prototype to production. **Technical Proficiency** * Proficient with Python and LLM tooling: LangChain, HuggingFace Transformers, OpenAI APIs, and prompt tuning techniques. * Familiarity with vector databases (e.g., Solr, Elasticsearch, Qdrant, Weaviate), knowledge graphs, and hybrid retrieval architectures. * Working knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD, and model serving tools (TorchServe, Triton, Ray Serve). * Cloud infrastructure experience on AWS, Azure, or GCP. **Preferred Background** * Graduate degree in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or equivalent experience. * 6 years of post\-degree experience, with 3\+ years in a data science or applied AI leadership role, with a focus on NLP/LLM systems. * Prior experience in legal tech, legal AI, or document\-intensive domains is highly desirable. * Familiarity with ethical/legal considerations in deploying generative AI in professional settings. **Work in a Way That Works for You** We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals. **Working Pattern** Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive. **About the Business** LexisNexis Legal \& Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision\-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services. U.S. National Base Pay Range: $115,400 \- $192,300\. Geographic differentials may apply in some locations to better reflect local market rates.This job is eligible for an annual incentive bonus. **We know your well\-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click** **here** **to access benefits specific to your location.** We are committed to providing a fair and accessible hiring process. If you have a disability or other need that requires accommodation or adjustment, please let us know by completing our Applicant Request Support Form or please contact 1\-855\-833\-5120\. **Criminals may pose as recruiters asking for money or personal information. We never request money or banking details from job applicants. Learn more about spotting and avoiding scams** **here** **.** Please read our Candidate Privacy Policy . We are an equal opportunity employer: qualified applicants are considered for and treated during employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship status, disability status, protected veteran status, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. ***USA Job Seekers:*** EEO Know Your Rights .

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Who** **We Are** ------------------ Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end\-to\-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction. Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer\-first software with cost\-efficient, large\-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in. We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute. **The Way We Work** ------------------- The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice: * **Move with Urgency:** We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping. * **Take Ownership:** We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through. * **Communicate Openly:** We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together. * **Build Great Teams:** We lead by example, empower others, and create healthy teams where people can do their best work. * **Raise the Bar:** We're always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most. * **Think Long\-Term:** We design for what's next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact. **About the Role** ------------------ Lightning AI is seeking a **Senior Infrastructure Software Engineer** to join our Infrastructure Engineering team. Our Infrastructure Engineering team builds the software systems that operate and manage Lightning AI's large\-scale GPU and bare\-metal infrastructure. We develop services, APIs, tooling, and automation that bridge the gap between our physical infrastructure and the systems our customers depend on for AI/ML training, inference, and HPC workloads. In this role, you will build production software and automation that support infrastructure throughout its lifecycle, from provisioning and bring\-up through monitoring, maintenance, and decommissioning. You will design systems that enable engineers and software to interact programmatically with thousands of servers, storage systems, and high\-performance networks, reducing manual operations and making infrastructure management more reliable, repeatable, and scalable. This is a software\-first infrastructure role that combines strong software engineering with Linux systems and hardware\-aware infrastructure automation. You will work closely with teams across Infrastructure, Networking, Data Center Operations, and Platform Engineering to bring new capacity online and continuously improve how we operate our infrastructure at scale. *This role may be fully remote within the U.S., or hybrid out of one of our office hubs (NYC, SF, Seattle, or London), with occasional team and company offsites. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time.* **What You Will Do** -------------------- ### **Infrastructure Software \& Automation** * Design, build, and operate production services, APIs, tooling, and automation for managing large\-scale bare\-metal and GPU infrastructure * Build and extend software systems that support infrastructure provisioning, configuration, monitoring, and lifecycle management * Develop reliable automation that reduces manual operational work and improves the consistency and scalability of infrastructure management * Build tools and interfaces that enable engineers and other systems to interact programmatically with physical infrastructure ### **Provisioning \& Lifecycle Management** * Build and extend systems for server discovery, provisioning, configuration, validation, and lifecycle management * Automate infrastructure bring\-up and capacity deployment across large fleets of compute systems * Integrate software and automation with hardware management and provisioning systems * Improve tooling and workflows for managing infrastructure throughout its production lifecycle ### **Reliability \& Observability** * Build telemetry, logging, and observability capabilities that provide visibility into the health of our infrastructure * Develop tools and automation to identify, diagnose, and respond to infrastructure and hardware issues * Translate recurring operational issues and hardware failure modes into improvements to software, tooling, and automation * Improve the reliability and scalability of infrastructure operations as the fleet grows ### **Architecture \& Collaboration** * Partner with Network, Infrastructure Operations, Data Center, Platform Engineering, and other teams to define requirements and build new infrastructure capabilities * Participate in architectural discussions and help define the technical direction of Lightning AI's infrastructure software * Make pragmatic design decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity, and speed of execution * Write clear design documents and technical documentation and contribute to engineering best practices **Who You Are** --------------- ### **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering, infrastructure engineering, or related experience * Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production backend systems in Python or similar object\-oriented programming languages * Strong experience with Linux in production environments * Experience building APIs, tooling, or automation for managing infrastructure at scale * Familiarity with containerization and orchestration concepts * Understanding of HPC and bare\-metal infrastructure fundamentals, including provisioning and out\-of\-band management * Ability to navigate ambiguity and make pragmatic architecture decisions while building for long\-term reliability and scale * Experience working in a startup or other fast\-paced environment with a high degree of ownership and autonomy ### **Ideal Experience** * Experience with bare\-metal hardware troubleshooting and provisioning, including technologies such as PXE/iPXE, BMC, Redfish, or IPMI, particularly with Dell hardware * Experience with GPU servers, either in bare\-metal environments or under virtualization * Experience with network switches, routers, and firewalls, particularly SONiC switches, Palo Alto firewalls, or Juniper Networks * Experience with high\-performance storage systems, particularly VAST * Experience supporting AI/ML or HPC infrastructure at scale **Compensation** ---------------- **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees' health, well\-being, and long\-term success: * **Comprehensive Health Coverage:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents. * **Meaningful Equity:** RSUs that give employees a stake in the company's long\-term success. * **Retirement Savings:** 401(k) matching (U.S.) and pension contributions (U.K.). * **Flexible Time Off:** Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and floating holidays to support work\-life balance. * **Company\-Wide Winter Break:** Two weeks of company closure each winter to disconnect and recharge. * **Paid Parental \& Family Leave:** Paid leave to support you and your family through life's important moments. * **Professional Development:** Annual learning and development allowance to support your professional growth. * **Wellness Benefits:** Wellness and work\-from\-home stipends to support your physical and mental well\-being. * **Sabbatical Program:** Four weeks of paid sabbatical leave after four years of service. * **Flexible Work:** Flexible schedules and a hybrid work model for our office\-based teams. * **In\-Office Meals:** Complimentary meals at our office hubs. Benefits may vary by location, team, and role. *At Lightning AI, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and create better products. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We are dedicated to building a culture where everyone can thrive and contribute to their fullest potential.*

jobs.title: Sr. Director, AI-Native Intelligence & Data Insights
jobs.description: **Date:** Oct 13, 2026 **Primary Location:** Radnor, PA, US **Company:** Lincoln Financial **Alternate Locations:** Radnor, PA (Pennsylvania); Charlotte, NC (North Carolina); Fort Wayne, IN (Indiana); Greensboro, NC (North Carolina) **Work Arrangement:** Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office **Relocation assistance:** is not available for this opportunity. **Requisition \#:** 76793 **The Role at a Glance** ------------------------ Lincoln Financial Group is building an AI Native Intelligence platform that turns enterprise data — starting with call center audio and transcripts, and expanding to claims, policy, and underwriting data — into a conversational, agentic layer the business can query directly. Instead of static reports, the platform is designed to let business users ask natural\-language questions and get grounded, cited answers, backed by a real semantic understanding of Lincoln's data. We're looking for a Senior Director to own the architecture and technical delivery of this platform end to end. This is a hands\-on, builder\-leader role: someone who sets the technical vision and roadmap, but who is equally comfortable reviewing a Bedrock agent's tool\-calling logic, debugging a Step Functions pipeline, or sketching a knowledge graph schema on a whiteboard. You'll build and lead the team that takes this from pilot to enterprise scale. **What you'll be doing** ------------------------ * Own the end\-to\-end architecture for the AI Native Intelligence platform on AWS — ingestion, enrichment, the semantic/business ontology layer, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), knowledge graphs, and agentic orchestration (Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, Amazon Neptune, OpenSearch Serverless, AWS Glue, Amazon Transcribe/Comprehend, and related services). * Translate diverse enterprise datasets — call center transcripts and audio, policy administration, claims, underwriting — into a unified, governed data and semantic foundation that supports natural\-language querying and analytics. * Design and evolve the business ontology, knowledge graph, and KPI/metrics glossary that ground the platform's AI in Lincoln's own business definitions, so answers are accurate and consistent with how the business already measures itself. * Lead build\-vs\-buy decisions across the AI/ML and data stack, and stay ahead of a fast\-moving AWS AI landscape — model updates, agent frameworks, vector and graph databases, evaluation tooling. * Build, mentor, and scale a team of engineers, data scientists, and architects; jobs.description: Responsible AI Senior Manager \| Senior Level \| Full time Job No. R00363318 \| Multiple Locations **We Are:** Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world's leading businesses, governments, and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth, and enhance citizen services, creating tangible value at speed and scale. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer: Back-end
jobs.description: **About LogicGate** LogicGate is the leading AI GRC platform for the Enterprise, helping governance, risk, and compliance teams limit surprises, strengthen resilience, augment program performance, and confidently quantify impact and business value. Built to provide a centralized view of risk and compliance, with AI intelligence woven into the platform's core, LogicGate delivers real\-time insights and actionable data to help drive current business decisions, with the flexibility to scale alongside evolving business needs. Recognized as a Leader in the GRC Market, LogicGate continues to further solidify its position as a best\-in\-class platform. **The GRC Market** Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) is a rapidly expanding sector, with a global market size projected to reach $104\.5 billion by 2031\. LogicGate is at the forefront of this industry transformation, empowering enterprise professionals to navigate complex regulatory environments, manage critical uncertainty, and operate with integrity at scale. **Senior Software Engineer: Platform** ====================================== **About the Role** ------------------ As a Senior Software Engineer: Platform, you will design and scale the foundational APIs and backend services powering LogicGate's Risk Cloud platform. As enterprise GRC demands expand, you will tackle critical system bottlenecks, optimize cloud data stores, and ensure high\-availability multi\-tenant reliability. Working in Java/Kotlin, Spring Boot, and AWS, you will solve complex architectural challenges while elevating technical standards across the engineering chapter. In this role, your technical leadership will directly ensure our platform remains scalable, resilient, and performant. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **System \& Data Architecture:** Design and build high\-throughput backend services, core platform APIs, and distributed data stores using Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, Neo4j, Redis, PostgreSQL, and RabbitMQ to expand multi\-tenant Risk Cloud capabilities. * **Quality \& Continuous Delivery:** Write robust unit, integration, and service\-level tests while partnering with DevOps to evolve cloud infrastructure and automated CI/CD pipelines (AWS, Terraform, Docker, GitLab CI). * **Observability \& Optimization:** Monitor operational metrics, tracing, and alerts in Datadog to proactively diagnose system bottlenecks, optimize database query performance, and ensure platform health. * **Cross\-Functional Leadership:** Facilitate technical design reviews, decompose complex epics alongside Product and Design teams, and mentor engineers across squads to elevate code quality and execution. * **AI Workflow Efficiency:** Leverage AI coding assistants, LLMs, and modern developer automation tools to streamline engineering workflows, refactor legacy patterns, and accelerate feature delivery velocity. **What You Bring** ------------------ ### ***Required:*** * **Backend Expertise:** 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience developing enterprise backend systems using Java, Kotlin, or comparable JVM languages with Spring Boot. * **Distributed \& Cloud Systems:** Proven track record of designing, deploying, and maintaining high\-scale distributed systems and RESTful APIs in an AWS cloud\-native environment. * **Data \& Storage Proficiency:** Strong hands\-on experience with relational or non\-relational databases, caching mechanisms, and asynchronous message brokers (e.g., PostgreSQL, Neo4j, Redis, RabbitMQ). * **Testing \& Quality First:** Deep commitment to modern testing practices across the testing pyramid, treating test automation as an essential component of shipping software. * **AI Literacy \& Agentic Tooling:** Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience leveraging modern AI coding tools, LLMs, or AI agents (e.g., custom developer tools, agentic workflows, or automated assistants) to enhance problem\-solving, code quality, and engineering velocity. * **Distributed Work \& Team Engagement**: Thrives in a remote, highly collaborative engineering culture with willingness to attend occasional department onsites and company events. ### ***Nice to Have:*** * **LogicGate Tech Stack:** Direct hands\-on experience with LogicGate's tech stack: Java, Kotlin, Python, Spring Boot, Neo4j, Redis, RabbitMQ, Docker, Terraform, and GitLab CI. * **Architecture Knowledge:** Familiarity with graph database modeling, event\-driven architectures, or multi\-tenant SaaS application design. * **Full\-Stack \& SDLC Leadership:** Brings a holistic perspective to the software development life cycle \- combining deep backend expertise with a desire to work across the stack, optimize CI/CD pipelines, and apply infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) best practices. The anticipated base salary range for the role is $125,000 \- $165,000 per year \+ variable \+ equity \+ benefits. Actual salaries may vary and will be based on factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Internal candidates who have current pay within or above the hiring range are still encouraged to apply if interested. **How We Work** At LogicGate, we empower organizations to transform risk into a strategic advantage. As we continue to scale, we are looking for driven, high\-performing individuals who are ready to take ownership, raise the bar, and do the best work of their careers. Our culture is built on execution, collaboration, and a shared commitment to excellence. We believe the strongest, most innovative teams are forged by diverse perspectives. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment where differences are celebrated and supported. **Global Total Rewards** We invest in our people with a comprehensive and competitive rewards package designed to support our team members across the US and the UK: * **Compensation \& Equity:** Competitive base salaries, variable compensation plans, and equity options. * **Health \& Wellbeing:** Comprehensive health, wellness, and lifestyle benefits tailored to your region. * **Time Away:** Generous paid time off and annual company holidays so you can recharge and return at your best. * **Growth \& Development:** Continuous career advancement through structured mentorship, leadership training, and premium learning platforms. *Recognized as a top workplace by Built In, Crain's Chicago Business, and the Chicago Tribune.*

customer deployments, from individual cabinet installs to large\-scale, multi\-site rollouts. * Transform client specifications into actionable deployment blueprints for white space environments. * meet specific equipment demands. * Ensure reliable power delivery by planning and coordinating A and B side redundancy. * Analyze electrical loads, breaker assignments, circuit capacity, and rack\-level power needs. * Manage the installation and coordination of RPPs, PDUs, busways, branch circuits, and cabinet power connections. * Improve power utilization by identifying available capacity and determining optimal redistribution strategies. * Assist in the execution of equipment additions, moves, and changes within operational data halls. * Create and evaluate floor layouts, rack elevations, cabinet placements, and cage designs. * Manage the installation and adjustment of cold and hot aisle containment systems. * Provide support for cross\-connects, pathways, cabling, and light fiber requirements. * Foster collaboration between vendors, construction teams, facility operations, and internal engineering departments. * Maintain project schedules and documentation while balancing multiple deployments across various sites to ensure client satisfaction. * Guarantee that all installations adhere to customer specifications and facility redundancy standards. * Facilitate the project turnover process, including testing and final customer sign\-off. **Essential Qualifications*** Proven background in mission\-critical, colocation, white space, or data center infrastructure. * Deep technical proficiency in electrical power distribution within data hall environments. * Hands\-on experience with the processes of weeding, stripping, grooming, and balancing power. * Comprehensive knowledge of load management, electrical capacity, redundancy, breakers, circuits, and rack power. * Demonstrated success in supporting deployment projects or customer tenant fit\-outs. * Capability to handle diverse project scopes, from single\-cabinet tasks to complex, multi\-site initiatives. * Practical familiarity with A and B side power configurations, branch circuits, busways, RPPs, and PDUs. * Ability to interpret construction drawings, rack elevations, floor plans, and electrical one\-line diagrams. * Strong communication skills to effectively document projects and coordinate with customers. * Commitment to maintaining safety and operational integrity within sensitive, active data center spaces. * Willingness to travel as needed, typically around one week per month, to support regional requirements. **Desired Skills*** Foundational mechanical knowledge regarding equipment heat loads, airflow, and cooling. * Experience working with hot and cold aisle containment solutions. * Familiarity with fiber pathways, structured cabling, and cross\-connect standards. * Proficiency in design software such as Revit or AutoCAD. * Ability to multitask by coordinating deployments across several data center locations at once. * Understanding of deployment turnover, quality assurance, and commissioning workflows. * Relevant certifications such as CDCP, jobs.title: CNC Methods & CAM Programming Engineer (Precision Machining)
jobs.description: **Your day at a glance** ------------------------ You start by reviewing a new Technical Data Package (TDP) and the contract requirements. You translate both into clear routings and business\-system entries, then open your preferred CAD/CAM suite to build efficient, reliable CNC programs for complex, tight\-tolerance components. Before lunch, you select cutting tools, design or refine a custom fixture, and head to the floor to perform a critical setup. You qualify the process, capture learnings, and hand off a proven method to the machinist who’ll run production. Later, you walk a cell to spot waste, proposing a lean tweak that trims cycle time and improves repeatability. An engineer swings by with a question about sampling plans; you coach them through the approach. Before you wrap, you support an estimate for a new RFQ, validate process risks, and ensure every step aligns with customer, solicitation, and contractual requirements. **What you’ll own** ------------------- * Develop robust manufacturing methods and sophisticated CNC programs for precision\-machined parts. * Select tooling strategies and design/support fixturing to secure quality and throughput. * Perform crucial machine setups; qualify and transfer proven processes to machinists. * Champion process improvements and lean initiatives to reduce waste and variation. * Mentor engineers, machinists, and peers; serve as the go\-to for programming and machining best practices. * Contribute to quality planning activities, including sampling plans and control strategies. * Support estimating for new work and partner on process engineering tasks. * Translate contractual and TDP requirements into the business system and ensure compliance. * Tackle additional technical tasks to meet business needs with minimal supervision. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * BS in Manufacturing Engineering (or related field) or equivalent experience; typically 5–7\+ years in CNC manufacturing. * Deep knowledge of manufacturing processes, machining methods, and modern tooling technologies. * Proficiency with CAD/CAM platforms and hands\-on experience on the shop floor. * Familiarity with sampling plans and techniques. * Experience with aerospace and/or DoD manufacturing preferred. * Comfort with MS Office for documentation, analysis, and communication. * Working knowledge of Quality systems and standards, including ISO 9001 and AS9100\. * Understanding of government contracting requirements. * Collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in a team environment. **Why you’ll love it here** --------------------------- * Competitive pay * Comprehensive benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and accident insurance * 9 paid holidays * Vacation/PTO beginning after 90 days * 401(k) with employer match up to 4% * Salaried role with a 9/80 schedule — enjoy every other Friday off

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Meeru AI** Meeru AI is building an AI\-native platform that transforms how finance and accounting teams operate. We connect to enterprise financial systems — ERPs, CRMs, billing platforms, HRIS — and apply machine learning to turn fragmented operational data into grounded, auditable intelligence for CFOs, controllers, and FP\&A leaders. We deploy on customer terms — \*\*SaaS multi\-tenant, SaaS single\-tenant, and on\-premises\*\* — across \*\*AWS, Azure, and GCP\*\*. Our customers are Fortune 500 finance teams who require data isolation, auditability, and compliance. **The Role** We are looking for a \*\*Staff AI Engineer\*\* to own the AI and intelligence layer — and the discipline that keeps it honest. Our output sits adjacent to externally reported financials, so "sounds plausible" is not good enough: everything the AI produces must be grounded in, and traceable to, verified data. You own the machine\-learning models that learn each customer's patterns, the LLM and agentic systems that produce grounded natural\-language output, and the rigor that keeps that output faithful. You build per\-customer models without leaking the very signal they're meant to detect, and you set a high bar for evaluation and grounding across the layer. This is a senior, hands\-on role. You set technical direction for the AI layer, partner closely with the evaluation engineer to make quality measurable, and turn user feedback into durable improvements. **What makes this role different** * Grounding is a hard requirement no fabricated or unsupported output, ever. Faithfulness is a gate, not a tuning goal * Clear separation of concerns ML surfaces and prioritizes; generated text only states what is supported by verified data or confirmed by a human * Per\-customer intelligence models that learn each business's behavior, with strict anti\-leakage discipline * Deploys in customer clouds including managed LLMs in\-VPC, so customer data never leaves their environment **Requirements** * **Staff\-level applied ML/AI experience in production.** You have shipped and owned real ML and AI systems used by customers, and you have set technical direction for others, not only built prototypes. * **Strong classical machine learning.** Hands\-on depth in time\-series modeling, anomaly and outlier detection, and gradient\-boosted models such as LightGBM or XGBoost, using Python, scikit\-learn and pandas or Polars. * **Modern LLM and agent patterns.** You have built retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool\-using agents, and structured (schema\-validated) output, and orchestrated them with LangGraph or a similar framework. * **Rigor on evaluation, grounding and hallucination control.** You know how to measure whether an LLM's output is faithful to its source data, and you have built guardrails that stop unsupported statements from reaching users. * **Discipline around data leakage and honest evaluation.** You design features, splits and validation so models are never trained or scored on information they would not have in real use. * **Clear thinking about what ML can and cannot claim.** You can explain to non\-ML colleagues where a model's output is evidence and where it is only a signal, and why that line matters when results sit next to reported financials. * **Real software engineering.** You write tested, production\-grade Python services, are comfortable with SQL against warehouses like Snowflake or PostgreSQL, and have shipped containerized software. * **Technical leadership.** You mentor engineers and work closely with backend, data, product and evaluation colleagues to turn feedback into lasting improvements. Nice\-to\-haves* **Finance or accounting domain experience.** Familiarity with ERP, billing or FP\&A data and the audit expectations around it. * **Feature\-attribution literacy.** Experience with tools like SHAP, and a clear view of where attribution explanations break down. * **Human\-in\-the\-loop systems.** You have designed review, confirmation or correction workflows and fed them back into models. * **Managed LLMs inside customer clouds.** Experience running AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or Azure OpenAI inside a customer's VPC so their data never leaves their environment. * **Sparse and zero\-inflated data.** Experience modeling rare events or data that is mostly zeros. * **Multi\-deployment enterprise software.** Exposure to products shipped as multi\-tenant SaaS, single\-tenant SaaS and on\-premises across AWS, Azure and GCP.

We look for teammates who can navigate ambiguity, reason from data and customer signals, work across technical and organizational boundaries, and turn complex problems into durable, measurable outcomes. jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer - Intelligence Systems
jobs.description: **Associate Software Engineer, Intelligent Systems** **Reports to:** Director of Intelligent Systems \& Integration **Role Overview** Monti Inc. is a Cincinnati\-based copper conductor manufacturer building practical internal systems across manufacturing, finance, HR, compliance, purchasing, and leadership workflows. As the Associate Software Engineer, Intelligent Systems, you will help design, build, test, and support internal AI\-enabled applications, automations, integrations, and workflows. We are looking for someone early in their career who is highly comfortable working with modern AI coding tools, cloud platforms, and real business systems. This role is ideal for a builder who may not have years of enterprise experience yet, but who learns quickly, uses tools like Codex and Claude Code fluently, and wants to help turn messy operational problems into useful software. This is not a research ML role. It is a practical engineering role focused on using AI tools, cloud infrastructure, APIs, databases, and business context to ship useful systems. The right person should be comfortable working with AI coding assistants, reading unfamiliar code, asking good questions, debugging across systems, and learning cloud and integration patterns quickly. **Key Responsibilities** Development \& AI Tooling * Build and maintain internal tools, automations, and AI\-assisted workflows. * Use Codex, Claude Code, and similar tools effectively as part of daily development. * Assist with LLM\-powered workflows such as classification, extraction, summarization, research, and document processing. * Write clear, maintainable code with tests where appropriate. Integration \& Systems Support * Help integrate systems using APIs, databases, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Azure, and third\-party platforms. * Help debug issues across systems, including application code, cloud services, logs, credentials, and data flows. * Support production systems with monitoring, documentation, and careful change management. Collaboration \& Documentation * Work with business users to understand real workflows before building solutions. * Document decisions, setup steps, known issues, and operational procedures. * Learn Monti’s systems and gradually take ownership of small\-to\-medium projects. Example Projects * Build an internal dashboard for tracking operational data. * Automate a manual SharePoint or Teams\-based workflow. * Help create an AI\-assisted document classification or extraction process. * Improve monitoring and alerting for an existing integration. * Build a small tool that helps purchasing, HR, finance, or operations move faster. * Help evaluate AI outputs using examples, review steps, and simple quality checks. What Success Looks Like Within the first 90 days, this person should be able to: * Understand Monti’s internal engineering workflow and development environment. * Use Codex and Claude Code productively to inspect code, make changes, test work, and document findings. * Ship a small internal automation or AI\-assisted workflow with guidance. * Debug a simple integration or cloud issue using logs, documentation, and support from the team. * Write clear documentation that helps future work move faster. * Show good judgment about when to automate, when to ask for review, and when human approval is needed. **Qualifications \& Experience** Required * Strong comfort using AI coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar systems. * Basic software development experience in one or more languages such as TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C\#, or similar. * Familiarity with Git, GitHub, pull requests, and code review workflows. * Basic understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, and cloud services. * Comfort working in a terminal and reading logs/errors. * Ability to learn unfamiliar systems quickly and ask clear questions. * Strong written communication and documentation habits. * Careful judgment when working with sensitive business data. Preferred * Experience with Azure, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID, or Microsoft Graph. * Experience with Terraform or infrastructure\-as\-code. * Experience building small web apps, scripts, internal tools, or automation workflows. * Familiarity with SQL and relational databases. * Experience using LLM APIs, structured outputs, RAG, agents, or prompt engineering. * Exposure to manufacturing, ERP, finance, HR, purchasing, or compliance workflows. * Interest in production reliability, monitoring, and secure system design. **Core Competencies** We want a curious, tool\-native builder who is excited by real operational problems. jobs.title: Director, Onboard Core Software
jobs.description: Motional is at the forefront of the driverless revolution. We are looking for a Director of Onboard Core Software to lead the teams that deliver the software foundation Motional's products are built on: embedded firmware, the operating system, the runtime, and middleware on the vehicle's various computing platforms. You will own the onboard software infrastructure end to end and lead the teams responsible for it. The ideal candidate has hands\-on experience with systems software on physical hardware and has led engineering organizations with several levels of management. You should be comfortable owning a large area that spans many teams, taking on problems that aren't well defined yet, and working out boundaries directly with other organizations. **Mission Summary:** As the Director of Onboard Core Software, you will lead the strategic vision and execution for the software foundation of Motional's autonomous vehicles, from embedded firmware through the operating system, runtime, and middleware. This leadership role is centered on establishing a single roadmap, intake process, and escalation path for the onboard stack, and serving as the primary engineering counterpart to Vehicle Platform Engineering, Autonomy, and Safety for everything that runs on the vehicle's compute platform. You will keep the current\-generation platform healthy in production while building the next\-generation platform program. You will own cross\-cutting system behaviors such as startup sequencing, storage lifecycle, compute, ECU bring\-up, and cross\-layer latency to ensure the platform performs safely and reliably, and that the entire product is a delight for our customers, from the autonomy features that drive the vehicle to the customer\-facing features riders experience in our cars. **What You'll Be Doing:** * **Stack Ownership:** Own the onboard software stack from firmware through middleware. That includes software on embedded platforms including SoCs, safety MCUs, and GPU compute; the operating systems, drivers, and interfaces to the physical world; task runtime and compute resource management; system health monitoring; and safety and diagnostics software. * **Organizational Leadership:** Lead and develop a team of engineering managers and technical leaders. You own hiring, leveling, performance, and career growth for the group, and you will build leaders who can run their teams autonomously. * **Cross\-Functional Accountability:** Be the main contact for onboard software for stakeholder and partner teams. You will settle boundary questions between organizations, run intake and prioritization, and handle escalations when your teams' software is on the critical path. * **Delivering Quality:** Define what "done" means for onboard software at each release, including quality metrics to ensure delivery of a safe and reliable product. **What We're Looking For:** * **Education:** BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent knowledge and work experience. * **Experience:** 12\+ years of software engineering experience, including 5\+ years leading organizations of 40 or more engineers as a manager of managers. This should be in a field where software runs on physical hardware, such as automotive, robotics, aerospace, or consumer devices. * **Systems Software Depth:** Hands\-on experience building, or leading teams that built, embedded firmware, Linux kernel or BSP software, real\-time middleware, or high\-performance runtimes. You can talk through boot sequencing, IPC latency, or resource scheduling with Principal Engineers. * **Production Operations:** Experience running software in production on a fleet or in the field, including keeping a current platform healthy while bringing up the next one. * **Technical Leadership:** Experience hiring, developing, and retaining talent as an organization grows. * **Cross\-Organizational Ownership:** Experience owning a large area that spans many teams. You build trust with peer organizations, work out boundaries directly, and make decisions people follow. * **Communication:** Clear writing and speaking. You can explain technical tradeoffs to executives, peers, and engineers across your team and others. * **Inclusive Leadership:** Experience building inclusive teams and making room for people with different working styles, ideas, and backgrounds. * **Engineering Rigor:** Ability to set and hold the team to high standards for engineering quality. **Bonus Points (Not Required):** * Experience with functional safety in automotive (ISO 26262, safety MCUs, safety monitors, diagnostics), or working closely with a safety organization on requirements and designs for safety\-critical/regulated environments. * Experience with high\-performance, high\-bandwidth, low\-latency systems, such as moving large amounts of data across numerous subsystems with tight timing requirements. * Familiarity with physical AI ecosystems, where machine learning models sense and act in the real world. That includes how those models run on embedded compute, how they depend on sensors and the onboard runtime, and how on\-road and simulation data is used to train and evaluate them. * Experience in the autonomous vehicle or robotaxi industry. **We encourage a hybrid schedule with in\-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.** \#LI\-AE1 **Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We're driven by something more.** **Our journey is always people first.** We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move. **Higher purpose, greater impact.** We're creating first\-of\-its\-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it's not only good for our business, it's the right thing to do. **Scale up, not starting up.** Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully\-autonomous cross\-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest\-standing public robotaxi fleet. We're driven to scale; we're moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges. Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube. *Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To comply with Federal Law, we participate in E\-Verify. All newly\-hired employees are queried through this electronic system established by the DHS and the SSA to verify their identity and employment eligibility.*
