jobs.title: Full-Stack Senior Developers
jobs.description: Natoli Engineering is hiring two senior full\-stack developers to design, build and run our software portfolio. For more than 50 years, Natoli has made tablet compression tooling, tablet presses and related equipment for manufacturers worldwide from its headquarters in St. Charles, Missouri. Our software includes instrumentation and control software for our presses, tooling management and inspection tools, customer portals such as TabletCAD and our online store, internal business systems, and natoli.com. This is a hands\-on, senior individual\-contributor role. You will write production code most days and take work from first conversation with a stakeholder through requirements, design, testing, deployment and support. The two developers share ownership of the portfolio and report to the Head of IT; neither role leads or manages a team. AI is central to how we will build software. We want developers who already use AI coding assistants and agents every day, know how to build AI into development tools and practices, and know where AI output needs a careful human check. You should also have shipped and maintained real enterprise software, care about quality and documentation, and explain technical trade\-offs clearly to non\-technical people. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Portfolio ownership and technical direction** * Share ownership of Natoli's software portfolio with the other senior developer: software sold with our equipment, customer portals, internal business systems and natoli.com. Divide the work and back each other up. * Shape the technical roadmap and architecture for each application, and agree priorities with the Head of IT: new features, customer commitments, security fixes and technical debt. * Help set and follow engineering standards: coding conventions, branching strategy, code review and definition of done. * Review code from peers and contractors, and pair on the hardest problems. * Recommend build\-vs\-buy decisions and evaluate frameworks, libraries, vendors and tools. ### **AI\-enabled development** * Use AI coding assistants and agents \[such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor] every day across the SDLC: design, coding, refactoring, testing, code review and documentation. * Review, test and take responsibility for every line of AI\-generated code before it ships. * Build AI into Natoli's development tools and practices: AI\-assisted pull request review, test generation inside a TDD workflow, documentation generation, and AI steps in CI/CD pipelines. * Maintain the shared context that makes AI tools effective here: repository instruction files, prompt libraries, coding conventions, and connectors (such as MCP servers) to internal systems and documentation. * Work with the Head of IT on AI guardrails: approved tools, what code and data may go to which AI service, security review of AI output, and licensing and IP. * Add AI features to Natoli products and internal apps where they earn their place, such as search and assistants over technical documentation, using LLM APIs, retrieval and evaluation. * Measure the effect of AI on cycle time, defect rates and review effort, and evaluate new models and tools as they appear. * Share what works with colleagues across IT through demos, short guides and pairing. ### **Requirements and SDLC** * Gather requirements from customers, sales, support and internal users, and turn them into user stories, acceptance criteria and technical specs. * Own the full SDLC: discovery, design, build, test, release, maintenance and retirement. * Work in an agile cadence (Scrum or Kanban as each product needs) and help run backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives. * Estimate effort, track delivery and report status, risks and trade\-offs to the Head of IT. * Plan releases and versioning for customer\-facing products, including release notes and upgrade paths. ### **Architecture, data and performance** * Design secure, scalable, maintainable systems: front ends, APIs, services and integrations with third\-party systems (ERP, CRM, payments, identity). * Design relational schemas: normalization, keys and constraints, indexing, and safe, versioned migrations. * Choose the right data store for each job (relational, document, key\-value, search) and tune queries for performance. * Design caching at every layer (CDN, HTTP, application, distributed caches such as Redis), including invalidation strategy. * Design multi\-tenant patterns for SaaS products, including tenant data isolation. ### **Quality and testing** * Practice and champion test\-driven development (TDD). * Maintain a layered automated test suite: unit, integration, contract and end\-to\-end tests. * Build quality gates into the pipeline: test coverage, static analysis, linting and dependency and security scanning. * Triage production incidents, find root causes and write blameless post\-incident reviews. ### **CI/CD, cloud and operations** * Build and mainta skills, which are still scarce. Local pay data for AI skills is thin, so revisit the band after the first round of applicants. * Budget for both hires: $270,000–$330,000 combined base, plus bonus and benefits. * Hire both into the same band and set each offer by skills and experience, so the two peers are paid fairly relative to each other. * Pay toward the top of the band for FDA\-regulated software experience (21 CFR Part 11\), commercial software experience, or a stack that is hard to hire for locally. * Expected total cash per hire: about $142,000–$182,000\. * Other levers if base is tight: a $5,000–$15,000 signing bonus, extra PTO, a $2,000–$5,000 yearly training budget, and paid AI tool subscriptions. ### **Market benchmarks** Payscale, Built In and Orbyt pages listed under Sources · St. Louis base pay · checked October 2026 Each source reports a different spread, so compare the dots rather than the line lengths. Orbyt's modeled figures run highest; self\-reported Payscale and Built In data run lower. **Benefits, work arrangement and EEO statement** ------------------------------------------------ Fill in the brackets with your actual plan details. * Medical, dental and vision insurance, with \[X]% of premiums paid by Natoli * 401(k) with a \[X]% company match * \[N] days of paid time off plus \[N] paid holidays * Annual bonus program (5–10% target for this role) * $\[X] yearly professional development budget for courses, certifications and conferences * Company\-paid AI development tools and model access * Hybrid schedule: \[3] days a week at our St. Charles, MO headquarters, the rest remote * \[Paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, home\-office equipment] **Work authorization:** Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. \[Visa sponsorship is / is not available for this role.] **Equal opportunity:** Natoli Engineering Company, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by law. We provide reasonable accommodations during the hiring process on request. **Notes for the hiring manager** -------------------------------- * **Keep the title at senior individual contributor.** Avoid "Lead" or "Manager"; both attract candidates who expect direct reports and a higher band. * **Hire for complementary strengths.** Both hires must meet the same bar, but one could lean toward back\-end, data and equipment integration, the other toward front\-end, customer portals and natoli.com. * **Explain the two\-person structure.** Tell candidates how the two developers will split ownership and how decisions get made with the Head of IT, since neither one leads. * **Test AI skills directly.** Add a live exercise: a small task in a sample codebase using the candidate's own AI tools, then ask how they checked the output. Keep a system\-design session, a real pull\-request review and a requirements role\-play with a non\-technical stakeholder. * **Trim the must\-haves.** The required list has 15 items; move anything you would waive for a great hire into Preferred. * **Fill every bracket.** Your real stack and tools help candidates self\-select and cut screening time. * **Post the range.** Missouri does not require salary ranges in job posts. Illinois does for employers with 15\+ employees when the job may be done partly in Illinois, which can apply to hybrid hires living in the Metro East. Confirm with HR or counsel. **Sources** ----------- * Natoli Engineering home page (products, software and locations) * Payscale: Lead Software Engineer, experienced, St. Louis (19 profiles; updated March 2025\) * Built In: Lead Software Engineer, St. Louis (anonymous employee submissions) * Orbyt: Full Stack Developer salaries, St. Louis (modeled estimates, updated August 2026; also reports BLS OEWS May 2025 figures for software developers)

jobs.description: **About The Job** ================= Navan is an all\-in\-one travel, corporate card, and expense management solution that eliminates the hassles of corporate travel \& expense management while giving finance leaders real\-time spend visibility and control. The Frontend Architect is essential to our mission, building shared libraries, developer tooling, and infrastructure, evolving the platform for both human and AI\-assisted development, and driving performance and reliability initiatives. **What You'll Do** ================== * **Architect Micro\-Frontend Infrastructure:** Design and evolve micro\-frontend platform using Module Federation in React \& Angular. Create and maintain shared NPM packages enforcing consistency and patterns across the organization. Drive team collaboration through architectural governance, review processes, and cross\-functional alignment. * **Drive Developer Platform Strategy:** Create developer tools and automation that streamline workflows and boost productivity across engineering teams. Author technical documentation and mentor engineers through code reviews. * **Enable Reliable Coding Agent Workflows:** Structure repositories, component libraries, documentation, and development environments so engineers and coding agents can reliably build, test, and extend the platform. jobs.description: We are seeking a highly motivated and technically skilled Embedded Software Engineer to design, develop, test, and optimize embedded software solutions for advanced electronic systems and hardware platforms. The ideal candidate will contribute to the development of reliable, scalable, and high\-performance firmware while collaborating with cross\-functional engineering teams to deliver innovative products. This role involves working across the embedded software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, firmware development, hardware integration, debugging, verification, and system validation. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong programming fundamentals, analytical thinking, and a commitment to engineering excellence. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, debug, and maintain embedded software and firmware for microcontroller\-based and processor\-based systems. * Develop efficient, reliable, and maintainable software using C and C\+\+. * Collaborate with hardware, systems, and software engineering teams to define requirements and implement embedded solutions. * Integrate firmware with hardware components, sensors, peripherals, and communication interfaces. * Implement and troubleshoot communication protocols, including UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, and USB. * Develop software for real\-time operating systems (RTOS) and resource\-constrained environments. * Perform unit testing, integration testing, system validation, and firmware performance analysis. * Diagnose complex hardware and software issues using debugging tools, test equipment, and systematic root cause analysis. * Optimize firmware performance, memory utilization, execution time, and power consumption. * Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and engineering documentation activities. * Support hardware bring\-up, prototype development, system integration, and product verification. * Follow established software development standards, coding guidelines, quality processes, and configuration management practices. * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives involving development tools, testing processes, and software reliability. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. * 0–3 years of experience in embedded software development, firmware engineering, or a related engineering discipline. * Proficiency in C and/or C\+\+ programming, including pointers, memory management, data structures, and debugging. * Fundamental understanding of microcontrollers, microprocessors, embedded architectures, and hardware\-software interaction. * Familiarity with embedded communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I2C, or CAN. * Understanding of software development fundamentals, testing methodologies, and debugging techniques. * Experience using version control systems such as Git. * Ability to analyze technical problems, develop effective solutions, and communicate findings clearly. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with ARM\-based microcontrollers or platforms such as STM32, ESP32, or comparable embedded architectures. * Familiarity with real\-time operating systems, including FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or equivalent platforms. * Exposure to embedded Linux, device drivers, bootloaders, or low\-level system programming. * Experience with hardware debugging tools, including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG, or SWD debuggers. * Knowledge of software testing frameworks, static analysis tools, and automated validation processes. * Familiarity with continuous integration, continuous delivery (CI/CD), and automated build systems. * Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and engineering change management. * Exposure to IoT, automotive electronics, robotics, industrial automation, telecommunications, or semiconductor applications. **Work Environment** * Work collaboratively with software, hardware, systems, and product engineering teams. * Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, and project planning activities. * Support laboratory testing, hardware integration, and prototype validation as required. * Follow applicable engineering quality standards, product safety requirements, and organizational development procedures. **What We Offer** * Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits. * Opportunities for professional development and technical advancement. * Collaborative engineering culture focused on innovation and continuous improvement. * Access to modern development Our group maintains mission\-critical infrastructure for OMS/EMS, Pricing, and Position Marking across listed derivatives trading operations. You'll be at the intersection of financial markets and engineering excellence, where downtime is measured in millions and quality is non\-negotiable. **Test Infrastructure \& Automation** * Design, build, and scale automated testing frameworks from scratch for mission\-critical OMS/EMS platforms, pricing engines, and position\-marking systems * Own end\-to\-end test automation for real\-time trading workflows, market data integration, and regulatory reporting pipelines * Build test harnesses that validate nanosecond\-latency order routing, exchange connectivity, and risk calculations **CI/CD \& DevOps Integration** * Embed automated test suites into continuous integration/deployment pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) * Enable multiple daily deployments to production through robust quality gates and automated regression coverage * Champion shift\-left testing practices across engineering teams transitioning to modern architecture **Cross\-Functional surveillance, audit trails, and reporting accuracy * Collaborate with middle office and external clients to validate reconciliation, P\&L attribution, and settlement workflows * Conduct code reviews with developers, advocate for testability, and drive quality standards across the engineering organization **Production Resilience** * Build test data generation pipelines that mirror live market conditions and high\-volume trading scenarios * Own root\-cause analysis for test failures, flaky tests, and production defects * Establish observability and synthetic monitoring for critical trading paths **Technical Foundation** * Programming proficiency: Strong command of Python, Java, C\#, or JavaScript/TypeScript—you write production\-quality code, not just test scripts * Testing expertise: Deep understanding of unit, integration, API, contract, and end\-to\-end testing trade\-offs; experience with testing frameworks (pytest, JUnit, TestNG, Jest, Cypress) * DevOps \& CI/CD: Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI; comfortable with infrastructure\-as\-code **Financial Markets \& Real\-Time Systems** * Understanding of order management systems (OMS), execution management systems (EMS), or FIX protocol * Familiarity with listed derivatives (options, futures), pricing models, or position\-keeping concepts * Experience testing low\-latency, high\-throughput systems where performance and correctness are critical **Mindset \& Approach** * Quality ownership: You see quality as a team responsibility, not a gatekeeper function * Velocity mindset: You thrive in fast\-paced environments and enable rapid, safe deployments * Curiosity: You ask 'why' and dig into system behavior, architecture decisions, and trading workflows * Modern engineering practices: You're excited about cloud\-native architecture, microservices, event\-driven systems, and observability **Why This Role Matters** You'll be joining a team that has transformed Nomura's approach to software delivery in capital markets. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Internal Tools
jobs.description: **About North Cloud** The public cloud is rapidly evolving, with businesses investing over $200 billion annually in cloud technology. As AI accelerates demand for scalable infrastructure, cloud costs are soaring, and most teams still rely on spreadsheets to manage them. At North, we’re building the next\-generation cloud, AI, and data spend management platform. We give companies real\-time visibility, control, and automation over their digital asset finances so they can grow efficiently without wasting time or money. Backed by top\-tier investors and trusted by companies managing complex cloud environments, North is building the financial operating system for the public cloud. **About the Role** ------------------ ### **Be Our First Internal Tools Engineer** You'll be North's **first dedicated Internal Tools Engineer**, joining our Engineering team to build this function from the ground up. This is an opportunity to establish the technical foundation, architecture, and best practices for how we develop internal tools, integrations, and automations across the company. You'll have significant ownership over identifying opportunities, setting technical standards, and building scalable solutions that can be reused as North grows. Rather than inheriting an established roadmap or legacy systems, you'll help define what internal tooling looks like at North and shape how we approach automation across the organization. While this is a hands\-on individual contributor role, **your work will lay the groundwork for a future Internal Tools team**. As the company scales, the systems, processes, and engineering practices you establish will serve as the foundation for expanding the function. We’re looking for an **Internal Tools Engineer** to join our Engineering team and build the systems, automations, and tools that make North operate faster and more effectively. You’ll work across all of North to identify manual, repetitive, or inefficient workflows and turn them into reliable software. That could mean building an internal application from scratch, integrating systems through APIs, automating a multi\-step operational workflow, or using AI to eliminate work that previously required significant manual effort. You won’t just receive a list of tickets. We want someone who can understand a problem, determine whether and how it should be automated, propose a technical approach, and own the solution through production. We care about building internal systems with the same engineering discipline we apply to our customer\-facing product. The goal isn’t to create a collection of one\-off scripts—it’s to build reliable, maintainable, reusable tooling that can scale with the company. You’ll sit within Engineering while partnering closely with teams across North, giving you visibility into how the entire business operates and the opportunity to improve it through software. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Build internal tools from end to end.** Design, develop, deploy, and maintain applications and services that help North’s teams operate more efficiently. * **Automate manual workflows.** Identify repetitive or time\-consuming processes across the company and replace them with reliable software and automation. * **Build AI\-enabled workflows.** Use LLMs, APIs, agents, and other AI technologies where they can meaningfully reduce manual work or improve decision\-making. * **Connect our systems.** Build integrations between the platforms North uses across engineering and the broader organization, creating reliable data and workflow connections between them. * **Build Python services and APIs.** Develop maintainable backend services that power internal applications, integrations, and automations. * **Create internal interfaces.** Build lightweight dashboards, applications, and interfaces that make internal systems intuitive for non\-engineering users. * **Design reusable systems.** Build service layers, libraries, abstractions, and integrations that can support multiple workflows instead of solving the same problem repeatedly. * **Own architecture decisions.** Determine the right technical approach for new tools and automations, including when to build, integrate, automate, or keep a process manual. * **Own tools in production.** Monitor, debug, maintain, and improve the systems you build as workflows and business requirements evolve. * **Build for reliability.** Implement strong testing, observability, error handling, permissions, and guardrails so internal automations can be trusted. * **Work directly with internal users.** Understand how teams actually work, translate their problems into technical requirements, and iterate based on feedback. * **Experiment quickly.** Prototype new approaches—including AI\-powered solutions—while knowing when an experiment needs to become production\-quality software. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * 3–7 years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems * Strong Python experience and the ability to write clean, maintainable, idiomatic code * Experience building backend services, APIs, integrations, or internal applications * Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, and working with third\-party platforms * Experience automating workflows or building tools that meaningfully reduced manual work * Ability to take an ambiguous operational problem and independently turn it into a technical solution * Experience designing and operating production systems rather than only building prototypes * Ability to write reusable code and abstractions instead of relying on one\-off scripts * Strong fundamentals around Git workflows, code review, testing, and collaborative software development * Strong critical thinking skills—you reason from first principles, evaluate tradeoffs, and can explain why you chose a particular approach * Pragmatic use of AI and LLM coding tools: you use them to move faster while still understanding the code, architecture, and tradeoffs behind what you ship * Strong testing discipline and an understanding that internal tooling still requires reliability, security, and maintainability * Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Comfort operating independently in a fast\-moving environment where priorities can change quickly * A builder mentality—you naturally notice inefficient processes and start thinking about how software could make them better **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building AI\-powered internal tools, agents, or LLM\-based workflows * Experience with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, tool calling, RAG, or agentic systems * Experience with workflow automation platforms such as n8n, Zapier, or similar tools * Experience building internal admin panels, dashboards, or lightweight frontend applications * JavaScript or TypeScript experience * Experience integrating SaaS platforms across functions such as engineering, sales, recruiting, finance, or operations * Experience with AWS and cloud infrastructure * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience with tools such as Terraform * Experience with databases, data pipelines, or event\-driven architectures * Experience in a startup or similarly fast\-moving environment * Experience owning an internal platform or tool from initial problem discovery through ongoing production support * Outstanding recognition in competitions, technical projects, open\-source work, or business ventures **Work Setup** -------------- We offer both hybrid work models based out of our Dumbo Brooklyn office, as well as remote US, with opportunities to travel to the office for team onsites. **Benefits** ------------ * Unlimited PTO * 16 weeks of paid parental leave (birthing parents receive an additional 4 weeks at 50% pay) * Two company\-wide breaks per year: one around Labor Day and one at the end of the year * Aetna Medical PPO plan with the majority of the premium covered by North * Dental and vision insurance * Flexible spending account (FSA) for health expenses and commuter benefits * 30\-day sabbatical every 4 years **Compensation** ---------------- **$150,000 – $200,000 base salary, depending on experience \+ equity** **The pay range for this role is:** 150,000 \- 200,000 USD per year(USA)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: The Senior Software Engineer is a hands\-on, full\-stack engineer who owns the delivery of product features from acceptance criteria to production. Working primarily on Traverse and Grove, this role takes a feature or epic, designs it, builds it, tests it, ships it, and stays accountable for how it behaves in production, without needing task\-level direction. This role is the team's dependable owner of scoped, multi\-card work and a day\-to\-day technical resource for less experienced engineers. The Senior Software Engineer makes and documents local architectural tradeoffs within established patterns, uses AI\-assisted development as a fluent daily practice, and helps engineers on the team grow through pairing and code review. Team\-wide technical direction and code quality standards are owned by the Principal Engineer role, and the Senior Software Engineer co\-builds the agentic engineering framework alongside the Principal Engineer. **This is a hybrid role working 3 days out of our Dublin, OH office.** **Experience** **Required:** * 5\+ years of professional software development experience in a SaaS or web product environment, including production ownership of features you designed and delivered. * Professional experience with Ruby on Rails and a modern JavaScript/TypeScript front end (React preferred), and with relational database design and query performance in PostgreSQL. * Working knowledge of AWS at the application layer (for example S3, queues, and managed database or serverless services), sufficient to deploy, debug, and operate your own features. * Experience reviewing others' code and mentoring less experienced engineers. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Nice to Have:** * Experience in Health and Human Services, government technology, or another regulated vertical SaaS domain. * Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS architecture or Domain\-Driven Design. * Experience contributing to agentic SDLC practices such as AI\-assisted code review, automated test generation, or prompt and runbook standards. * Experience with serverless architectures or mobile application development. * Familiarity with SOC 2 or HIPAA\-aligned engineering practices. **What you’ll be doing** Feature Ownership, Design, and Quality * Own features and epics end to end, from refinement and design through implementation, automated testing, release, and production follow\-up, with minimal direction and a clear record of delivering on commitments. * Design the feature before building it: data model and PostgreSQL schema changes, Rails models and services, API contracts, and React/TypeScript component structure. Make local architectural tradeoffs and document the reasoning in the merge request or design notes. * Participate actively in Amigos and refinement: challenge unclear acceptance criteria, surface risks and dependencies early, and split oversized work into small, end\-to\-end slices. * Write and own automated tests across unit, integration, and end\-to\-end levels for the work you ship, and treat passing tests and a clean pipeline as part of the definition of done. * Follow the team's established architecture patterns, code quality standards, and security\-by\-default practices, and raise proposed changes to them for team decision rather than diverging on your own. * Handle sensitive case, family, and agency data with care, applying least\-privilege access, input validation, and data protection practices expected of software used by HHS agencies. Production Operations and AI\-Assisted Delivery * Deploy your own changes through the GitLab pipeline, verify them in production, and follow through on regressions using logs, error tracking, and metrics. * Participate in the on\-call rotation: triage and resolve production issues, communicate status clearly, escalate early when needed, and contribute to blameless post\-mortems and their follow\-up actions. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code as the primary tool, with GitHub Copilot or Codex as secondary) as a daily working practice: frame prompts with context and constraints, decompose work into verifiable steps, review and correct AI output, and never ship code you cannot explain. * Co\-build the team's agentic engineering framework with the Principal Engineer: contribute improvements to runbooks, prompts, and workflows, and bring what you learn in daily AI\-assisted work back into how the team builds software. Mentoring and Team Collaboration * Mentor Software Engineers through pairing, thorough code review, and direct, actionable feedback, and serve as an escalation point for engineers working through technical problems. * Keep growing too: pair with the Principal Engineer on hard problems, welcome direct feedback on your own code and designs, and take on work that stretches you. * Review merge requests for correctness, test coverage, security, and maintainability, explaining the reasoning behind your fee lps you earn lower premiums * Robust EAP program that includes free therapy sessions, lifestyle coaching, legal/ID theft services, and more * 12 weeks fully paid parental leave * Up to $5,000 adoption fee reimbursement * $500 wellness reimbursement after 60 days of employment * Generous PTO policy and 10 company paid holidays * Company paid cell phone plan Find yourself checking a lot of these boxes but doubting whether you should apply? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every qualification. At Northwoods, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you are excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Northwoods is committed to diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are excited to work with talented people, period. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national or ethnic origin, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital or civil status, political affiliation, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the jurisdictions in which we operate. **Who is Northwoods?** Northwoods makes software solutions that improve the quality of the life of case managers and social workers in the Health and Human Services (HHS) field. Recognized as one of Columbus’ top places to work, working at Northwoods means being part of a team that’s passionate about making an impact on the lives of HHS professionals and the families they serve. We believe in creating a culture of inclusivity and accountability seeking to hire professional, passionate and driven individuals that believe in the values that we believe in: * Curiosity – Willing to test assumptions, courage to ask questions, and active listening. * Community – Helping and mentoring each other, celebrating diversity and acknowledging our team members’ contributions. * Resourcefulness – Willing to try and fail. Asking for help and trusting the expertise of our team. * Stewardship – Safeguarding Northwoods’ values, culture, mission, and resources. We believe that our team members are all accountable adults, not only to themselves but to each other, and we treat them that way. Our team works incredibly hard and is proven through dedication to their craft and our mission. **Our Solutions** Our products are designed for state and county social care program areas, including child welfare, childcare, child support, economic assistance and adult \& aging agencies. These solutions leverage technology to allow case workers and social workers to easily collect, store, manage, and share case content and data more efficiently. By simplifying processes, our customers can spend more time engaging with the families they serve, make better informed decisions and achieve better outcomes. **Traverse** – A SaaS solution that allows for easy, on\-the\-go access to case files, case work and interview forms and intelligent insights on case content and materials, which lead to better engagement and better outcomes. **Compass** – Compass solution is some of our longer standing software that supports multiple markets for both state and county customers. Our focus on reducing time wasted on paperwork and administrative burdens allows case workers to better serve families in need. **Grove \-** Our trusted team of experienced child welfare professionals becomes an extension of agency staff supporting them with administrative tasks such as referral and records requests, compiling documents for court, and document organization. Workers can focus on fostering healthier families without sacrificing their own well\-being.

jobs.title: AI Engineer – Founding Member, NJ Office
jobs.description: **Hi, I'm Andreas. Come build the new Nu Image® with us.** I'm the CEO of Nu Image®, and we're opening a new office in New Jersey. I'm looking for an AI engineer to be a founding member of it, and yes, the desk next to mine is open. **Open to current New Jersey residents only (on\-site in Mahwah/Wyckoff, NJ). We are not offering relocation.** Here's the setup. We're building the next generation of our technology, and it's a small, tight core: you, working directly with our CTO, with AI agents as the force multiplier. You'll own the AI engineering and the hands\-on code development. AI agents do most of the typing here. But make no mistake: **you'll own the code, not just prompt it.** You'll understand the architecture, read every line the agents write, and be able to debug and fix it by hand when they get it wrong. When something breaks in production, "the agent wrote it" isn't an answer. You are the builder, and the result is yours. And here's the line I care about most: **I don't want someone who waits to be told what to do.** See a problem? Fix it. See a better way? Build it and show us. Initiative is the job. If you're the person at the meetup who can't stop talking about your agent setup, and you can also explain what's happening under the hood, keep reading. **Who we are** * Nu Image® is a US telehealth company. Founded in 2004, online since 2008\. * LegitScript certified, serving all 50 states. * We're opening a new office in the Mahwah / Wyckoff area of New Jersey. This role is based there, fully on\-site and in person. No relocation offered. * Home page: https://nuimage.com **What you'll build (with our CTO)** * **A modern web platform and internal tools** that people actually enjoy using. * **Integrations and automation** that connect systems and take busywork off people's plates. * **AI\-powered workflows**, plus the agent setups, guardrails and review steps that let a small core build like a much bigger one. * **Secure, reliable, well\-tested systems** with healthcare\-grade privacy and security baked in from day one. **What a week roughly looks like** No two weeks are the same, but expect a mix of: \- Agents running in parallel on branches while you review diffs, push back on bad code, and write the tricky parts yourself. \- Working through architecture and priorities with our CTO, then turning them into shipped code. \- Whiteboard sessions on new ideas, and turning the good ones into working prototypes. \- Digging into a weird bug by hand: logs, queries, a debugger, and some stubbornness. \- Spotting something nobody asked about (a slow query, a flaky job, a tool that would save us hours) and handling it. \- Showing what shipped, what broke, and what you want to try next. **Perks of the role (just for fun; these are about the job, not benefits)** * Founding member of the NJ office. You'll help shape how it works. * First dibs on the whiteboard. * You pick the office coffee machine. Choose wisely. * You get to name the agents. * The CEO is one desk over, so your ideas get a fast yes or no. * Your ideas don't sit in a backlog for six months. **Must\-haves** **AI (front and center)** \- You ship with AI coding agents daily: Cursor, the Grok ecosystem (including Grok Bot), and similar tools. You have a setup, opinions, and receipts. \- You're current with today's AI tools and how they're changing month to month. \- You've built real agent workflows: task breakdown, parallel agents, prompt and agent orchestration, and review loops that catch bad output before it ships. \- You verify agent output: tests first, reading diffs line by line, and not trusting anything that just "looks right." \- You keep sensitive data (customer information, secrets, credentials) out of prompts, logs, and tools that aren't approved for it. **Fundamentals (you own the result)** \- **You can build and debug it yourself, without AI, when needed.** Reading unfamiliar code, stepping through it, and fixing it by hand is normal for you. \- Solid software architecture: you can explain why a system is shaped the way it is, and spot when an agent's design is going to hurt later. \- Strong PHP and Laravel: queues, jobs, the scheduler, events, and Eloquent without the N\+1 drama. \- Real SQL skills (MySQL): schema design, indexing, migrations, reading query plans, and writing the query yourself. \- Debugging: logs, stack traces, Xdebug or similar, reproducing issues, and finding root causes, not just symptoms. \- Security and privacy best practices: authentication and authorization, input validation, encryption, least privilege, OWASP top risks, secrets handling. **The rest of the stack** \- Vue and Tailwind on the front end. \- REST APIs: designing them and integrating with third\-party ones. \- Redis for queues, caching, and locks. \- Cloud experience (AWS a plus). \- Testing with Pest or PHPUnit. \- CI/CD with GitHub Actions or similar. \- Admin panel tools like Laravel Nova or Filament. **How you work** \- Initiative. You find the work instead of waiting for it. \- Ownership. jobs.title: Product Data Scientist (Growth)
jobs.description: **Product Data Scientist (Growth)** **About OpenArt** ----------------------------------------------------- OpenArt is an AI Storytelling and Visual Creation Platform used by millions worldwide. We’re building the next generation of creative tools powered by cutting\-edge AI, enabling anyone to create videos, visuals, characters, and stories with unprecedented speed and imagination. We believe the future of creativity is AI\-native, and we’re shaping that future. ### **Why Join OpenArt** * **Ride an inflection point.** OpenArt has grown **7–10X in revenue over the past 2 years** in one of the hottest categories in tech. Every experiment you run compounds against a steep trajectory. * **Own the experimentation practice** — you'll be the person who defines how OpenArt tests, learns, and ships product changes with real statistical rigor. * **Direct impact on the funnel.** Your work will shape activation, conversion, monetization, and retention for millions of creators. * **Meaningful equity, real upside** at an early\-stage company with strong momentum. * **Cross\-functional partnership** with Product, Design, Engineering, and Data team. * **Build from 0 1\.** Experimentation infrastructure, growth measurement, and retention frameworks are being laid down now — you'll shape them. * High ownership, low process, fast iteration environment. **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a **Product Data Scientist** focused on **growth and retention** to be the analytical partner PMs and engineers rely on when they ship changes to OpenArt's product experience. This role sits at the intersection of **experimentation, product analytics, and growth strategy**. Your primary job is to turn data into product decisions that move the funnel — activation, conversion, monetization, and retention — through rigorous A/B testing and sharp behavioral insights. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth — designing and analyzing experiments across signup, onboarding, activation, paywall/pricing, feature adoption, and retention loops. You'll also do the deep\-dive analyses that shape *what* teams decide to build in the first place: funnel diagnostics, cohort behavior, LTV segmentation, and retention driver analysis. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ ### **Experimentation (primary)** * Design, run, and analyze **A/B tests and other causal experiments** across signup, onboarding, activation, monetization, and retention surfaces. * Set the bar for experimental rigor at OpenArt — help decide test sizing, MDE, run duration, primary/secondary metrics, and readout standards. * Debug and resolve tricky test issues — sample ratio mismatch, novelty effects, interaction effects, multiple comparisons, segment heterogeneity. * Build and evolve OpenArt's experimentation practice as we scale — playbooks, guardrails, and post\-launch validation. ### **Growth \& retention insights** * Deep\-dive analyses on the growth funnel: signup activation paid conversion retention resurrection. * Own retention analysis — identify what drives long\-term retention vs. churn, and translate that into product recommendations. * LTV and cohort analyses that shape pricing, packaging, and monetization decisions. * Behavioral segmentation — find the user segments that matter and what drives their behavior. * Opportunity sizing — quantify the potential impact of proposed product changes *before* engineering builds them. ### **Metrics \& measurement** * Define and own key product metrics (activation, engagement, retention, monetization) alongside PMs. * Build and validate dashboards that leaders trust. * Ensure metric definitions stay consistent across product, marketing, and finance. ### **Communication \& influence** * Translate analyses into crisp, opinionated recommendations that PMs, engineers, and execs act on. * Push back with data when a proposed experiment is underpowered, mis\-scoped, or measuring the wrong thing. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- ### **Core Requirements** * **3–6 years** of experience in data science or analytics supporting product, growth, or lifecycle teams (level and title flex based on candidate). * **Solid A/B testing depth.** You've designed, run, and analyzed a lot of experiments. * **Strong SQL and Python** — comfortable working with data end\-to\-end without hand\-holding. * **Solid statistical foundation** * **Product intuition and insight\-generation instinct** * **Excellent communication** — you can tell a clear data story to a PM, an engineer, or a CPO, and hold your own in a room with strong opinions. * **High ownership and comfort in ambiguity.** ### **Nice to Have** * Experience as an early hire at a consumer startup. * Experience with consumer products, marketplaces, or subscription businesses. * Experience with experimentation platforms (in\-house or vendor: Statsig, Optimizely, etc.). * Familiarity with causal inference methods beyond A/B tests (diff\-in\-diff, synthetic control, propensity matching, CUPED). * Experience with our stack: BigQuery, Amplitude, Metabase, Stripe, GCP. * Exposure to AI/ML products or generative AI. * Comfort working across time zones with a globally distributed team. ### **Tech Stack You’ll Work With** BigQuery, SQL, Python, Amplitude, Metabase, Stripe, GCP **Compensation** ---------------- * Competitive base salary and bonus program * Equity — meaningful ownership in what you build * High autonomy, high growth environment **Work Setup** -------------- * Bay Area preferred (hybrid allowed) * Visa sponsorship available * We’ll consider remote for exceptional candidates

jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: OptionMetrics, headquartered in New York, NY. is a dynamic and innovative technology company, a trusted provider of financial information and research derived from the option markets. We are at the forefront of developing solutions that empower businesses. Our commitment to excellence, coupled with a collaborative, forward\-thinking culture, has made us the preferred choice for top\-tier talent. Our data and analytics models are utilized by over 350 investment banks, hedge funds, asset management firms, and academic institutions globally, solidifying our position as a leader in the industry. Are you ready to own the cloud foundation behind a market\-leading financial data business? At OptionMetrics, we're looking for a Senior Cloud Infrastructure \& DevOps Engineer to own our multi\-account AWS environment, our client\-facing file\-delivery platform, the deployment pipelines and scheduled workflows that ship our data, and the security controls around all of it. Our clients and internal teams depend on this infrastructure every day. You'll keep it reliable, automate how it runs, and leave it better documented than you found it. You'll report to the Head of IT Operations and work closely with Engineering, Product, Sales and Customer Support. ### **What You'll Own:** **Client file delivery (CrushFTP):** Production, test and DMZ environments on autoscaling and S3, client and support account provisioning, and operating the legacy platform through its retirement. **AWS multi\-account foundation:** Organizations, SSO and IAM, the Transit Gateway hub\-and\-spoke network, and the migration of workloads off the main account. **TLS and certificates:** A full certificate inventory, auto\-renewing ACM certificates, and alerting on expiring or mismatched certificates across every domain. **Edge and application security:** Cloudflare and AWS WAF rules, rate limiting, bot mitigation, and incident response for customer\-facing applications. **DevOps and release engineering:** CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, TeamCity), deployments to production and non\-production environments, and release plans for every production change. **Workflow automation and monitoring:** Our scheduled data workflows (Stonebranch/OpsWise), plus monitoring, alerting and on\-call (Site24x7, Opsgenie) for business\-critical jobs and services. **Infrastructure as Code:** Terraform and GitHub Actions with OIDC\-based deployment, a sandbox account, and code\-reviewed changes. **Cost and compliance:** Cost reporting, tag enforcement with AWS Config, and CrowdStrike coverage and access audits. ### **What You'll Do:** Design, build and operate highly available AWS infrastructure across dev, test, prod and DMZ accounts. Plan and run production changes with a published change notice covering scope, impact, rollback and confirmation. Perform and oversee deployments to production and non\-production environments, with a release plan, a rollback path and a Jira record for each. Build, maintain and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines, and help development teams ship safely and repeatably. Monitor and tune business\-critical scheduled workflows, troubleshoot failures, and drive failed jobs to root cause through the weekly failure review. Build monitoring, alerting, consolidated metrics and logs that give stakeholders a clear view of system and workflow health. Respond to infrastructure and security incidents: contain first, then find the root cause and document it in Jira. Turn repeated manual work into automation using scripts, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as Code and AI tooling. Apply least privilege to every access request: expiring SSO roles, and no long\-lived keys without a documented use case. Write and maintain runbooks, architecture and network diagrams, and Confluence standards for everything you own, including legacy systems. Keep Jira current: every ticket you own shows a status, a blocker or a next step, updated at least every two weeks. Take ad\-hoc requests from Sales, Support and Product. Clarify the need, commit to a date, and deliver. Coach junior engineers and hand off repeatable work to them with written runbooks. ### **How We Work:** **Disagree, then commit.** Push back with evidence. Once a decision is made, deliver it as agreed, or agree an alternative in writing. **Respect for colleagues.** Criticize the problem, not the people or teams involved, in every channel. **Stay calm when escalated.** Answer with status and next steps. **Make your work visible.** Post a daily written standup update (Shipped / Next / Blockers) and take part in team rituals. **Review every change.** Production changes go through code review, including urgent ones. **Own the whole job.** Documentation, legacy systems and request handling are part of the role, not a distraction from it. ### **Skills You'll Need:** 6\+ years in cloud or infrastructure engineering, including 4\+ years running production AWS. Deep AWS experience: VPC, Transit Gateway, Client VPN, IAM, SSO, Orga ail. Strong Linux administration skills. Hands\-on DevOps experience: CI/CD pipelines, release management, and supporting development teams through deployments. Experience running a job scheduler or workflow automation platform (Stonebranch/OpsWise, Control\-M, Airflow or similar) and troubleshooting failed pipelines. Production experience with Terraform and CI/CD in GitHub Actions, including OIDC. Solid grounding in TLS/PKI, DNS (Route53 and external providers) and file transfer over FTP, FTPS, SFTP, SSH and HTTP/HTTPS. jobs.title: Senior Support Engineer, Product Data Quality & Resolution
jobs.description: **Senior Support Engineer, Product Data Quality \& Resolution** **Role Purpose** The Senior Support Engineer is responsible for investigating and resolving complex product\-data issues that prevent hardware from being successfully onboarded into Oracle data centers. Acting as a technical point of contact for operational support, the role partners with Oracle's global manufacturing partners, Product Engineering, Data Centre Operations, and cross\-functional engineering teams to investigate technical issues, identify root causes, and drive timely resolution of critical operational incidents. The successful candidate will manage technical investigations, recommend corrective actions, and identify opportunities for systemic improvement. Responsibility for implementing product or process changes will transition to the appropriate Product Engineering or Program Management teams once investigation and recommendations are complete. This role supports a global operational environment and participates in a follow\-the\-sun support model, including scheduled weekend and after\-hours coverage as required. **Technical Support \& Investigation** * Investigate and resolve complex product\-data issues impacting hardware onboarding into Oracle data centers. * Monitor, prioritize, and respond to technical support tickets within the operational support queue. * Perform technical triage to identify root causes and determine appropriate resolution paths. * Collaborate with Oracle's global manufacturing partners to investigate and resolve product\-data quality issues while ensuring corrective actions are measurable, verified, and minimize future recurrence. * Monitor daily manufacturing data feeds to identify data\-quality issues and operational exceptions requiring investigation. * Perform detailed root cause analysis, including writing SQL queries to examine raw database records and investigate non\-standard technical issues. * Read and interpret XML and JSON data to identify missing, incorrect, duplicated, or improperly formatted product information. * Utilize REST services to retrieve, validate, and submit product data where required. Use Python, where appropriate, to analyze, transform, or validate data supporting technical investigations. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner with Product Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Data Centre Operations, and other cross\-functional teams to coordinate technical investigations. * Recommend corrective actions that address underlying system or process issues rather than individual incidents alone. * Initiate and coordinate recommendations for systemic improvements while transitioning implementation ownership to the appropriate Product Engineering or Program Management teams. * Where investigations require work at remote manufacturing or data centre locations, coordinate appropriate handoff to the responsible Product Engineer or operational team. Track investigations, recommendations, and follow\-up activities through completion to ensure timely resolution. * **Operational Excellence** * Prioritize technical issues based on business impact, operational urgency, and data center onboarding risk. * Effectively manage competing priorities within a fast\-paced operational support environment. * Produce clear investigation reports, root cause analyses, and technical documentation. * Develop and contribute to operational knowledge articles, troubleshooting documentation, and support best practices. * Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, workflows, and data quality based on investigation outcomes. Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from engineering teams to senior leadership. * **Required Skills and Experience** **Technical Skills** * Strong analytical, investigative, and root cause analysis skills. * Experience writing SQL queries for technical investigation and data analysis. * Strong Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reporting. * Ability to read and interpret XML and JSON. * Experience working with REST APIs and related data sources. * Basic Python programming skills for data analysis and automation. * Understanding of data validation and product\-data quality principles. * Familiarity with server and rack\-level hardware, configuration, and topology. Understanding of Product Bills of Materials (BOMs) and parent\-child component relationships. * **Professional Skills** * Ability to coordinate technical investigations across multiple teams and geographic regions. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Confidence communicating with both technical teams and senior leadership. * Strong organizational and prioritization skills. * Ability to perform effectively under pressure while managing multiple concurrent investigations. * Experience identifying and recommending systemic improvements that reduce recurring operational issues. Ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed cross\-functional teams. * **Measures of Success** Success in this role will be demonstrated through: * Reduction in product\-data issues impacting hardware onboarding into Oracle data centers. * Faster investigation and resolution of critical operational incidents. * Reduced recurrence of issues through effective root cause analysis and recommended corrective actions. * Improved product\-data quality across Oracle's manufacturing partner network. * Earlier identification and resolution of data\-quality issues before products reach Oracle data centers. * Effective collaboration and communication across Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Data Centre Operations, and other global teams. * High\-quality technical documentation and knowledge sharing that improves operational efficiency. Consistent delivery of technical support within a global 24x7 operational environment. * **Location** : Houston, TX \| Austin, TX \| Nashville, TN

jobs.title: Platform Security Engineer
jobs.description: Outset invented a better way to do research: AI\-powered user interviews. Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale. The research industry is massive (\>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high\-cost services. That's our opportunity. Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures. The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people. We’re a tight\-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises. We are looking for an experienced Platform Security Engineer to harden the security of the systems that power our business and products. You will help us secure both our AWS infrastructure and our code base, partnering directly with engineering and other security teams to identify risk, improve architecture, investigate incidents, and build practical security controls. The role combines application, cloud and infrastructure security, detection engineering, and incident investigation. During security and privacy incidents, you will serve as the lead technical investigator for the platform. You will work closely with the Incident Commander (Head of Security), to determine what happened, understand the impact, preserve relevant evidence, and guide containment and remediation. **Responsibilities** * Identify, assess, and help remediate security risks across our AWS infrastructure, Terraform code, application architecture, and product code. * Partner with engineering teams to design secure systems and incorporate security into normal development and operational workflows. * Participate in security reviews of RFC and PRR documentation, providing clear, actionable feedback on architecture, data flows, access controls, abuse cases, and technical risk. * Review application and infrastructure changes where additional security scrutiny is warranted. * Participate in external penetration tests, including preparation, technical coordination, analysis of findings, remediation planning, and validation of fixes. * Help improve the effectiveness and repeatability of the penetration\-testing program, with the opportunity to assume ownership of the program over time. * Serve as the lead platform investigator during security and privacy incidents, working within the incident\-response process led by the Head of Security. * Analyze application, cloud, identity, network, audit, and infrastructure telemetry to determine the scope, impact, and root cause of incidents. * Translate investigation findings into containment actions, durable remediations, improved detections, and clear technical documentation. * Contribute to the design, implementation, tuning, and maintenance of SIEM detection rules that monitor our platform. * Investigate and respond to alerts involving AWS infrastructure, application behavior, access patterns, data movement, and other platform activity. * Improve logging and telemetry where existing data is insufficient to detect threats or investigate incidents. * Develop security tooling and automation that help engineers identify and address vulnerabilities earlier. * Partner with SRE and engineering teams on cloud configuration, identity and access management, secrets management, vulnerability management, and infrastructure hardening. * Help establish practical security standards that reduce risk without unnecessarily slowing product development. **Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience in application security, cloud security, infrastructure security, or security\-focused site reliability engineering. * Experience securing production systems in AWS, including familiarity with identity, networking, logging, data protection, and common cloud attack paths. * Strong working knowledge of Terraform and infrastructure\-as\-code security practices. * The ability to assess security across both infrastructure and application layers rather than treating them as separate environments. * Experience reviewing application architecture or source code for security vulnerabilities and design weaknesses. * Familiarity with common application, API, authentication, authorization, and data\-security risks. * Experience investigating complex technical events using application logs, cloud telemetry, audit trails, and other security data. * Experience writing, tuning, or responding to SIEM detection rules. * The ability to distinguish meaningful security signals from expected production behavior and noisy telemetry. * Experience evaluating penetration\-test findings, determining their practical risk, and partnering with engineers on remediation. * Strong scripting or software\-development skills for building security tools, automations, and integrations. * Demonstrated proficiency with agentic software development. * Sound judgment when balancing security risk, operational reliability, engineering effort, and product priorities. * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical risks and recommended actions to both engineering and non\-engineering stakeholders. * A collaborative approach that helps engineering teams build safer systems and make informed security decisions. **Bonus** * Partnership with IT Security in building and supporting each security domain * Technical project management experience; ability to build a plan, clarify priorities, and both lead a team of collaborators and yourself to execute with urgency. * Experience serving on a security or privacy incident\-response team. * Experience leading technical investigations during security or privacy incidents. * SANS FOR509 training or certification. * Purple teaming experience, including using offensive findings to improve defensive coverage. * Experience owning or coordinating an external penetration\-testing program. * Experience with threat modeling, detection engineering, cloud forensics, or security automation. Compensation Range: $210K \- $300K

Identity \& Access Security * Support identity and access management technologies, policies, and processes. * Assist in implementing and maintaining least\-privilege access controls, authentication mechanisms, and privileged access management solutions. * Participate in access reviews and security control validation activities. Cloud \& Infrastructure Security * Configure and maintain security controls within Microsoft Azure and other cloud platforms. * Support endpoint protection, email security, network security, and data protection technologies. * Monitor cloud security posture and recommend improvements to reduce risk and improve resilience. Compliance \& Governance * Assist with security audits, assessments, and compliance initiatives. * Maintain security policies, standards, baselines, and technical procedures. * Support regulatory and framework requirements, including HITRUST, CIS Controls, and other applicable standards. Threat Intelligence \& Continuous Improvement * Monitor emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and industry trends to improve defensive capabilities. * Participate in threat hunting, control validation, and security testing activities. * Recommend improvements to security processes, technologies, and operational effectiveness. * Contribute to strategic cybersecurity initiatives and roadmap development. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. * 3 3\-5 years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, systems engineering, network engineering, or a related technical discipline. * Experience implementing and supporting enterprise security technologies and controls. * Experience with Microsoft security technologies * Knowledge of security principles related to networking, operating systems, endpoint protection, cloud security, and identity management. * Knowledge of security frameworks and best practices, including CIS Controls and HITRUST. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across cross\-functional teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * CISSP, GSEC, GCIA, GCIH, CRISC, Security\+, or other relevant cybersecurity certifications. **Work Environment** This job functions in a professional home or office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and fax machines. **Physical Demands** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, see, talk, or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms. Visual acuity is necessary for tasks such as reading or working with various forms of data for extended periods. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. **Benefits:** Hybrid, remote and flexible on\-site work schedules are available, based on the position. PANTHERx Rare Pharmacy also affords an excellent benefit package, including but not limited to medical, dental, vision, health savings and flexible spending accounts, 401K with employer matching, employer\-paid life insurance and short/long term disability coverage, and an Employee Assistance Program! Generous paid time off is also available to all full\-time employees, as well as limited paid time off for part\-time employees. Of course we offer paid holidays too! **Equal Opportunity:** PANTHERx Rare Pharmacy is an equal opportunity employer, and does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, promotions or any term or condition of employment based on race, age, religion, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran's status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Support Engineer II
jobs.description: **Support Engineer II** **Location:** Cincinnati, OH/Northern KY Hybrid (every other Friday onsite) **About the Role:** Path Forward IT is seeking a **Support Engineer II** to provide intermediate technical support primarily by phone and ticketing system, with occasional onsite assignments. The role is responsible for following established procedures, monitoring ticket queues, and maintaining service level agreements (SLAs) for tickets and calls. **Key Responsibilities:** * Document all activities, projects, and tickets daily in the ticketing system. * Handoff and document in\-progress tickets before the end of each shift. * Monitor ticket gateway and designated queues. * Escalate issues according to IT Glue documentation. * Resolve escalations from the Level I team as assigned. * Create or update IT Glue articles with new customer findings. * Assist with ISP and vendor calls for service outages. * Build client rapport during onsite visits (in\-person troubleshooting, site walkthroughs, client interaction). * Travel up to 25–50% as assigned. **Expectations:** * Maintain established call and ticket SLAs as defined by manager. * Maintain customer satisfaction (CSAT) scores as defined by manager. * Submit weekly timesheets by end of shift Friday. * Work and document established billable hours each week. * Be available for on\-call weeks and company\-wide outage responses. * Meet annual goals and objectives set in HRIS with quarterly reviews. **Technical Proficiencies:** * **Ticketing software:** Incident management and time tracking. * **Remote support:** Running scripts and pushing actions. * **Active Directory:** Strong knowledge of domain controllers, group policy, and security groups. * **Virtualization:** Strong knowledge of VMware/Hyper\-V for incident and operational support. * **Microsoft Windows/Servers:** Strong knowledge of patching, maintenance, and differentiating physical/virtual servers; ability to add new drivers to print servers. * **Networking:** Strong troubleshooting skills (DHCP, DNS, VLAN, and circuit/ISP issues). * **AzureAD and Microsoft 365:** Strong working knowledge. * **Microsoft Servers and Network Equipment:** Installation, troubleshooting, and training. * **Project Documentation:** Proficiency with central repositories for project documentation. * Maintain a strong understanding of technical infrastructure (servers, networks, and applications). * Software as assigned. **Physical Requirements:** * Ability to handle equipment, talk, hear, read, write, and interpret documents. * Occasionally lift and move objects up to 25 pounds (with or without reasonable accommodations). **Why Join Path Forward IT?** Path Forward IT, a Blue Alliance company, is a nationally recognized managed services provider (MSP) that exclusively supports the healthcare industry. Ranked among the top 15% of MSPs nationwide, we deliver world\-class IT services that ensure technology never stands in the way of patients receiving the care they need. Our work is driven by urgency, empathy, and a patient\-centered mindset. We understand the critical nature of healthcare operations and prioritize our work to empower providers to focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional care. Founded in 2002, Path Forward IT has grown to a team of over 100 professionals located across 40\+ states. We foster a collaborative, career\-focused culture where team members thrive. Many of our employees have been with us for years, and we regularly celebrate 5\- and 10\-year milestones. **A Team Environment Built for Growth:** Joining Path Forward IT means working alongside IT specialists supporting complex, enterprise environments. As part of the Blue Alliance network, you gain access to a community of hundreds of peers and experts across the country. This means more opportunities for learning, professional development, and career advancement without losing the close\-knit feel of a smaller team.You’ll enjoy the best of both worlds: * The autonomy and client engagement typical of a local MSP * The resources, support, and structure of a leading national IT services organization **A Unique Opportunity Through Blue Alliance:** As a Blue Alliance partner company, Path Forward IT provides team members with unmatched opportunities to learn, lead, and succeed. Each company in the network maintains its unique identity while working toward shared goals. If you’re looking to make a meaningful impact and grow your career in a supportive, future\-focused environment, this is the place for you. **Benefits of working at** **Path Forward** **IT:** * Be part of a fun, awesome team * 9 paid holidays * 401K Retirement with matching contributions * Excellent medical, vision and dental insurance * Life insurance and disability insurance * Cell phone stipend * 3 weeks PTO **Top Reasons our Employees Love Being Part of the Blue Alliance Family:** * Entrepreneurial Culture * Fast\-paced Flow, with a Variety of Projects * Collaborative Work Environment * Training \& Certifications * Career Growth Opportunities **Ready for the next step?** The greatest rewards are reserved for those who want to be better and then put in the hard work, to be their best version of themselves. Interested applicants should click to submit their resume and application above.*Please be* *advised* *we,* *Path Forward IT,* *participate* *in E\-Verify.*

jobs.description: **Inventure IT \| Savannah, GA 31401** **Salary:** From $60,000 per year (negotiable based on experience) **Job Type:** Full\-time \| Hybrid Inventure IT is a technology venture firm seeking a vibrant, detail\-oriented ecommerce professional in historic downtown Savannah. This role is a hands\-on technical position focused on building, maintaining, and improving scalable ecommerce solutions across our portfolio of companies, with deep hands\-on work in Shopify customization and configuration, API integrations, and custom application development. Our ecommerce team is creative\-heavy, moves fast, and needs a dependable technical team member who enjoys solving problems, implementing solutions, and supporting ongoing ecommerce projects. Working within our creative team, this role serves as a technical bridge between creative and development, helping translate project needs into functional solutions and coordinating with developers when needed. We’re looking for someone who is genuinely passionate about ecommerce technology, comfortable working on integrations, troubleshooting technical challenges, and collaborating with other team members, and excited to grow with a team that spans technology services, healthcare, real estate, and consumer brands. If you’re a self\-starter who can hold yourself accountable across multiple priorities simultaneously and has a commitment to continuous learning, we encourage you to apply. **What are you doing during your first two weeks?** * Meet the team and get settled in. * Get familiar with our tools: Slack, Google Workspace, Asana and our ecommerce platforms. * Review our current lineup of projects and learn about our companies, products, systems, and development frameworks. * Attend planning meetings with stakeholder teams, review assigned tasks, and begin collaborating with project managers and development team members. * Review existing Shopify stores, configurations, and current development workflows to become familiar with our ecommerce environments. **What are you doing during your first full month?** * Begin independently completing assigned Shopify development tasks within active ecommerce projects. * Begin providing technical support for client projects, responding to incoming support tickets, troubleshooting issues, and implementing solutions. * Contribute to an integration, automation, or ecommerce development project as part of a larger team initiative. * Review and document existing API connectors and automation workflows, identifying gaps and improvement opportunities. **What are you doing during your first three months?** * Contribute consistently to multiple ecommerce and platform projects, both internal and external, as a valued member of the development team. * Establish strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and external implementation partners. * Get in the groove of managing your time, contributing to projects, and following our agile methodologies to become a productive and dependable member of our technical team. * Build confidence and independence in completing assigned development tasks, troubleshooting issues, and supporting ongoing ecommerce improvements. **Responsibilities** * Develop, customize, and maintain Shopify storefronts, integrations, APIs, automation workflows, and applications to improve platform functionality. * Build and maintain API connector integrations and automation solutions, technical support for client projects, responding to incoming support tickets, troubleshooting issues, and implementing solutions to keep projects running smoothly. * Work with project managers and team members to understand requirements and implement technical solutions. * Collaborate with internal team members and external development partners as needed. * Collaborate with internal
