preferred without the requirement of AI. * Experience with Amazon marketplace operations preferred, including catalog setup, product detail page customization, and marketplace configuration. * Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work effectively within tight turnaround times. * Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. * Willingness to learn new technologies and follow established development processes. * Ability to utilize AI tools independently, appropriately, and responsibly. **Preferred Skills** * Shopify theme customization and app configuration. * Liquid / Hydrogen / Oxygen framework familiarity. * Experience with custom application development or AI\-assisted development tools, with the ability to build and implement solutions that support ecommerce functionality. * API integration and automation. * Familiarity with Amazon marketplace operations, including product and catalog management, and ecommerce automation tools. * Familiarity with NetSuite integrations and the ability to quickly learn new integration platforms. * .NET / C\# development. * SQL Server familiarity. * Ecommerce development and technical support. * Familiarity with Matrixify for automation. * Familiarity with Asana, Autotask, or similar software for project management, task tracking, and technical support ticket workflows. * Google Analytics and Merchant Center. **Soft Skills** * Ability to work independently and manage multiple assigned tasks and priorities simultaneously. * Ability to solve problems creatively and effectively. * Flexibility and willingness to adapt to changing design needs and priorities. * Excellent attention to detail and ability to produce high\-quality work. * Strong communication and collaboration skills. * Ability to bridge communication between creative and development teams, translating project needs into clear technical requirements and solutions. * Ability to accept feedback, follow direction, and work collaboratively within established team processes. * Willingness to learn, ask questions, and take accountability for assigned tasks, deadlines, and communication. **Benefits** * Competitive salary paid weekly, based on experience and qualifications. * Opportunity to work with a dynamic team in a collaborative and supportive environment. * Work\-from\-home days offered weekly per team needs and company policy. * Professional development opportunities and potential for career growth. * 401(k) with matching. * Health insurance. * Dental insurance. * Vision insurance. * Life insurance. * Paid time off. **Work Location \& Schedule** You must be able to commute to the office in the 31401 postal code. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Frontier Engineer (P3\) \| Remote, United States \| Pax8** =================================================================== **Design the future of intelligent cloud commerce at Pax8 as a Senior Engineer, leading mission\-critical systems that shape how our platform evolves across the United States and beyond.** **Why This Role Matters** ------------------------- This is not a traditional senior engineering position. As a Senior Frontier Engineer, you'll operate at the intersection of architecture, platform evolution, AI\-enabled engineering, and business impact. You'll shape foundational systems that influence multiple products, teams, and strategic initiatives across Pax8\. You'll have the autonomy to solve complex technical challenges, define engineering standards, and help guide how AI and intelligent automation are responsibly integrated into our technology ecosystem. At Pax8, we're embracing the AI era. New team members join an environment where innovation, experimentation, and continuous learning are embedded into everyday work, creating opportunities to grow alongside rapidly evolving technologies. **Life at Pax8** ---------------- Pax8 is the leading cloud commerce marketplace, supporting more than 39,000 partners and connecting over 130 technology vendors with hundreds of thousands of businesses worldwide. Our culture combines ambition, innovation, and collaboration, creating an environment where talented people can make a meaningful impact while growing their careers. Learn more about our culture, mission, and community at: * https://www.pax8\.com * https://www.pax8\.com/en\-us/about\-us/ **What You'll Be Doing** ------------------------ * ️ Lead the architecture and evolution of business\-critical platform services that power experiences across multiple teams and products * Design resilient, scalable systems with a deep understanding of long\-term platform strategy, interoperability, and organizational impact * + Anticipate operational risks and proactively build safeguards that prevent issues before they reach production environments * Use data and outcomes to continuously assess whether engineering investments are creating meaningful value and adjust direction accordingly * Guide complex technical transitions, platform modernizations, and migration programs while minimizing disruption for dependent systems * Produce high\-quality architectural guidance, technical standards, and reference designs that help elevate engineering practices across the company * ️ Establish operational, reliability, security, and AI governance standards for systems with broad organizational influence * Mentor and influence engineers across teams, helping raise technical judgment, architectural thinking, and engineering excellence * Drive responsible adoption of AI\-enabled engineering approaches, ensuring quality, safety, reliability, and business value remain at the forefront **The Impact You'll Have** -------------------------- The decisions you make will influence far more than a single application or team. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, AI
jobs.description: PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding *what can be built, where, and how*. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest\-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean\-energy, and infrastructure development across the country. Despite being a $1\.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de\-risk projects, and scale with confidence. As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization. We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top\-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber. **Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in\-office days per week). We prefer NYC\-based candidates or those open to relocation.** **Role Overview** ================= We're hiring a Staff/Principal Engineer to build PermitFlow's core product AI Assistant, infrastructure, and workflow agents. This is a role that will require UX and technical acumen to deliver high quality agents in a genuinely complex domain, while also up\-leveling our core agentic infrastructure and data flywheel. Submitting a permit means comprehending construction documents, extracting project details, confirming every requirement has been met and often filling in pdf forms. Errors compound across steps and a failed submission adds real cost for our customers as projects slow. The ideal candidate will mix an exceptional history of product delivery with true experience building AI and Agentic infrastructure from the ground up. You ship quickly, instrument everything, hold a high quality bar, and stay close to the users of what you build. This role reports directly to our VP of Engineering. We're hiring at Staff or Principal, with the level based on past experience and interview performance. **What You'll Do** ================== * Own the agent architecture. Design the reasoning loop, planning and decomposition strategy, state and session model, and recovery behavior for long\-running tasks. * Build the context layer. Retrieval, memory, and context\-window management over project documents, jurisdictional requirements, prior submissions, and customer\-specific conventions. * Design the action surface. Define the tools the assistant can call, the permissions model around them, and the human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints for actions that are expensive or irreversible. * Make evaluation the engine of progress. Stand up offline and online eval harnesses that measure task completion and failure modes. Build the iteration loop that lets the whole team improve agent quality on evidence. * Set the bar for the org. Establish the abstractions, SDKs, and review standards other engineers build agentic features on. * Stay close to the customer. Sit with permit coordinators and builders, watch the assistant fail in real conditions, and bring that back into the system design. **What We're Looking For** ========================== * You've shipped an assistant or agentic product at meaningful scale * Deep, current knowledge of the agentic stack (tool calling and tool design, context engineering, memory, retrieval, orchestration patterns, etc) * You’ve built eval harnesses that changed what a team worked on, and you can articulate what makes an eval trustworthy. * You are a genuinely strong software engineer, not an AI specialist who needs someone else to make it production\-ready. You’ve owned services in production and you write code that other people are glad to inherit. * You operate with earned authority. You influence through demonstrated judgment, working code, and clear writing rather than title or mandate. * 10\+ years of software engineering experience with recent time spent building LLM\-powered products. **What We Offer** ================= * Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high\-growth company * 100% company\-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees \+ healthcare FSA * 401(k) savings plan * Unlimited PTO and paid family leave * Home office \& equipment stipend * Daily in\-office lunch and dinner provided * Commuter benefits (pre\-tax transit and parking) *PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.* *We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.* Compensation Range: $250K \- $300K

jobs.title: AI Engineering and Architecture Lead
jobs.description: **About PharmaEssentia:** It’s not often you get the chance to make a real impact on the lives of others, while expanding your own possibilities. You’ll find that rare opportunity at PharmaEssentia. Join us, and let’s transform lives, together. PharmaEssentia Corporation is a rapidly growing biopharmaceutical innovator. We are leveraging deep expertise and proven scientific principles to deliver effective new biologics for challenging diseases in the areas of hematology and oncology, with one product approved and a diversifying pipeline. We believe in the potential to improve both health and quality of life for patients with limited options today through the combination of rigorous research and innovative thinking. Founded in 2003 by a team of Taiwanese\-American executives and renowned scientists from U.S. biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies, today we are listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE: 6446\) and are expanding our global presence with operations in the U.S., Japan, Singapore, South Korea, and China, along with a world\-class biologics production facility in Taichung. **Position Summary** The AI Engineering \& Architecture Lead owns PharmaEssentia’s AI architecture and leads the engineering team that builds on it. This is the most important single hire in the Global Data \& AI Enablement (GDAI) plan: the team today has no dedicated AI engineering capability, and this role creates it. Reporting to the Head of Global Data \& AI Enablement, this leader is accountable for turning governed data assets into production AI applications and agents that change how commercial teams work — opportunity identification, proactive field alerts, HCP intelligence, field copilots, next\-best\-action workflows, and omnichannel intelligence. Backend ETL is delivered by an external vendor into Snowflake, so this role’s value sits above that layer: architecture, build\-versus\-buy judgment, engineering standards, and delivery. technical degree (computer science, engineering, or related field) preferred * 10\+ years in software or ML engineering, including 3\+ years leading engineers * Has shipped and operated LLM\-based or agentic applications in production — not prototypes, proofs of concept, or pilots — and can describe what broke and what it cost * Hands\-on ownership of retrieval, orchestration, evaluation harnesses, monitoring, and cost control for AI systems in production * Experience architecting applications on a cloud data platform, ideally Snowflake * Demonstrated build\-versus\-buy decisions, and experience holding a technology vendor to technical account on scope and quality * Still technical: able to review code, debug a production system, and set standards by example **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare commercial environments, or another regulated industry with review and audit requirements * Experience standing up an AI engineering function from zero rather than inheriting one * Integration experience with CRM and field\-facing systems (Veeva, Salesforce) and marketing platforms * Familiarity with evaluation, guardrail, and observability tooling for LLM applications * Experience in an organization where adoption, not delivery volume, was the measure of success **Location and Work Arrangement** This position is based in Burlington, Massachusetts, and follows a hybrid work model requiring on\-site presence three days per week. The expected base salary range for this position is $190,000\-245,000\. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education and geographical location. Market and organizational factors are also considered. In addition to base salary and a competitive benefits package, successful candidates are eligible for short\-term and long\-term incentives. **Benefits of working with our team:** PharmaEssentia USA strives every day to improve the lives of patients as well as our employees. As a valued member of PharmaEssentia USA, you will enjoy the following benefits:* Comprehensive medical coverage * Dental and vision coverage * Generous paid time\-off * 401(k) retirement plan with competitive company match * Medical \& Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account * Up to $150 monthly cell phone reimbursement * Employee Assistance Program * Free parking **EEO Statement:** *At PharmaEssentia USA, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. PharmaEssentia USA believes that diversity and inclusion among our team are critical to our success as a global company, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool.* *PharmaEssentia does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Staffing agencies should not send resumes to our HR team or to any PharmaEssentia employees. PharmaEssentia is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies.* At PharmaEssentia, our goal is to treat as many people with cancer as possible. That means challenging the status quo with better science that leads to better lives. By joining our team, you will not only expand your own possibilities, but you will contribute to expanding options for people with cancer. https://us.pharmaessentia.com/careers/ SMZ5pj9UBh

jobs.title: Data Product Engineer, Global Data and AI Enablement
jobs.description: **About PharmaEssentia:** It’s not often you get the chance to make a real impact on the lives of others, while expanding your own possibilities. Reporting to the Manager, Data Product Engineering, this role will transform vendor\-delivered raw data in data warehouse into curated, reusable, and well\-documented data tables that support commercial analytics, business operations, and AI applications. The successful candidate will partner with cross\-functional teams to design, deploy, monitor, and enhance production data products. The role will reduce repeated manual data work, improve the consistency and speed of internal decision\-making, and create trusted data assets that can be reused across analytics and AI use cases. Key Responsibilities ==================== * Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain data transformations, curated data tables, reusable models, semantic\-layer components, and production\-ready datasets in Snowflake. * Build integrated data products combining claims, Veeva CRM, HCP/HCO hierarchies, Specialty Pharmacy/HUB, specialty distributor/3PL, payer/access, sales, and marketing\-engagement data. * Translate internal customer requirements and product specifications into scalable technical designs under the direction of the Manager, Data Product Engineering. * Codify approved business rules and develop the supporting datasets, workflows, and rules\-based alerts that surface relevant opportunities, exceptions, or actions to field and business teams through approved downstream channels. * Develop reusable data models that reflect consistent definitions and can support multiple analytics, operational, and AI use cases. * Implement automated testing, reconciliation, data\-quality controls, monitoring, and alerting; investigate root causes and coordinate issue resolution with Data Foundations \& Integration and external vendors. * Use SQL and/or Python to transform complex datasets, automate recurring processes, implement business logic, optimize queries, and reduce manual data preparation. * Apply version control, peer review, deployment controls, and automated delivery practices to improve the reliability and maintainability of production data products. * Optimize data models and transformation workflows for performance, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and Snowflake cost efficiency. * Support production monitoring, incident resolution, and ongoing enhancements to existing data products based on user feedback, changing business needs, and source\-data changes. * Maintain clear documentation for data sources, lineage, transformations, business rules, data models, quality controls, dependencies, and intended product use. * Collaborate cross\-functionally to provide trusted datasets and interfaces for predictive analytics, AI applications, and agent\-based solutions. Qualifications * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, data engineering, data science, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, data product engineering, or a closely related role, with demonstrated ownership of production data products. * Strong SQL and hands\-on Python skills for data transformation, business\-rule implementation, automation, testing, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. * Hands\-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud dat ncluding claims, CRM, HCP/HCO, sales and distribution, Specialty Pharmacy/HUB, payer/access, or marketing data. * Experience delivering data products to downstream BI, CRM, field\-facing, workflow, or application environments is valuable. * Experience designing dimensional, relational, or analytics\-oriented data models and producing reusable, curated datasets from complex multi\-source data. * Experience translating business requirements into production data products, including rules\-based workflows, operational datasets, alerts, or decision\-support outputs. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Perception
jobs.description: ### **About Us** At Pickle Robot, we're on a mission to automate global supply chains with Physical AI. Our robots work alongside warehouse teams to unload trucks and containers — one of the toughest, most understaffed jobs in logistics — making the work safer, faster, and more efficient for the people doing it. Loading trucks comes next, followed by the Dill Autonomy Engine: generalized autonomy that will eventually orchestrate robots across entire logistics processes. We're looking for a rigorous and self\-directed Senior Machine Learning Engineer to own machine learning problems end\-to\-end on the systems that decide how our robots grasp packages. This role will focus on problem formulation, building the data engines that feed our models, training and experimentation, and the evaluation rigor that tells us whether a model is genuinely better. Our platform and robotics engineers own runtime integration and edge deployment, so you can stay focused on the modeling loop. ### **What You'll Do** * Own ML Problem Formulation: You will turn ambiguous picking performance goals into well\-posed ML problems, deciding what the model predicts, how labels and rewards are defined, what loss to optimize, and what "better" actually means. This is the core of the role. * Build the Data Engine: You will own dataset strategy end\-to\-end, from large\-scale synthetic scene generation and distributed cloud dataset jobs to scene diversity filtering and self\-supervised label generation. You will identify when the data, rather than the model, is the bottleneck, and fix it. * Train and Iterate on Large Vision Models: You will fine\-tune large backbones with multiple task\-specific heads, run disciplined experiments, and know both which experiment to run next and when to stop. * Own Evaluation and Verification: You will define offline metrics that predict on\-robot outcomes and online metrics that help you improve performance on edge cases. * Drive Technical Excellence: As a senior member of the team, you will conduct rigorous code reviews, mentor engineers earlier in their careers, and contribute to the perception and grasping roadmap. * Hand Off Cleanly to Production: You will produce deployable models with sane latency budgets, exportable graphs, and reproducible artifacts, partnering with the engineers who own runtime integration and inference optimization rather than owning that yourself. ### **What You'll Bring** * 5\+ Years of Experience in Machine Learning and Computer Vision, including models you personally carried from problem statement to measured outcome. * A track record of framing problems. You can translate high\-level product requirements into specific engineering tasks and explain technical trade\-offs to non\-expert stakeholders. * Hands\-on Experience Building Datasets at Scale: generation or collection, curation, automated quality assurance, coverage and bias analysis, and active learning to systematically close edge cases. * Rigorous Evaluation Habits: baselines, ablations, metric design, and a clear sense of when a result is real. * Expert\-level Python and PyTorch skills. * Comfortable with cloud training infrastructure (GCP or AWS), Docker, and experiment tracking tools. * **Professional experience with at least one of the following:** + Developing and training multi\-task models + Developing and training multi\-modal models + Developing and training multi–view models + Self\-supervised, outcome\-based, or reward\-driven learning. ### **Pay at Pickle** At Pickle Robot Company, we believe transparency builds trust. The salary range listed here is provided in accordance with Massachusetts law and reflects what we reasonably and in good faith expect to offer for this role. We often consider candidates at different levels of seniority, and final compensation will reflect the level at which a candidate is hired, along with factors like experience and location. ### **Pickle Perks** Pickle provides best\-in\-class benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance; unlimited vacation; paid federal and state holidays; 401(k) contributions of 5% of your salary; company\-covered travel expenses; and other perks to make your working life more fun, comfortable, and productive. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description: PlanITROI is hiring a proven, hands\-on AI Agent builder who specializes in B2B lead generation. You must have personally architected, built, deployed, and operated AI agents that generate measurable B2B prospecting results. **We're seeking an AI engineer who can build the intelligence behind the system** AI agents that use tools, make decisions, coordinate workflows, and turn enterprise buying signals into qualified sales meetings. If you are an expert at building AI agents for B2B lead generation and can prove they work, we want to meet you. **About PlanITROI** 25 years of success. Global industry recognition. Founder\-led. No corporate red tape. An ambitious future powered by AI and Robotics! For more than 25 years, PlanITROI has helped enterprise organizations maximize the financial value of retired technology through IT lifecycle management, repair, refurbishment, redeployment, remarketing, reverse logistics, and secure IT Asset Disposition (ITAD). PlanITROI is recognized in Gartner's ITAD Market Guide, is an IAITAM Platinum Sponsor, and has built our business around reuse\-as\-intended\-use, prioritizing reuse over recycling. **Our mission:** Maximize the financial value of technology while extending its useful life. Every device we recover creates value for clients, reduces unnecessary electronic waste, and gives technology a second life as affordable technology. **Why you'll love working here** **Founder\-led. Move fast. Get things done.** Work directly with entrepreneurial leadership. No layers of corporate bureaucracy or endless approval cycles. Great ideas get heard, tested, and implemented. **Built like an AI startup, backed by an established company.** Bring your engineering ideas to a business with 25 years of enterprise relationships, operating experience, and real market opportunities. **Engineer something big.** Build AI agents capable of researching 5,000\+ enterprise accounts, identifying buying signals, reaching 250,000\+ potential right contacts, and generating qualified meetings at scale. **See measurable results.** Your agents will directly influence enterprise revenue and help more technology get repaired, reused, and returned to productive use. **Work with people who value builders.** We believe in optimism, discipline, humility, ownership, continuous improvement, and recognizing teammates who help others succeed. **Your mission: Build an intelligent AI\-powered lead generation engine** Design, build, deploy, and continuously improve an interconnected system of specialized AI agents that identifies enterprise buying opportunities and converts them into qualified meetings. You will own the technical outbound engine end to end, from buying\-signal detection and account intelligence to contact discovery, multichannel orchestration, CRM integration, experimentation, and measurement. Our target market (ICP) includes enterprise organizations with 5,000 to 1,000,000\+ employees, 80%\+ mostly knowledge workers with complex buying committees, and existing technology providers. Your challenge is to find the right buyer, recognize the right moment, and create a compelling reason to engage in PlanITROI. *This role reports to the Founder \& CEO and the Chief Strategy Officer. You'll work directly with them and the VP of Marketing, with no layers in between.* **Your goal:** Qualified enterprise meetings generated and MSA's signed! **What you will build and own** * **AI Intent Signal Detection Agents.** Identify, ingest, evaluate, and score buying signals, including technology refresh cycles, leadership changes, office moves, M\&A, RFP activity, contract timing, job postings, technology initiatives, and social activity. Trigger the right next action. * **AI Buying Committee Intelligence Agents.** Identify high\-value ICP accounts, research enterprise organizations, map buying committees, select the best 1 to 5 contacts for each entry point, validate contact information, and continuously track changes. * **AI Personalization \& Challenger Messaging Agents.** Combine account intelligence, buying signals, persona\-specific pain points, account history, and incumbent\-provider context to create relevant, personalized outreach at scale. * **AI Multichannel Orchestration Agents.** Coordinate email, LinkedIn, voicemail drops, AI calling where appropriate, and human SDR/BDR follow\-up. Manage sequencing, timing, channel rules, routing, and next\-best actions. * **AI Objection Handling \& Follow\-Up Agents.** Recognize and respond intelligently to objections such as "We already have a provider." Maintain conversational context, determine appropriate follow\-up, and escalate to humans when needed. * **AI Performance \& Optimization Agents.** Measure results across signals, personas, channels, and campaigns. Identify winning and losing hypotheses, recommend experiments, and improve qualified meeting conversion. *These are functional capabilities, not a requirement to deploy six separate agents. You will desi y. Using them isn't the role; building the agents that run on top of them is. We are seeking proven hands\-on expertise in: * **AI agent engineering:** LLMs, tool calling, reasoning workflows, agent memory, state management, multi\-agent orchestration, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * **Agent frameworks:** LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, or comparable frameworks. * **Software development:** Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, custom integrations, and automation architecture. * **GTM integrations:** Salesforce, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, 6sense, Bombora\-type intent sources, and AI calling/voicemail platforms. * **Enterprise prospecting:** Intent signals, ICP scoring, buying\-committee identification, contact resolution, enrichment, personalization, objection handling, and multichannel sequence design. * **Production operations:** Agent monitoring, debugging, data quality, CRM synchronization, deduplication, deliverability, compliance, error handling, and auditability. * **Scale:** Engineering reliable systems capable of very high outbound volumes, reaching 250,000\+ contacts across email, LinkedIn, and voicemail, while protecting platform limits, accuracy, compliance, and deliverability. You must understand both the technical engineering and the B2B prospecting strategy required to turn agents into a functioning revenue system. **What success looks like** * **Qualified meetings generated:** Your primary business outcome. Meetings must satisfy defined ICP, persona, and business\-need criteria. * **Signal\-to\-meeting conversion:** How effectively your agents convert meaningful buying signals into conversations and qualified meetings. * **Contact Precision:** Reaching the right decision\-makers and buying committees. * **Agent deployment velocity:** How quickly you turn a campaign idea into a reliable, working agent and live test. * **Multichannel conversion:** Positive responses, conversations, qualified meetings, and opportunities by signal, persona, channel, and campaign. * **System reliability:** Data accuracy, deliverability, CRM integrity, routing, compliance, and scalability. * **Learning rate:** How quickly do you identify what isn't working, fix root causes, and scale what produces results. **Our hiring process: Show me, don't tell me** We hire proof, not interviews alone. We're not interested in theoretical AI expertise or polished presentations about what agents might do. The process has three stages: * **Live demo.** Show us AI agents you personally built and deployed for B2B lead generation, and the results they produced. * **Build a project.** Build an outbound agent from a campaign premise we give you, using your own tools. * **Live technical session.** Demo your build, work a live account, and walk us through your architecture. Across these stages, be ready to show: * Your agent architecture, decision logic, prompts, tools, data integrations, and orchestration. * How your agents identify opportunities and execute prospecting workflows. * How do your agents handle exceptions, incomplete data, failures, and human intervention? * Real performance data: qualified meetings, pipelines, conversions, or measurable improvements your systems produced. **Ready for the challenge?** If you love solving difficult technical problems and want to build something ambitious, PlanITROI is where you can make an impact. Bring your engineering expertise, working agents, ideas, and your drive to succeed. We'll bring 25 years of industry experience, enterprise relationships, a substantial market opportunity, and the ability to move fast. **Build the agents. Own the results. Help us grow.** *PlanITROI offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, a 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and more. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and value diversity at all levels of the organization.* Learn more: PlanITROI.com \| NextraTech.com \| DigitalDreamsProject.com

jobs.title: Founding Solutions Architect
jobs.description: **Own Your Intelligence** ------------------------- Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team. Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high\-performance training, and deployment into one full\-stack system for post\-training at frontier scale \- from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open\-source models trained end to end for long\-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full\-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own. Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go\-to\-market for a category that does not fully exist yet. **Your Role** ------------- Every serious AI team evaluating infrastructure asks the same question: will this actually run my workload better, faster, or cheaper than what I have today? Most vendors answer with slides. We want to answer with benchmarks on the customer's own workload, and then design the production architecture that delivers on them. As our Founding Solutions Architect, your mission is to make Prime Intellect the technical winner in every deal. You will own the path from workload discovery through architecture, benchmark, proof of concept, and production design. You will sit with customers' ML engineers to understand what they are actually training and serving — GPU type, cluster requirements, networking, utilization and performance objectives — then design the right architecture on Prime infrastructure, run the POC against their baseline and the competitive alternatives, and turn latency, throughput, utilization, and cost results into a technical business case that holds up under scrutiny. This is a founding role. There is no playbook yet for how we prove technical wins; you will write it. The benchmark methodologies, reference architectures, and POC frameworks you build will become how Prime Intellect sells to every lab and enterprise that follows. **Responsibilities** -------------------- **Technical Discovery \& Architecture** * Lead deep technical discovery across training, post\-training, and inference workloads * Understand each customer's GPU requirements, cluster topology, networking, storage, utilization patterns, and performance objectives * Design customer architectures on Prime infrastructure that meet those objectives and are ready for production * Partner with engineering on migration and deployment requirements so what we design is what gets shipped **Benchmarks, POCs \& the Technical Business Case** * Own workload benchmarks and proofs of concept against customer baselines and competitive alternatives * Translate latency, throughput, utilization, and cost results into a defensible technical business case for ML engineers and executive buyers alike * Set the standard for benchmark quality: methodology, reproducibility, and honest comparison * Drive time to technical validation down with every deal **Playbooks \& Platform Adoption** * Develop repeatable benchmark and reference\-architecture playbooks that scale beyond you * Support technical evaluation and adoption of Model Factory, bringing customers from compute onto the full training stack * Feed what you learn from customer workloads back into product and research priorities **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Strong ML infrastructure, distributed systems, cloud, or GPU\-compute background * Working knowledge of modern training and inference stacks, CUDA/GPU environments, and model\-serving patterns * Customer\-facing experience in solutions architecture, sales engineering, forward\-deployed engineering, or a similar role * Ability to communicate fluently with both ML engineers and executive stakeholders — and to know which conversation you are in * A strong bias toward proving claims with real customer workloads and benchmarks rather than slides * High ownership — you see gaps and build the fix before anyone asks * AI\-native in how you work: you use LLMs, automation, and programmatic tools to move faster **Bonus:** * Hands\-on experience running or optimizing large\-scale distributed training (FSDP, Megatron, DeepSpeed, or similar) or high\-throughput inference (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT\-LLM) * Experience benchmarking across hardware generations (H100, H200, GB200\) and interconnects (InfiniBand, RoCE) * Background at a GPU cloud, neocloud, hyperscaler AI team, or frontier lab infrastructure team * Experience building a solutions or forward\-deployed function from scratch **How We Measure Success** -------------------------- Technical win rate · POC\-to\-commercial conversion · Time to technical validation · Benchmark quality · Deployment readiness · Model Factory technical attach **Why This Role** ----------------- You will be the technical face of Prime Intellect in every deal that matters, working directly with the ML teams at labs and enterprises deciding where to build — and with our own research and engineering teams on what the platform needs to win. You will see more real\-world training and inference workloads in a year than most engineers see in a career, and you will define how a new category of infrastructure proves itself. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Cash compensation range of $250–$320k \+ meaningful equity * Flexible work (remote or San Francisco), with travel to customer sites as needed * Visa sponsorship and relocation support * Professional development budget * Team off\-sites and conferences * A front\-row seat to building the infrastructure layer for open AI

We are seeking a Senior Azure Data Engineer to help design, build, and operate our next\-generation enterprise data platform on Microsoft Azure. You will own end\-to\-end delivery of data pipelines and data products that power analytics, regulatory reporting, operational dashboards, and emerging AI/ML use cases. You will partner closely with data architects, analytics engineers, data scientists, business stakeholders, and platform engineering teams to deliver reliable, performance, secure, and cost\-efficient data solutions. This role is ideal for an engineer with strong hands\-on depth in Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics and/or Databricks, and modern Lakehouse patterns, who is comfortable leading migration programs (e.g., Informatica\-to\-ADF, on\-prem warehouse\-to\-cloud), mentoring mid\-level engineers, and shaping engineering standards across the team. Key Responsibilities: Pipeline Design \& Development * Design and build robust, reusable, parameter\-driven ingestion and transformation pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Synapse Pipelines, Data Bricks and/or Microsoft Fabric Data Factory. * Implement medallion architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold) on Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 using Delta Lake, Parquet, and structured streaming patterns. * Build performant ELT workflows that leverage pushdown to source systems (Synapse Dedicated SQL Pool, Azure SQL, Teradata) where appropriate. * Develop and optimize PySpark notebooks and jobs on Azure Databricks or Synapse Spark. Data Modeling \& Warehousing * Design dimensional models (Kimball star/snowflake) and data vault patterns for analytics consumption. * Implement Slowly Changing Dimensions (Type 1/2/3\), Change Data Capture, and late\-arriving data patterns. * Tune distributed SQL workloads in Synapse Dedicated SQL Pool / Fabric Warehouse, including distribution keys, partitioning, and clustered column store indexes. Platform Engineering \& DevOps * Implement CI/CD for data pipelines using Azure DevOps (YAML pipelines, ARM/Bicep/Terraform) across Dev / SIT / UAT / Prod environments. * Instrument pipelines with robust logging, auditing, and monitoring using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and KQL. * Define and enforce coding standards, code review practices, branching strategies, and release management. Migration \& Modernization * Lead or contribute to legacy\-to\-cloud migrations — e.g., Informatica PowerCenter to Azure Data Factory, on\-premises Teradata / Oracle / SQL Server to Synapse or Fabric. * Perform workload assessment, capacity planning, and cost modeling for target\-state architectures. * production incident response for critical pipelines. Required Qualifications: * Deep hands\-on expertise with Azure Data Factory: pipelines, datasets, linked services, triggers, parameterization, mapping data flows, and all three Integration Runtime types (Azure, Self\-hosted, SSIS). * Strong Experience in Data Bricks and PySpark. * Production experience with one or more of: Azure Synapse Analytics (Dedicated and Serverless SQL Pools, Spark Pools) OR Azure Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) OR Microsoft Fabric (Warehouse, Lakehouse, OneLake). * Strong working knowledge of Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (hierarchical namespace, RBAC \+ ACLs, lifecycle management, security). * Experience with Azure Key Vault, Azure AD / Entra ID (including managed identities and service principals), and private networking (VNet integration, private endpoints). * Monitoring and troubleshooting with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and KQL. * Advanced SQL — window functions, CTEs, query optimization, execution plan analysis, performance tuning. * Strong Python for data engineering — pandas, PySpark, REST API integration, unit testing (pytest). * Proficient in T\-SQL; familiarity with Spark SQL, KQL, PowerShell, and Bash shell scripting. Preferred Qualifications: * 5\+ years of data warehouse development experience. * 5\+ years of data modeling experience using ERWIN or similar tools. * 2\+ years of experience with Azure Data Factory and Snowflake. * Medicaid Domain Knowledge is a plus.

jobs.title: Lead Platform Engineer, AI and DevSecOps
jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- RadarFirst is seeking a Lead Platform Engineer, AI \& DevSecOps Engineer to lead the next stage of our cloud, security, reliability, and AI operations maturity. This role will own the platforms, practices, and operating model that enable our engineering teams to build, deploy, monitor, secure, and continuously improve production SaaS systems and agentic AI capabilities. Since launching RadarFirst's first agentic AI offering using AWS Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and AgentCore Gateway, we are expanding the DevOps remit to include production\-grade AI infrastructure and operations. The person in this role will help mature the environment required by customers in highly regulated industries, including governance, secure agent/tool access, observability, continuous LLM and agent evaluations, traceability, incident response, cost controls, and operational readiness for future agent development. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. The right candidate is an experienced platform, DevSecOps, or SRE leader who can set direction, build shared engineering practices, mentor others, and create a more DevOps\-forward engineering culture across historically siloed teams. This position can be based out of our HQ in Portland, OR, or remote from anywhere in the U.S. **Our Technical Stack** ----------------------- Our front end is built with Angular and Material Design, using TypeScript for strong typing and maintainability. Backend services are written in Go and Nest.js. Technologies currently in use include Packer, Ansible, Docker, Terraform, CloudFormation, Python, Go, Bash, Datadog, Git, TeamCity, Jira, Slack, and Google's productivity suite. We deploy on AWS using EC2, ECS, RDS\-hosted PostgreSQL, S3, OpenSearch, Lambda, SES, CloudWatch, IAM, and related AWS services. Our agentic AI environment uses AWS Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and AgentCore Gateway, with a growing need for AI\-specific observability, evaluation, governance, and operational automation. **Essential Responsibilities \& Duties** ---------------------------------------- ### **Platform and Reliability** * Own and evolve the DevSecOps, platform engineering, and AI operations roadmap, with clear goals for reliability, security, deployment maturity, developer productivity, auditability, and customer readiness. * Design, implement, and operate secure, scalable, fault\-tolerant AWS infrastructure for SaaS and AI workloads. * Implement automation to reduce manual deployment, provisioning, compliance, monitoring, and support work. * Monitor platform KPIs and cost drivers, including cloud spend, token consumption, model usage, latency, error rates, deployment frequency, change failure rate, recovery time, and operational toil. ### **AI Operations** * Lead the operational maturity of RadarFirst's agentic AI platform, including the management of AWS Bedrock, AgentCore, AgentCore Gateway, agent/tool governance, policy controls, observability, evaluation workflows, and cost management. * Build observability across infrastructure, applications, and agentic workflows, including logs, metrics, traces, token usage, latency, error rates, tool invocation behavior, evaluation results, and customer\-impacting SLOs. * Partner with Engineering, Product, Security, Compliance, and Customer\-facing teams to ensure AI systems meet expectations for regulated industries, including auditability, access control, privacy, traceability, incident response, and defensible governance. * Define and evolve CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, and release\-management practices that improve speed, safety, reproducibility, and rollback confidence. ### **Security and Governance** * Lead incident response and reliability improvement efforts, including post\-incident reviews, root\-cause analysis, alert tuning, runbooks, operational readiness reviews, and long\-term remediation. * Maintain and improve security practices across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, secrets management, authentication, authorization, vulnerability scanning, and software supply chain controls. ### **Leadership and Culture** * Create shared engineering standards and paved paths that help product engineers ship safely without waiting on bespoke DevOps support. * Drive a DevOps\-forward engineering culture by reducing team silos, improving ownership models, clarifying operational responsibilities, and coaching teams on secure, observable, supportable software delivery. * Mentor DevOps, platform, and software engineers; help develop future technical leaders and raise the organization's operational bar. Opportunity exists for people management for a small team. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 10\+ years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, SRE, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, or a closely related engineering role. * Proven track record designing and operating production AWS infrastructure for SaaS or enterprise software environments. * Experience leading technical cal, and troubleshooting skills. ### **Strong Plus** * Hands\-on experience with AWS Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, AgentCore Gateway, or comparable agentic AI platforms. * Experience implementing LLM or agent evaluation frameworks, including automated regression tests, golden datasets, human review workflows, prompt/version management, safety checks, and release thresholds. * Experience building governance for agent tool access, including policy enforcement, identity, permissions, audit trails, redaction, approval flows, and controlled access to internal systems. * Experience with OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Datadog, Langfuse, Arize/Phoenix, Promptfoo, TruLens, OpenAI Evals, or similar AI observability/evaluation tools. * Experience with regulated customers in healthcare, insurance, financial services, government, or privacy/security\-sensitive industries. * SaaS scale\-up experience. * Certifications or training such as SANS/SEC\-540, SSCP, CISSP, CAP, CSSLP, HCISPP, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Certified Security Specialty, or AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more likely to doubt the strength of their qualifications, so we encourage you to submit an application if you're interested in this role despite any reservations you may have about your background or skill set. **Who We Are** -------------- At RadarFirst, our mission is to make regulatory risk and data privacy simple, actionable, and sustainable. We're transforming how organizations handle incidents and compliance with automated, purpose\-built SaaS solutions. Recognized as pioneers in privacy, we've earned patents, industry awards, and the confidence of some of the world's most highly regulated industries, from healthcare and insurance to finance and beyond. ### **Our Values** * Build What's Next * Be Good People * Own the Outcome * Customer Success is Our Success * True Transparency ### **Why Join RadarFirst?** At RadarFirst, our team is filled with smart, thoughtful, and forward\-thinking contributors who are experts at what they do. Our culture of innovation and trust is paramount to our success. We work hard, but we also encourage and support a healthy work/life balance. We offer a generous package of benefits and perks that make RadarFirst a great place to work, including: * Comprehensive benefits that include medical and dental, 401k, Life and Disability insurance, generous flexible time off policy, paid holiday time, and 12 weeks paid parental leave. Plus flexible spending accounts for medical, dependent care, and commuter expenses * Community outreach programs to encourage giving back to our community both as a group and individually * Commitment to anti\-racism work and accountability to our short\-term and long\-term equity \& inclusion action plan RadarFirst is a community\-first organization, operating on a hybrid model. We actively support all employees working in the way they need. For those who wish to work from the office, these are some features of our downtown Portland office: * On\-site amenities such as indoor bike racks, showers, lockers, and gym facilities * Casual work environment in an ideal central location, close to great food, shopping, and transportation options *This employer participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E\-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E\-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I\-9\.* The salary range for this role is $155,000 \- $175,000 \#LI\-REMOTE

jobs.title: Director, AI & Data Science
jobs.description: **DIRECTOR, AI \& DATA SCIENCE** Data Engineering \& Analytics, AI, and Data Science \| Full\-Time, Salaried \| Player\-Coach \| Reports to the Co\-CEOs **Company** Seeking.com (Reflex Media) **Location** Remote, anywhere in the USA **Team** Six to seven individual contributors across data engineering, analytics, data science, ML, and MLOps **Education** Bachelor’s degree in a technical field required. Master’s or PhD preferred. **Compensation** $175,000 to $225,000 base **Schedule** Collaboration across time zones. Regular working\-hour overlap with our Singapore Dev team and partners is required. **Travel** Required for team weeks and quarterly planning in Las Vegas **About the Role** Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas. We are a lean company of about 60 people, so every leader here builds. You will lead our combined Data Engineering \& Analytics, AI, and Data Science team of six to seven individual contributors and report directly to the Co\-CEOs. This team is Seeking's central AI capability: the models, infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, and continuous\-learning systems the whole company runs on. Expect about half your time leading and half writing code, building models, and debugging production systems yourself. Your first mandate is to achieve 100% AI automation of routine user\-uploaded content moderation, with accuracy proven superior to our human moderators and at a lower total cost. Next is AI customer support that resolves member tickets end to end. You own both outcomes completely, from policy and data through production results. Over time, the team will extend AI to fraud prevention, matching, member onboarding and success, marketing, monetization, retention, and product development, in partnership with the leaders who own those areas. Every initiative carries a measurable target, a named owner, and a mechanism for continuous learning. The immediate problems come first, and this role exists to solve them. This role is for someone who manages a hands\-on team today and still ships code. If your recent roles had managers reporting to you, or you plan to delegate the technical work and manage through status meetings, this is the wrong role. If you walk into ambiguity and know exactly what to do, keep reading. **What You Will Do** **1\. Set the foundation in your first 30 days** * Bring Product, Support, and Operations to one written moderation policy with a single owner. When teams disagree, you run the process that settles it. * Inventory every production AI system with a named owner, backup, dependencies, and monitoring gaps. * Trace every upload from receipt through model decision, enforcement, and any human review. Quantify every path that still needs a human, with its root cause, cost, and fix. **2\. Prove AI beats our human moderators, then reach 100%** * Test the AI and our moderators on the same held\-out cases, with reference decisions set by independent, policy\-qualified reviewers. Report missed violations and wrongful rejections separately, with sample sizes and confidence intervals. * Close every gap: missing coverage, uncertain model outputs, system failures, unenforced decisions, and duplicate human review. Expand automation in controlled stages, each with a tested rollback. **3\. Build systems that keep getting better** * Every production system improves through verified feedback, independent evaluation, and controlled releases. Run a monthly learning cycle in which a new model ships only when it beats production on the same independent test. * Version every dataset, policy, prompt, and model so every gain can be proven and every change can be rolled back. **4\. Run production AI like a business** * Give every production AI system monitoring, alerts to a named owner, documented recovery, and regular failure drills. * Report results in business terms: quality, cost per outcome, revenue, efficiency, and member experience, with savings reconciled with Finance. Keep one executive dashboard and run a weekly review with the Co\-CEOs. **5\. Automate support, then partner across Seeking** * Own AI customer support end to end: agents that resolve tickets and execute approved actions, such as subscription changes and eligible refunds, held to the same evaluation, rollout, and monitoring standards as moderation. * Once moderation and support are delivered, partner with the leaders of Marketing, Product, and other departments on fraud, matching, onboarding, monetization, and retention. Bring the Co\-CEOs a ranked list of opportunities by impact on cost, revenue, efficiency, and member experience. * In those partnerships, department leaders own their business outcomes. Your team owns the models, infrastructure, evaluation, and learning systems, and is accountable for their performance. **6\. Lead and grow the team** * Review each person's work line by line, pair on hard problems, and give direct feedback every week. Build a growth plan for everyone, recruit strong talent, and address performance gaps early. * Set quarterly OKRs for the function and each direct report, with leading and lagging KPIs for every Key Result. Run the work in Jira, Confluence, and Monday. **What You Must Bring** * A Bachelor’s in Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical field. A Master’s or Ph.D. in CS, AI, ML, Statistics, or a related quantitative field is strongly preferred. * Seven or more years delivering production data or ML systems, including three or more years managing teams of individual contributors. You manage a hands\-on team today, or did so recently. * Strong Python and SQL, with production code you personally wrote in the past year. You will code in the interview. * Production ML and architecture judgment. You have designed, built, and operated ML and LLM systems end to end, from data pipelines through evaluation, deployment, and monitoring, on a major cloud platform. * You have done this before. You led an AI automation program in moderation, trust and safety, support, or a comparable decision system, from a measured human baseline to automated decisions at scale. * Evaluation rigor and continuous learning. You measure false negatives and false positives separately, report uncertainty, keep test data clean, and have built systems that improve through feedback and controlled updates. * Measurable business impact. You can name the cost, revenue, efficiency, or member outcomes your work moved, with the numbers. * Cross\-functional influence. You have found AI opportunities in other departments, won over their leaders, and taken the solution from concept into production. * A record of mentoring engineers and scientists into stronger, more senior contributors. * Daily use of Claude, Claude Code, Cowork, or comparable AI tools. If someone has to explain to you why AI matters, this role is not for you. **Nice to Have** * Production work in multi\-modal or computer vision moderation, fraud detection, recommender systems, or marketing and monetization models such as propensity, pricing, and lifetime value. * Our stack: AWS (S3, Redshift, SageMaker, Bedrock), Looker, and Kubernetes. **Compensation** * $175,000 to $225,000 base, commensurate with experience. Full\-time, salaried, remote within the US. * 99% coverage of our medical base plan, dental, and vision. 50% 401(k) match up to 6%. Flexible Spending Account and flexible paid time off. **How We Hire** * Recruiter screen: code you wrote in the last 90 days, the team you manage, and logistics. * Practical round: live SQL and Python, plus a production architecture discussion. * Systems round: work through a simplified moderation workflow. Find where items fall back to humans, define an honest automation rate, and design the evaluation against human moderators. * Co\-CEO round: treat it as a pitch. Study the product, ask sharp questions, and bring your 90\-day plan for moderation and customer support. * References, including a former direct report. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Reflex Media is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We strictly prohibit discrimination of any kind. Candidates are encouraged to apply for qualified positions regardless of race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristics as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Reflex Media's hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and the needs of the company. All offers of employment are contingent upon the completion of a full background and reference check. QtKLmXwX64

jobs.title: NetSuite Developer & Product Data Engineer
jobs.description: NetSuite Developer \& Product Data Engineer Webberville, Michigan · Hybrid, a few days per week on\-site · Full\-time Every part we sell starts as someone else's spreadsheet. Dozens of vendors, dozens of ideas about what a column called "size" means, and hundreds of thousands of parts listed on Amazon, eBay, Walmart and our own store that all depend on us getting that data right. Today that data lives in too many places. We want it to live in one: NetSuite, as the record for every part we carry, feeding each marketplace from a single clean source. That is the job. Half of it is NetSuite development, the SuiteScript and SuiteQL you write yourself. The other half is product\-data engineering, turning messy vendor catalogs into records a customer can trust when their machine is down and they need the right part the first time. If you have been waiting for a problem that is honestly both, this is it. **What product data means here** Supplier catalogs in every format a vendor can invent, item attributes, fitment and cross\-reference data, validation rules, and the feeds that push all of it out to the marketplaces. Not analytics about a software product. The real catalog, and the plumbing that keeps it right. **The split, and what you own** A 50/50 role, by design: about half NetSuite development, about half data engineering. Routine item fixes and listing corrections stay with our listing team. You build and own the system underneath: the pipelines, the records, the validation, the integrations. You build it once, correctly, so it holds. * **NetSuite development:** SuiteScript, SuiteQL, saved searches, custom records and fields, and the workflows that make NetSuite the system of record for product data. * **Vendor data ingestion:** collecting, aggregating and normalizing supplier catalogs into clean, structured, trustworthy records. * **Marketplace data operations:** building and maintaining the feeds and syncs that publish product data to Amazon, eBay, Walmart and our own store, with the validation and compliance checks that keep listings accurate. * **Integrations and APIs:** connecting NetSuite, our marketplace channels and the tools around them so data moves reliably and nothing is re\-keyed by hand. **A concrete first win:** take one priority supplier feed that arrives today as inconsistent, half\-trusted input and turn it into validated records publishing cleanly to every channel. Then do it again for the next one. **Who you are** You build things. Not because someone handed you a ticket, but because you saw the gap, sketched the fix, and had a working version running before anyone scheduled a meeting about it. You are comfortable being the person in the room who can actually write the script. You also think in systems. You know a clever one\-off script is a liability if nobody can tell where its data came from, and that a schema decision made in a hurry gets paid for by someone three years later. Before you build, you ask what else touches this. And you ship anyway. You can tell the difference between the version that is right and the version that is right enough for this quarter, and you choose well under pressure. You would rather get a clean feed live for twenty thousand parts this month than a perfect one for two hundred thousand next year. Most people are strong on one of those and patient with the other two. We are looking for the person who holds all three at once and reads the tension between them as part of the work, not a frustration. **What you need** * You can do both halves: NetSuite development (SuiteScript) and product\-data engineering (SQL or SuiteQL, plus Python or a comparable language for data work). Deep in one, solid in the other. You would deepen the other half here, and we will back you while you do. * You have done this before on large, messy datasets, at real volume and with real stakes. * You design data structures and integrations that other people can rely on and understand later. * You are legally authorized to work in the United States. We are not able to sponsor employment visas for this role. * You can be on\-site at our Webberville, Michigan location a few days per week, including quarterly company planning days. Reasonable accommodations will be considered for qualified candidates. **Nice to have, not required** * NetSuite experience at a distributor, retailer, manufacturer or ecommerce business, including integrations, imports and production troubleshooting. * Experience with parts, fitment or catalog data (ACES and PIES style data, OEM cross\-references). We can teach the parts domain to the right person, so this is a plus, not a gate. * Comfort using AI developer tooling, for example model\-assisted code generation or automated test drafting, to move faster on pipeline and script work. **How we use AI** We use AI the way we use SQL: daily, without ceremony, and only where it is better than the alternative. We run agents on real work across the catalog, and the data layer you build is what makes those agents trustworthy or not. You should be fluent enough to put a model into a workflow, and skeptical enough to take it out when it starts making things up. We are early on this and we know it. You would be the person who makes the foundation solid. **The team** You would join the Ecommerce, Systems \& Innovation team and report to its Director. We built the team by merging our business\-systems and ecommerce teams into one group, so the people who fix the data sit next to the people who sell from it. Small team, real ownership, and a short path from an idea to a thing that is live. **About Reliable Aftermarket Parts** We started in a basement in Michigan in 2009\. Today we stock hundreds of thousands of aftermarket parts for farm, construction, industrial and lawn and garden equipment, and we ship them from Webberville, Michigan. Our customers are people with a machine that is down and money on the line, which is why getting the part and the data right the first time is the whole job. **Pay and benefits** * Competitive salary, based on your experience and the scope you can own, not on your salary history. We share the range early in the conversation. * Full\-time, salaried. * Benefits through ADP TotalSource: medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, and voluntary life and disability coverage, plus employee discount programs. Specific plan details are shared during the hiring process. **How to apply** Apply through our careers page. A resume is enough to start. If you have something that shows how you work, a GitHub, a data project, a NetSuite build you are proud of, we would rather see it than read about it, but it is not required.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About the team:** ------------------- Rubrik secures and accelerates the world’s AI transformation. As AI agents reshape the enterprise, Rubrik’s Enterprise AI Incubation team proves it on Rubrik itself. We are building a thinking enterprise: applications that don't just record the business but help run it. They learn from our data, act through our own agents, and improve with every decision. Fully backed by executive leadership, this team drives meaningful, large\-scale enterprise transformation. **About the role:** ------------------- We want senior engineers who have already shipped agents that real people rely on, and who are ready to do it again at higher stakes. You will drop into the real work, redesign it around agents that carry it end to end, and ship it as the new way that part of Rubrik operates.You’ll own your agent systems end to end: understanding the workflow, designing the architecture, writing the code, deploying, and running it in production. Rather than simply querying an API, you engineer robust, production\-grade infrastructure around model endpoints, integrating custom tooling, context pipelines, automated evaluations, and defensive guardrails to ensure resilience against unstructured real\-world data. You also decide whether a problem needs an agent, a simpler automation, or nothing at all, and you have explicit authority to stop or re\-scope work that won’t deliver impact. You thrive in ambiguous environments with a low\-ego mindset, leveraging AI coding tools as core collaborative partners in your engineering workflow. **What you’ll do:** ------------------- * Lead product discovery alongside Product Managers and domain experts to understand real workflows, map them out, and define clear problems, baselines, and success criteria as the foundation for building agentic solutions. * Design, build, test, and deploy production agents, automations, and internal tools using coding agents, LLM APIs, and agent frameworks, integrated with Rubrik’s internal agent platform and business systems. * Turn complex processes into multi\-agent workflows that carry real work and make decisions: orchestrators that qualify and routes deals, workers that move orders through approval and fulfillment under business rules, agents that monitor signals and recommend actions for customer health, or coordinated agents that handle hire\-to\-retire steps across HR, IT, and managers with shared state and clear handoffs. * Engineer agents for autonomy with reliability, including tool and orchestration flows, context management, caching, retries, and failure handling. * Leverage full\-stack engineering across backend services, APIs, data models, interactive screens, approval UIs, and chat interfaces as the complete medium to deliver high\-ownership, user\-facing agent systems. * Apply solid software engineering practices to AI systems, treating prompts, skills, configs, and specs as versioned artifacts, with code review, tests, CI or CD, and staged rollouts. * Implement evaluation, guardrails, and quality control: derive evals from workflow data, establish quality gates and guardrails, integrate human\-in\-the\-loop approvals where needed, and monitor production runs to refine agents over time. * Use measured results to decide how to evolve or retire agents, and turn successful systems into patterns and libraries that can be reused. **Experience you’ll need:** --------------------------- * Around 7 or more years of professional software engineering experience in production systems, and around 2 or more years of professional, hands\-on experience building AI agents and agent powered production applications with measurable outcomes. * Strong full stack engineering background, with a track record of designing, building, and owning services end to end, including backend APIs and integrations, data models, and user facing interfaces such as approval UIs, dashboards, or chat surfaces. * A builder mindset: comfortable defining baselines and metrics, reporting results in business terms, working in a fast moving environment, and closing the loop by building, demoing, learning, and building again. If you like seeing improvements in hours saved, errors avoided, and teams unblocked, you will have plenty of chances to measure that here. ### **Software engineering skills and best practices:** * System design: break down complex problems, design APIs and data models, reason about latency, throughput, and failure modes, and choose simple, robust architectures. * Algorithms, data structures, access control permissions, and data provenance. Spec driven development: turn vague requirements into clear problem statements, write or refine design docs, and use a Spec Plan Task Code* Converge flow so work is traceable from design to code, including when you use AI coding agents. * Execution discipline: use version control, code review, automated tests, CI or CD, staged rollouts and rollbacks, logging, metrics, and tracing, and improve sy ext graphs: entities and relationships, GraphRAG, hybrid retrieval. * Agent frameworks and runtimes: Google ADK, LangGraph, OpenAI style, cloud or container platforms. * Backend: Python, FastAPI or similar stacks. * Tools integration: MCP, Slack or Teams bots, REST APIs, webhooks. * Data systems: Snowflake, Salesforce, graph stores. * UX: conversational flows, chat surfaces, guided forms, simple dashboards for agent output. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the role based on U.S. location. Within the range, the salary offered will be determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US Pay Range $188,500—$282,700 USD **Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation** ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real\-time guardrails, fine\-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes. **Inclusion @ Rubrik** ---------------------- At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data. Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential. ### **Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:** * Our Company: We are committed to building a merit\-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here. * Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries. * Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities. **Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled** ------------------------------------------------ Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. drive to tackle ambiguous challenges effectively. * Commitment to staying updated on AI trends and leveraging them to deliver business value. * Understanding of ethical and responsible AI principles and practices **Preferred Experience** * Prior exposure to Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC), commercial real estate, or industrial operations. * Familiarity with construction tools and APIs (Procore, Autodesk BIM 360 / ACC, Bluebeam, DroneDeploy). * Experience designing conversational interfaces or automated field data capture workflows (voice\-to\-text, field forms) The salary may vary within the anticipated range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, and abilities.
