jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **OUR STATEMENT** The San José State University Research Foundation (SJSURF) is committed to building a work environment where everyone can show up as their own self and have an opportunity to contribute, develop, and advance in their career. Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) are core values of the organization. We strive to attract, retain, and develop employees who reflect the community and society where we work and live. The Research Foundation aims to develop a culture where everyone feels welcome, shares their views, and where differences in backgrounds and perspectives are seen as adding value. The Data Engineer supports SJSU's Campus Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence initiatives through the development, integration, and maintenance of enterprise data solutions. The position contributes to the development and maintenance of data pipelines and data models that integrate information from multiple university systems into trusted, governed data platforms used for institutional reporting, analytics, and data\-driven decision\-making. **GENERAL NATURE OF POSITION** Working under the guidance of senior technical staff, the Data Engineer applies knowledge of computer science, information systems, database technologies, programming, data architecture, and cloud\-based data platforms to develop and support enterprise data solutions. The position works with technical teams and university stakeholders to analyze requirements, troubleshoot data and system issues, design technical solutions, document business and technical requirements, and support vendor and locally developed systems. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** 1\. Develop, test, implement, and maintain data pipelines and integration processes that extract, transform, and load data from multiple enterprise source systems into SJSU's data warehouse and analytics platforms. 2\. Develop and maintain SQL queries, database objects, data transformations, and data models in support of reporting and analytics requirements. 3\. Apply programming and scripting languages such as Python, Java, SQL, or similar technologies to develop, maintain, and support data solutions. 4\. Analyze source\-system data structures, relationships, and business rules to support integration into enterprise data platforms. 5\. Troubleshoot data pipeline, integration, database, and production data issues by reviewing SQL queries, source data, system logs, application logic, and code; collaborate with senior developers and other technical teams to resolve more complex issues. 6\. Develop and maintain processes to validate data quality, integrity, consistency, and completeness. 7\. Develop and deploy scalable, secure, and reliable data solutions in cloud environments to support analytics and business operations. 8\. Support data solutions using relational databases, cloud computing environments, data lakehouse technologies, and platforms such as Oracle, Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform. 9\. Apply established data architecture, ETL/ELT, data warehousing, metadata management, and database design principles when developing and maintaining data solutions. 10\. Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, application developers, system administrators, and functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical data requirements and solutions. 11\. Support analytical methodologies including segmentation, statistical analysis, regression, forecasting, data mining, and predictive modeling as appropriate. 12\. Provide production support for applications and data solutions, ensuring SLA compliance through effective monitoring, troubleshooting, incident resolution, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. 13\. Analyze structured and unstructured datasets to identify trends, anomalies, relationships, and information useful for university decision\-making. 14\. Support the team in building trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders through reliable, accurate data work. 15\. jobs.title: Contract Developer — ColdFusion to PHP Migration
jobs.description: **Contract Developer — ColdFusion to PHP Migration** Senior full\-stack · Contract · Fully remote **Location:** Fully remote (U.S.) **Engagement:** Contract, hourly **Rate:** $50–$75 / hour **Focus area:** Legacy ColdFusion migration to a modern PHP framework **COLDFUSION FLUENCY IS REQUIRED ON DAY ONE** This engagement is too short to learn ColdFusion on. We need someone who can open an undocumented CFML codebase in week one and tell us what it does. Candidates with only casual exposure, or who plan to come up to speed on the job, will not be considered. **ABOUT THE ROLE** We are looking for a senior full\-stack contract developer with real depth in both ColdFusion and PHP to lead the migration of a legacy web application to a modern PHP framework. This is a hands\-on technical role, not an advisory one. You will read, analyze, and decipher an existing ColdFusion codebase — including undocumented logic and legacy patterns — and re\-architect that logic into clean, scalable PHP. You will also build new functional capability in the new architecture as the migration proceeds. Dynamic Digital modernizes outdated technology, builds on proven frameworks, and delivers efficient development that helps our clients grow with confidence. We are a small team, the feedback loop is short, and what you build goes live for real clients. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Codebase audit and deconstruction.** Analyze existing ColdFusion (CFML/CFCs) application logic, data flow, background jobs, and business rules. * **Migration strategy and execution.** Re\-architect and rewrite ColdFusion features into modern PHP — Laravel, Symfony, or structured OOP PHP — keeping business rules intact while clearing legacy debt. * **Feature development.** Design and build new functional modules and RESTful APIs directly in the new PHP architecture. * **Database and data integration.** Maintain, refactor, and migrate relational schemas (MySQL, MS SQL, or PostgreSQL) and tune query performance through the transition. * **Dual\-environment support.** Keep the ColdFusion and PHP systems interoperable — sessions, data, and side\-by\-side execution — during a phased rollout. * **Documentation.** Leave behind a written record of what the legacy system did and how the new one replaces it, so the next developer is not starting where you started. * **Code review and accountability.** Review everything you ship, including anything produced with AI assistance, for correctness, quality, and security. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * 7\+ years of professional development experience, with substantial production ColdFusion among it. * **ColdFusion expertise — non\-negotiable.** Extensive production experience with Adobe ColdFusion or Lucee. You can read, debug, and translate both tag and script syntax, legacy includes (cfinclude), custom tags, components (.cfc), and application lifecycle scopes (Application.cfc / Application.cfm). * **PHP expertise.** Strong command of modern PHP (8\.x), object\-oriented architecture, design patterns, and current framework standards such as Laravel or Symfony. * **Migration track record.** You have moved a legacy monolith onto a modern framework before without breaking production business logic. Be ready to talk through one in detail. * **Front\-end proficiency.** Modern JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, and CSS3 — Tailwind or Bootstrap. * **Relational databases.** Advanced SQL, query optimization, indexing, and data mapping. * **API design.** Hands\-on experience building and consuming RESTful endpoints. * **Version control.** Solid understanding of Git. * **AI\-assisted development.** Comfortable using it, and accountable for what you ship with it. AI\-generated code gets the same review for quality and security as anything you write by hand — which matters more than usual when the source logic is undocumented. * **Independent delivery.** You work from a written scope and deliver with minimal oversight. Most of our coordination is asynchronous. * Work we can review — a portfolio, public repositories, or a system you can walk us through in detail. Formal degree not required. **PREFERRED** * Lucee specifically * Automated testing during migration * CI/CD pipelines * Hosting, DNS, and server migration * WordPress / PHP CMS work * Scheduled jobs and queue systems **HOW THE ENGAGEMENT WORKS** * Independent contractor (1099\). You invoice us; you are not an employee of Dynamic Digital. * Hours and the length of the engagement are set in the written scope before work begins. * Hourly at $50–$75, depending on experience and the scope. Rate is agreed before work begins. * The work is scoped in writing — phases, deliverables, and milestones — before it starts. * Fully remote anywhere in the United States. Our team is in Willow Grove, PA and works Eastern hours. * You control your own schedule, tools, and how the work gets done. Dynamic Digital is a web development agency in Willow Grove, Pennsylvania, managed by Sahajanand, LLC. We modernize outdated technology and build on proven frameworks so our clients can grow with confidence. Small team, short feedback loops, and the work you build goes live for real clients. Pay: $50\.00 \- $75\.00 / hour Job Type: contract Education: No education required Work location: This is a remote position Dynamic Digital LLC. 2713 Easton Rd, Willow Grove, PA, 19090

data warehouse and lakehouse architectures, ETL/ELT, and the modern data stack, including hands\-on Databricks (or similar, such as Snowflake or BigQuery).  re engineering background beyond data or AI marketing KPIs. * Familiarity with go\-to\-market data and systems: CRM (e.g., Salesforce), marketing automation, web analytics, and MarTech tools. * Experience building interactive applications with jobs.description: Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd, Slideshare, Everand, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise. **Culture at Scribd, Inc.** --------------------------- We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer. We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in\-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in\-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location. So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long\-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude. This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization. **The team.** Data \& Analytics at Scribd brings together Analytics Engineering, Data Science, and Product Analytics to turn fragmented data and inconsistent definitions into trusted foundations, and to build AI\-assisted tools that bring reliable intelligence into how teams make decisions. **The role.** This role supports Content Supply \& Understanding, the team that owns Scribd’s library of more than 400 million documents, which reaches over 250 million monthly active users. The team’s remit covers who contributes the content, how well we understand it, and how it reaches users. You will report to the Senior Manager, Data Analytics, and work embedded alongside Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, and Analytics Engineering partners. The role is open at the Senior and Lead levels, and we will level based on the experience you bring. At the Senior level you own analytical workstreams within a defined area. At the Lead level you also set the measurement strategy for the area, take on the most open\-ended problems, and raise the bar for the analysts around you. **Mandate.** Make it possible to say with confidence what is in the corpus, where it falls short of what users look for, and whether enrichment is making content easier to find and use, with numbers that stay comparable as content sources, models, and pipelines change. **Core philosophy.** A metric definition is a shared artifact. We care about documentation, versioning, and data quality as much as the readout on top, because a number that quietly breaks upstream is worse than no number at all. **About you** ------------- * You are at your best when the question is not yet well formed. You look at an incomplete picture, work out what matters, and produce an answer a product team can act on, with the limits of the evidence stated plainly. * You are equally comfortable as the strategist and the analyst. You can size an opportunity, model its return, write the SQL behind the metric, and defend the number in a room full of product and executive leaders. * You are skeptical by default. When a metric moves sharply, your instinct is to find the field or pipeline that changed before you write the narrative. * You are pragmatic. You ask what the right next version is, and you use AI where it creates measurable value. * You communicate early and plainly, and you write things down. Methodology and metric documentation are part of the deliverable. **You will** ------------ * Build measurement for content understanding. Define how we measure classification and metadata coverage, accuracy, and the effect of enrichment on discovery and engagement. * Own analytics for content supply and generate insights on where the corpus falls short: size the gap between user demand and the corpus, estimate the value of closing it, and help prioritize where to invest, using the same market sizing, segmentation, and ROI methods applied in go\-to\-market analysis. * Partner with Product Managers on strategy and roadmap. Translate product bets into success and guardrail metrics, size opportunities, and make trade\-offs explicit. * Design and read experiments (A/B tests and other methods) for content\-related product changes, from hypothesis through analysis and readout. * Define and maintain the KPIs, metric definitions, and dashboards for the content domain, and work with Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering on instrumentation and data quality so that metrics stay consistent over time. * Investigate discontinuities and anomalies in  . able to build web features using agentic workflows and modern frontend frameworks * Cloud experience (AWS or GCP), containerization (Docker); familiarity with AWS services such as ECS, RDS, and Kinesis, plus observability tools like Datadog * Preferred: Experience with workflow orchestration engines (Temporal, Cadence, or AWS Step Functions) **Benefits** * $160K \- $180K \+ stock options * 401k with company match * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * FSA, dependent care, and commuter benefits * Paid parental leave and unlimited PTO * TeleDoc, One Medical, Talkspace, and WellHub access * Citi Bike membership * $100 monthly Seated dining credit

jobs.title: R&D Systems Developer
jobs.description: **About Selkirk Sport** At Selkirk Sport, we’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of pickleball innovation. Our mission is to *Fuel the Pickleball Obsession* by creating the sport’s premier products and ecosystem. As a leading global brand in premium pickleball equipment, we’re expanding our international presence and seeking top\-tier talent to support our growth in the U.S. and abroad. We pride ourselves on a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Selkirk applies first\-principles thinking to design scalable, process\-driven systems that create lasting operational advantage. **Job Summary** --------------- Selkirk Sport is hiring an R\&D Systems Developer to build the software, automations and AI tools our R\&D team uses to design and test the next generation of pickleball gear. You’ll work on\-site with our USA R\&D team in Coeur d’Alene, Idaho, and report to our Director of Business Tools. This role suits a developer with a few years of hands\-on experience across different technical stacks, who can take a project from idea to working tool with minimal hand\-holding. You’ll sit with the engineers and technicians who use what you build, figure out what they need, and get it into their hands fast, even when requirements change along the way. If you’ve built MCP servers, React apps or AI tools that real people use, and you want to see your work in the hands of the people designing the paddles pros play with, we’d like to meet you. **What you'll get to do** * **Tools for the R\&D team.** Design, build and maintain internal applications, scripts and interfaces, often in React, that support testing and product development workflows. * **AI tools and MCP servers.** Create AI assistants and automations that cut manual work, and build MCP servers and connectors that give AI tools secure access to internal systems and data. * **Connected R\&D data.** Build integrations, APIs and data flows that link R\&D tools and test data with company systems, plus dashboards that turn raw test results into information engineering and quality teams can use. * **Fast iteration.** Work side by side with engineers and technicians every day to gather requirements, ship working tools, and adjust when priorities shift. * **A development team behind you.** Partner with our Business Tools developers on code quality, standards and architecture, and help evaluate new technologies worth adopting. **AI is part of the job** ------------------------- At Selkirk, AI tools are part of how work gets done. In this role you'll build them. We're looking for someone who has created AI tools, LLM\-based applications or MCP servers, or who can show us they learn new technology quickly enough to start doing so right away. **Who you are** You'll fit right in if you have: * 3 to 5 years of experience in software development, systems development or a related technical role * Experience across multiple technical stacks, and a track record of learning new platforms and switching technologies quickly * Working knowledge of APIs, databases and integrating systems and data sources * Strong critical thinking, problem\-solving skills and attention to detail * Comfort with requirements and priorities that change mid\-project * The ability to explain technical work in plain language to engineers, technicians and operations teams Bonus points for:* Experience building MCP servers, AI tools or LLM\-based applications * Experience with React or similar front\-end frameworks * A background in sporting goods, consumer products, manufacturing or R\&D * Familiarity with Palantir or other enterprise data platforms * **Where and when you'll work** This is an on\-site role at our Coeur d'Alene, Idaho facility, working alongside the USA R\&D team. You'll be on our 4\.5\-day schedule: Monday through Thursday, 7:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., and Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. Some flexibility is needed during intensive development cycles. **Our investment in you** ------------------------- * Medical, dental and vision insurance, starting the first of the month after your start date * 401(k) or Roth with a company match: 100% of the first 2% and 50% of the next 3% * Up to 3 weeks of paid time off per year, accrued each pay period, plus paid company holidays * Paid sick leave of at least 3 days per year, more where state law requires * Paid maternity and paternity leave * Company\-paid life and AD\&D insurance, with options to buy more * Telemedicine for you and your household at no cost * A confidential Employee Assistance Program for counseling, legal and financial support * Additional voluntary benefits plans * 75% off Selkirk gear, plus up to 60% off leading outdoor, fitness and nutrition brands through ExpertVoice **Our application process** --------------------------- We keep it quick and respectful of your time:* One\-way video interview. Answer a few questions on your own schedule. * Online assessment. A short assessment of critical thinking, attention to detail and problem solving. * Interview. A video interview over Google Meet with the hiring manager. If you want to build the tools behind the next generation of pickleball gear, we'd love to hear from you. **Why Selkirk Sport?** Pickleball is the fastest\-growing sport in the world, and Selkirk is leading the charge. Joining our team means more than just a job—it means being part of a high\-energy brand that is defining a new era of sports culture. Whether you are collaborating with us in the office, working remotely, or joining our international teams, you will be part of a collaborative culture that values innovation and high performance. If you’re ready to bring your expertise to a fast\-paced environment where your work makes a direct impact, we want to hear from you. **Let’s build the future of pickleball together.**

jobs.description: ### **Our Purpose** At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here. ### **About Us** SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI\-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real\-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters. Our teams are builders, problem\-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission\-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity. ### **What Are We Looking For?** We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes. As a Staff Back\-End Engineer, you will be tasked with building backend infrastructure for our AI security product, focused on monitoring AI assets, assessing risks, and delivering actionable insights. You will work in a fast\-paced, innovative environment that requires agility, adaptability, and continuous iteration. Your work will also include enforcing security policies and ensuring safe, compliant AI deployment while contributing to the future of cybersecurity. ### **What Will You Do?** Primary responsibilities include: * Design, develop, and maintain scalable server\-side applications and APIs. * Implement and optimize database schemas, queries, and data storage solutions. * Collaborate with frontend developers to integrate user\-facing elements with server\-side logic. * Participate in code reviews and contribute to architectural decisions. * Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing systems. * Implement security and data protection measures. * Work with cloud services (e.g. AWS, Azure, or GCP) to deploy and manage backend services. * Contribute to the development of microservices architecture. * Stay updated with emerging backend technologies and industry best practices. ### **What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?** Ideal candidates will have: * 8\+ years of backend development experience in Node.js and TypeScript. * Experience with database management. * Experience developing and integrating APIs, including designing and building RESTful APIs; familiarity with GraphQL is a plus. * Experience designing and implementing microservices. * Experience with scalability and performance optimization, including caching strategies, message queues, and large\-scale, distributed architectures. * Experience implementing authentication, authorization, and data protection mechanisms. * Strong problem\-solving skills. * Communication and collaboration skills. ### **Why SentinelOne?** AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI\-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add\-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. SentinelOne participates in the E\-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.

At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. **Staff Software Engineer – File Ingestion (Customer\-Facing Services)** ======================================================================== ### **Build the Future of the AI Data Cloud** Snowflake’s File Ingestion team owns the core engines behind **COPY INTO** and **Snowpipe** — the primary arteries landing customer data into the AI Data Cloud at hundreds of petabytes per quarter. We are expanding our core mission to build next\-generation, **external\-facing ingestion services** that directly expose file\-ingest capabilities to external platforms, partner ecosystems, and customer applications. As a **Staff Software Engineer**, you will lead the architectural vision and execution for these mission\-critical, customer\-facing services. global scale. ### **What You’ll Do** * **Drive Technical Vision \& Architecture:** Define the multi\-year architecture and technical strategy for high\-throughput, external\-facing ingestion services and APIs across multi\-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). * **Deliver Customer\-Facing Innovations:** Lead the end\-to\-end execution of enterprise\-grade external features, ensuring low\-latency data landing, high availability, and seamless ecosystem integration (e.g., Snowpark Connect, partner connectors). * **Set Technical Direction:** Author foundational design documents, establish technical standards for reliability, security, and scalability, and lead high\-stakes architectural reviews across engineering orgs. * **Lead Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Partner closely with Principal Architects, Product Management, Security, and external developer platforms to translate customer requirements into resilient system architecture. * **Elevate Engineering Excellence:** Mentor and sponsor Senior, Mid\-level, and Junior engineers; raise the bar for system design, code quality, testing methodologies, and operational maturity. * **Direct Customer \& Strategic Impact:** Engage with enterprise customer engineering teams to solve complex integration challenges, debug production edge cases at scale, and turn direct customer feedback into core platform capabilities. ### **What We’re Looking For** * **10\+ years** of experience designing, building, and operating large\-scale distributed systems or cloud\-native infrastructure in production. * Proven track record of **architectural leadership**, having successfully taken complex, customer\-facing services or external APIs from initial concept to General Availability (GA) and global scale. * **Expert proficiency in Java or C\+\+** (strong preference for engineers comfortable working across both systems\-level C\+\+ and managed service Java frameworks). * Deep expertise in **external API design, cloud service execution engines, messaging/streaming systems (e.g., Kafka, Pulsar), or database internals. * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a demonstrated ability to drive technical consensus across cross\-functional leadership, product partners, and external technical stakeholders. * BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Iceberg, Delta Lake) and integration with ecosystems like Apache Spark or Ray. * Advanced performance engineering expertise: memory management, SIMD, vectorization, lock\-free data structures, or I/O optimization at PB\-scale. * Strong background in metadata management, transactional state machines, or consensus protocols (e.g., Raft, Paxos). * Active contributor to open\-source data infrastructure, cloud\-native compute systems, or query engines. ### **Why This Team** * **Massive Strategic Impact:** You will lead the expansion of Snowflake's most critical data\-path surface into direct, customer\-facing integrations that unlock new platform ecosystems and drive platform volume. * **Broad Architectural Scope:** Your work will bridge edge API layers, control\-plane orchestrators, file scanners/parsers, query planners, and underlying storage engines. * **High Customer Visibility:** Work directly on features that power the external integrations for Fortune 500 enterprises, seeing the immediate revenue and performance impact of your architecture. * **Culture of Technical Leadership:** Partner directly with Snowflake’s top architects and leads in an environment that values deep technical autonomy, rigorous engineering, and long\-term architectural stewardship. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Ingestion
jobs.description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. **Software Engineer — Ingestion Execution Platform** ==================================================== **Build the always\-on engine behind Snowflake ingestion** ---------------------------------------------------------- Snowflake’s ingestion products land customer data into the AI Data Cloud at petabytes scale, on a path to much larger scale. Those products run on a shared, always\-on **ingestion execution platform**: a multi\-tenant control plane that owns pipeline lifecycle, durable work queues, single\-owner execution, step orchestration across control plane and compute, multi\-tenant scheduling, source monitoring, and cluster topology. You will build the substrate other ingestion teams ship on. Reliability, fairness, and efficiency at this layer multiply across ingestion products. As a **Software Engineer**, you will own substantial platform work end to end: take a hard distributed\-systems problem from design through production, make neighboring teams more successful, and raise the bar on correctness, isolation, and operability. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Design and ship core platform capabilities. Work on areas such as multi\-tenant isolation, fair scheduling, ownership and placement, durable queues, source monitoring, or compute allocation. You own the work from design through production. * Strengthen isolation and fairness. Build and evolve the primitives that let many products and pipelines share one platform safely: quotas, backpressure, resource accounting, and intelligent placement. * Raise reliability and observability. Improve availability and latency for pipeline health, ingest APIs, and compute allocation. Instrument the system so behavior is visible and actionable. * Build a clean platform surface. Give product teams a consistent way to express pipelines and processing steps, so they can ship on shared primitives rather than special\-casing the stack. * Scale the control plane. Design for more concurrent pipelines, higher ingest volume, and efficient use of compute and metadata as customer usage grows. * Operate what you ship. This platform sits on the critical path for production ingest. You will participate in production support, improve observability, and automate operational work. Mentorship of junior engineers is part of the job. You will also work closely with engineers on larger platform bets. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * 3–6\+ years building and operating large\-scale distributed systems or cloud infrastructure in production. You have shipped something hard that other teams depend on, not only application features. * Track record of end\-to\-end ownership: you took an ambiguous, cross\-cutting problem, wrote the design, landed the code, and lived with it in production. Comfortable operating above your level, influencing adjacent teams and helping sequence larger bets without waiting to be told what to do. * Strong proficiency in Java (this codebase is Java\-first). C\+\+ or systems\-level experience is a plus. You write concurrent, failure\-aware code and you care about the invariants. * Experience in at least one of: multi\-tenant control planes, durable queues and at\-least\-once processing, distributed locking / leases / membership, cluster scheduling, or streaming/ingest execution engines. * Instinct for correctness under failure. You think carefully about crashes, retries, redelivery, and exclusive ownership. * Clear written and verbal communication. You can write a clear design for engineers on neighboring product teams, and you can hold a technical argument without ego. * BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Experience building internal platforms used by multiple product teams (orchestration, job/runtime frameworks, multi\-tenant schedulers). * Background in multi\-tenant isolation and fairness: resource accounting, request throttling, quota systems, or load\-aware placement. * Hands\-on with transactional or consensus\-backed metadata stores (for example etcd, ZooKeeper, or Spanner\-style systems). * Familiarity with open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake), Kafka\-style streaming, or warehouse scheduling. * Performance work at scale: tail latency, memory and thread accounting, I/O batching, or cost\-per\-unit efficiency. * You have used AI as a serious engineering collaborator (design review, debugging, test generation) and can show how it made you faster without lowering the bar. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: * The estimated base salary range for this role is $160,000 \- $230,000\. * Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan. jobs.title: Marketing Technologies Director
jobs.description: Position Type: Location(s): United States, Remote Date Posted: Job ID: R\-125279 **Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?** Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting\-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. **Marketing Technologies Director** The Marketing Technologies Director, leads PlayStation's global marketing technology organization across engineering, product management, UX, measurement and experimentation, audience activation, and marketing data. This leader owns the technology vision, architecture, product strategy, and roadmap for platforms used by marketers worldwide to reach hundreds of millions of players. The role is accountable for building secure, scalable, AI\-enabled capabilities that improve marketing effectiveness, speed, and customer experience. We are seeking a technology leader with direct software or data engineering experience building marketing technology products and platforms. The successful candidate can lead engineers and technical product teams, make architecture and build\-versus\-buy decisions, and translate marketing needs into durable systems. Experience limited to administering vendors or managing a marketing technology stack without direct engineering experience does not meet the requirements of this role. **Key Responsibilities** **Technology Engineering and Product Leadership** * Lead multidisciplinary teams responsible for marketing technology engineering, product management, and UX, with clear goals, operating rhythms, and accountability for delivery. * Own end\-to\-end delivery and operation of global marketing platforms, from discovery and architecture through launch, adoption, reliability, and continuous improvement. * Set the architecture for marketing platforms, APIs, data pipelines, audience services, orchestration, and activation integrations. * Define the marketing technology product vision and prioritize a multi\-year roadmap based on customer value, technical feasibility, business impact, risk, and platform health. * Establish engineering standards for security, privacy, reliability, observability, scalability, and the management of technical debt. * Lead product discovery and UX research with marketing teams globally, converting user needs into intuitive workflows and measurable product outcomes. * Evaluate build, buy, and partner options with technical rigor, and ensure third\-party platforms integrate into a coherent, maintainable architecture. **Measurement Experimentation and Audience Activation** * Lead the measurement and experimentation function, including test design, measurement frameworks, platform capabilities, and the use of results in marketing decisions. * Lead audience activation and marketing data teams responsible for identity, segmentation, consent\-aware audience management, data quality, governance, and activation readiness. * Connect audience, measurement, and activation capabilities across marketing channels so teams can plan, execute, learn, and optimize through shared data and platforms. * Partner with Data Science and Analytics leaders to embed experimentation, causal measurement, predictive models, and decision support into marketing workflows. * Assess and scale AI and automation use cases that improve marketer productivity, decision quality, and customer relevance. **Strategy and Transformation** * Serve as the technical and strategic partner to Media, Creative, Brand Marketing, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Data Science, and Business Analytics leaders. * Align SIE teams that own or influence the marketing technology stack around a single architecture, product vision, roadmap, and set of investment priorities. * Lead high\-priority transformation initiatives, managing execution, organizational dependencies, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. * Partner with marketing leaders to redesign workflows, processes, decision rights, and operating models around new platform capabilities. * Balance global platform standards with appropriate local and product\-level flexibility while maintaining security, privacy, and architectural integrity. * Define success measures and post\-launch KPI tracking for platform performance, adoption, marketing effectiveness, and business impact. **Skills and Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in software engineering, computer science, data engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience is acceptable. An advanced degree is preferred. * 12\+ years of experience across software or data engineering, technical product management, and marketing technology, including leadership of global teams. * Direct software or data engineering experience and a record of leading engineering teams that built and operated production marketing technology systems. * Demonstrated success building, launching, and operating enterprise SaaS products or internal platforms, beyond implementing or administering third\-party tools. * Technical depth in cloud architecture, APIs, systems integration, data pipelines, identity and audience systems, security, privacy, reliability, and scalability. * Experience leading multidisciplinary organizations spanning engineering, product management, UX, measurement and experimentation, analytics or data science, and audience activation. * Strong command of experimentation methods, marketing measurement, analytics, and the use of data to improve product and marketing decisions. * Experience with AI\-powered products, machine learning platforms, or automation in production environments. * Experience owning multi\-year technology and product roadmaps and making investment, architecture, and build\-versus\-buy decisions. * Ability to influence senior leaders, communicate technical tradeoffs clearly, and lead transformation across teams and regions. In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top\-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. This is a flexible role that can be remote, with varying pay ranges based on geographic location. For example, if you are based out of Seattle, the estimated base pay range for this role is listed below. $207,400—$311,200 USD Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks. jobs.title: Data Engineer, AI & Automation
jobs.description: Description: **POSITION: Data Engineer, AI \& Automation** --------------------------------------------- **Location \& Hours:** Fort Lauderdale HQ \| On\-site, Full\-time **Department:** Sound Income Strategies **FLSA Classification:** Exempt **Who We Are** -------------- **Sound Income Strategies,** a Sound Income Group company, is a Registered Investment Adviser (RIA) with $4\.5 billion in assets under management. The firm provides discretionary and non\-discretionary investment management services to independent financial advisors and their clients nationwide. As a fiduciary, Sound Income Strategies is committed to portfolio oversight, regulatory compliance, and disciplined investment implementation aligned with clients’ objectives. **Position Summary** -------------------- Sound Income Strategies is seeking a **Data Engineer, AI \& Automation** to modernize our operational data infrastructure, reporting, and business workflows. Reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer, this hands\-on individual contributor will serve as the primary internal owner of backend data engineering and applied AI automation. This role combines Snowflake expertise, strong data analysis, and production software engineering to consolidate information from custodians, trading platforms, portfolio reporting systems, and other business sources. The ideal candidate can understand how our teams work, identify valuable improvements, and independently build, deploy, and maintain reliable tools that employees use in their daily work. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Data Engineering and Data Quality** * Develop and maintain backend data pipelines, integrations, and data models in Snowflake to support accurate, accessible operational data. * Learn and work within the existing data aggregation architecture; integrate and reconcile information from custodians such as Schwab, trading platforms such as Orion, portfolio reporting systems such as Black Diamond, and supplemental sources. * Analyze source data, investigate discrepancies, and implement validation, reconciliation, and quality checks to ensure reporting and downstream applications use complete, accurate information. * Translate complex data into useful business outputs and partner with internal stakeholders and front\-end contributors to validate dashboards, reports, and application functionality. **Applied AI and Workflow Automation** * Meet directly with Operations and other SIS teams to understand manual processes, define requirements, and prioritize improvements with the CTO. * Build and deploy backend services, internal tools, and automations that improve operational efficiency and reduce repetitive manual work. * Develop production AI functionality using Anthropic Claude, including document retrieval, text extraction, document understanding, and multi\-step workflows. * Implement and maintain Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations connecting AI applications to approved tools and data sources, with appropriate permissions and human review. * Use managed model platforms such as Snowflake Cortex, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or comparable services to support practical business applications. **Production Ownership and Collaboration** * Own solutions from requirements and design through testing, deployment, documentation, user adoption, and ongoing support. * Monitor data pipelines and AI workflows; troubleshoot failures, evaluate output accuracy, and improve reliability, performance, and operating costs. * Implement access controls, logging, and appropriate safeguards for sensitive client and financial data in collaboration with the CTO and Compliance. * Participate in vendor and platform implementation meetings, learn existing systems, and coordinate technical dependencies across internal teams and external partners. * Maintain clear technical documentation and user guidance, and communicate priorities, progress, risks, and results to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Requirements: **Must\-Have Qualifications** ----------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or a related technical discipline. * 3\+ years of software engineering experience in backend, data\-intensive, or workflow automation systems, with demonstrated ability to independently build, deploy, and maintain production solutions. * Strong hands\-on proficiency in Snowflake, SQL, and a backend programming language such as Python, including experience with data modeling, APIs, and data pipelines. * Hands\-on experience integrating Claude into production business applications, including document retrieval, text extraction, and document understanding. * Practical experience implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations and working with a managed model platform such as Snowflake Cortex, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or a comparable service. * Demonstrated ownership of production LLM\-powered functionality or agentic workflows, including output evaluation, failure handling, cost management, and appropriate human review. * Experience handling sensitive data in a regulated or high\-trust environment, with strong analytical, troubleshooting, and data quality skills. * A track record of translating operational needs into practical, maintainable tools, with strong communication, documentation, collaboration, and prioritization skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in financial services preferred but not required. * Familiarity with RIA operations, custodian data, trading systems, or portfolio reporting platforms. * Experience with cloud\-based data aggregation platforms and vendor\-supported application environments. * Ability to contribute across the application stack when a business solution requires it. **Physical \& Work Environment Requirements** --------------------------------------------- * This is a full\-time onsite position based in Fort Lauderdale, FL – we are not considering remote candidates. * Ability to work for extended periods at a desk using a computer. * Ability to lift up to 10 pounds if/when necessary. **Benefits** ------------ We’re proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your professional and personal well\-being, including: * 100% employer\-covered medical benefits and HRA account * Dental \& vision plans * PTO \+ 10 NYSE company holidays per year * 401K with company match program * Free onsite parking * Company\-provided laptop and required technology * Access to an on\-site gym (free of charge) * Weekly car wash (at an additional cost) *Sound Income Group is an equal opportunity employer that complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws, rules and regulations. It is our policy to employ and promote qualified candidates without discrimination on the basis of race, color, sex, age, origin, sexual orientation, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by law. Our hiring decisions are based solely on merit, qualifications and business needs.*

jobs.description: At **Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU)**, our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people\-first philosophy. As a **Manger of IT Quality Assurance**, you will lead our Quality Assurance (QA) and Business Analysis (BA) teams within our organization. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality of our software products and services through effective QA processes while also driving business analysis activities to align IT solutions with business objectives. This role requires strong leadership skills, technical expertise in QA methodologies, and a strategic mindset to optimize IT processes and deliverables. The Manager will collaborate closely with stakeholders across the organization to gather requirements, define project scope, and ensure high\-quality software solutions are tested and delivered on time. **Why Join SCCU?** * **Member\-Focused Mission:** Be part of a not\-for\-profit organization that reinvests in its members. * **Hybrid and Flexible Schedule Options:** Available for select positions. This position is Hybrid with 2 days per week required in office. * **Career Growth:** We prioritize internal promotions and offer on\-the\-job training. **Manger of IT Quality Assurance Key Responsibilities:** * Provide leadership, guidance, and mentorship to the IT quality assurance and business analysis teams. Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment, promoting professional growth and development opportunities. * Recruit, mentor, and develop team members to ensure high performance and career growth. Set clear goals and objectives for the teams and monitor performance against these targets. * Collaborate closely with Systems Development, and other departments to translate business requirements into technical specifications and solutions. * Facilitate communication between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure alignment throughout the project lifecycle. * Work closely with project managers and teams to ensure QA and BA activities are integrated into project plans and timelines. Monitor project progress, identify risks and issues, and implement mitigation strategies. * Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of IT business analysis and quality assurance processes. * Tool selection for QA and BA teams to mature their processes within the organization. Quality Assurance * Oversee the quality assurance process, including test planning, execution, and reporting. Develop and implement quality assurance standards and best practices. * Ensure that all software products meet established quality criteria, including functionality, performance, and reliability. * Organize, manage, and assist manual and automated testing to ensure minimal production defect. * Facilitate the decomposition of business requirements, into Use Cases and Acceptance Criteria * Organize and manage manual and automated test case libraries. * Participate in deployment testing exercises, and SCRUM events as needed. * Lead Instructor Training on QA\-related topics. * Keep abreast of changes in technology, standards, and relevant developments in IT \& testing by maintaining professional competency through training, reading, etc. * Lead QA process improvement initiatives and identify opportunities for automation and optimization to streamline workflows. Business Analysis * Lead the IT business analysis team in gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements. * Work closely with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into functional specifications. * Ensure that proposed solutions meet business objectives and address key challenges or opportunities. * Coordinate the requirements gathering process for applications, overseeing documentation and validation of changes. * Stay informed about emerging technologies, trends, and best practices in IT business analysis and quality assurance. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or other relevant degree or equivalent experience is required. * 8\-10 years of experience in IT business analysis or quality assurance required, with a minimum of 5 years in IT Management. **Manger of IT Quality Assurance Compensation:** * Starting Compensation: $131,940\.00 \- $139,734\.00 annually * Bonus Opportunity: Eligible for ONE SCCU Annual Bonus. **SCCU Benefits** * Health \& Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus an Employee Assistance Program. * Financial Perks: 401(k) match (5%), HSA match, and SCCU\-paid insurance (short/long\-term disability, life insurance). * Education Support: Tuition reimbursement after one year of service. * Generous Time Off: 20\+ days of PTO, birthday PTO, and 11 federal holidays. * Exclusive Discounts: Lower rates on loans, credit cards, and no fee SCCU accounts! **Work Schedule** * Monday – Friday: 8:00 a.m. \- 5: er understand that my employment is for no definite period and may be terminated at any time without prior notice.* Show this detailed description on internal job boards No Detailed description for internal job boards **Manger of IT Development Duties and Responsibilities:** * Manage the resources and activities of the IT Application Development team comprised of on and off\-shore technical professionals responsible for providing software solutions for SCCU’s custom built and vendor provided applications. * Develop, maintain and execute on an IT Roadmap that will effectively forecast and meet the business’ needs. * Understand key stakeholder’s needs, features, and functionality and provide technical solutions that will address their software application needs. * Manage and execute project plans to deliver commitments with quality within the agreed upon timelines and budgets. * Work with project management to ensure accurate project status is provided regularly, risks are anticipated and mitigated, and issues are raised and addressed quickly. * Staff projects with the appropriate technical talent, track progress, and provide guidance and direction to help remove impediments and meet project milestones and timelines. * Drive continuous improvement by utilizing metrics and team feedback to identify and improve software engineering practices, processes, development and delivery. * Provide coaching, technical direction, supervision and development of the IT Application Development team. * Conduct regular meetings with direct reports to set objectives, review their workload and performance. Provide mentorship and support to help them achieve their career development goals. **Minimum Qualifications:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the minimum level of knowledge, skills and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions: * Demonstrated project management leading or supervising systems/applications development team members utilizing proven SDLC methodologies such as Waterfall and Agile (Kanban, Scrum) overseeing the technology life cycle from requirements analysis, feasibility estimates, design, code, documentation, testing, implementation, and support. * Experience designing software for scalability, reliability, and performance using Microsoft Stack (.NET framework, MVC, ASP.NET, VB.Net, C\#, React or Angular/Blazor, ASPX, WPF, WinForms), JSON, XML, SOAP, and relational database development (SQL Server, Oracle). * Ability to build strong relationships with diverse teams within an organization * Ability to handle multiple, competing priorities, and navigate ambiguity * Strong leadership, communication and organizational skills * A deep understanding of the software development life\-cycle, and a track record of shipping software on time * A passion for people management and mentorship **Education \& Training:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or other related field is required, ITIL certification strongly preferred. **Prior Experience:** * 8\-10 years of related experience required; 5 years of experience working directly within engineering teams, 3\+ years of managing teams within a development organization, 5\+ years developing and building scalable enterprise software engineers people management in a technology function to include 3 years of demonstrated leadership capabilities, demonstrated in a management role of IT Professionals in a Software Development/Engineering environment. Preferred experience managing both on\-shore and off\-shore development teams. jobs.description: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. They will administer our current BI platform, build dashboards quickly, and partner with the business to shape a modern, unified reporting and analytics solution. ### **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Business\-critical responsibilities include, but are not limited to: + Administering our BI platform (currently Tableau Server) as its sole administrator: upgrades, patches, maintenance, license management, SSO, and data drivers + Supporting 12 department sites and their Site Admins, plus about 700 users, including owning the tbl\-site\-admins and tableau Slack channels + Handling all BI requests through Slack and Jira (about 12 a week): access, ownership changes, data source issues, troubleshooting, and fixing bugs + Communicating proactively with Site Admins, users, and developers about downtime, upgrades, and widespread issues + Quickly designing and building dashboards and data products that turn complex data into clear, decision\-ready insight + Maintaining an inventory of existing reports and dashboards and working with business owners to decide what to migrate, rebuild, or retire + Helping stakeholders pick the right solution for each use case (dashboard, custom application, Grok team bot, and so on) and leading the migration to it + Setting standards for data access, row\-level security, and visualization quality ### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * Strong SQL, including complex joins, window functions, and performance tuning * Data visualization and dashboard design: chart selection, UX, and storytelling with data * Row\-level security and data access controls * Rapid dashboard development in one or more BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Superset, or similar) * Platform administration fundamentals: SSO/SAML, APIs, and monitoring * Comfort using AI tools to speed up analysis, development, and migrations ### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Data modeling and warehouse concepts (star schemas, semantic layers) on platforms such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Databricks * Python or JavaScript for data prep, automation, or custom visuals ### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:** $132,000 \- $198,000 USD Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short \& long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks. *SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. This role supports a Windows\-centric environment with on\-premises Active Directory that is transitioning to Microsoft Entra ID, along with macOS and Linux endpoints, local networks and peripherals, and a mix of on\-premises, AWS, Azure, and vendor\-hosted cloud systems that keep lab production running. The Engineer I is a first point of hands\-on contact for keeping lab staff and production equipment productive and contributes directly to the company's directory and device\-management modernization. This is an early\-career position well\-suited for someone with one to two years of help desk or desktop support experience, or equivalent training, who wants broad exposure across endpoints, identity, networking, and cloud. Breadth of familiarity is valued over depth; the Engineer I will receive active mentorship from the IT and engineering team and is expected to build technical depth on the job. A Level I engineer reliably performs foundational support work with guidance and is beginning to take on more independent troubleshooting. The position is based primarily on\-site at the Cumming, GA lab, with remote work when business needs require. This role is not expected to travel; travel to another lab location would be infrequent and occur only if an unusual situation requires on\-site support. This position reports to the IT Operations Supervisor. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS **Technical Skills** * **Windows Endpoints:** Working proficiency supporting Windows 10/11 desktops and laptops, including setup and reprovisioning, drivers, patches, user profiles, printers, and common peripherals * **Identity \& Directory:** Foundational experience with Active Directory user and group administration (account creation, password resets, unlocks, group membership); awareness of Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, and how cloud identity differs from on\-premises AD * **Microsoft 365:** Ability to support Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint for end users, including mailbox access, sync, and basic licensing issues * **Networking:** Understands core networking concepts including TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, Wi\-Fi, and VPN; can use basic tools (ping, ipconfig, tracert, nslookup) to isolate connectivity problems before escalating * **macOS \& Linux:** Basic ability to navigate and troubleshoot macOS and Linux systems, including user accounts, network settings, application installation, and common command\-line tasks * **Cloud Fundamentals:** Conceptual understanding of AWS and Azure (virtual machines, storage, identities and roles) sufficient to triage user\-facing issues with cloud\-hosted applications and route them correctly * **Ticketing \& Remote Support:** Experience working from a ticket queue, documenting troubleshooting steps and resolutions, and supporting users with remote\-control tools **Soft Skills** * **Customer Service:** Patient, professional, and approachable with non\-technical users; able to resolve issues with minimal disruption to lab production * **Communication:** Explains technical issues in plain language; communicates clearly by phone, Teams, and email with users at remote labs; escalates issues with relevant context and steps already taken * **Ownership \& Follow\-Through:** Takes responsibility for tickets from intake through resolution; follows documented procedures; keeps users informed of status * **Learning \& Adaptability:** Eager to build depth across Windows, identity, networking, and cloud; asks questions after doing initial research; comfortable with change during an active systems modernization * **Discretion:** Handles access to user accounts, devices, and patient\-related data with confidentiality and sound judgment Preferred Qualifications * Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience * Entry\-level certifications such as CompTIA A\+, Network\+, or Security\+; Microsoft 365 Fundamentals (MS\-900\), Azure Fundamentals (AZ\-900\), or Endpoint Administrator (MD\-102\); or AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner * Exposure to Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, or other endpoint management tools * Exposure to hybrid identity concepts (Entra Connect or Cloud Sync, hybrid\-joined devices) or participation in an AD\-to\-Entra migration * Experience with Apple device management (Jamf, Intune for macOS, or similar) * Familiarity with basic scripting in PowerShell or Bash to automate routine tasks * Experience supporting multi\-site organizations or remote locations * Experience in a regulated healthcare, medical device, or manufacturing environment (e.g., HIPAA, ISO 13485\) * Exposure to supporting 3D scanners, 3D printers, CAD workstations, or other specialized product ups and offboarding * Support CAD and production workstations and connected lab equipment, coordinating with vendors when issues fall outside internal scope * Apply software updates and patches following established schedules and change procedures * Maintain accurate hardware and software asset inventory * Be available for occasional after\-hours or weekend work for maintenance windows and urgent production issues across Eastern and Central time zones **Identity, Access \& Microsoft 365** * Perform routine Active Directory and Entra ID account administration, including onboarding, offboarding, password resets, account unlocks, and group membership changes, following documented procedures * Support MFA enrollment, sign\-in issues, and access\-related user problems, escalating policy changes to senior team members * Assist with user\- and device\-level tasks for the transition from on\-premises Active Directory to Entra ID, including device enrollment, user communication, and post\-migration troubleshooting, under guidance * Support Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint **Network \& Infrastructure Support** * Perform first\-line troubleshooting of wired, wireless, VPN, and internet connectivity issues at all labs, gathering diagnostic details before escalating * Complete physical infrastructure tasks at the Cumming site such as patching cables, replacing network devices, moving equipment, and checking UPS units * Serve as on\-site hands for senior engineers and vendors performing infrastructure work at the Cumming site, and coordinate remote hands at other labs * Monitor assigned system and service health alerts and route issues to the appropriate owner **Cloud \& Vendor Systems Support** * Triage user\-reported issues with cloud\-hosted and vendor\-hosted applications (AWS, Azure, and vendor\-specific platforms), determining whether the cause is local, network, identity, or service\-side * Open, track, and follow up on vendor support cases, keeping users and internal stakeholders informed * Perform basic, well\-documented administrative tasks in AWS and Azure as assigned, with appropriate access and oversight **Documentation, Security \& Compliance** * Document tickets thoroughly, including troubleshooting steps, root cause where known, and resolution * Create and maintain knowledge base articles, how\-to guides, and standard procedures for recurring issues * Follow security and compliance practices required by HIPAA, ISO 13485, and 21 CFR Part 11, including access controls, change records, and handling of protected health information * Report suspected security incidents, phishing attempts, or policy violations promptly through established channels **AI Tooling \& Practices** * Use AI\-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Microsoft Copilot) to research issues, draft documentation and knowledge base articles, and build simple scripts * Verify AI\-generated outputs before acting on them, especially commands or configuration changes applied to production systems * Follow organizational policies for AI usage and avoid sharing sensitive company or patient information with external AI services **Collaboration \& Growth** * Communicate clearly with team members about work status, progress, and blockers * Ask questions to seek help and clarification after doing initial research, without waiting too long when stuck * Receive feedback graciously and apply it to improve work quality * Help others when asked and provide constructive feedback where possible * Participate in learning activities, including agreed training and certification goals, and treat everyone with respect * Participate in culture fit interviews as part of the recruiting process BENEFITS AVAILABLE INCLUDE: * Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance * Short\-term Disability, Long\-term Disability, AD\&D and Life Insurance Policies * Paid Vacations * 9 Paid Company Holidays * Bonus Plan * 401(k) with Company Match **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**

jobs.title: Data Engineer II
jobs.description: SpyCloud is on a mission to make the internet a safer place by disrupting the criminal underground. SpyCloud's solutions thwart cyberattacks and protect more than 4 billion accounts worldwide. Cybersecurity is an exciting, evolving space, and being at the forefront of the fight to disrupt cybercrime makes SpyCloud a special place to work. If you're driven to align your career with a fantastic mission, look no further! This Data Engineer II role sits on the Engineering team, reporting to the Senior Director of Data Engineering. Your focus will include evolving our data platform using technologies such as Databricks and Spark, building scalable data pipelines, and serving customers through purpose\-built data stores including RDS, Elasticsearch, and DynamoDB. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with ownership of complex data engineering initiatives that support the scalability, reliability, and continued evolution of SpyCloud's data platform. **What You'll Do:** * Design, build, and improve scalable data systems with a focus on performance, and reliability. * Use Databricks and Spark to prepare, transform, and serve high\-quality data to customers and downstream systems. * Build, optimize, and maintain real\-time and batch data pipelines using AWS technologies such as Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, ECS, EKS, and Terraform, as well as develop and maintain pipelines within the Databricks ecosystem. * Identify and implement improvements to the cost and performance of data ingestion, transformation, and storage workflows. * Be available for on\-call support to troubleshoot and remediate data pipeline failures outside of standard business hours. * Partner with Product Management, SpyCloud Labs, and Engineering teams to understand requirements and develop effective technical solutions. * Evaluate and implement modern tooling for data processing, ML/AI data workflows, and observability. * Contribute to architectural and technical design decisions and help implement scalable solutions aligned with engineering standards. * Promote engineering best practices through collaboration, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing. * Identify and resolve complex data quality, performance, security, and reliability issues across production systems. * Independently own complex data engineering initiatives from design and development through deployment and production support. * Contribute to the continued evolution of SpyCloud's data platform as product, customer, and AI requirements grow. **Requirements:** * 5\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, or a closely related discipline. * Experience building and operating Lakehouse, Databricks, or large\-scale distributed data architectures in AWS. * Strong understanding of distributed systems as they relate to data storage, processing, and computing. * Experience building and managing Elasticsearch/OpenSearch data stores. * Hands\-on experience designing, building, and maintaining ETL and data\-processing pipelines. * Experience preparing and managing data for machine learning and LLM workflows. * Strong development skills in Python, particularly when building data\-intensive systems. * Practical experience with DynamoDB and other AWS\-native data services. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform. * Experience troubleshooting complex data pipeline, performance, and data quality issues in production environments. * Ability to independently own complex technical projects from design and development through deployment and production support. * Ability to evaluate technical trade\-offs and contribute effectively to architectural and design decisions. * Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Nice to Have:** * Familiarity with AI/ML tools and technologies such as SageMaker, LangChain, or vector databases. * Understanding of data governance, privacy, and compliance considerations within AI and ML environments. * Experience with observability and monitoring tools for large\-scale data platforms. * Experience with Go or C programming languages. * Experience working with cybersecurity or security\-related datasets and technologies. * Comfort working in fast\-paced environments with evolving product and technical requirements. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field. **Base Salary Range:** $104,000 – $135,000 The salary range reflects the expected base compensation for a fully qualified candidate at this level based on experience, qualifications, and market data at the time of posting. **U.S.\-Based Benefits \+ Perks (for Full Time Employees):** At SpyCloud, we are committed to working alongside individuals who are equally passionate about preventing cybercrime, regardless of their department or role. Guided by our core values in all business decisions, we prioritize unity in our mission and ensure all SpyCloud  phishes, combolists, and third\-party breaches also powers many popular dark web monitoring and identity theft protection offerings. Customers include 7 of the Fortune 10, along with hundreds of global enterprises, mid\-sized companies, and government agencies worldwide. Headquartered in Austin, TX, SpyCloud is home to more than 250 cybersecurity experts whose mission is to protect businesses and consumers from the stolen identity data criminals are using to target them now. To learn more and see insights on your company's exposed data, visit spycloud.com. **Our Mission:** Our mission is to make the internet a safer place by disrupting the criminal underground. Together with our customers and partners, we aim to end criminals' ability to profit from stolen information. **Who We Are:** SpyCloud is a place for innovative, collaborative, and problem\-solvers to thrive. Individually, we're amazing, but together, we're unstoppable. We celebrate diversity and various perspectives and aim to create an inclusive and supportive environment for all. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer of choice. All aspects of employment decisions will be based on merit, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of any status protected under federal, state, or local law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, and protected veterans are encouraged to apply. SpyCloud complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. SpyCloud expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment. Improper interference with the ability of SpyCloud's employees to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge. SpyCloud shares the right to work and participates in the E\-Verify program in all locations. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us. **Our Culture:** Our culture is something really special. We're all driven to disrupt the cybercriminal economy as we keep customer accounts safe from compromise. We support a truly worthy and serious mission, but we have fun doing it together. If you are driven, inventive, and collaborative, you'll fit right in. **SpyCloud's Recruitment Policy:** We will never ask an applicant for sensitive or personal financial information during the recruitment process. We advise all applicants seeking employment with SpyCloud to review available information on recruitment fraud. Anyone who suspects that they have been contacted by someone falsely representing SpyCloud should email careers@spycloud.com. **Compensation Transparency Policy:** At SpyCloud, we believe in transparency and fairness in compensation. We strive to ensure that all employees are fairly compensated for their contributions, and we openly discuss our compensation philosophy and structure. We are committed to providing competitive salaries and benefits packages to attract and retain top talent, and we encourage open dialogue and feedback regarding compensation matters. Learn more and apply: SpyCloud Careers SpyCloud is not sponsoring visas at this time. For applicants residing in California, please click here to read SpyCloud's CCPA Notice.
