jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data Science and Machine Learning
jobs.description: **Senior Manager, Data Science and Machine Learning** ===================================================== New York, NY Squarespace is hiring a Senior Manager, Data Science and Machine Learning to lead the team behind our predictive models, causal inference frameworks, and AI evaluation systems. These are the tools that inform how we acquire customers, keep them, and serve them at scale. Reporting to the VP of Data, you'll lead a team of 12 data scientists and ML engineers doing work that is directly tied to how Squarespace leverages AI and data\-driven capabilities. You will work closely with product, engineering, and analytics partners across the organization to introduce new ways to leverage data in our products and decision systems, for customers and internal use. This is an opportunity to step into a critical senior leadership seat and set the direction for how machine learning and data science are practiced at Squarespace. This is a hybrid role working from our NYC office 3 days per week. You will report to the VP, Data. **You'll Get To...** -------------------- * Lead and develop a team of 12, including three direct reports who manage their own teams * Set the technical and strategic direction for predictive modeling, causal inference, and AI evaluation across Squarespace's product and business priorities * Apply data science to Squarespace's biggest growth levers: marketing measurement, sales growth, product optimization, customer support allocation, and risk and credit modeling * Partner with product, engineering, and business leaders to translate complex statistical and ML work into decisions and systems that drive customer acquisition, retention, engagement, and growth across our global products. * Build the systems, processes, and team culture that raise the quality and speed of data science delivery across the organization * Evolve the team's ML infrastructure and tooling as AI capabilities at Squarespace grow **Who We're Looking For** ------------------------- * 12\+ years in data science or machine learning, including experience leading technical teams through complex, high\-stakes projects * 5\+ years managing managers, with demonstrated ability to develop senior individual contributors and team leads simultaneously * Hands\-on experience building or overseeing production predictive models, causal inference frameworks, or AI evaluation systems * Skill at aligning product, engineering, and business partners around a shared roadmap and navigating trade\-offs clearly, especially in explaining statistical or technical trade\-offs to executives without losing the nuance * Experience scaling a data science or ML function, including team structure, hiring, and technical standards **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building or overseeing LLM evaluation harnesses, including golden sets and LLM\-as\-judge methods * Familiarity with prompt and model lifecycle management in production * Experience designing human\-in\-the\-loop review for AI\-driven features * Background in marketing science, experimentation, or credit/risk modeling **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- * A choice between medical plans with an option for 100% covered premiums including medical, dental, and vision * Supplemental Life and Disability Insurance plans * Fertility and adoption benefits * Headspace mindfulness app subscription * Global Employee Assistance Program * Retirement benefits with employer match * Flexible paid time off * 12 weeks paid parental leave and family care leave * Pretax commuter benefit * Education reimbursement * Employee donation match to community organizations * 7 Global Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) * Dog\-friendly workplace * Free lunch and snacks * Private rooftop * Hack week twice per year ### **Cash Compensation Range: $223,000 \- $358,800 USD** The base salary for this position will vary based on job\-related criteria including relevant skills, experience, and location, among other factors. In addition to the cash compensation above (which includes base salary and, where applicable for eligible roles, may include overtime pay), Squarespace employees are eligible to be granted an option to purchase our common stock. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive structure in addition to base salary. **About Squarespace** --------------------- Squarespace is a design\-driven platform helping entrepreneurs build brands and businesses online. We empower millions of customers in more than 200 countries and territories with all the tools they need to create an online presence, build an audience, monetize, and scale their business. Our suite of products — from Squarespace and Squarespace Payments, to subsidiaries like Tock, Bio Sites, and Unfold, as well as Acuity Scheduling — works together to help customers stand out and succeed online. By fundamentally changing the way individuals and businesses around the world build an online presence, we empower our customers with a competitive advantage in reaching their audience. The company is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Dublin and Aveiro. For more information about our company, visit https://www.squarespace.com/about\-us. **Our Commitment** ------------------ Today, more than a million people around the globe use Squarespace to share different perspectives and experiences with the world. Not only do we embrace and celebrate the diversity of our customers, but we also work toward the same in our employees. At Squarespace, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. \#LI\-Hybrid **Thank you in advance for providing the following details about your work history from your resume! This helps us ensure that your candidate information is accurate and consistent during the hiring process.** **Squarespace will never solicit your personal banking information or ask you to transfer money in connection with a job offer or interview. We also will not reach out to you via phone or SMS without your permission or knowledge.** **If you plan to use AI in any capacity during your candidate journey, please review our** **Candidate AI Policy****.**

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Acoustics
jobs.description: Join Starkey as a software engineer and help turn advances in hearing science, acoustics, and signal processing into innovative features that improve people’s lives. Collaborate with talented, cross\-functional teams, grow your expertise in a modern C\#/.NET environment, and make every detail count as we help the world hear and live better. Starkey is a world leader in the manufacturing and distribution of advanced hearing technologies. We are in the business of connecting people and changing lives. Our teams come to work each day focused on ensuring people everywhere have the products and services they need to hear better and live better. Founded in 1967 by Bill Austin, Starkey is known for our cutting\-edge hearing health innovations, industry\-leading research and development, and not being afraid to push the edge of what’s possible. We are headquartered in Eden Prairie, Minnesota, have over 5,000 employees in 29 facilities across the globe, and do business in more than 100 markets worldwide. Watch this video to see more of what sets Starkey apart: https://youtu.be/9cUYwTlCepg?si\=wkovx8\_R\_iINfrc6 (https://youtu.be/9cUYwTlCepg?si\=wkovx8\_R\_iINfrc6\) Starkey is looking for a software engineer to work at the intersection of software engineering, hearing science, acoustics, and signal processing. In this unique position, you will join our software engineering team and collaborate heavily with other various teams to bring innovative new hearing aid features to market. This is an opportunity to join a team that does meaningful work surrounded by other bright and talented engineers. The ideal candidate for this position is someone who takes pride in learning how complex systems work, has an interest in translating the physical world to the digital one, and pays attention to minute details that others do not notice. In the world of hearing aids, every millimeter, decibel, and bit matters: come join a team that brings that spirit with them to work every day as we help the world to hear better and live better! *You Will Be* * Working in a modern C\#/.NET codebase that is leveraged by all of Starkey’s customer\-facing and internal software applications to program hearing aids * Working with R\&D cross\-functional teams to build and maintain the subsystem of our fitting software that is focused on modelling the acoustics of our hearing aids as well as the impact of new signal processing algorithms on acoustic performance * Collaborating with clinical and customer\-facing teams to debug and root cause issues that audiologists face in the field * Learning to balance tradeoffs and technical constraints that impact acoustic performance, usability, and maintainability for patients and clinicians * Analyzing and presenting data to decision\-making stakeholders * Receiving mentorship from seasoned software engineers and engineers in other disciplines as you learn the hearing aid domain from every angle *Our Culture Provides* * An experienced and knowledgeable team with a culture of professional growth and knowledge sharing * Fun\-loving work environment * An excellent work/life balance * Hybrid work environment * Excellent starting salary, competitive benefits package, and company paid continuing education *You Will Need* * Experience and interest in both software development and acoustics with a bachelor’s degree in at least one of these areas: computer science, electrical engineering, hearing science, audiology (or adjacent domain) * Understanding of object\-oriented software design * A learner’s mindset with a willingness to ask questions and soak up knowledge * Ability to thrive in a team environment * Passion for science, data\-driven decision making, and experimentation *Salary and Other Compensation:* *The target pay rate for this position is between $94,000 \- $131,000 annually. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include: geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.* *This position is eligible for a bonus based upon performance results. There is no guarantee of payout.* *The following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements, include medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan with company match, company\-paid life and short\-term disability insurance, long\-term disability insurance, employee assistance plan, hearing aid benefits, Paid Time Off, paid holidays, paid floating holidays, paid volunteer service day, paid paternity and maternity leave and tuition reimbursement.* \#LI\-MP1 Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Pega Software Engineer - Financial Services
jobs.description: Overview: Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most. **Office Location(s)**: Bloomington, IL; Dallas, TX; Atlanta, GA; Phoenix, AZ **Hybrid Work arrangement:** A **"Hybrid"** position means selected candidates will be assigned to a facility and will spend some time working both in office and from their home. Hybrid work arrangement for Enterprise Technology is defined as residing within a 180\-mile radius of the Hubs and Corporate. **\*\*\*\*\*Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g. H\-1B visa) for this opportunity\*\*\*\*\*** Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential: Responsibilities: Join the State Farm Life Workflow / Pega team to build and modernize workflow\-driven applications that power Life policy administration across Underwriting, Service, and Claims. You’ll design Pega (PRPC) case/workflow solutions and REST integrations that improve operational reliability, reduce time\-to\-market, and deliver better experiences for customers and agents. Qualifications: **Required Qualifications** * Pega Platform (Pega 24\.x\+) development experience (case/workflow \+ rules). * Java \+ REST/API integration experience. * HTML experience for UI enhancements/components. * Experience delivering and supporting enterprise applications end\-to\-end. * Experience supporting applications and API’s by analyzing logs and using Pega debugging tools. * Strong communication and collaboration skills for delivering business outcomes. **Preferred Qualifications** * Life insurance / insurance domain experience. * Production reliability experience (performance tuning, reliability improvements, runbooks/automation). * Dynatrace experience (dashboards, alerting/triage patterns). * Postgres experience. * Cloud experience (AWS) and/or Kubernetes. * Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) / identity integration. * Automated testing experience and CI/CD maturity. * Pega certifications (CSA/SSA/LSA) and/or demonstrated architecture leadership. **\*\*\*\*\*Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g. H\-1B visa) for this opportunity\*\*\*\*\*** Our Benefits: Because work\-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45\-hour work week! * Potential starting salary range: $97,000 \- $130,000 * + Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience + High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience * Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary **At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. jobs.title: Home Office - Technical Delivery Manager
jobs.description: Join Our Team as a Technical Delivery Manager! Do you enjoy structure, visibility and accountability? We’re looking for a Technical Delivery Manager to serve as the bridge between our business teams and software development organization. We need someone who understands how software work moves from an initial business request to clear requirements, development, testing, release, and completion. If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you! **Compensation:** $105,000\-$125,000 commensurate with experience **What You’ll Do:** * Serve as the primary coordination point between business stakeholders and the software development team for assigned initiatives, enhancements, defects, and support\-related development work. * Manage and govern the intake of technical requests across Monday.com, Freshservice, and other approved channels, ensuring work is documented, categorized, assigned, and routed appropriately. * Review incoming requests to confirm the business problem, desired outcome, priority, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and required stakeholder decisions are clearly understood before development begins. * Facilitate conversations between business and technical teams, translating business needs into actionable work without losing the intent behind the request. * Maintain a consolidated view of open development work, including website initiatives, operational projects, defects, enhancements, technical dependencies, and Freshservice tickets requiring engineering support. * Act as the gatekeeper for work entering the development queue, helping prevent incomplete, duplicative, unapproved, or poorly defined requests from disrupting active priorities. * Partner with business and technology leaders to establish priorities and ensure the development team is working on the highest\-value approved items. * Coordinate work through discovery, design, development, testing, release, and closure, ensuring ownership and next steps remain clear throughout the process. * Lead or facilitate standups, refinement sessions, planning discussions, delivery reviews, retrospectives, and stakeholder status meetings when needed. * Identify blockers, stalled decisions, cross\-team dependencies, scope changes, and resource conflicts early, and drive them toward resolution. * Coordinate development work originating from Freshservice, ensuring support tickets are appropriately linked, tracked, communicated, and closed once development work is completed. * Protect the development team from unnecessary interruptions and context switching by helping stakeholders follow an organized intake and prioritization process. * Ensure Monday.com boards and related workflow tools accurately reflect the current status, ownership, priority, risks, dependencies, and next actions for open work. * Provide clear, concise updates to leadership and stakeholders regarding progress, risks, decisions needed, delivery expectations, and changes in priority. * Coordinate with UX, QA, marketing, infrastructure, support, vendors, and other teams when successful delivery requires work outside the development group. * Help establish practical delivery standards, including definitions of ready and done, acceptance criteria, testing expectations, release readiness, documentation, and post\-release validation. * Support the organization’s continued adoption of Kanban, continuous delivery, work\-in\-progress limits, cycle\-time measurement, and other flow\-based delivery practices. * Continuously improve the way technical work is requested, reviewed, prioritized, delivered, communicated, and measured. * Who We’re Looking For: * Bring 3–5 years of experience in technical project management, delivery management, program management, business analysis, product operations, or a similar role supporting software development teams. * Have experience serving as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, particularly when requirements are initially incomplete or priorities compete. * Understand the software development lifecycle and can follow technical discussions, ask informed questions, and recognize when requirements, dependencies, or proposed solutions do not align. * Have strong project and work\-management discipline, including experience managing backlogs, priorities, dependencies, risks, decisions, milestones, and stakeholder communication. * Are comfortable owning the administrative and operational discipline required to keep Monday.com, Jira, Azure DevOps, Freshservice, or similar systems accurate and current. * Can distinguish between an operational support issue, a defect, an enhancement, a project, and a larger product or architectural decision, and route each appropriately. * Know how to turn loosely defined requests into clear, actionable work without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. * Are confident in facilitating conversations with executives, business leaders, engineers, designers, support teams, and external partners. * Communicate clearly and directly, providing enough information for stakeholders to stay aligned without overwhelming them with unnecessary detail. * Are comfortable pushing back constructively when work is not ready, priorities are unclear, scope is expanding, or new requests would disrupt committed work. * Take ownership of follow\-through and do not wait for others to surface stalled decisions, blockers, or missed commitments. * Can bring structure to an environment that is still maturing its project intake, prioritization, development, testing, and release\-management practices. * Are collaborative, practical, organized, and low ego, with a strong bias toward helping the broader team succeed. * Other Qualifications (not mandatory): * Experience coordinating websites, e\-commerce, customer\-facing digital, or multi\-brand development work. * Experience managing development work originating from an IT service management platform such as Freshservice or ServiceNow. * Experience designing or improving intake, prioritization, backlog, release\-management, or demand\-management processes. * Experience supporting a transition from sprint\-based Agile practices to Kanban or continuous delivery. * Experience with cycle time, throughput, aging work in progress, cumulative flow, or other delivery\-performance metrics. * Background in business analysis, software development, UX, QA, IT operations, or technical support. * Experience working in storage, real estate technology, retail, e\-commerce, or other multi\-location operating environments. * Certifications such as PMP, PMI\-ACP, PSM, CSM, or Kanban\-related credentials are helpful but not required. * Why You’ll Love Working Here: * Innovative Environment: Be part of a forward\-thinking team that values creativity and technical excellence. * Growth Opportunities: Develop your skills and career with mentorship from senior leaders and exposure to new technologies. * Collaborative Culture: Work in a supportive and collaborative environment where your contributions make a real difference. * Work Environment: This position is located at our home office in Columbia, MO. * Work Hours: We operate primarily on a standard business\-hours schedule with some flexibility, and we maintain a culture where work\-life balance is taken seriously. Ready to take your career to the next level? Apply now and be a key player in shaping our digital future! \#SMH1

jobs.title: Principal AI & Business Process Automation Engineer

process automation, systems integration, business process improvement, or related technical work. * Experience documenting, designing, developing, and implementing technical solutions that automate business processes or integrate business systems. * Practical experience applying AI and generative AI technologies to business or technical solutions. * Experience working with enterprise systems, APIs, workflow automation, cloud services, or related integration technologies. * Strong business analysis and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to understand and document business problems, process maps, and workflows then translate them into practical solutions. * Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work directly with business and technical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience developing AI agents, chatbots, AI\-enabled knowledge systems, or other AI automation solutions. * Experience deploying or maintaining private or operations, sales and sales operations, accounting, finance, or other business functions. * Experience with Infor SyteLine or similar manufacturing ERP systems. * Experience with platforms such as HubSpot CRM, StarShip, Power BI/Fabric, SharePoint, or Power Automate. * Relevant AI, cloud, or automation certifications. **Location:** This position is located in Longmont, CO. **Base Compensation:** $120,000 \- $176,000 is the projected base salary range and will be determined by the candidate’s overall qualifications and experience. **Bonus:** This position is eligible for an We welcome all applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **How You'll Make An Impact** At Strive Health, patients come first. We're on a mission to transform chronic conditions by identifying risk earlier, coordinating thoughtful care, and supporting people through every stage of their health journey. Our work reduces emergency visits, improves outcomes, and helps patients live fuller lives. You'll work alongside passionate Strivers who care deeply about making an impact, show up for one another as One Team, and find ways to elevate the everyday. If you're looking for meaningful work where your contributions truly matter, you'll feel right at home at Strive! **Benefits \& Perks** * **Hybrid\-Remote Flexibility** –Work from home while fulfilling in\-person needs at the office, clinic, or patient home visits. * **Comprehensive Benefits** – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance programs, employer\-paid and voluntary life and disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts. * **Financial \& Retirement Support** – Competitive compensation with a performance\-based bonus program, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources. * **Time Off \& Leave** – Paid holidays, vacation time, sick time, and paid birthgiving, bonding, sabbatical, and living donor leaves. * **Wellness \& Growth** – Family forming services through Maven Maternity at no cost and physical wellness perks, mental health support, and an annual professional development stipend. To learn more about our offerings, click **here**. **What** **You'll** **Do** As a Staff Software Engineer in our Product \& Technology organization, you will help define and evolve the technical strategy and architecture of Strive's platform, ensuring engineering decisions align tightly with our clinical and business goals. This is a senior, hands\-on individual contributor role. You will take on the most complex and ambiguous technical problems, designing and building scalable, reliable, and secure software while balancing the need to maintain and scale existing systems with the need to deliver new capabilities for patients, clinicians, and partners. Your impact will extend well beyond the systems you build yourself. You will help teams make sound architectural decisions, establish reusable patterns and standards, address systemic technical risk, and mentor engineers across multiple teams, raising the bar on design, implementation quality, and cross\-functional collaboration. This role reports to a Senior Engineering Manager or Director of Engineering. **The Day to Day** * Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for one or more critical domains within Strive's platform, grounded in our business objectives and long\-term product vision. * Design and deliver end\-to\-end solutions for complex, cross\-team initiatives, from problem framing and architecture through implementation, rollout, and production operation. * Stay hands\-on in the code, writing high\-quality, well\-tested, observable software, especially where complexity, risk, or ambiguity calls for senior engineering leadership. * Make pragmatic architectural tradeoffs that balance scalability, reliability, security, compliance, delivery speed, cost, and long\-term maintainability, while keeping the platform simple for other engineers to build on. * Design and evolve the APIs, services, data models, integrations, and distributed systems that support Strive's products and healthcare operations. * Partner with Product, Clinical, Data, Security, and Operations leaders to make sure we solve the right problems in the right order, with clear outcomes and measures of success. * Identify systemic technical risks, architectural limitations, performance bottlenecks, and technical debt, and lead the work to address them. * Establish reusable architectural patterns, reference implementations, and engineering standards that help teams build consistently and effectively. * Drive platform\-wide improvements in developer experience, reliability, observability, security posture, and performance that measurably improve how engineering delivers value. * Provide technical leadership across teams by facilitating design and architecture reviews, guiding major engineering decisions, and unblocking teams through hands\-on help. * Participate in production support and incident response, helping teams find root causes and turn operational lessons into better architecture, tooling, and practices. * Collaborate with Security and Compliance to ensure systems protect sensitive healthcare information and meet regulatory and organizational requirements. * Mentor and coach engineers and tech leads through design discussions, code reviews, pairing, and day\-to\-day work, helping them strengthen their technical judgment and grow as owners of their domains. * Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI\-assisted engineering tools, and identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, software quality, and engineering effectiveness. * Co xperience building them into application and system design. * Strong experience designing and scaling distributed systems, event\-driven architectures, and data pipelines on AWS or a similar cloud platform. * Familiarity with healthcare interoperability, clinical data, electronic health records, or standards such as FHIR and HL7\. * Experience with relational and non\-relational data stores and systems processing significant volumes of operational or clinical data. * Experience influencing engineering strategy beyond a single team, such as setting technical direction or establishing architecture, testing, observability, and operational standards across teams. * Experience leading modernization efforts involving legacy systems, architecture evolution, or significant technical debt. * Experience with AI\-assisted software development tools, and with evaluating new technologies through prototypes, reference implementations, and incremental adoption. * Exposure to kidney care, value\-based care, or other complex clinical workflows. **About You** * You are a builder who enjoys designing systems, writing code, solving hard problems, and seeing your work run successfully in production. * You are energized by ambiguous, high\-impact problems and can turn loosely defined challenges into clear technical approaches, even where process and systems don't yet exist. * You pair broad knowledge of software engineering with deep expertise in one or more areas, and you use that breadth to weigh the organizational impact of technical choices. * You have strong technical judgment and know that the best solution isn't always the most complex one, or when a long\-term platform investment is worth it versus a simpler approach. * You balance short\-term needs with long\-term architectural investments and keep a clear view of tradeoffs and sequencing over time. * You are an excellent systems thinker and communicator who explains decisions and the reasoning behind them, and proactively shares risks, tradeoffs, and progress. * You raise engineering standards through influence, collaboration, and example rather than authority, and you enjoy helping others grow their skills and autonomy. * You challenge assumptions constructively while staying open to different perspectives and new information. * You take ownership of outcomes, including the reliability and maintainability of software long after it ships. * You approach privacy, security, and risk thoughtfully because the systems you build support patients and clinicians, and you handle sensitive information with integrity and discretion. * You are collaborative, low\-ego, and motivated by the success of the broader team rather than ownership boundaries. * You are outcome\-driven and curious, using data, experimentation, and feedback loops, as well as thoughtful adoption of AI and other new capabilities, to keep improving the platform and how engineering works. **Annual Salary Range: $130,000 \- $163,000\. This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 15%** Final compensation will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications. Strive Health is an equal opportunity employer and drug free workplace. At this time Strive Health is unable to provide work visa sponsorship. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Please apply even if you feel you do not meet all qualifications. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to talentacquisition@strivehealth.com. **We do not accept unsolicited resumes from outside recruiters/placement agencies. Strive Health will not pay fees associated with resumes presented through unsolicited means.**

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Payments
jobs.description: Substack is building a new economic engine for culture, giving the brightest, most interesting, and most creative people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. jobs.title: Sr. Security Engineer

Hands\-on Execution \& Engineering * Cloud \& infrastructure security: Harden our cloud environments (AWS/GCP), manage IAM policies, and configure network security. * AppSec \& CI/CD: Integrate automated security scanning (SAST/DAST) into our deployment pipelines and conduct code reviews. * Endpoint \& corporate security: Deploy and manage our MDM, MDR solutions, and identity providers. * jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)

testing applications deployed on AWS or other public cloud platforms, or backend services built on microservices. * Familiarity with visual regression testing tools such as Percy, Applitools, or networking products, smart home technologies, connected device ecosystems, or e\-commerce websites. **Why Join TP\-Link** * Shape the quality of TP\-Link’s global websites and web experiences, used by jobs.description: **Build a Safer World.** ------------------------ TRM Labs provides AI\-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. **About the Role** ------------------ The Scam Disruption team is TRM's tip of the spear against pig butchering syndicates, romance fraud networks, and investment scam operations that steal billions from victims each year. As a **GEOINT Analyst**, you’ll be the team's location specialist: finding where scam compounds are, who is operating them, and how they move, then turning that picture into intelligence law enforcement partners can act on. You will operate the "intelligence flywheel" daily, fusing geospatial, ad tech, on\-chain, and off\-chain data to build operational pictures that help dismantle scam operations. **The Impact You Will Have** ---------------------------- * Locate and map scam compounds using satellite and aerial imagery, geolocation, and open\-source geospatial data, and track how they change over time, including construction, expansion, and relocation after raids * Place people and devices to a location using ad tech and commercial location data, IP geolocation, and other location\-bearing telemetry, and build pattern\-of\-life pictures of operators and controllers * Fuse location intelligence with on\-chain attribution, OSINT, and commercially available data to identify operators, controllers, and movement patterns * Find the seams: pivot from a single address, IP, photo, or victim lead to the compound and the people running it * Partner with the Threat Intelligence Analyst (Scams Expert), the CTI Analyst, and the All\-Source Lead to translate disruption strategy into targeting packages that influence law enforcement and government action **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * **3 to 5 years of hands\-on GEOINT, imagery analysis, or location\-based targeting experience**: military or Intelligence Community geospatial roles (e.g., NGA, Army 35G), law enforcement targeting, or a mission\-aligned private sector equivalent such as a GEOINT or OSINT services firm * **Geolocation and imagery tradecraft**: you can take a photo, video, IP, or set of coordinates, place it with confidence, and explain how you got there * **Ad tech and commercial location data (strongly preferred)**: experience with mobile ad IDs, bidstream, or other commercial location data. Ideally you bring both GEOINT and ad tech * **Works beyond the government toolkit**: you can get answers from open\-source and commercial tools when classified systems and data aren't available * **Creative tactical thinking** — demonstrated ability to pivot from a single point to a network view, identifying operators behind operations * **Link and pattern analysis fluency** — ability to correlate disparate data sources to generate defensible target packages * **Clear written and verbal communication**: you can explain your methods, your confidence, and your own role in plain terms, and write memos, attribution write\-ups, and leads that are actionable * **AI fluency (required)** — you use AI tools in your workflow, synthesizing data, drafting outputs, and accelerating analysis, with examples of how AI has impacted your work * **Crypto experience is a plus, not a requirement** — we teach on\-chain tradecraft; we cannot teach the targeter's instinct * **Familiarity with Southeast Asia scam compounds or Chinese\-run criminal networks is a plus** * **Location**: remote in the UK, EMEA, or US (including Washington, DC). You must already have the right to work where you're based. **About the Team** ------------------ * The Scam Disruption team operates within TRM’s Blockchain Intelligence organization, alongside threat intelligence analysts, on\-chain investigators, and federal partners * All\-Source Investigators are the operational core, converting strategy and tooling into prosecutable, actionable intelligence * Distributed team with an async\-first approach via Slack and Notion, plus structured syncs for alignment * High autonomy, high standards, low bureaucracy — work directly with analysts, engineers, and customers who depend on your output **Team Operating Rhythms** -------------------------- * Weekly team syncs to align targeting priorities and review disruption opportunities * Daily async standups via Slack on active work, returns, and target packages in flight * Primary time zone overlap: US Eastern / Central * All output documented in Notion and TRM’s investigative tools * Surge availability expected during time\-sensitive disruption windows **Application Instructions** ---------------------------- If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team. Bef ing and intense environment. We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure\-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission\-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. **Leadership Principles** ------------------------- We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. * Impact\-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly. * Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday. * Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger. **Join our Mission** -------------------- At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast. TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed\-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. **Privacy Policy and Additional Information** --------------------------------------------- By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy. We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM. Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law. If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com. To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non\-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real\-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. jobs.title: Software Test Engineer I
jobs.description: **GROW WITH US:** Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no\-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry. **STAY AWESOME:** Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control\-IQ\+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human\-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com **A DAY IN THE LIFE:** Defines and executes tests of software products in accordance with software test plans and procedures. Able to debug issues and drive to closure by working closely with appropriate stakeholders. Takes ownership for product initiatives, by identifying and executing on projects. Create documents that capture test operations and reports results to software engineering. Capable of creating and reviewing automated test scripts to expedite test execution. Software Test Engineer I's at Tandem are also responsible for: * Develops and assists with implementation of software validation test plans. * Automates test plans and provides input on test frameworks/tools. * Works with CI systems to ensure tests are updated and functional across multiple builds/releases. * Prepares and reviews software test plan reports including pass/fail product evaluations. * Performs and documents software test audits in compliance with test plan procedures. * Assists product development engineers in the diagnosis and replication of product failures. * Oversees and identifies actual or potential problems in test plans. * Manages own time efficiently to complete work and associated paperwork by assigned completion dates. * Records and compiles data for documentation of test procedures and prepares reports. * Reviews data for compliance to specifications, recognizes events outside the norm, and reports abnormalities. * Estimates test efforts for new project deliverables. * Plans and implements test strategies for system upgrades. * Works as a contributing member of cross\-functional teams as needed, working closely with R\&D engineering, Technical Support and Quality Engineers to match software testing processes with documented specification requirements. **WHEN \& WHERE YOU’LL WORK:** Hybrid: This role will be a mix of in\-office work at our corporate headquarters in Del Mar, CA and remote work. This position is expected to be in office 2 days per week but may vary depending on business demands. **WHAT YOU’LL NEED:** * Ability to read and follow procedures and flow diagrams. * Able to effectively share information and ideas within and outside of department in written or verbal form; able to put forth own ideas and gain understanding from others. * Proficient at supporting effective interactions between team members and among cross\-functional teams. * Demonstrated ability to schedule and coordinate project priorities and resources and to produce high quality work. * Experience with Scrum and Agile methodologies. * Experience with MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook). * Proficient knowledge of at least one embedded or cloud\-based programming language, preferably JavaScript, Python, C or C\# would be a plus. * Familiar/working knowledge of CI systems. * Familiar with common test frameworks and automation tools, preferably selenium web driver, jasmine, mocha, Appium would be a plus. **EXTRA AWESOME:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline (w/ 0\-2 years of experience) OR Bachelor's degree in another discipline may be considered with 3 years of directly related experience with software testing or quality assurance. * Coursework in software engineering concepts, highly preferred * Ability to participate in specification and clarification of software requirements * Ability to comprehend an E2E system, under concepts of design change * Ability proofread, follow detailed work instructions and exhibit critical thinking skills. **COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS:** The starting base pay range for this position is **$39\.23 to $43\.27** per hour. Base pay will vary based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes bonus and a robust benefits package. Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, a minimum of 20 days of paid time off (with accrual starting on day 1\) and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here! **YOU SHOULD KNOW:** Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local Fair Chance laws and regulations. A conditional offer of employment from Tandem is contingent upon successful completion of a pre\-employment screening process comprised of a drug test (excluding marijuana) and background check, which includes a review of criminal history information. Tandem has good cause to conduct a review of criminal history information of candidates for this position, as this role may involve access to proprietary, sensitive and/or confidential information, including customer protected health information. This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders. **SPONSORSHIP:** Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. **WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:** At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well\-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome! Explore the benefits and reasons to love Tandem at https://www.tandemdiabetes.com/careers. **BE YOU, WITH US!** We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us. Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organization, and we welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone. **REFERRALS:** We love a good referral! If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share! **APPLICATION DEADLINE:** The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications. Make a move that matters. Join Tandem Diabetes Care, where we're turning challenges into triumphs every day and where your talents will help shape a healthier, happier tomorrow. \#LI\-KT1 \#LI\-Hybrid

Track process performance and provide feedback to engineering, manufacturing and management. * Perform performance testing on production products to ensure specifications are met. * Maintain product conformance through performing metrology and/or metallurgy inspections. * Work with manufacturing and suppliers in process improvement to reduce process variation and increase process control. * Work with the plant Supplier Quality Engineer to ensure quality product is being supplied/processed is of the highest quality. * Work with cross functional teams on continuous improvement activities through statistical analysis and data analysis, such as process capability study, Gauge R\&R, process flowcharting, design of experiments. * Help manage and create corrective action plans to ensure timely root cause/8D analysis and effective corrective/preventive action. * Participate in reviewing designs of new products and engineering changes with respect to product quality control planning and gauge requirements. * Perform process and quality system audits to ensure compliance to specifications and documented procedures. * Determine acceptance quality levels by means of random sampling techniques, where feasible. * Track project schedules to ensure adherence to timelines * Works on projects and continuous improvement initiatives in a self\-directed manner **What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:** * Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering or related technical field. * 1\-3 years of related work experience in a manufacturing setting. * Experience in metal manufacturing and plastic injection molding preferred. (i.e. Machining, stamping, forging, or assembly) * Strong statistical data analysis ability (Minitab, etc.) * Excellent problem\-solving skills, exercises independent judgement and works well under pressure in a dynamic environment. * Self\-motivated, organized, efficient, process oriented with a strong work ethic. * Project management and mentoring experience a plus. * Ability to travel \<10%. **Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:** * ASQ or similar Quality Certification * Working knowledge of Solidworks/Data Analytics/ML/AI. **We provide these great perks and benefits:** * Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans. * Generous 401 (K) savings plan. * Education assistance. * On\-site grab\-n\-go food and coffee service. * And many more, check out our benefits site HERE. *Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.* ##### **Categories** Milwaukee Tool ##### **About Us** Milwaukee Tool, founded in 1924, is a global leader in delivering innovative solutions to the professional construction trades that increase productivity and safety. (TTI) (HKEx stock code: 669, ADR symbol: TTNDY). For more information on the full line of Milwaukee® products, please call 1\-800\-SAWDUST or visit Milwaukee Tool.

Knowledge and Semantic Systems * Design NLP pipelines that power enterprise knowledge graphs and semantic layers. * Develop ontology\-aware language understanding systems. * Build entity resolution, canonicalization, taxonomy mapping, and concept extraction capabilities. * Connect language understanding with graph\-based reasoning and enterprise knowledge discovery platforms. Platform and Scale * Build highly scalable distributed NLP systems processing petabytes of enterprise content. * Optimize inference architectures for latency, throughput, cost efficiency, and reliability. * Lead deployment strategies across on\-prem, cloud\-native, hybrid, and enterprise environments. * Partner closely with platform engineering teams to operationalize NLP services at global scale. evaluation * Vector databases * Embedding models * Search engines * Knowledge graphs * Distributed ML infrastructure * AI observability and evaluation platforms Preferred Qualifications * PhD with published research in NLP, IR, ML, or AI in top\-tier peer reviewed journals and conferences * Experience building systems that serve hundreds of millions of users or process billions of documents. * jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- The Farmer's Dog was born from a mission to change the landscape of pet health, providing dogs and their humans with honest, smart, and simple care. We're starting by radically improving the $90 billion pet food industry, replacing bags of highly\-processed pellets with a personalized subscription service that sends complete and balanced, freshly\-made dog food directly to customers' doors. Our ultimate goal is to create innovative, delightful and personalized experiences across all aspects of pet care, and we believe our direct\-to\-consumer business model, holistic approach to growth, and dynamic culture uniquely position us to shepherd this backwards industry into the future. To date, The Farmer's Dog has delivered over 1 billion meals nationwide and raised over $150M in funding to help us build a company as healthy as the dogs who are eating those meals. Join us as we continue to develop ways of bringing peace of mind to customers, health to their companions, and much\-needed change to the way people feed and care for their pets. \#LongLiveDogs **What We Stand For and Where You'll Come In** ---------------------------------------------- The Farmer's Dog is seeking a Data Engineer 2 to join our growing group! You will maximize your technical expertise and data analysis skills to develop, implement, and maintain data analytics solutions within the organization. This role will collaborate with cross\-functional groups \- including data scientists, data engineers, and business partners to gather requirements, design data models, build data pipelines, and deliver practical insights. You will be critical to ensure data integrity, optimize data workflows, and enabling partners to make effective decision\-making rooted in data. If you have a genuine love for data, technology, problem\-solving and want to improve how The Farmer's Dog makes strategic decisions at the company level, then this is the role for you! **One Team:** We don't think of ourselves as "Acquisition Marketers", "Engineers", "Data Analysts", or "Product Managers". Beyond denoting skill sets and areas of expertise, we don't think departments matter. We'd rather align ourselves to the goals we're working to achieve and make sure we have necessary subject matter expertise to drive meaningful impact. We strive to orient ourselves around customer problems TOGETHER – getting the right people, with the right context, in the right rooms/Zooms to solve problems holistically. **We are skeptical about everything and precious about nothing:** Ideas can and should come from anywhere, and we aren't tied to our own. We proactively source input. We talk to our customers and leads regularly and are quick to change course if we know there's a better or more impactful way to solve problems. **We consider the customer journey in all of our decisions:** We know that no interaction exists in a silo and therefore understand how important every single one is. We ensure our strategy sets prospective and new customers up for success and drives long\-term retention. We answer questions and address problems early and proactively. We understand the value of different channels, initiatives, and messages and know how to articulate impact and advocate for prioritization holistically. **We Execute For Impact:** We don't subscribe to "best practices" or "industry KPIs". We're uninterested in how we compare to "benchmarks"; instead we orient ourselves around being the best we can possibly be. Similarly, we don't subscribe to rigid or classical expectations of roles – i.e. acquisition is hyper\-focused on improving customer retention and experience. **We Are Focused and Work Without Assumption**: We are not beholden to ideas. We have goals and believe everything beyond that is a series of hypotheses to validate. To that end, we seek to work in sequence and not in parallel. We constantly ask ourselves, "what's the most important hypothesis I should be working on right now? How do I confirm or reject that hypothesis as fast as possible?". We rarely have timelines/deadlines and are constantly taking in new information and adjusting our priorities accordingly. We don't expect to be perfect the first time. **How You'll Make An Impact** ----------------------------- * Build and maintain data pipelines for structured and unstructured data supporting reporting, analytics and AI/ML use cases. * Write production\-level code that processes and validates millions of events per day. * Develop AI tooling and automation to enhance data engineering capabilities and workflows. * Ingest data from APIs, databases, file systems, and streaming platforms into our data infrastructure, and build and maintain pipelines for structured and unstructured data that support reporting, analytics, and AI/ML use cases. * Establish and maintain robust data governance frameworks across our data warehouse to ensure data integrity, reliability, and security across the organization * Impl nd data requirements and deliver solutions and you have experience communicating technical concepts effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * You're **detail\-oriented with strong problem\-solving skills** and can manage multiple priorities effectively * You are eager to learn new technologies, expand your skill set in a fast\-paced environment, and take initiative to optimize systems. * You love dogs. **Office Guidelines** --------------------- We are an in\-office culture, made of in\-office people who thrive on the collaboration and magnetism of working in a shared space. We are seeking individuals who excel in this type of environment, where being present fosters deeper connections and engagement. We ask all team members to be in office 4 \- 5 days a week to build a collaborative and invested environment to foster our unique in\-person culture we are proud to have. This office policy is subject to change at company discretion. **Our Belonging Philosophy:** ----------------------------- At TFD, we believe Belonging is a shared commitment to creating a workplace where every person feels respected, valued, and empowered to be themselves. When people feel a true sense of belonging, they do their best work, take smart risks, and bring forward diverse perspectives — leading to stronger decisions and deeper relationships. We anchor this belief in a simple phrase: "Everyone's welcome at the dog park." No matter your background, identity, or role, there's space for you here. There's no one way to show up at the dog park— just shared space, mutual respect, and the freedom to be yourself. Being included is just the beginning, it's about contributing your voice, growing through challenges, and building trust through shared goals. This philosophy guides how we lead, how we hire, how we communicate, and how we grow. We continuously evaluate to ensure we are creating a consistent experience that cultivates belonging for all employees, from hiring and performance reviews to talent development. We also believe Belonging happens in everyday moments of connection; lunch with a new teammate, a shared laugh, or a quick story about your weekend. Our structure includes biannual employee surveys, manager training, TFD camps, and support from Humans to ensure we're listening and learning from our Team. Together, these efforts reflect what Belonging means at TFD: a culture where everyone can thrive. **A Few of Our Best Benefits** ------------------------------ * Dog\-friendly office in SoHo * Market\-competitive compensation and equity packages * Comprehensive Healthcare, Dental, and Vision * Company supported mental health benefits * 12 week paid parental leave * Competitive 401k plan with company match * Flexible PTO * Discounted fresh food for your pup * Your pet interrupting video calls (and in\-person meetings) is now a feature, not a bug **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** ------------------------------------------ The Farmer's Dog, Inc. is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic or status. For more information, please visit Know Your Rights. **Reasonable Accommodations** ----------------------------- TFD complies with applicable federal, state, and local disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact humansops@thefarmersdog.com. **We're Here to Help** ---------------------- We're happy to answer any questions you may have about the position or our hiring process \- please reach out at careers@thefarmersdog.com.

jobs.title: Sr Cloud Data and AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Details** --------------- Location: Hartford, CT Category: Data \& Analytics Employment Type: Full time, Hybrid or Remote Job Ref: R2627133\-168 Sr Data Engineer \- GE07BE We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. The Employer Group Actuarial Service area is seeking a Senior Cloud Data Engineer who combines deep expertise in cloud data engineering with a passion for Artificial Intelligence (AI), automation, and modern data platforms. The ideal candidate will help design and implement scalable data solutions while leveraging emerging AI technologies, intelligent automation, and cloud\-native capabilities to accelerate business insights, operational efficiency, and innovation across Employer Benefits actuarial functions. This position is in a small group that works directly with our customers and prides itself in delivery capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to have a significant bottom\-line impact through the delivery of quality and actionable information to our business customers. The ideal candidate is a highly motivated, results\-oriented individual with strong technical skills and project\-level leadership experience. We are looking for a well\-rounded individual that is comfortable working in a process light environment and willing to cross the traditional role boundaries of developer, BA, Architect and project lead. To be successful in this role you must be comfortable working directly with customers in an iterative fashion to achieve the desired result. As such, strong verbal communication and the ability to create your own technical specifications and designs based on customer needs is critical for success in this role. This role can have a Hybrid or Remote work schedule. Candidates who live near one of our locations will have the expectation of working in an office 3 days a week (Tuesday through Thursday). Candidates who do not live near an office should maintain their current work arrangement with the expectation of coming into the office as business needs arise **Responsibilities**: * Regularly engage in continuing education and serve as a technical expert in Informatica IDMC, Snowflake, AI and Generative AI platforms, cloud\-native data services, CICD tooling, environment management, Oracle, metadata\-driven architectures, and enterprise data quality processes. * Evaluate, prototype, and operationalize emerging AI technologies, including Generative AI, Agentic AI workflows, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), and Model Context Protocol (MCP)\-based integrations. * Design and develop high quality, scalable data solutions to enable pricing and reserving activities for Employer Benefit Actuarial team. * Ability to synthesize, reconcile, and explain data differences between GB actuarial output against other standard published data. * Gain deep understanding on various Actuarial applications, data elements and business process. * Work closely with Actuarial customers during the close of current financial months to provide solutions to time sensitive issues while ensuring strategic solutions are planned for next release cycle. * Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers while fostering collaboration across onshore and offshore teams to deliver innovative, scalable, and sustainable data solutions. Leverage strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to discover, integrate, and optimize data from diverse sources, enabling informed decision\-making and supporting mission\-critical business processes. * Ability to discover, analyze and integrate data from various sources to support decision making and enable critical business processes * Consult with cross\-functional team partners to understand business needs and develop reliable and effective solutions that are easily maintainable. * Ability to work directly with the customers to understand their needs and provide solutions. * Willingness to develop deep functional knowledge in the pricing and rating process. * Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes to support Insurance processing, actuarial analysis, and reporting. * Use Enterprise GitHub for version control, documentation, code collaboration, and technical project management. * Research, evaluate, and champion modern data technologies, frameworks, and best practices to drive operational excellence and accelerate data\-driven innovation. Build deep functional knowledge of pricing, rating, and actuarial processes while working within agile delivery frameworks and partnering across organizations to enhance enterprise data assets and capabilities. **Qualifications**: * Bachelor’s degree with at least 7 years of applicable work experience. * Experience in following is required: Snowflake, IDMC, Informatica, Oracle * Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools, Snowflake Cortex and Agentic AI capabilities, Generative AI platforms, Model Context Protocol (MCP), cloud\-based AI services, and intelligent automation frameworks. * Experience building AI\-powered self\-service analytics, intelligent data catalogs, automated reconciliation frameworks, or knowledge management solutions. * Demonstrated passion for continuous learning in Artificial Intelligence, cloud architecture, automation, and emerging technologies. * Experience with CICD, GitHub, Autosys, and SQL * 7\+ years ETL / Data analysis / Warehouse Technologies experience * Strong data warehouse knowledge preferably in the insurance domain, Demonstrated expertise in Data analysis, Data Quality and reconciliation processes. * Group Benefits business knowledge is a plus. * Knowledge of AWS and cloud\-based data solutions is a plus * Strong experience in Python , R and other modern languages, including experience building APIs, automation frameworks, AI\-driven applications, and cloud\-native data services. * Experience in on\-premises to cloud migration of data pipelines, modernizing them to leverage full cloud potential. * Experienced in Agile and Kanban Methodologies **Candidate must be authorized to work in the US without company sponsorship. The company will not support the STEM OPT I\-983 Training Plan endorsement for this position.** **Compensation** The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include short\-term or annual bonuses, long\-term incentives, and on\-the\-spot recognition. The annualized base pay range for this role is: $117,200 \- $175,800 Equal Opportunity Employer/Sex/Race/Color/Veterans/Disability/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity or Expression/Religion/Age
