jobs.title: Business Systems Developer – Ecommerce & Integrations
jobs.description: **Build More than just Software** The Image Group is looking for a **Business Systems Developer – Ecommerce \& Integrations** to join our growing IT team. We’re looking for an early\-career developer who enjoys writing code but also wants to understand **why they’re building it and how it impacts the business**. This isn’t a role where you’ll spend your entire day maintaining one application. You’ll work across ecommerce, ERP, APIs, integrations, automation, databases, and supplier systems. You’ll gain exposure to the entire lifecycle of a transaction—from a customer placing an order online through NetSuite, our suppliers, fulfillment, invoicing, and reporting. Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who wants to grow. You’ll work closely with our IT Director and Lead Solutions Architect, with the opportunity to develop from a hands\-on developer into someone capable of designing and owning complex business technology solutions. What You’ll Do You’ll help develop, integrate, automate, and improve the systems that run our business. Your work will include: · Developing and enhancing our Magento ecommerce platform and internal applications. · Building and maintaining integrations between Magento, NetSuite, suppliers, and other business systems. · Working with REST APIs, web services, JSON/XML, SQL, databases, and integration platforms. · Developing automation that eliminates manual processes and improves efficiency. · Supporting integrations for products, inventory, pricing, orders, shipping, invoicing, and fulfillment. · Troubleshooting complex application and data issues and developing long\-term solutions. · Assisting with NetSuite development, workflows, scripting, and integrations. · Participating in application upgrades, testing, deployments, and code reviews. · Working directly with business users to understand problems and develop practical technical solutions. · Learning our business and progressively taking ownership of applications, integrations, and projects. Who We’re Looking For We’re less interested in someone who checks every technology box and more interested in someone with a **strong technical foundation, curiosity, and the ability to learn**. You may be a great fit if you: · Have approximately **2–4 years of professional software development experience**. · Have a degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or equivalent professional experience. · Have experience with one or more modern programming or scripting languages. · Understand databases, SQL, APIs, and web application development. · Enjoy solving problems and figuring out how systems work together. · Are interested in understanding business processes—not just writing code. · Can communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical people. · Are comfortable learning technologies you haven’t worked with before. · Want increasing responsibility and ownership as your skills develop. Experience with **PHP, JavaScript, SQL, Magento/Adobe Commerce, NetSuite, Celigo, REST APIs, Git, or cloud technologies** is a plus, but we don’t expect you to already know everything we use. What You’ll Learn This role provides exposure to a technology environment that would normally span several different positions. You’ll have the opportunity to develop experience with: · Magento / Adobe Commerce · NetSuite ERP · Celigo and integration platforms · REST APIs and system integrations · Ecommerce architecture · Supplier and inventory integrations · Business process automation · ERP and ecommerce data architecture · Business intelligence and reporting · Solution design and architecture · Agile/Scrum development Where This Role Can Go We’re hiring for more than the position we need today. Initially, you’ll spend most of your time developing, troubleshooting, building integrations, and learning how our systems and business work. As your experience grows, so will your responsibility. You’ll begin designing solutions, owning integrations and applications, working directly with business stakeholders, and contributing to larger technology decisions. We see a potential career path from: **Business Systems Developer → Senior Developer / Solutions Developer → Solutions Architect** We’re looking for someone who wants to become more than a strong programmer. We want to help develop someone who understands **technology, architecture, and the business that technology supports.** About The Image Group The Image Group is a promotional products and marketing solutions company that helps organizations manage branded merchandise, ecommerce programs, print, apparel, signage, and other marketing solutions. Technology is an important part of how we differentiate ourselves. Our IT team develops and integrates many of the systems that connect our customers, ecommerce platforms, internal teams, suppliers, and ERP environment. If you’re looking for a development role where you’ll be exposed to a wide range of technologies, solve real business problems, and have the opportunity to grow into a much larger technical role, we’d like to hear from you. Send resume to our HR Department, Paula Cruz at pcruz@theimagegroup.com Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **How to Apply** ---------------- A cover letter and resume are important submissions for the hiring team to get a sense of your experience. In the cover letter, in two pages or less, please let us know how this role aligns with your career aspirations and skill set. Submit both a cover letter and resume as one file (because of system limitations). **Who We Are** -------------- **About the Center for Academic Innovation** Through curricular innovation, tools for student success, and educational research and analytics, the University of Michigan Center for Academic Innovation is building the future of education. Our vision is a future in which education connects and empowers learners everywhere to reach their full potential throughout their lives. To realize our vision, we make it our mission to collaborate across campus and around the world to create equitable, lifelong educational opportunities for learners everywhere. **About the Technology Infrastructure and Support Team** The TIS team builds and maintains the technology behind CAI's learning, media, and IT work. Our work spans Michigan Online infrastructure, cloud storage, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, studio production, XR, AV systems, media asset management, and internal support. TIS is also home to the AI Enablement Team, which partners with teams across the Center to test promising ideas and turn the ones that work into tools and workflows people can rely on. Working closely with Creative Studios, Operations, and product engineering teams, we keep CAI's systems dependable and secure so learners, faculty, and staff can focus on their work. For more information, please visit our website: Academic Innovation. **Responsibilities\*** ---------------------- * Prototype and test AI\-enabled workflows for CAI projects selected through intake, building lightweight applications, connectors, retrieval pipelines, and automations that integrate with existing CAI systems * Support pilots with domain experts, collect user feedback, diagnose failures, and iterate * Build evaluation datasets, test cases, and repeatable harnesses for quality, reliability, safety, and cost * Implement logging, access controls, guardrails, and operational telemetry in partnership with TIS staff * Establish defined operating work for CAI's local AI server, including model deployment, updates, monitoring, and runbook upkeep * Share practical guidance through demonstrations, office hours, and workshops for staff and student fellows **What You'll Do** ------------------ The Center for Academic Innovation at the University of Michigan is seeking an Applied AI Engineer for a one\-year post\-graduate fellowship focused on practical AI prototyping, evaluation, platform operations, and knowledge transfer. Reporting to the Director of Technology Infrastructure and Support, you will work closely with the AI Enablement Lead and TIS colleagues to build and test AI\-enabled workflows, integrations, evaluation tools, and technical documentation. The successful candidate is a careful builder who can learn quickly, explain tradeoffs clearly, and turn experiments into maintainable, well\-documented assets. You will report to the Director of Technology, Infrastructure and Support. **What makes this fellowship distinctive** You will help operate CAI's dedicated multi\-GPU local AI server and the open\-source software stack that supports it, gaining experience deploying, evaluating, and monitoring models. Projects across the Center will give you a varied portfolio of applications and reusable tools. You will also share your work through demonstrations, office hours, and workshops. The fellowship combines hands\-on delivery, platform operations, and knowledge transfer, with documented project outcomes and a handoff to the next cohort to help build a fellowship alumni community over time. **Required Qualifications\*** ----------------------------- * A bachelor's degree in computer science, information, human\-computer interaction, data science, engineering, learning sciences, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and applied experience, completed by the start date * Hands\-on programming experience in Python, JavaScript, or a comparable language, including experience working with APIs * Experience building applications with large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, structured outputs, agents, or related AI techniques * Experience using Git and working with cloud, container, or modern application\-development environments * Experience designing tests or evaluations and interpreting both quantitative results and user feedback * Working knowledge of software security, privacy, access control, and responsible AI practices * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation and agent frameworks, experience with evaluation or observability tooling * Ability to learn and appropriately use new technologies to improve processes, communication, and outcomes, including AI\-enabled tools where relevant to the role, consistent with university policy and job responsibilities **Modes of Work** ----------------- Positions that are eligible for hybrid or mobile/remote work mode are at the discretion of the hiring department. Work agreements are reviewed annually at a minimum and are subject to change at any time, and for any reason, throughout the course of employment. Learn more about the work modes. **Additional Information** -------------------------- This is a one\-year term\-limited fellowship with the possibility of annual renewal depending on funding and performance. Candidates must have legal authorization to work in the United States. The mode of work for this position is **Hybrid** with a minimum of 4 days in the office per week, Monday through Thursday, with an option of remote work on Fridays. On occasion, you may be required and must be available to work onsite on Fridays if necessitated by our center's policy and domain leadership or by your job requirements. The salary for this position will be based upon the selected candidate's education and experience. We support the creative, responsible, and ethical use of AI tools to enhance our work, in alignment with institutional policies and best practices. Excellent benefits are available, for details, see http://benefits.umich.edu/. **Salary Information** The general salary range for this position is $85,000 \- $92,000\. Candidates can expect to be paid a competitive and equitable salary. Factors used to determine salary include education level, experience, knowledge and skills for the position and salaries that are currently established within the unit. All candidates are encouraged to discuss salary questions to honor alignment and transparency throughout the recruiting process. **Organizational Statement on Harassment** We believe all individuals deserve to be treated with respect and dignity and have the right to work in a professional atmosphere that promotes mutual respect and a safe space for collaboration. Any concerns shared with any staff members and student employees in the Center for Academic Innovation will be reported to the Equity, Civil Rights, \& Title IX Office to be reviewed and addressed, and the Center for Academic Innovation encourages reporting of any forms of harassment including sexual and gender\-based harassment. **Background Screening** ------------------------ The University of Michigan conducts background checks on all job candidates upon acceptance of a contingent offer and may use a third party administrator to conduct background checks. Background checks will be performed in compliance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act. **Application Deadline** ------------------------ Job openings are posted for a minimum of seven calendar days. The review and selection process may begin as early as the eighth day after posting. This opening may be removed from posting boards and filled any time after the minimum posting period has ended. **Decision Making Process** --------------------------- Applications will be reviewed as received throughout the posting period and continue until the position is filled. **U\-M EEO Statement** ---------------------- The University of Michigan is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. ### **Job Opening ID** 284255 ### **Working Title** Applied AI Engineer ### **Job Title** AI Appl Developer Assoc ### **Work Location** Ann Arbor Campus Ann Arbor, MI ### **Modes of Work** Hybrid ### **Full/Part Time** Full\-Time ### **Regular/Temporary** Regular ### **FLSA Status** Exempt ### **Organizational Group** Vp Acad Innovation ### **Department** Center for Academic Innovation ### **Posting Begin/End Date** 10/13/2026 \- 11/03/2026 ### **Salary** $85,000\.00 \- $92,000\.00 ### **Career Interest** Information Technology

jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- As a **Legal AI Engineer** focused on helping law firms adopt generative AI, you will partner directly with customers to uncover their highest\-value legal workflows and show how Thomson Reuters Legal AI can address them. jobs.title: Business Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **About** **Tia** ----------------- Tia is building a new model for women's healthcare, one that treats women as whole people, not separate conditions or life stages. By integrating primary care, mental health, gynecology, dermatology, and wellness across both in\-person and virtual settings, Tia is improving outcomes, lowering costs, and creating a better experience for patients and providers alike. **About the Role** ------------------ At Tia, our business teams support the people, processes, and systems that make women's healthcare possible. From credentialing providers to supporting clinic operations, too much of their time goes toward repetitive tasks, moving information between systems, tracking paperwork, and rebuilding reports. As our Business Automation Engineer, you'll help teams spend more time on the work that needs their expertise. You'll partner with People Operations, Credentialing, Clinical Operations, Data, Product, Business Analytics, and other teams to understand their workflows and build practical solutions using automation, AI, and code. You'll work with your manager to define problems and priorities, then own projects from discovery through launch and ongoing maintenance. Product partners will support architecture and data decisions. As your portfolio grows, you'll keep workflows reliable and adapt them as Tia's needs change. This role offers the opportunity to apply emerging technology to real business problems and make a measurable difference in how Tia operates. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Understand and improve business processes** * Work directly with teams to understand how work gets done, including exceptions, workarounds, and handoffs. * Map workflows and identify where human judgment is essential and where automation can reduce repetitive work. * Partner with your manager to define project scope, priorities, and measures of success. **Build practical, reliable solutions** * Design and build workflows using n8n or similar automation platforms, AI tools, and Python or JavaScript/Node.js. * Connect systems through APIs, webhooks, and other integrations. * Choose the simplest effective solution, whether that is a spreadsheet improvement, standard automation, or an AI\-assisted workflow. * Test normal operations and edge cases, and build in error handling, logging, alerts, and appropriate human review. **Own workflows after launch** * Monitor performance, troubleshoot failures, and update workflows as systems, policies, and business needs change. * Follow Tia's security, access, and AI governance controls when working with sensitive employee, business, or patient\-related information. * Maintain clear documentation so others can understand, review, and support your work. **Help teams adopt and sustain improvements** * Involve teams throughout discovery, design, and rollout. * Explain technical decisions in plain language and train teams to use their workflows. * Enable teams to make appropriate adjustments independently, with clear guidance on when technical support is needed. **Measure impact and share learning** * Establish baselines and measure time saved, accuracy, reliability, and adoption after launch. * Report results honestly, including limitations and approaches that did not work. * Partner with Product to transition solutions that could become part of Tia's products. * Evaluate emerging AI and automation tools and recommend where they can improve business operations. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- **Required Qualifications** We value the quality of what you've built and how you approach problems. Candidates who demonstrate these capabilities through research or independent projects are encouraged to apply, even without traditional professional experience. * 1\+ year of relevant experience in workflow automation, software development, systems integration, or technical operations, or equivalent hands\-on experience through internships, research, or substantial independent projects. * Experience leading a substantial project from an unclear starting point to a working solution. * Hands\-on experience building and troubleshooting workflows in n8n, Zapier, Make, Workato, or a comparable platform, with the ability to learn n8n quickly. * Ability to write Python or JavaScript/Node.js scripts, call APIs, and handle logic beyond the capabilities of low\-code tools. * Working knowledge of REST APIs, authentication, webhooks, and data movement between systems. * Comfort using SQL to query and validate data, and working with complex Google Sheets. * Experience applying LLM tools or APIs to practical problems, with an understanding of their limitations, how to evaluate outputs, and when human review is needed. * Ability to break complex processes into manageable steps and anticipate exceptions and downstream effects. * A disciplined approach to testing, documentation, monitoring, and handling sensitive data. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to earn trust with nontechnical teams. * Initiative, persistence, and accountability: you make progress through ambiguity, raise blockers early, and learn from mistakes. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Google Workspace automation, including Apps Script. * Experience building AI workflows that use tool calling, retrieval\-augmented generation, or agents. * Familiarity with machine learning fundamentals and how to assess whether a model is appropriate for a task. * Experience handling sensitive data in healthcare, finance, or another regulated environment. * Experience measuring operational improvements through time studies or before\-and\-after comparisons. **How You'll Make an Impact** ----------------------------- Success in this role means: * Delivering agreed\-upon projects and communicating progress and blockers clearly. * Building workflows that teams adopt and that remain reliable after launch. * Demonstrating measurable improvements in time spent, accuracy, or process quality. * Providing documentation and training that help teams use and sustain improvements. * Identifying opportunities to simplify work while protecting the human judgment and expertise essential to Tia's operations. **Work Location** ----------------- This is a remote role, based in the United States. \#LI\-Remote **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- Tia is committed to pay equity and pay transparency. Compensation for this role will be determined based on job\-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, location, role leveling, business needs, and market conditions. The expected annual compensation for this role is: **$90,000 \- $100,000**. You are also eligible for: * Medical, dental, and vision benefits * 401k * Parental leave * Performance\-based bonus * Equity * Paid time off, sick leave, and holidays #### **About Tia** Tia is on a mission to transform healthcare for women by increasing access, improving outcomes, and delivering a better care experience. Our "Whole Woman, Whole Life" model integrates primary care, gynecology, mental health, dermatology, and wellness across in\-person care and a national virtual platform. We are a Series D, venture\-backed company trusted by more than 120,000 women across four markets. Through our technology\-enabled care model and partnerships with leading health systems, Tia is building one of the most comprehensive preventive care models for women. #### **About Tia's Culture** Tia is building a culture of excellence in people, process, and product. For us, excellence is not perfection. It is the ongoing pursuit of improvement through learning, reflection, experimentation, curiosity, grit, and care for ourselves and others. We are looking for people who are energized by building, iterating, asking why, and helping create a fundamentally better healthcare experience for women. This position may require attendance at company and team off\-sites. #### **Scam Notice** Tia will never ask for payment, gift cards, or sensitive financial information during the hiring process. All communication from our team will come from an official company email address ending in @asktia.com. If something feels off, please contact peopleservices@asktia.com. #### **Equal Opportunity** Tia is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity of experience, perspectives, and background leads to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users and patients. We strongly encourage people of color and members of the LGBTQ\+ community to apply. If you are committed to collaborative problem solving, high\-quality work, and making waves in women's healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (AI Agents)
jobs.description: Traba is building the AI operating system for the industrial supply chain \- the network of warehouses, manufacturers, logistics providers, and workers behind the physical goods people rely on every day. We started by tackling labor, supplying industrial businesses with consistent, reliable temporary workforces, and quickly became the fastest growing staffing company in America. Since then, we've expanded our suite of AI agents to help logistics providers, manufacturers, 3PLs, and other industrial businesses fully automate their manual workflows, derive insights from their data streams, and transform their decision intelligence. Our mission is to build a world where the global supply chain operates at peak efficiency. We’re proud to be backed by some of the world’s best investors, including Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst. **You'll build the AI agents themselves—the harnesses, evals, orchestration, and model strategy the rest of Traba's product runs on.** We're seeking an entrepreneurial Senior AI Agent Engineer to join as a founding member of the Agents team and build the next layer of Traba's product—an agentic platform that synthesizes the data flowing through our marketplace and operates autonomously inside our customers' supply chain workflows. (Our Applied AI team puts these agents to work across the product; you own the agents and infrastructure they depend on.) You'll embed deeply in our customers' operations, design and ship production agent harnesses on top of frontier models, and turn what you learn in the field into durable product. You will partner closely with our CTO, product, and our operators to take 0\-to\-1 ideas to scaled deployments. **About You** ------------- * **Builder with an AI operator's instinct.** You've shipped real product on top of LLMs—not just chat wrappers. You've designed agent harnesses, structured tools, written evals, and tuned prompts against production traces. You think in capability, reliability, and unit economics—not just whether the model says the right thing. * **Domain\-immersed.** You enjoy time with the people who do the work—learning an industry's vocabulary, edge cases, and operational tempo—and let that shape what you build. * **High\-agency in ambiguity.** Dropped into a fuzzy customer problem with a half\-formed hypothesis and a deadline, you scope, build, evaluate, and ship without waiting for a spec. * **Sweat both ends of the stack.** You move between prompt iteration, eval design, backend services, and customer\-facing UI in the same week, and you care about evals that catch regressions and traces that are easy to debug. **You Will** ------------ * Embed with customers and operators to understand how supply chains run today—then design and ship agents that take meaningful work off their plate. * Build production agent systems on frontier LLMs: tool use, sub\-agents, retrieval, structured outputs, MCP servers, and the orchestration that ties them together. * Own evaluation as a first\-class discipline—datasets from real traces, rubrics and graders, experiments, and improvements you can prove move the needle. * Architect the data, services, and APIs the agent layer depends on—integrating our internal systems with customers' WMS, TMS, and ERP environments. * Codify repeatable deployment patterns so each new customer rollout is faster than the last. **You Have** ------------ * 5\+ years of software engineering, with 1\+ year shipping LLM\- or agent\-based features into production. * Strong in Python and/or TypeScript/Node.js, and comfortable designing APIs, distributed systems, and data models in PostgreSQL. * Hands\-on with the modern agent stack: production\-scale prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, orchestration patterns, and frontier model APIs. * A track record of building in fast, ambiguous environments—ideally at a vertical AI, AI\-agent, forward\-deployed, or data\-product company. * Excellent written and verbal communication—you can run a customer workshop in the morning and write a clean design doc in the afternoon. **Benefits** ------------ * Start\-up equity * Competitive Salary * 100% Paid health, dental \& vision coverage * Dinner Provided via DoorDash, free DashPass \& stocked kitchen for NY employees * Commuter benefit * Gympass Benefit * ✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, HealthAdvocate, Teledoc Health **Salary Range Details** ------------------------ The compensation range for this position is set between jobs.title: Sr AI Architect/Engineer
jobs.description: An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives. Come join the excellence! **Overview** ------------ Researches, designs, plans, develops and/or evaluates new, advanced network technologies by translating customer requirements or strategic business objectives into final product design. Work typically includes in\-depth assessment of the customer’s networked application needs, providing network modeling and simulation testing, consulting to further clarify needs, and engineering high\-speed technology network transports to deliver application functionality.**Responsibilities** -------------------- **Why this role exists** ======================== TNS is moving from AI governance and foundations into execution. The platform building blocks are in place or underway — Microsoft 365, Copilot, Entra ID, SharePoint, and Anthropic's Claude models via AWS Bedrock. What we don't yet have is a dedicated person who can both **build and operate the secure, production\-grade AI platform that lets AI work safely against our data** *and* **embed with our lines of business to turn that capability into measurable value.** This role does both. You'll be the technical engine and the on\-the\-ground partner who makes AI a productive, trusted tool across the enterprise — and who multiplies that impact by enabling others to build, not just building yourself. **What you'll do** ================== Your time will span two connected halves. **Build and operate the AI platform** ------------------------------------- **Model platform and private hosting.** Own our Claude deployment on AWS Bedrock end to end — model access and versioning, region and data\-residency decisions, provisioned throughput vs. on\-demand, and the private, VPC\-isolated hosting posture that keeps our data inside our boundary and out of third\-party training. Evaluate and manage additional models where they fit, and maintain a routing layer so applications aren't hard\-wired to a single model or provider. **Harness and orchestration management.** Build and maintain the application harness that sits between our users and the models: prompt and context management, tool and function calling, agent orchestration, retrieval pipelines, guardrails and content filtering, caching, and fallback behavior. Own the evaluation harness too — regression suites, quality benchmarks, and the release process that lets us upgrade models without breaking what's in production. **Data connectivity.** Design and build secure, governed connections between AI systems and TNS data — Microsoft 365 and Graph, SharePoint, databases, data warehouses, APIs, and line\-of\-business systems. Own the retrieval architecture, indexing and freshness strategy, and the permission\-trimming that ensures every user sees only what they're entitled to see, with no leakage across boundaries. **Security and access control.** Architect least\-privilege access across identity, network, and data layers — IAM and Entra ID, private networking, encryption and key management, secrets handling, and tenant isolation. Defend against AI\-specific threats: prompt injection, data exfiltration through model outputs, insecure tool use, and over\-permissioned agents. Partner with security and governance so every deployment is auditable and compliant by design, with a full audit trail of prompts, outputs, and data access. **Monitoring and observability.** Instrument the platform for production operations — latency, error rates, throughput and quota headroom, output quality and drift, guardrail trips, and anomalous usage. Build the dashboards and alerting that let us find problems before users do, and the usage telemetry that tells us which solutions are actually delivering value. **Cost management.** Own AI spend as a first\-class engineering concern: token\-level cost attribution by application and line of business, budgets and alerting, model right\-sizing (using the cheapest model that meets the quality bar), prompt caching and context optimization, batch processing where latency allows, and provisioned\-throughput decisions. Produce the chargeback and unit\-economics reporting leadership needs to fund the portfolio with confidence. **Reusable foundations.** Turn all of the above into patterns, templates, and guardrails so each new use case is faster, cheaper, and safer to build than the last. **Ship value with the business (forward\-deployed engineering)** ---------------------------------------------------------------- * Embed directly with teams across our lines of business (Communications, Waypoint, Payments, Corporate/Shared) to identify high\-value AI and automation opportunities. * Prototype quickly, validate with real users, and take the strongest ideas to production. * Drive adoption — measure whether solutions are actually used and delivering value, and iterate until they are. * Enable others: seed and support a networ urable value — reduced cost to serve, shorter cycle times, and volume absorbed without added headcount. * Establish a use\-case intake and prioritization process so demand is triaged by value rather than by who asks loudest. * Deliver AI cost transparency and attribution by application and line of business. * Enable at least one capable AI champion in each line of business. **What you bring (required)** ============================= * Strong software / solutions engineering background with hands\-on experience building and deploying production AI/LLM applications — RAG, agents, tool use, orchestration, and evaluation. * Direct experience with a managed model platform in production; **AWS Bedrock strongly preferred**, along with the surrounding AWS estate (IAM, VPC, KMS, CloudWatch, PrivateLink). * Demonstrated ability to build and operate data connectivity to enterprise systems with permission\-aware retrieval. * Working command of enterprise security and data governance: identity and access, data protection, encryption and key management, and AI\-specific threat models. * Production operations instincts — you instrument what you build, and you've owned the monitoring and on\-call reality of a live system. * Cost discipline: you treat inference spend as an engineering constraint and can show where the money goes. * Genuine business fluency and communication skills — you're comfortable sitting with finance, operations, or sales, understanding their problems, and translating them into solutions. * A demonstrated bias toward shipping and adoption, not just building demos. **Nice to have** ================ * Depth in the Microsoft / Azure ecosystem alongside AWS (Azure AI, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Entra ID, SharePoint / Graph) — our environment spans both. * Experience in a regulated or security\-sensitive industry — payments, telecom, or financial data. * Self\-hosted or fine\-tuned model experience, and a clear view of when it beats a managed API. * Infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD for AI systems (Terraform, pipelines, automated evals in the release path). * Change\-management or internal\-consulting experience. * Prior forward\-deployed or customer\-facing engineering experience. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Who you are** =============== The rare blend of builder and partner. You carry the technical depth of a staff engineer and the people instincts of an internal consultant. You're energized by variety — a private\-networking and key\-management problem in the morning, a finance\-team workflow in the afternoon. You measure yourself by value delivered and adopted, not lines of code. You teach and multiply rather than hoard knowledge. And you operate with ownership: when a deployment is struggling or a cost\-line spikes, you own the fix. **How your success is measured** ================================ In short: reduced cost to serve on named processes, use cases shipped and *sustained* in production, adoption across lines of business, champions enabled, platform reliability and cost\-per\-unit\-of\-value, and a clean security and governance record. For this role, we anticipate paying $150,000 \- $250,000 annually. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. TNS offers a competitive benefit package including medical and dental coverage, life insurance, paid holidays and vacations, and a 401K plan with company match. If you are passionate about technology, love personal growth and opportunity, come see what TNS is all about! TNS is an equal opportunity employer. TNS evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Director, Data Center & Network Engineering
jobs.description: Truliant’s mission is to improve lives by putting our members first, providing great service and straightforward financial solutions. Our core values of Member Focus, Service, Guidance, Relationships, and Community define how we interact with members to fulfill our mission of improving lives and providing a foundation on which we conduct ourselves. Our Promise to Our Teammates: Truliant strives to provide all teammates with an enjoyable place to work where they feel valued, empowered and rewarded for all that they do. **Why this role matters** At Truliant Federal Credit Union, reliable and secure technology helps our teams serve members with confidence. As Director of IT Data Center and Network Engineering, you’ll shape the strategy behind our data center, cloud, network, and telecom environments while ensuring they can scale with the business. This is an opportunity for a technology leader who enjoys building strong teams, modernizing complex infrastructure, and turning long\-term strategy into dependable day\-to\-day performance. **What you’ll do** In this role, you’ll lead the teams and strategy responsible for Truliant’s core infrastructure. You’ll balance operational stability, security, scalability, and cost while advancing cloud\-first capabilities and keeping technology aligned with business priorities. Day to day, you’ll: * Guide the design, deployment, and ongoing performance of data center, cloud, network, telecom, storage, compute, backup, LAN, SD\-WAN, and related infrastructure. * Build and develop high\-performing engineering teams while overseeing staffing, coaching, priorities, delivery methods, and operational results. * Partner with executives, business leaders, Risk, Legal, Vendor Management, and strategic sourcing to guide roadmaps, budgets, vendor relationships, contracts, governance, and disaster recovery readiness. Beyond that, you’ll identify opportunities to automate and simplify work, review operational and risk metrics, influence enterprise technology decisions, and serve as an escalation point when teams need a practical path forward. **What you bring** We’re looking for a strategic, hands\-on technology leader who can connect infrastructure decisions to business outcomes, communicate clearly with technical and executive audiences, and create an environment where teams can do their best work. This role is a great fit if you have: **Required Experience:** * 8\+ years of equivalent IT work experience. * 5\+ years of demonstrated leadership experience in a related IT role within a medium\-to\-large enterprise, including on\-premises infrastructure and outsourced or cloud services. * 5\+ years of experience in technology procurement and asset tracking. * At least 1 year of experience in each of the following: application support for internally developed and third\-party solutions; modern on\-premises and cloud infrastructure planning and implementation; and hands\-on software, hardware, and data management troubleshooting. **Required Skills:** * Lead infrastructure strategy, technical project implementation, and engineering delivery using waterfall, agile, or hybrid approaches. * Apply operational knowledge of SD\-WAN, VPN, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IPSec, firewalls, routing, and switching. * Apply operational knowledge of telephony technologies, including SIP, VoIP, SBC, unified communications, call processing, automated attendants, ACD queues, and skill assignments. * Administer and manage licensing for VMware vCenter, vSphere ESXi, VMware Horizon VDI, and supporting products. * Work with cloud computing protocols and standards across Azure, AWS, or GCP, and support infrastructure decisions spanning on\-premises and cloud environments. * Interpret technical documentation, research technology issues, analyze complex problems, and implement practical efficiency improvements. * Manage budgets, capacity, vendors, contracts, risk considerations, and executive\-level operational reporting. * Communicate clearly in English, verbally and in writing, and translate technical priorities for executives, department leaders, engineers, and business partners. **Education/Certifications:** * Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or a related field, or a Bachelor of Arts degree. You should also be comfortable making independent decisions, adjusting resources and priorities as needs change, working with minimal supervision, and maintaining a strong commitment to excellent member service. **What sets you apart** You don’t need to check every box, but here’s what will help you thrive in this role: * Experience shaping disaster recovery strategy across network, telecom, on\-premises, and cloud environments. * Exposure to infrastructure that supports robotic process automation, advanced data analytics, or artificial intelligence capabilities. * Experience contributing to enterprise technology governance, long\-range cloud planning, or cross\-functional roadmap decisions. **What you’ll get** We believe in supporting our team members both professionally and personally. In this role, you can expect: * A visible leadership opportunity to shape infrastructure strategy that supports Truliant’s member\-focused mission. * The chance to modernize a broad technology environment spanning data center, cloud, network, telecom, disaster recovery, and emerging capabilities. * Meaningful partnership with executive leaders and teams across the credit union, with the ability to influence priorities and long\-term decisions. * Opportunities to grow leaders, strengthen engineering practices, and build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. * A comprehensive benefits package and a workplace focused on professional development, reliable service, and the success of both members and team members. **Ready to apply?** If you have a passion for member service and would like to invest in a meaningful career with opportunity for growth, we encourage you to apply to Truliant! As a member of the Truliant family, you will enjoy the following full time benefits: * No\-cost employee Medical, dental, vision coverage * Prescription benefits (including mail order) * Paid holidays and Paid Time Off (PTO) * 401(k) plan with contribution matching * Paid community involvement volunteers hours * Paid group life Insurance * Teammate loan discounts * Tuition reimbursement * Short and long\-term disability * Health \& Wellness program * Teledoc (physician video conferencing) * Onsite fitness facilities or health club reimbursement * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Medical flexible spending account * Dependent care flexible spending account

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Account Data Services
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Tech **Compensation** ---------------- * $190K – $284K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus **WHO WE ARE** At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide. **Our Ambition:** To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like. Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high\-growth environment, join us and be part of a team that’s transforming the way the world pays. **ABOUT THE ROLE** Trustly moves money between consumers, merchants and banks across the US. We are building our US engineering hubs in San Francisco and New York, starting with a small group of staff engineers who will take technical ownership of our most critical systems. You will own Account Data Services end to end: its architecture, its reliability, its operation in production, and where it goes next. You'll own how account data is retrieved, stored and served: the account data store and the APIs for account activity, account holder name and balance. Payments and our data products both depend on them, with contractual latency commitments. You'll start by learning a mature, business\-critical codebase fast, using AI tools to map it and writing the documentation others will build from. Within your first year, you'll help hire and lead the team that owns it with you. **What you'll do** * Own the architecture, service contracts and production health of Account Data Services. * Own the operation of your services: on\-call, SLAs, incident response and root\-cause fixes. There is no separate operations team; the team that builds the service runs it. * Meet the observability standards set for every service, and make the service measurably better each quarter. * Use AI tools to understand existing code quickly, then turn what you learn into design docs, interface definitions and runbooks that engineers and AI agents can work from. * Partner with the engineers who run these systems today, across the Americas and Europe, to transfer knowledge. * Direct AI\-assisted implementation: write and close implementation plans, review output against requirements, and own integration testing. * Help hire and shape the team that will own this domain. **What you bring** * Typically 10\+ years building and operating production software systems, including several years owning systems at staff level or equivalent. * Hands\-on experience with payments, banking or other financial systems where correctness, auditability and uptime matter most. * You have carried the pager for systems you built, and improved them because of it. * A track record of taking over an unfamiliar, business\-critical codebase and becoming its owner. * Daily use of AI coding tools (such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot), with clear views on where they help and where human review has to hold. * Strong distributed systems design: data consistency, idempotency, concurrency. * Clear writing. Your design docs and incident write\-ups are the ones other people reuse. * Production experience with Java or a comparable backend language. * Experience owning high\-volume data retrieval and storage services with strict latency SLAs, consumed by both real\-time and data\-product use cases. **Nice to have** * Experience with ACH, RTP, FedNow or open banking. * Experience helping build a new engineering hub or leading a major platform transition. **LOCATION \& WORKPLACE** This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco office. We look for team members to be in the office Tuesday through Thursday. **SALARY RANGES IN US\-BASED ROLE POSTING** Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Recruiters can share more information with applicants about the specific salary range for preferred locations during the hiring process. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include other perks and benefits. **WHAT WE OFFER** At Trustly, you will have the chance to solve meaningful challenges alongside some of the brightest minds in FinTech. Together, we are shaping the future of payments in an environment that celebrates curiosity, collaboration, and innovation. You will be challenged and empowered to grow, making a real impact every step of the way. Our team is as diverse as the global footprint we serve, with colleagues across Silicon Valley, the U.S., Canada, Brazil, Europe, and beyond. At Trustly, we foster a workplace where everyone feels they belong—a place where teamwork thrives, ideas flourish, and we never forget to have fun along the way. We offer innovative perks and benefits packages that include: * Flexible paid time off \& generous PTO accrual plans * Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and other insurances * FSA \& HSA plans for medical and dependent care * Home office set\-up allowance * Internet stipend * Retirement plan match for 401k and RRSP * Gender\-neutral paid parental leave, and more! (The benefits and total compensation packages outlined above are for full\-time employees; some exclusions apply for temporary positions.) At Trustly, we embrace and celebrate diversity of all forms and the value it brings to our employees and customers. We are proud and committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and believe an open and inclusive environment enables people to do their best work. All decisions regarding hiring, advancement, and any other aspects of employment are made solely on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. Compensation Range: $190K \- $284K

jobs.title: Software Engineer (L2) Messaging Channels Team
jobs.description: **Who we are** At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. Our dedication to remote\-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . **Hiring and how we work** We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! Also, while we are a remote\-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad\-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off\-sites or customer meetings. . **See yourself at Twilio** Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Engineer L2 (Messaging Channels). **About the job** This position is needed to power the future of communications by developing the connectivity, compliance and rich messaging features required to enable adoption of new messaging channels and drive continued growth of existing channels such as WhatsApp, RCS and Facebook Messenger. Our team navigates the complexities of requirements across many channels to enable Twilio customers to have a unified and seamless experience. We enable startups, non\-profits and Fortune 500 companies to send billions of messages a year on our platform. We are looking for candidates passionate about designing, developing, deploying and operating software solutions at scale to help Twilio deliver the best user experience for modern, rich messaging. **Responsibilities** In this role, you’ll: * Build High\-Scale APIs: Design, develop, and maintain high\-performance REST APIs and backend microservices using Java and Go. * Power Rich Messaging: Build and enhance rich messaging features, managing high\-throughput message routing and delivery pipelines. * Operate Cloud Systems: Deploy and support backend services in AWS (open to Azure/GCP experience), prioritizing system reliability, low latency, and fault tolerance. * Leverage Modern AI Tools: Actively integrate AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) into your daily workflow to accelerate output and elevate code quality. * Own System Reliability: Support team on\-call rotations to maintain high availability and operational excellence for critical communications services. * Collaborate Remotely: Partner asynchronously across distributed engineering teams using clear technical written and verbal communication. **Qualifications** Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! **Required:** * 3\+ years of hands\-on software development experience building backend services in Java or Go * Experience designing and building production RESTful APIs as a core part of your day\-to\-day role * Experience operating distributed systems on top of cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred, or equivalent experience with Azure/GCP) * Hands\-on use of AI development tools (e.g. Claude, Copilot) to streamline coding, debugging or documentation * Strong written and verbal technical communication skills * Ability to participate in on\-call rotation (includes weekends and holidays) **Desired:** * Experience with NoSQL datastores (e.g. DynamoDB) * Experience with message queuing (e.g. Simple Queue Service) * Experience deploying and supporting containerized applications in Kubernetes * Prior experience with telecom or rich messaging platforms (RCS, SMS/MMS, OTT messaging) **Location** This role will be remote and based in the USA **Travel** We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in\-person meetings. **What We Offer** Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. **Compensation** *\[OPTION A: NON OTE ROLES]* * *Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.* The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows: * Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $116,960\.00(Developing Minimum for Tier 3\) \- $175,440\.00 (Mid for Tier 3\). * Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $123,760\.00 (Developing Minimum for Tier 2\) \- $185,640\.00 (Mid for Tier 2\). * Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $137,520 (Developing Minimum for Tier 1\) \- $171,900\.00 (Mid for Tier 1\). * This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. **Application deadline information (required for ALL US jobs)** Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 12/15/2026, but may change based on business needs. **Twilio thinks big. Do you?** We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts. You will work closely with business analysts, product managers, quality assurance and business stakeholders to effectively implement data solutions. This role will be responsible for building and maintaining data pipelines, optimizing performance of database environments and automating data processes. jobs.description: We’ve learned that what is best for patients is also best for employees. Learn more about why we are one of the Best Companies to Work for in Texas®. The Senior Data Engineer is Internal Audit's technical specialist for enterprise data, information technology, and cybersecurity risk. This position independently builds and maintains reliable data pipelines. It also manages outsourced, risk\-based IT audits from planning through reporting, serving as the primary liaison with the third\-party audit firm. The role connects system activity to business processes, develops testable risk hypotheses, identifies exposures that may fall outside the third\-party audit scope, and converts complex technical evidence into clear audit conclusions and practical recommendations. The position requires discretion with confidential and sensitive information and works closely with the Internal Audit team, explaining technical work and supporting detail to team members and stakeholders as needed. Position Responsibilities Data Engineering * Design, build, document, monitor, and maintain secure ELT pipelines that acquire data from enterprise applications, databases, APIs, files, and approved cloud sources. * Validate completeness and accuracy; clean, normalize, reconcile, join, and transform data; and load trusted data into approved warehouses, marts, or audit workspaces. * Design and optimize databases, schemas, data models, and reusable analytical structures using advanced SQL. Use JavaScript or other tools when appropriate for integration and automation. * Develop risk\-based hypotheses with auditors and process owners, determine the data needed to test them, identify patterns or exceptions, investigate why they occurred, and distinguish indicators from confirmed findings. * Produce reproducible, audit\-ready workpapers that document sources, populations, transformations, parameters, validation, exceptions, limitations, code, and conclusions. * Communicate results to audit team members for testwork and explain technical findings to management in clear business terms when needed. IT Audit and Cybersecurity * Serve as the department’s primary IT point of contact on outsourced IT audits. * Understand system architecture, configurations, integrations, logs, security tooling, and technical terminology well enough to challenge explanations, identify missing risks, and recognize when audit evidence does not support management’s conclusion. * Evaluate prior IT Audit finding management action plans and compensating controls to determine whether they address the risk and root cause, operate at the required precision and frequency, cover the full population, create reliable evidence, and reduce exposure to an acceptable level. * Review external audit or assessment scopes and results to identify technology risks, systems, interfaces, dependencies, or control areas that were not addressed; coordinate evidence and follow\-up without duplicating work unnecessarily. * Communicate technical/system issues into business terms auditors and stakeholders can act on and communicate business risk back into technical terms IT can act on. Education and Experience Minimum * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data engineering, cybersecurity, accounting information systems, or related fields. Four additional years of directly related experience may be substituted for the degree. * 3\-5 years of progressively responsible, hands\-on data engineering experience, including production of ELT or ETL pipelines, data warehousing, database design or modeling, and data\-quality controls. * At least 2 years of experience supporting IT audit, IT risk management, information security, or IT controls work. This experience may be gained concurrently with the data engineering experience above. Preferred * Master’s degree in a related field. * 7 or more years of hands\-on data engineering experience. * 3 or more years of IT audit or IT risk and controls experience. * Healthcare or similarly regulated industry experience, including sensitive data and critical operational systems. * Experience with EHR, ERP, HR and payroll, timekeeping, identity, security, audit management, backup, cloud, API, or OData platforms. Licensures, Certifications, and Registrations Minimum * Active CISA or CISSP certification required within 18 months of hire and maintained in good standing thereafter. Continuing professional education (CPE) requirements for the applicable certification must be maintained throughout employment. Preferred * Active CISA certification at hire (CISSP also accepted). CISA is strongly preferred for audit responsibilities. Skills and Abilities Minimum * Advanced SQL proficiency and hands\-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server. * Working proficiency in data transformation, analysis, and automation. * Working knowledge of IT risk and controls frameworks such as NIST, COBIT, or ISO 27001\. * Ability to operate independently, learn unfamiliar systems, question incomplete explanations, manage competing priorities, and communicate effectively with engineers, process owners, executives, external auditors, and governance committees. * Ability to collaborate effectively and build strong working relationships across audit, IT, and business teams. Preferred * Familiarity with MySQL or another major relational database platform. * Experience using JavaScript, APIs, or OData for data integration and automation. * Familiarity with FedRAMP requirements for cloud service providers. * Familiarity with Workday and EPIC UMC Health System provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. \*Request for accommodations in the hire process should be directed to UMC Human Resources.\*

jobs.title: Senior Director, Finance AI SME, FP&A and Forecasting Transformation - Eden Prairie, MN preferred, Remote considered
jobs.description: UnitedHealth Group is a health care and well\-being company that's dedicated to improving the health outcomes of millions around the world. We are comprised of two distinct and complementary businesses, UnitedHealthcare and Optum, working to build a better health system for all. Here, your contributions matter as they will help transform health care for years to come. Make an impact with a team that shares your passion for helping others. Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people\-led, responsible AI while **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.** The Senior Director, Finance AI SME, FP\&A and Forecasting Transformation will serve as a senior finance subject matter expert embedded within Finance AI transformation pods. This leader will partner closely with Finance, Data, Technology, Risk and Controls, and business stakeholders to blueprint current\-state and future\-state finance processes, translate business requirements into agent\-ready workflows, and help develop proof\-of\-concept AI systems that can be validated, governed, and scaled. This role is designed for a senior finance leader with deep FP\&A and forecasting experience who can bridge the gap between business finance and technical delivery teams. The individual will bring practical expertise in enterprise forecasting, variance analysis, financial planning, driver\-based modeling, performance reporting, and executive decision support. The role requires the ability to understand how finance work is performed today, identify where AI and automation can materially improve speed, quality, controls, and insight, and help convert future\-state designs into tangible AI\-enabled solutions. The Senior Director will operate in a cross\-functional pod model, working side by side with data engineers, solution architects, forward deployed engineers, AI/ML resources, risk and controls partners, and business finance leaders. The person will not simply advise from the sidelines. They will be expected to lead hands\-on blueprinting sessions, define use\-case requirements, pressure\-test data and control assumptions, validate prototype outputs, and ensure that AI systems are solving real finance problems in a way that is accurate, explainable, auditable, and adoptable. The purpose of this role is to provide senior\-level FP\&A and forecasting expertise to Finance AI pods that are redesigning core finance processes and developing proof\-of\-concept AI systems. The Senior Director will help move Finance from periodic, manual, and fragmented forecasting and analysis processes toward more continuous, driver\-based, data\-enabled, and AI\-supported decision intelligence. The role will focus on three integrated mandates: * Blueprint the current state. Understand and document existing FP\&A and forecasting activities, including process flows, data inputs, handoffs, manual workarounds, estimation methods, controls, outputs, and decision points * Design the future state. Partner with business and technology stakeholders to define how forecasting, variance analysis, scenario modeling, performance reporting, and decision support should operate when AI, data, controls, and human judgment are designed together from the beginning * Develop and validate AI proof\-of\-concept systems. Translate finance requirements into clear prototype designs, partner with data and technology teams during development, validate outputs against business expectations, and help determine whether POCs should be killed, refined, scaled, or transitioned to the AI Factory for productization You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely \* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week. **Primary Responsibilities:** Finance SME Leadership in Pod Delivery * Serve as a senior Finance SME within cross\-functional Finance AI pods focused on FP\&A, forecasting, performance reporting, and decision intelligence * Partner with pod leads, business finance leaders, data teams, solution architects, and engineering resources to define the business problem, target outcomes, scope, requirements, and success criteria for each POC * Bring practical FP\&A judgment to AI design decisions, ensuring prototypes reflect how finance leaders actually forecast, analyze, explain, and make decisions * Act as the translator between finance users and technical teams, converting business needs into clear, testable requirements for AI\-enabled workflows * Help ensure pod work remains focused on high\-value finance problems rather than disconnected technology experimentation Current\-State Blueprinting * Lead structured blueprinting sessions with Finance, business, data, and technology stakeholders to map current\-state forecasting and FP\&A processes * Document key process steps, business owners, data sources, systems, handoffs, manual workarounds, spreads river\-based forecasting, P\&L analysis, business metrics, executive reporting, and financial planning processes * Experience working across business, finance, technology, and data teams to deliver process improvement, automation, analytics, or transformation initiatives * Ability to map complex current\-state processes and translate them into simplified future\-state operating models * Proven solid analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate data quality, process gaps, business logic, and control implications * Proven solid executive communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex issues, frame trade\-offs, and make clear recommendations * Ability to operate in ambiguity, influence without direct authority, and move work forward across a matrixed organization * Proven high degree of ownership, urgency, judgment, and attention to detail **Preferred Qualifications:** * MBA, CPA, CMA, or equivalent advanced finance, accounting, or analytics credential * Experience with AI, machine learning, automation, analytics products, data products, or digital finance transformation * Experience with Oracle EPM, enterprise planning tools, data visualization platforms, financial data marts, Snowflake, Azure, or related enterprise data environments * Experience designing or implementing driver\-based forecasting, rolling forecasts, scenario modeling, or advanced business performance analytics * Experience supporting finance transformation in a regulated environment with SOX, SEC reporting, audit, model governance, or other control considerations * Familiarity with agentic AI concepts, LLM\-enabled workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, retrieval\-augmented generation, prompt evaluation, and AI output validation * Experience working in a product\-oriented or agile delivery model, including POCs, pilots, MVPs, product roadmaps, and adoption measurement * All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy. Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). The salary for this role will range from $159,300 \- $273,200 annually based on full\-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable. Primary responsibilities include work on i\-detect, a One Health participatory surveillance platform where community members report health events in people, animals and the environment, for early detection of public health threats. jobs.description: **Position overview Position title:** Assistant Professor Salary range: The current salary range for this position is $111,400–$163,200 (9\-month academic year salary), however, off\-scale salary and other components of pay, which would yield compensation that is higher than this range, are offered to meet competitive conditions. Anticipated start: 07/01/2027 Review timeline: Not yet provided Application Window **Open date:** October 12, 2026 **Next review date:** Tuesday, Dec 1, 2026 at 11:59pm (Pacific Time) Apply by this date to ensure full consideration by the committee. **Final date:** Tuesday, Dec 1, 2026 at 11:59pm (Pacific Time) Applications will continue to be accepted until this date. Position description **Position Description:** The University of California, Berkeley invites applications for an approved faculty position at the non\-tenured (tenure\-track) Assistant Professor level in the area of AI for Materials. This appointment will start as a 100% Materials Science and Engineering (MSE) appointment, with the appointee joining the Bakar Institute for Digital Materials for the Planet (BIDMaP) in the College of Computing, Data Science, and Society (CDSS) as a member, with access to its collaborative resources and postdoctoral program. It is the intention to move to the position to a 50/50 split appointment between MSE and a future interdisciplinary data science unit if/when established in CDSS, with MSE as the home department. **About the Units:** The MSE department is part of the College of Engineering (COE) and maintains close ties with Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (LBNL). It advances the understanding and design of materials through an interdisciplinary blend of chemistry, physics, and engineering, pairing rigorous fundamentals with modern, application\-driven approaches. Our key strength is our collaborative, cross\-disciplinary research community, with abundant opportunities for students and collaborators across campus and beyond. BIDMaP is an institute in CDSS, a new college at Berkeley, with the goal of advancing the state\-of\-the\-art in the core of computing, data science, and statistics, while making sustained progress on issues of human and societal significance. BIDMaP advances the synthesis, design, and translation of innovative materials aimed at mitigating critical global challenges. Through the integration of pioneering chemistry with machine learning, artificial intelligence, and robotic automation, BIDMaP transforms materials innovation into targeted solutions for clean air, clean water, advanced batteries, and sustainable chemical production. **About the Position:** We seek outstanding candidates demonstrating the potential to build a world\-class research program that uses and advances AI to enable transformational progress in materials science and engineering. Research may span the development of new AI methods motivated by materials challenges, co\-development of emergent AI with materials theory and experimentation, and the deployment of AI to accelerate materials research, discovery and innovation. Application areas are intentionally broad, encompassing the full breadth of materials science—from soft to hard matter and inorganic to organic systems—and all stages of the materials lifecycle, including synthesis, processing, modeling, theory, characterization, fabrication, integration, deployment, and reuse. Candidates are encouraged to pursue interdisciplinary and non\-traditional approaches, including autonomous experimentation and data generation, scientific foundation models, language\-based methods, multimodal learning, robotics and automation, AI/ML methods for characterization, and techno\-economic or lifecycle analysis. The successful candidate will help position Berkeley at the global forefront of both AI and materials innovation while contributing actively to the intellectual communities of MSE and BIDMaP. jobs.title: IT Technician 5 - User Services
jobs.description: The University of Nevada, Reno (UNR) appreciates your interest in employment at our growing institution. We want your application process to go smoothly and quickly. Final applications must be submitted prior to the close of the recruitment. If you need assistance or have questions regarding the application process, please contact our recruitment helpline at (775\) 784\-1495 or jobs@unr.edu . **Job Description** The University of Nevada, Reno is recruiting for an IT Technician 5 position within the Office of Information Technology (OIT) – User Services. \*\*This position does not provide layoff rights and is contingent upon funding.\*\* The technician will work as a member of the Endpoint Services unit and will be responsible for supporting and managing endpoint devices across the University’s central campus and offsite locations. This includes the deployment, configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of OIT\-managed computing devices and peripherals, including computers, laptops, printers, and other related technologies. Responsibilities may include troubleshooting hardware, software, and operating system issues; installing and configuring software; managing endpoint connectivity and peripheral devices; and supporting applications such as Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Cloud, ESRI, Autodesk, and other enterprise technologies. This position is called upon to transport equipment to various physical locations, work on a bench in the shop area, and perform on\-site repairs when possible. Duties also include evaluating and recommending replacement parts and hardware upgrades for institutionally owned equipment; performing equipment relocations, replacements, and modifications; deploying new endpoint devices using established imaging, configuration, and management processes; coordinating deployments with department personnel; performing data transfers in accordance with University, OIT, and departmental data security requirements; and advising departments on University\-approved surplus procedures to ensure the secure disposition of institutional data and equipment. The position also supports device lifecycle management activities and shared computing environments, including instructional labs, classrooms, and other institutional technology spaces. **Essential Qualifications** * Graduation from high school or equivalent education and two (2\) years of IT work experience in the installation, maintenance, and repair of network workstation hardware and software; **OR** * One (1\) year of relevant experience as an IT Technician 4 in Nevada State service; **OR** A n equivalent combination of education and experience as described above. * A valid Class “C” driver’s license or higher operator’s license is required at the time of appointment and as a condition of continuing employment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Microsoft Intune (Endpoint Manager), Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (formerly SCCM), JAMF, Active Directory, Group Policy Management (GPMC), DeepFreeze, and LabStats. * Experience deploying, managing, and troubleshooting Windows endpoint devices in an enterprise environment, including PowerShell scripting and automation to support deployment, configuration, reporting, and operational efficiency. * Experience with operating system deployment, software packaging, endpoint security practices, and device lifecycle management. A request to accelerate salary must be approved by Human Resources and abide by the Nevada Administrative Code. To view the classified compensation schedules, please visit: Classified Compensation . Select Salary schedule, PP01\.
