jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Unsecured Installments
jobs.description: **About Upstart** At Upstart, we're united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that's both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We're proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn't mean distant. We're intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you'll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you're energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we'd love to hear from you. **The Team:** Unsecured Installments is one of Upstart's core lending products, helping borrowers access credit through a seamless, digitally native experience. The team owns critical parts of the borrower journey across offer generation, pricing, underwriting, funding, and borrower experience, while working closely with the broader lending platform that powers Upstart at scale. Recent work has focused on improving borrower flows, repricing and rate flexibility, partnership experiences, and the overall quality of the customer\-facing experience. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Unsecured Installments team, you'll be a technical leader for the frontend and full\-stack experiences that borrowers interact with directly. Working primarily in React and TypeScript, you'll own the delivery of large, multi\-month projects, shape the architecture of the team's mobile\-web and full\-stack surfaces, and set a high bar for quality across the borrower experience. You'll partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to turn ambiguous problems into durable, well\-architected solutions, and you'll mentor other engineers along the way. **How you'll make an impact** * Own the design and delivery of large, complex backend and full\-stack initiatives, from planning and sequencing through launch and long\-term maintenance. * Set technical direction for the team's service architecture, APIs, data models, and system integrations, owning a 3–6 month roadmap and proactively addressing systemic gaps that threaten reliability or team effectiveness. * Partner closely with product, frontend, design, platform, and other backend engineers to translate roadmap priorities and borrower needs into scalable, high\-quality systems. * Raise the bar for engineering excellence through thoughtful service and API design, data integrity, testing, observability, security, and operational rigor across business\-critical lending workflows. * Lead through ambiguity by breaking down loosely defined problems into clear, testable plans and using data to inform tradeoffs involving scope, scalability, performance, reliability, and customer experience. * Mentor and grow other engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance, and serve as a trusted collaborator across the team. * Contribute to how the team uses AI in development workflows and product capabilities, with a pragmatic view of where it can create meaningful leverage. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, and 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Deep proficiency designing and building backend services and APIs in a language such as Python, Java, Kotlin, Go, Ruby, or Node.js. * Strong experience with service architecture, API design, data modeling, relational or non\-relational databases, and distributed systems. * Track record of independently leading the design and delivery of large, business\-critical backend or full\-stack projects in production. * Experience building reliable production systems, including testing, monitoring, incident response, performance optimization, and long\-term operational ownership. * Ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments where product requirements, constraints, and system boundaries evolve over time. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the a oducts or high\-volume transactional systems with strong requirements around reliability, scalability, correctness, and security. * Background in fintech, lending, payments, or other regulated financial products involving complex workflows and high quality expectations. * Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous processing, event\-driven architectures, or service\-oriented architectures. * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, relational and non\-relational data stores, messaging systems, and CI/CD workflows. * Experience with experimentation, feature flagging, or platform capabilities that support iterative product improvements in production. * Hands\-on experience leveraging generative AI in product features or internal engineering workflows. * Passion for building products that expand access to credit and improve financial outcomes for consumers. **Position location** This role is available in the following locations: Remote **Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in\-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in\-person sessions' cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2\-4 consecutive days at a time. \#LI\-REMOTE \#LI\-MidSenior **What you'll love** At Upstart, our benefits for full\-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well\-being, family, and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: * Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly * Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada) * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only) * Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada. * Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only) * Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security * Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements * Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country) * Family\-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life\-centered resources * Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only) * Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well\-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you * Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from * Connection and community through team events, all\-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs) * Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro\-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec. Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices. *If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email candidate\_accommodations@upstart.com* https://www.upstart.com/candidate\_privacy\_policy

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description: Valence has built the only AI native coaching platform for enterprise, offering personalized, expert, and human\-like guidance and support to any leader or employee. We’re not just talking about the future of work — we’re building it now, with the most innovative Fortune 500 companies across healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, and technology. Learn more about our work with Microsoft: Valence Brings AI Coaching More Deeply Into the Flow of Work with Microsoft 365 Our focus is on the problems that actually decide whether AI changes how organizations operate — the ones with no playbook, no obvious answers, and no guarantee of success. If you want to be part of the small group that defines how AI transforms the future at a global scale, this is your chance. And this isn’t for everyone. We’re not looking for people who want predictability or incremental progress. We only want those who are restless at the edge of what’s possible, who get bored when things feel “done,” and who are driven to redefine what AI can mean for leaders, companies, and the world. Because at Valence, the work worth doing is the kind that redefines work itself. **The Role** ------------ As a Senior/Staff Product Engineer, you will be instrumental in architecting, building, and scaling both backend systems and user\-facing experiences that power our LLM\-driven coaching platform. You will ship features end\-to\-end \- from designing resilient APIs and integrating models to delivering polished interfaces in the browser \- while collaborating closely with cross\-functional partners in product, design, and infrastructure. This is a *ground\-floor opportunity* to shape a category\-defining product used by enterprise customers worldwide. You’ll contribute to: * Full stack architecture, development, and optimization of features spanning backend, AI/model integration, and frontend interfaces. * Designing for scale, performance, and security in enterprise environments. * Debugging across the stack \- from model behavior and backend services to UI logic and client performance. * Collaborating with product, design, and operations to deliver delightful, resilient user experiences. * Helping evolve the engineering culture, tooling, hiring, and technical roadmap as the team grows. **About Valence** ----------------- We're the only company pioneering leadership coaching for large enterprises in an AI\-first way. Our mission is to transform how the world's biggest companies approach learning and development, helping teams work better together through AI\-powered personalization that adapts to individual goals and organizational culture using the latest advances in machine learning and natural language processing. We've been featured in Harvard Business Review, TIME, World Economic Forum, Financial Times, Forbes and an Inc. 5000 fastest\-growing private companies in America. Our clients represent the most diverse and sophisticated enterprise AI implementations globally, including Coca\-Cola, Delta, Nestlé, General Mills, Schneider Electric, Deutsche Telekom, AstraZeneca, Prudential, CVS and Bristol Myers Squibb. Working at Valence means you'll work directly with Fortune 500 technology leaders, building expertise through the most complex enterprise deployments while gaining insight into diverse organizational approaches to AI transformation. These aren't just any enterprise clients \- they're the companies defining what AI\-first business transformation looks like across every major industry. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Build and extend critical backend services:** architect APIs, integrate LLMs and related services, and optimize server\-side systems for performance and reliability. * **Develop polished frontend experiences:** craft intuitive UI flows, ensure accessibility and responsiveness, and manage data flow between frontend and backend. * **Own end\-to\-end delivery:** from scoping requirements, writing tests, deploying code, to monitoring and observability in production. * **Collaborate deeply:** work across product, design, data, and infrastructure to solve real user problems and accelerate delivery. * **Drive best practices:** help shape engineering standards, CI/CD automation, observability, and performance benchmarking. * **Mentor and grow:** support team members through code reviews, technical discussions, and institution of scalable practices. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * **Strong full stack experience:** you have shipped production\-grade systems involving both backend and frontend components, and you’re comfortable owning APIs and user experiences end\-to\-end. * **Technical breadth/ Engineering skills:** deep proficiency with Python (Django preferred) or similar languages for backend; strong JavaScript skills and familiarity with modern frameworks (e.g., React, Vue). * **Frontend craftsmanship/ UX obsessed:** experience building responsive, high\-performance UI with attention to usability an , performance, security, and maintainability in large, distributed environments. * **Builder at Heart:** you’ve architected and shipped production\-grade, user\-facing systems. You balance polish with speed, knowing when to prioritize craftsmanship and when to push scrappy experiments to learn fast. * **Versatility and pragmatism:** you balance sound architectural decisions with a willingness to prototype and iterate quickly when needed. * **Customer\-Centered \& Product\-Focused:** you care as much about usability, accessibility, and adoption as you do about code quality. You think beyond “does it work” to “does it work for the user, at scale, and in enterprise environments.” * **Startup fluent:** you thrive in ambiguity, value momentum over perfection, and enjoy wearing multiple hats. **What You'll Get** ------------------- **Ownership \& Rapid Growth** * Outsized missions from day one, with direct responsibility for company\-defining projects * Work alongside the executive team with transparency into strategy and decision\-making * Influence on direction through real\-time customer feedback and market insights **AI\-First Operator** * Work directly with cutting\-edge AI models and next\-generation platforms * Build expertise in enterprise AI implementation across Fortune 500 companies and multiple industries * Establish yourself as a recognized leader among peers in shaping how AI transforms work at a global scale **Compensation** * Competitive salary including base \+ bonuses * Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision) from day one * Generous PTO, company\-wide R\&R shutdowns, and paid parental leave * Retirement plan support for US and global employees **Equity** * Meaningful ownership in a venture\-backed company at a growth inflection point * Financial upside that comes from scaling fast * Top\-up grants as we scale and you deliver exceptional performance — your compensation grows alongside your impact **Top\-Performing Culture** * A culture built for top talent: intensity to win, growth without limits, and a team that solves hard problems and celebrates big wins together **Learn more about us and meet our team** **here** **Location and Work Environment** --------------------------------- This role can be either remote or hybrid from our offices in New York or Toronto. Candidates must be comfortable working with colleagues in different time zones (UK), and have valid travel documents without work authorization restrictions in the US. **Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------- We are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and supported. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and offer accommodations upon request throughout the hiring process. If you have any questions, please reach out to Allison Langille, Head of People, at jobs@valence.co. **Employment Verification \& Commitment** ----------------------------------------- We use third\-party services to verify employment history, education, and other information relevant to your candidacy. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of these verification checks. This is a full\-time role that requires a high level of focus, availability, and commitment. Employees may not hold concurrent full\-time employment with another organization while employed at Valence. Any outside consulting, advisory, freelance, or other professional work must be disclosed and approved in advance and must not interfere with job responsibilities, availability, performance, or create a conflict of interest \- including risks related to confidentiality, intellectual property, or competition. *Valence takes candidate fraud seriously. We verify identity, LinkedIn profiles, employment history, and references; any misrepresentation during the hiring process is grounds for withdrawing an offer or ending employment. All offers are contingent on successful completion of these checks.* \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Distinguished Engineer - ML/AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. ### **What you’ll be doing...** As a Dist Engr\-AI Engineer within our team of propensity modelers, you will be responsible for the technical execution of Verizon's transition to a modern, agile pod model. You will work directly at the critical touchpoints of the customer lifecycle and high\-impact trigger events, providing the advanced machine learning support needed to unlock deep microsegmentation and hyper\-personalization. Your work will directly empower marketers, optimize customer journeys, and drive down churn across our most critical customer segments. Responsibilities include: * Leading the design, development, and optimization of agentic AI, LLM, and machine learning/deep learning solutions. * Building, training, and deploying our high\-priority propensity models to predict customer behaviors, churn risk, and key lifecycle triggers. * Drive consolidation of overlapping propensity models into a shared customer state and unified models, reducing operational and development cost. * Operating independently to manage end\-to\-end model development pipelines, from advanced feature engineering to production deployment and monitoring. * Serve as a subject matter expert on agentic development, machine learning and predictive modeling, providing technical guidance and mentorship to junior data scientists. * Owning the lifecycle of models deployed in high\-impact areas, ensuring continuous optimization, accuracy, and measurable business performance. * Presenting complex model insights, performance metrics, and strategic recommendations clearly to senior leadership and cross\-functional business partners. **What we're looking for...** You are a data science professional who thrives on solving complex analytical problems with minimal guidance. You have a proven track record of managing high\-priority machine learning projects, and you excel at collaborating directly with business partners to deliver data\-driven customer experiences that impact the bottom line. **You will need to have:** * Bachelor's degree or six or more years of work experience. * Eight or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience. * Experience working on high\-priority or high\-visibility technical initiatives within a corporate setting. * Experience designing and measuring A/B tests or uplift models for targeting. * Strong expertise and experience in machine learning/deep learning algorithms, including transformer, transfer learning, NLP, expertise in using Pytorch and scikit\-learn packages, as well as probability calibration and time\-based validation. * Experience with Python, R, and SQL for advanced statistical modeling and large\-scale data extraction. * Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, or Azure) and production MLOps tools for tracking and maintaining model workflows. **Even better if you have one or more of the following:** * Knowledge of LLM agent architecture: Google ADK, LangChain/LangGraph, multi\-agent orchestration, retrieval\-augmented generation RAG , MCP, A2A protocols, ONNX\-based embeddings, vector databases and semantic search. * Knowledge of cloud\-scale data engineering: Big Query pipelines, GCP (Cloud Run, Vertex AI). If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $137,000\.00 \- $263,000\.00\.

Since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. With over 6,000 employees spanning 50\+ locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies and engineering expertise that address real\-world challenges across a wide range of industries. Our sustainable solutions, made from high quality, graded scrap steel, promote circular construction by making piping systems infinitely reconfigured and minimizing environmental impact. Today, our high\-quality products are used in more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world's most critical and prestigious structures. **An Industry Leader With a Heart as Big as Its Ambition and Innovation** *At Victaulic, we're committed to constructing a better world for and with our people.* **Let's Build a Better World Together.** Our commitment to our people is built on four pillars: * We build from within. * We stand behind our people. * We foster an environment for constant learning. * We engineer change for a more stable and sustainable world. **YOUR IMPACT STARTS HERE** We're looking for a Production Engineer to join our Operations team supporting the Duluth, GA facility, reporting to the Production Engineering Supervisor. existence of equipment capabilities, material availability, and necessary skill sets to manufacture the project * Prepare detailed cost estimates for production projects, including labor, materials, and overhead costs * Analyze project specifications, drawings, and other documentation to create accurate estimates * Review and adjust estimates based on project changes and updates **WHAT YOU SolidWorks * Familiarity with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel * Ability to communicate with multiple groups across departments and work in a team environment **WHAT SETS YOU APART** * Competitive compensation with performance\-based incentives * Career development programs and internal promotion pathways—we build from within * Tuition reimbursement and continuous learning opportunities **Build A Better Future** * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage * Retirement savings plans with company match * Life insurance and disability coverage **Build A Better You** * Paid time off, holidays, and flexible work arrangements where applicable * Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and wellness resources * Inclusive, team\-oriented culture where people look out for one another **Build A Better World** Join a company whose products contribute to a safer, more sustainable built environment every day. **IMMIGRATION SPONSORSHIP** Victaulic does not provide jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** **Reports to the CTO** Most doctors keep learning long after training ends and Vumedi is where they come to do it. We're hiring a Director of Engineering to lead a small, very senior US team of principal and staff engineers. This person will set the technical direction for the AI, data and platform work behind how physicians find, watch and learn from medical video. This is a role for a product\-minded engineering leader who still enjoys being close to the technology. You'll lead experienced engineers who own their areas end to end, shape what we build next with the CTO and Product, and help grow the US engineering organization. ### **About Vumedi** Vumedi is the largest video education platform for doctors worldwide. More than half a million clinicians, including **1 in 4 US doctors**, trust Vumedi for their ongoing education, whether they're tackling a rare disease, learning about new clinical trials or getting a refresher on a complicated surgical technique. * **500K\+** clinicians * **100K** peer\-to\-peer videos * **25** medical specialties * **80%** of the top 20 US hospitals contribute content We're headquartered in Oakland, CA, with offices in Minneapolis, MN, and Zagreb, Croatia. We're growing quickly: engineering has grown more than 65% in the last 18 months, and we're investing heavily in AI\-powered experiences for physicians. ### **What makes this role different** * **A senior team from day one.** You'll lead principal and staff engineers across AI Products, Data, Platform, Growth and Personalization. They're experienced builders, not a team you need to build from scratch. * **Broad technical ownership.** Few Director roles cover data, AI, platform and personalization together. You'll make them work as one system. * **AI in the product and in how we build it.** We ship applied LLM products like AskMedi, intelligent search and recommendations, and we expect AI to change how engineering works too. * **Direct influence.** You'll work closely with the CTO and Product leadership on strategy, with no layers in between. ### **What you'll do** * Lead, coach and grow a team of principal and staff engineers, giving them meaningful ownership and room to increase their scope and impact. * Set a clear technical strategy across data, AI, platform and personalization, and make the trade\-offs between them. * Partner with Product to shape roadmaps for physician\-facing experiences, balancing user experience, business goals, speed and long\-term quality. * Help our data work move beyond reporting toward data products, prediction and automation, working closely with our Analytics team. * Drive AI adoption across the development lifecycle, so the team builds and ships faster with higher quality. * Stay technically engaged: understand the architecture, take part in design discussions and read code, without needing to write production code every day. * Work closely with our engineering leaders in Zagreb on shared priorities, ownership and communication across time zones. * Put lightweight operating rhythms in place that create accountability without bureaucracy. * Hire seniors talents and help shape how US engineering is organized as it grows. ### **In your first six months, you will** * Earn the trust of the team and set clear ownership and expectations for each area * Agree on a technical roadmap across multiple areas with the CTO and Product * Hire senior engineers * Show measurable improvements in delivery speed, reliability or AI adoption ### **About you** **What you bring** * 12\+ years of software engineering experience, including 6\+ years in engineering leadership. * Experience managing senior ICs directly (staff or principal engineers) and (BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Composer).) * Build reusable frameworks and tooling (ingestion, transformation, quality, orchestration) that can be adopted by multiple product and domain teams. * Enable self‑service data consumption and governance by standardizing patterns, templates, and platform capabilities rather than one‑off pipelines. * Design logical and physical data platform architectures leveraging BigQuery, Dataflow/Apache Beam, Dataproc/Spark, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Storage. * Define and implement standardized ingestion, transformation, and serving patterns (batch and streaming) as reusable blueprints. * Optimize cost, performance, and reliability of GCP data workloads (partitioning, clustering, storage classes, autoscaling strategies). * Build opinionated data ingestion frameworks (e.g., config‑driven pipelines, connectors, schema handling, error handling) on top of Dataflow, Dataproc, or Composer. * Develop shared transformation libraries in Python/SQL/Beam (e.g., common SCD patterns, data quality checks, masking/tokenization routines). * Provide orchestration capabilities via Cloud Composer or Cloud Workflows with reusable DAGs/templates and CI/CD integration. * Implement robust data modeling (dimensional, data vault, or canonical models) and semantic layers in BigQuery and related tools. * Enforce data quality, lineage, and observability using standardized metrics, validation rules, and monitoring dashboards. * Apply security and governance controls: IAM, VPC‑SC, CMEK, row/column‑level security, and policy‑driven access patterns * Partner with domain data engineers, analytics, and ML teams to onboard use cases onto platform services and frameworks * Document patterns, runbooks, and best practices, and provide enablement through workshops and code examples. * Contribute to platform roadmap, tool selection, and evaluation of new GCP services and open‑source components **Required services. * Knowledge of cloud architecture principles (networking, security, IAM, reliability, cost management). * Experience with core GCP data services: BigQuery, Dataflow/Apache Beam, Dataproc, jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.description: **We are WisdomAI.** *We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.* WisdomAI builds AI\-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context. We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here. **Design at WisdomAI** WisdomAI is building an AI thinking partner for business — a context\-aware platform that answers questions from your data, builds apps, and powers agents that help run your business. Grounded in the context of your business, it delivers accurate, consistent answers that help people understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next. We're building a small, deliberately senior design team: fewer designers, more ownership each. As a Staff Product Designer, you'll set direction for the product experience as a whole, not a single feature: how our core surfaces fit together, how the design system scales with them, and what the craft standard of the company should be. You'll still do the hands\-on work yourself, and you'll make the designers around you better while you do it. You'll work directly with our VP of Design as a hands\-on partner, and as the team grows, there's room for this role to grow with it. Some UX patterns for AI are settling; many aren't. You'll lead on some of AI's most interesting design problems: how answers earn trust, how intelligent analytical agents create value and report back, how a generated app should feel, and how complex analysis becomes clear and actionable through New York Times–caliber data visualization. Part of this job is applying what works, part is inventing what doesn't exist yet, and part is deciding which of those a problem needs. The goal is a thinking partner that helps people make smarter decisions and take smarter actions. It's simple by default, with power one click away. Our product's entire promise is trust — people make real decisions from what we show them. A chart that's technically correct but visually misleading is a failure. An answer that's right but illegible is a failure. Craft isn't decoration at WisdomAI. It's the product working. We work AI\-forward. Exploration often starts in an LLM — clarifying intent, mapping edge cases, pressure\-testing a direction before a single frame exists. We move fluidly between tools like Figma, Paper, Claude, or Cursor. We're not precious about process or toolchain; we optimize for velocity and quality. At the staff level, you'll help define how the team works this way, not only practice it. **What you'll do** * Set the product experience vision across multiple areas, and turn it into a direction the team, PMs, and engineers can build toward. * Take on the most ambiguous, highest\-stakes problems: frame them with customers and leadership, explore the solution space, and carry the work through launch and iteration. * Shape the roadmap alongside product and engineering leadership, using customer insight and design exploration to influence what we build, not only how. * Design the moments where complexity becomes clarity: trustworthy AI answers that range from a single number to deep analysis, data visualizations that make the story clear enough to act on, artifacts from dashboards to apps and presentations, and intelligent analytical agents that work on users' behalf. * Own the coherence of the product. Define the interaction patterns and principles that keep chat, apps, agents, and visualizations feeling like one system. * Lead the evolution of our design system and its foundations, partnering with engineering on how it's built and adopted. * Prototype early and often using AI tools, and set the bar for how the team uses them, sharing prompts, patterns, and process. * Mentor designers through crits, pairing, and direct feedback, and raise the craft standard in what we ship. * Help shape how design works across R\&D: our rituals, our quality bar, and how design partners with product and engineering. * Help grow the team: shape who we hire and the culture they join. * Talk to customers directly. Treat research as a velocity tool, not a gate. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 8\+ years designing exceptional products, ideally in B2B, data, AI, or other complex domains, including time leading work across multiple product areas. * Exceptional visual craft and taste. You notice the 1px things, and you know which ones matter. * Mastery of typography, color, spacing, and hierarchy, with attention to the details that make interfaces feel effortless and hold up in daily use. * A portfolio that shows product vision as well as execution: work where you defined the direction, made complex systems feel simple, and shipped it. * Systems thinking. You design patterns and frameworks that other designers build on, and you can show where your decisions shaped a whole product, not one screen. * A track record of influence without authority. You've changed a roadmap, aligned leadership on a direction, or set a standard a team adopted. * Experience mentoring designers and raising the quality of a team's work. * A strong appetite for designing with AI. Hands\-on experience with LLMs and AI prototyping tools is strongly preferred, along with curiosity about whatever ships next. If you're not there yet but you're hungry to work this way, we want to hear from you. **Nice to haves** ----------------- * You code, or consider yourself one part design engineer — conversant in components, states, and how interfaces get built. * You have deep experience with data visualization, and opinions about it. * You've built or led a design system and know what it takes for shared components to scale. * You've led design on fast\-moving product teams where iteration and momentum win. * You've been an early design hire or helped build a design team from the ground up. * You've managed designers, or you're ready to. \- **Our CRAFT** CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves. **C — Customer trust.** Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around. **R — Relentless on outcomes.** We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now. **A — Authenticity.** We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together. **F — First principles, grounded in reality.** We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real\-world results decide. **T — Transparency.** We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong. \- **Equal opportunity employer** WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: St. George, UT Full\-time Posted 2026\-10\-13 Zonos is the AI operating system for cross\-border trade, powering everything from checkout to customs clearance for more than 50,000 ecommerce merchants and 70\+ postal operators across 200\+ countries. We help businesses grow globally by removing the complexity of international commerce—calculating, collecting, and guaranteeing duties, taxes, and fees at checkout so shoppers see the true total cost upfront, eliminating surprise charges at delivery and the burden of managing country\-specific tax requirements. Beyond ecommerce, Zonos supports carriers, postal operators, marketplaces, and customs agencies with AI\-driven tools that infer and validate key customs data, including HS codes, country of origin, and customs value, alongside licensed customs brokerage services that ensure goods move compliantly and efficiently across borders. ### **Overview** Behind almost every part of that is a data problem. Inferring an HS code from a messy product title, estimating customs value, deciding when an answer is confident enough to guarantee, spotting the shipments that need a human, and pricing risk across 200\+ countries all have real financial and regulatory consequences. We're hiring a data scientist who solves problems and ships the solution. Sometimes that's a fine\-tuned LLM. Sometimes it's a Bayesian model, a well\-designed experiment, an optimization, a simulation, or a 30\-line rule that beats everything else. We want someone with the whole toolbelt and the judgment to pick the right tool. Cleverness for its own sake doesn't interest us. You'll report directly to our Chief Data Scientist and work side by side with engineering, taking problems from "fuzzy and important" to something running in production that customers rely on. ### **How we work** Zonos doesn't have product managers. At the senior level, you talk to customers and internal teams directly, understand the problem, decide what's worth solving and how, and ship it. Part of the job is judgment: pushing back, proposing a simpler approach, or saying the data doesn't support the decision. Disagreements get resolved quickly and in writing, with clear owners. ### **Life in St. George UT** This role is on\-site at our headquarters in St. George, Utah, where our team enjoys Southern Utah's 300 days of sunshine each year. Snow Canyon State Park is minutes away, Zion National Park is about an hour's drive, and Las Vegas is about two. Relocation assistance is available for candidates moving here. ### **What you'll do** * Own data problems at the heart of the product, such as classification, valuation, risk, and compliance. Choose the approach, whether that's statistical modeling, classical ML, deep learning and LLMs, optimization, or a simple rule. * Work with messy, multilingual product and shipment data. Figure out what it actually says before modeling anything. * Quantify uncertainty and make it useful. Decide when we're confident enough to act, when to route work to a human, and what each error costs. * Design the evaluations, experiments, and analyses that tell us whether something actually worked, and hold the line when it didn't. * Write production\-quality Python and SQL, then ship, monitor, and iterate on what you build. * Join the on\-call rotation and debug in production, including the subtle failures that only show up on real traffic. * Bring rigor to product and business decisions beyond your own projects. ### **You might be a great fit if you...** * **Reach for the right tool, not the newest one.** You can explain why you chose a GLM over a transformer, or a heuristic over both, and tell us how it played out. * **Own the full loop.** You've framed a problem, built the solution, shipped it, and stayed with it after launch. * **Can point to impact.** You've shipped work that moved a real metric, and you can tell us which one and how you measured it. * **Write code engineers are happy to merge.** You explore in notebooks, and you ship clean, tested code. * **Lead with product judgment.** You ask "should we solve this?" before "how do we solve this?" * Want to live and work in sunny St. George, Utah, with a real work\-life balance. * You also bring: + 5\+ years of hands\-on data science work with a Bachelor's degree, or 3\+ years with a Master's or PhD, including things you built that ran in production. + Real depth in statistics: inference, experimental design, and uncertainty. You understand what the numbers mean, not just how to produce them. + Practical experience with ML and LLMs/NLP, including fine\-tuning, embeddings, evaluation, and text classification at scale. + Strong Python and SQL. * Nice to have: optimization or operations research, causal inference, forecasting, Bayesian methods, serving models on GPUs, and experience with trade, customs, logistics, ecommerce, or payments data. ### **What we offer** * **Compensation:** $200,000–$275,000 annual base salary, depending on experience and demonstrated impact. If your compensation expectations fall outside this range, we'd still love to hear from you. We're focused on finding the right person and are willing to be flexible for exceptional talent. * Relocation assistance is available for candidates relocating to St. George, Utah. * Medical, Dental, Vision, \& Life \- we pay 100% of the employee premium! * Paid parental leave and other life event leave * 401k retirement plan with generous company match * 4 weeks of vacation, plus sick and other paid time off. Take some time to relax! * Employee Assistance Program * 1 month paid time off at 5 year anniversary * Office stocked with snacks and drinks * Weekly company lunch **Ready to Join the Team?** --------------------------- Become a Zonut and help us create trust in global trade. We're building something meaningful—a company that puts people first and makes cross\-border commerce accessible to everyone. If you're passionate about solving complex challenges with cutting\-edge technology, we'd love to meet you.

jobs.title: AI Product Manager — AI Labs founding team
jobs.description: **About airSlate** airSlate is a global SaaS technology company that develops no\-code workflow automation, electronic signature, and document management solutions. Our award\-winning products \- **Sign****Now, pdfFiller, DocHub, altaFlow, Instapage, and US Legal Forms** \- serve over hundreds of millions of users and more than one million customers worldwide, helping organizations of every size digitize processes, improve efficiency, and transform how they work. We’re in an exciting phase of growth and transformation, with teammates in more than 20 countries across three continents and main hubs in the **United States, Poland, Ukraine and Philippines**. At airSlate, we’re building value for customers and a culture where growth and innovation go hand in hand. We’re looking for people eager to shape products, scale a company, and thrive in a fast\-moving environment. ### **About the team:** AI Labs is airSlate's bet on what comes after the toolbox era of software. No backlog rituals, no six\-month roadmaps, no committees — small teams, weekly ship cycles, real users from day one. We build AI\-native products for the businesses that actually run the economy: the contractor booking your kitchen remodel, the dentist scheduling your cleaning, the 10\-person shop drowning in W\-9s and PDFs nobody designed for them. They've been stuck with decades\-old software. We're here to change that, fast. ### **The opportunity:** For thirty years, software gave people toolboxes — edit this, sign that, file the other thing, one click at a time. AI lets us skip the toolbox entirely and hand people the outcome: taxes filed, contracts signed, staff onboarded, done. That's not an incremental upgrade. It's a chance to make our own products — and everyone else's — obsolete, fast. Whoever builds this first wins a category. We want it to be us, and we want it to be you.### **The role:** You'll own a brand\-new AI\-native product from the moment it's an idea. Not a backlog, not someone else's roadmap — and not a blank page either. The idea reaches you already pointed at a clear need, identified from what we can see across millions of existing customers. What it isn't yet is a product. That part is yours. You'll go and find out whether the need is as real as the data suggests. Who exactly is this customer? What would they actually pay for? Where's the wedge, what does the first version have to do, and what has to be true for this to become a real business rather than a clever demo? Then you'll build it, put it in front of people, and find out fast. You'll have a small team of engineers who are good, fast, and looking to you to make the next six months feel like an adventure instead of a slog. And you'll be backed by serious go\-to\-market muscle — figuring out and executing business models, marketing channels and customer acquisition. You'll have strong opinions on all of it, and they'll be heard. ### **What you'll do:** * **Get obsessed with the customer.** Talk to SMB owners, watch them work, mine the signal sitting in our millions of existing users — find the problem they actually have, not the one that's convenient for us. * **Validate it, then sharpen it.** You start with a promising idea, not an answer. Prove the need is real, then turn it into a specific customer, a specific problem and a wedge worth shipping. * **Run on hypotheses, not opinions.** Form a sharp hypothesis, design the test, read the result honestly even when it stings, move. * **Own whether it works.** Activation, time\-to\-value, engagement, retention — know these numbers cold and push them yourself. Did people get the outcome, and did they come back? That's your scoreboard. * **Turn mess into a thing worth building.** Insight is cheap; a sharp, buildable product decision is not. * **Build alongside your engineers, not above them.** Prototype with AI tools — v0, Cursor, Lovable, whatever's fastest — and fix your own interface instead of filing a ticket for it. * **Ship in days, not quarters.** Idea to something real in front of a user in about a week. Then do it again. * **Bring the energy that makes people want to build with you.** This is the job where "it's just a job" gets you replaced. ### **Who you are:** * \~3–5 years building software products and shipping V1s that real customers actually used — SMB experience is a strong plus. * Customer\-obsessed by instinct, not by training — you start from their problem, not our roadmap. * AI\-native. You use these tools every day, not just on slide decks, and you have sharp instincts for what they can and can't do yet. * You've run experiments that mattered — you can name the call you made, the test you ran, and what you learned when you were wrong. * Curious and genuinely unafraid to be wrong in public. Fast learners who chase the question outrun people who protect their ego. * A real nose for product. You can tell good from bad quickly, and say why. * Hands\-on by default. Given the choice between a rough prototyp rt of the interview, you're exactly who we're looking for.### **Why this and not somewhere else:** Startup speed and ownership, backed by a company with 100M\+ users, real infrastructure, and the resources to actually support what you build — plus direct access to leadership, because this hire is that important to us. You won't wait for permission. You'll build the thing, watch someone use it, and know within a week if you're onto something real.**What we offer** **Flexible working environment** \- Our teams operate across the globe. We value in‑person collaboration in our hubs, but we also embrace remote and hybrid working. You can work from one of our offices in the United States, Poland, Romania or Ukraine, or remotely from many countries. **Competitive compensation and stock options** \- We offer salaries that reflect local market conditions and experience, plus a performance\-based bonus system and stock options so you share in the company’s growth. **Professional growth and learning** \- We invest in your development through courses, conferences, and access to learning resources. We encourage career growth and internal mobility, supporting teammates who want to explore new opportunities within airSlate. **Health and well‑being** \- We provide comprehensive benefits tailored to each country, including health coverage, wellness programmes and access to fitness options. We also dedicate quarterly company\-wide Mental Health Days, when everyone takes time off to rest and recharge. **Family‑friendly culture** \- Family life is part of who we are, and we embrace it in many forms. From flexibility for parents to our airSlate Junior Club for kids, to company\-wide family days and our pet\-friendly approach, we’re committed to making work and life easier to balance. **Giving back** \- We support charitable initiatives around the world through the airSlate Care programme. Our current focus includes humanitarian aid in Ukraine and other regions, matching employee donations and supporting causes chosen by our teams. **Open communication** \- We encourage transparent dialogue at all levels. From team discussions to company\-wide Q\&A sessions with our CEO, we make sure everyone has the chance to be heard and to influence how we grow. *It is airSlate's policy to comply with all applicable equal employment opportunity laws by making all employment decisions without unlawful regard or consideration of any individual’s race, religion, ethnicity, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expressions, transgender status, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, marital status, age, national origin, genetic information, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, veteran or family status or any other basis protected by applicable national, federal, state, provincial or local law. airSlate's policy prohibits unlawful discrimination based on any of these impermissible bases, as well as any bases or grounds protected by applicable law in each jurisdiction. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. airSlate is pleased to provide such assistance and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request. Pursuant to relevant law, where applicable, airSlate will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* **Read our** **Recruitment Privacy Notice** **to Learn how we process your personal information.** We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

dynamics, controls theory, and control strategy development and testing. * Implementation experience with classical and modern controls methods and/or ML for Controls. * Strong embedded C (preferred) or C\+\+ programming skills. * Strong foundation in math (geometry, calculus, probability) and physics (kinematics, dynamics), and analytical skills. * Comfortable working with GenAI\-assisted engineering workflows (e.g. Claude Code, Gemini, Cursor). * Proven ability to collaborate within and across teams. * Deep knowledge in vehicle dynamics, controls theories, control strategy development and testing. * Effective oral and written communication skills. * Passionate about solving real\-world challenging autonomous driving problems. * Self\-starter with strong drive, accountability, and the ability to adapt quickly to new problems *At Nuro, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager, IT Service Management
jobs.description: Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. We are looking for a hands\-on Senior Technical Product Manager to own Oura's IT service management (ITSM) and employee service management (ESM) platforms. You will lead our move off a legacy ITSM tool to a modern, AI\-native platform, then bring service management to teams like HR, Finance, Legal, and Security on whichever platform or platforms fit them best. You will be fluent in ITSM theory, comfortable evaluating tools without bias, and willing to roll up your sleeves to configure, integrate, and ship. Above all, you will care about the people on the other side of every request and work to make getting help easy and seamless. ### **What You Will Do:** * Lead the migration from our legacy ITSM platform to a modern, AI\-native one, from data model, workflow, and catalog design through integrations, cutover, and decommission, with no loss in service levels or employee satisfaction * Be the voice of the employee. Design requests, catalog items, and knowledge from the worker's point of view so getting help is easy and frictionless, and use feedback and service data to keep removing friction * Own the platform as a product: a single roadmap and backlog, clear intake, and prioritization criteria that every service team can see and trust * Govern the service catalog and request fulfillment. Decide what gets added, changed, or retired, and move requests from manual work toward automated and identity\-governed fulfillment * Own the knowledge management function: the standards, structure, and governance that make knowledge accurate and findable for people and AI agents alike, while individual teams keep ownership of their own content * Define how AI agents operate in service management: which requests they resolve, which they route to a human, and the accuracy thresholds and guardrails behind each * Build a repeatable onboarding model for ESM so non\-IT service teams can adopt a consistent service experience, whichever platform fits them (intake, catalog, workflows, knowledge, reporting, access controls) * Keep the platform audit\-ready by designing change, incident, and access workflows that produce the evidence our SOX, SOC 2, and HIPAA controls require * Work hands\-on in the platform and with engineers on configuration, integrations, and automation, and direct vendor and partner work where needed This is a remote role based in the US. ### **What you'll bring** * 6\+ years in IT service management, service platform, or internal\-tools product roles * Led at least one end\-to\-end ITSM or ESM tool implementation or migration through go\-live * Strong grounding in ITSM concepts and practices (ITIL or equivalent), and the judgment to evaluate platforms on their merits rather than loyalty to one vendor * Hands\-on depth with a modern service management platform, including service catalog, workflow and SLA configuration, knowledge management, and reporting * Experience with an AI\-native ITSM platform (such as Atomicwork or Serval), or with Jira Service Management, Freshservice, or similar * Working knowledge of ServiceNow, including its data model, workflows, and administration, and how to get data and configuration back out of it * Experience designing access\-request and fulfillment workflows integrated with an identity provider or identity governance platform * Experience applying AI in a service desk: knowledge grounding, intent classification and routing, automated resolution, accuracy evaluation, guardrails, and human handoff * Technical depth to make and defend design calls with engineers: REST APIs, webhooks, SSO and SCIM, JSON data models, LLM and agent integrations (such as MCP and tool calling), and scripting in Python or JavaScript * A track record of running a platform as a product for multiple internal customer teams, including prioritizing across competing demand * Genuine empathy for the people you serve, with a record of simplifying service experiences and removing friction for employees * Clear written and verbal communication, including translating platform trade\-offs for service owners outside IT * Daily use of AI assistants, agents, and AI\-assisted build tools (such as Claude, Claude Code, or Cursor) to ship scripts, reports, and prototypes, with good judgment about when to verify output and when AI is the wrong tool ### **Nice to have:** * Experience with identity governance, including birthright and role\-based access models * CMDB or asset\-management data modeling, including device lifecycle integrations * Knowledge management program experience, including controlled vocabularies, taxonomy, and metadata standards; content governance and ongoing stewardship; and grounding AI agents in governed knowledge with source citation (retrieval\-augmented generation, or RAG, design beyond vendor defaults) * ESM experience with non\-IT teams such as HR, Facilities, or Legal, including handling sensitive employee data * SOX ITGC experience in a pre\-IPO or public company * Familiarity with iPaaS tools such as Workato * Experience supporting distributed teams across US and EMEA time zones * ITIL 4 certification ### **Benefits** At Ōura, we care about you and your well\-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health. What we offer: * Competitive salary and equity packages * Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources * An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends \& family * 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off * Paid sick leave and parental leave Ōura takes a market\-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. You're comfortable in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments and default to shipping over deliberating. **What does day\-to\-day look like:*** Design, refine, and iterate on rubrics and evaluation criteria for preference data * Review and label data with a high bar for quality, catching subtle issues others might miss * Build and maintain pipelines/infra that support data generation, collection, and evaluation workflows * Synthesize findings from data work into clear write\-ups, updates, or recommendations for the team * Collaborate closely with researchers/engineers to translate qualitative judgment into scalable processes **Required Skills:*** Proficiency in Python (especially building/maintaining pipelines and infra) or Typescript (experience contributing to or navigating large codebases like VSCode a plus) * Hands\-on experience with preference data collection and/or rubric creation * Strong written and verbal communication — able to distill technical work into clear, actionable summaries * Demonstrated high\-taste judgment — able to articulate why something is good, not just that it is. **Perks of Freelancing With Turing:*** Work in a fully remote environment. * Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. **Engagement Details:*** **Compensation:** Market rate. Please share a specific rate expectation (rather than a range) so we can quickly assess mutual fit * **Availability:** 40 hours/week preferred, with a minimum 6\-hour overlap with Pacific Time. If you're unable to commit to 40 hours, please share your available hours and overlap window * Employment Type: Independent contractor (does not include medical or paid leave benefits * **Duration:** 3 months, with an expected start date as soon as possible **Evaluation Process (approximately 30 mins):*** One round of interview (30 mins of technical \& cultural discussion)

jobs.title: Remote Software Engineer - Python/Typescript
jobs.description: ### **About Turing** Turing is one of the world’s leading AGI infrastructure companies, working with frontier AI labs to accelerate model development through high\-quality training data, evaluations, and engineering talent.### **About the Role** We’re looking for experienced, hands\-on software engineers to help **evaluate and improve AI coding models**. Rather than primarily building production applications, you’ll work with coding agents across real\-world repositories and assess the quality of their work. You’ll review generated code and agent behavior, determine whether solutions are technically correct, identify failure modes, and create the evaluation signals and feedback used to improve model performance. **Think of the coding agent as another engineer whose work you’re reviewing:** Can it understand the task? Did it choose the right approach? Is the resulting code correct, robust, and maintainable? Can you explain precisely where it succeeded or failed?### **What You’ll Do** * Evaluate AI\-generated code and solutions across real\-world software repositories * Review agent behavior, tool usage, and code changes for correctness and quality * Identify technical errors, weak approaches, and recurring model failure modes * Compare model outputs and explain why one solution is better than another * Create and refine rubrics and evaluation criteria for coding tasks * Produce high\-quality evaluation and preference data used to improve coding models * Build and maintain pipelines and infrastructure supporting data generation, collection, and evaluation workflows * Synthesize findings from data work into clear write\-ups, updates, and recommendations for the team * Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers to translate qualitative judgment into scalable processes * Share clear, actionable findings with AI researchers and engineers ### **What We’re Looking For** * **5\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience** * Strong proficiency in **Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or another major production language** * Experience working in substantial real\-world codebases * Strong code\-review skills and technical judgment * Ability to clearly explain why an implementation is correct, incorrect, or could be improved * Strong written communication * Experience using modern LLMs or AI coding tools Experience with **LLM evaluation, coding agents, RLHF, preference data, rubric design, or post\-training** is a plus, but not required.### **Engagement Details** * **Compensation:** Market rate; please provide a specific hourly rate expectation * **Availability:** 40 hours/week preferred, with at least 6 hours of Pacific Time overlap * **Type:** Independent contractor * **Duration:** Approximately 3 months * **Start:** As soon as possible * **Location:** North America, LATAM, or India ### **Evaluation Process** * AI interview (\~25 minutes) * Practical code/AI evaluation exercise (\~30 minutes) * Hiring manager interview (\~20 minutes) The practical exercise focuses on your ability to **review and evaluate AI\-generated code**, not competitive programming or algorithm puzzles.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager, IT Service Management
jobs.description: Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. We are looking for a hands\-on Senior Technical Product Manager to own Oura's IT service management (ITSM) and employee service management (ESM) platforms. You will lead our move off a legacy ITSM tool to a modern, AI\-native platform, then bring service management to teams like HR, Finance, Legal, and Security on whichever platform or platforms fit them best. You will be fluent in ITSM theory, comfortable evaluating tools without bias, and willing to roll up your sleeves to configure, integrate, and ship. Above all, you will care about the people on the other side of every request and work to make getting help easy and seamless. ### **What You Will Do:** * Lead the migration from our legacy ITSM platform to a modern, AI\-native one, from data model, workflow, and catalog design through integrations, cutover, and decommission, with no loss in service levels or employee satisfaction * Be the voice of the employee. Design requests, catalog items, and knowledge from the worker's point of view so getting help is easy and frictionless, and use feedback and service data to keep removing friction * Own the platform as a product: a single roadmap and backlog, clear intake, and prioritization criteria that every service team can see and trust * Govern the service catalog and request fulfillment. Decide what gets added, changed, or retired, and move requests from manual work toward automated and identity\-governed fulfillment * Own the knowledge management function: the standards, structure, and governance that make knowledge accurate and findable for people and AI agents alike, while individual teams keep ownership of their own content * Define how AI agents operate in service management: which requests they resolve, which they route to a human, and the accuracy thresholds and guardrails behind each * Build a repeatable onboarding model for ESM so non\-IT service teams can adopt a consistent service experience, whichever platform fits them (intake, catalog, workflows, knowledge, reporting, access controls) * Keep the platform audit\-ready by designing change, incident, and access workflows that produce the evidence our SOX, SOC 2, and HIPAA controls require * Work hands\-on in the platform and with engineers on configuration, integrations, and automation, and direct vendor and partner work where needed This is a remote role based in the US. ### **What you'll bring** * 6\+ years in IT service management, service platform, or internal\-tools product roles * Led at least one end\-to\-end ITSM or ESM tool implementation or migration through go\-live * Strong grounding in ITSM concepts and practices (ITIL or equivalent), and the judgment to evaluate platforms on their merits rather than loyalty to one vendor * Hands\-on depth with a modern service management platform, including service catalog, workflow and SLA configuration, knowledge management, and reporting * Experience with an AI\-native ITSM platform (such as Atomicwork or Serval), or with Jira Service Management, Freshservice, or similar * Working knowledge of ServiceNow, including its data model, workflows, and administration, and how to get data and configuration back out of it * Experience designing access\-request and fulfillment workflows integrated with an identity provider or identity governance platform * Experience applying AI in a service desk: knowledge grounding, intent classification and routing, automated resolution, accuracy evaluation, guardrails, and human handoff * Technical depth to make and defend design calls with engineers: REST APIs, webhooks, SSO and SCIM, JSON data models, LLM and agent integrations (such as MCP and tool calling), and scripting in Python or JavaScript * A track record of running a platform as a product for multiple internal customer teams, including prioritizing across competing demand * Genuine empathy for the people you serve, with a record of simplifying service experiences and removing friction for employees * Clear written and verbal communication, including translating platform trade\-offs for service owners outside IT * Daily use of AI assistants, agents, and AI\-assisted build tools (such as Claude, Claude Code, or Cursor) to ship scripts, reports, and prototypes, with good judgment about when to verify output and when AI is the wrong tool ### **Nice to have:** * Experience with identity governance, including birthright and role\-based access models * CMDB or asset\-management data modeling, including device lifecycle integrations * Knowledge management program experience, including controlled vocabularies, taxonomy, and metadata standards; content governance and ongoing stewardship; and grounding AI agents in governed knowledge with source citation (retrieval\-augmented generation, or RAG, design beyond vendor defaults) * ESM experience with non\-IT teams such as HR, Facilities, or Legal, including handling sensitive employee data * SOX ITGC experience in a pre\-IPO or public company * Familiarity with iPaaS tools such as Workato * Experience supporting distributed teams across US and EMEA time zones * ITIL 4 certification ### **Benefits** At Ōura, we care about you and your well\-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health. What we offer: * Competitive salary and equity packages * Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources * An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends \& family * 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off * Paid sick leave and parental leave Ōura takes a market\-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. Region 1 $143,000 \- $169,000 Region 2 $130,000 \- $153,000 Region 3 $117,000 \- $138,000 A recruiter can determine your Region based on your US location. We are not considering candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK), Delaware (DE), Iowa (IA), Mississippi (MS), Nebraska (NE), South Dakota (SD), West Virginia (WV), and Wisconsin (WI). Oura is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at Oura are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers! We've been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note: * Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards. * We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront. * Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email. Stay cautious and protect your personal details. To all recruitment agencies: Oura does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Oura employees, or any other organization's location. Oura is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
